Conclusion: USR可作为连接计算机视觉、自动驾驶、交通与城市计算研究的统一接口概念；但其价值目前仍停留在框架与协议层面，缺乏实例化系统与实证验证，属于综述/基准类工作。

Abstract: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at this https URL .

</details>


### [42] [SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28134)
*Matiur Rahman Minar,Seunghun Oh,Ganghyeon Jeong,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SceneTether：免训练的注意力读取策略，固定自回归视频生成器"读取的记忆位置"不变，仅将最相近时刻潜在键的低活动度值向源图像同位值混合，抑制长时程图像动画中的外观漂移，同时保留运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程图像动画需要背景/场景固定而水、烟、火等自然材质持续运动。自回归视频生成器依赖最近帧维持时序连续性，但历史帧携带累积的外观误差；直接稀疏化历史又会破坏运动连贯性，故需在"何处读取"与"读取到什么外观"之间解耦。

Method: 训练无关的注意力读取策略：(1) 保留最新潜帧的全部 key；(2) 由最先生成的潜帧估计活动度图并冻结，用于判定低/高活动区域；(3) 对低活动度区域的 value 向源图像同位像素对应的 value 做混合锚定，高活动度 value 保持不动以允许运动演化；(4) 不增加去噪评估次数，不改动 cache 更新规则。基线为 Causal Forcing++ 与 Echo 系列。

Result: 在 Causal Forcing++ 上，跨两个随机种子，源支撑区 PSNR 较逐帧 Echo 宿主提升 5.15 dB（后期活动度为 1.5 倍）；在预选的四分钟子集上较 spatial Echo-Forcing 提升 7.31 dB。等量的近期记忆覆盖率下，仅做 value 锚定即可带来 8.14 dB 提升。事后像素合成（同一活动图）静态保真度相当，但运动区域颜色漂移约为其两倍；小规模盲测中被试更偏好 SceneTether 的场景与运动自然性。

Conclusion: 将注意力"读取位置"与"读取外观"解耦是一种零额外推理成本、可即插即用的长视频外观稳定方案；value 锚定本身即为主效应来源，优于事后像素级合成。局限在于需源图像同位对齐假设与一次性活动图估计，缺少与更强记忆压缩/长上下文方案的联合评估。

Abstract: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [43] [Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28135)
*Xiangkui Cao,Jie Zhang,Meina Kan,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VIPE 通过构造隐私敏感/隐私遮蔽图像对，用内部特征残差定位隐私相关视觉表征并在其进入模型感知前加以抑制，从而从表征源头阻断 VLM 的图像隐私泄露，而非仅改变输出分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对性微调与模型编辑方法通过向"安全回复"对齐来压制敏感答案，实测表明这种保护是"表面"的：正常解码下模型拒绝披露隐私，但在句子补全场景仍会泄露。这说明模型仍保留对隐私信息的感知能力，隐私信息依旧存在于模型内部。因此需要从视觉表征层面削弱感知能力，而非只改输出分布。

Method: 提出 VIPE（Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure）：1) 构建成对的隐私敏感图像与隐私遮蔽图像，利用二者内部特征残差识别隐私相关的视觉成分；2) 在这些成分被模型感知之前进行抑制式擦除；3) 为保留良性视觉表征，将擦除目标中的特征差异投影到松弛的良性子空间，并自适应控制擦除强度。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA-OneVision 上的实验显示，VIPE 显著缓解前缀触发（prefix-triggered）的隐私泄露，同时在通用视觉-语言基准上保持有竞争力的效用。

Conclusion: VLM 的隐私保护不能停留在输出分布对齐层面，需在视觉表征空间消除敏感信息提取路径；VIPE 提供了"从源头阻断"的表征级擦除方案，并揭示了现有防御的虚假安全性。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE constructs paired privacy-sensitive and privacy-masked images, uses their internal feature residuals to identify privacy-related visual components, and suppresses these components before they are perceived by the model. To preserve benign visual representations, the erasure objective projects feature differences onto a relaxed benign subspace and adaptively controls the erasure strength. VIPE compels the model to ignore the extraction of sensitive information in the visual representation space, thereby blocking the source of privacy leakage more fundamentally rather than merely altering the model's output distribution. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision show that VIPE substantially alleviates prefix-triggered privacy leakage while maintaining competitive utility on general visual-language benchmarks.

</details>


### [44] [ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28136)
*Chenhao Wu,Zhaolong Su,Yang Liu,Tianrui Su,Yingguang Yang,Shang Luo,Yancheng Chen,Chongyang Zhang,Hao Zheng,Kefu Xu,Congjing Ran,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ENGRAM：面向相机条件视频世界模型的潜在空间记忆框架，用可靠性加权递归融合与遮挡感知分层读出替代集合合并与最前表面读出，降低训练依赖并显著提升新视角与闭环生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有相机条件视频世界模型依赖潜在空间记忆，但集合合并式更新使重复观测无法整合，且仅读出最前表面限制了同一目标单元处多深度证据的同时访问，导致3D一致性与长程生成质量受限。

Abstract: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. Abstract: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Conditional image enhancement requires spatially varying corrections, yet fixed-depth models allocate similar computational budgets regardless of where additional refinement is needed. Although one-step flow models reduce inference costs and iterative restoration methods introduce subsequent corrections, how predicted transformation dynamics can guide internal feature refinement remains underexplored. We introduce IRCMF, a dynamics-guided Conditional MeanFlow framework that combines regional interaction with recurrent internal revision. The decoder predicts signed interval velocity and a learned velocity-change cue. A soft-region graph aggregates contextual information for velocity estimation, while a dynamics-conditioned graph establishes regional relationships to guide recurrent bottleneck updates. The revised features are processed by the shared decoder to recompute velocity, establishing feedback between transformation dynamics and internal representations. An actor-critic policy controls regional updates and further revisions to balance enhancement quality and computational cost. We evaluate IRCMF on two computed tomography (CT) datasets, NLST for STANDARD-to-LUNG kernel enhancement and LDCT-and-Projection-data for simulated low-to-routine-dose enhancement. With nine decoder evaluations, IRCMF achieves slice-level PSNR of $36.24 \pm 3.49$ dB and SSIM of $0.97 \pm 0.01$ on NLST, and PSNR of $32.45 \pm 1.97$ dB and SSIM of $0.84 \pm 0.05$ on LDCT-and-Projection-data. The learned policy reduces average decoder evaluations to 4.42 and 3.45, respectively, lowering per-slice latency from 97.00 to 51.82 ms and from 97.12 to 41.95 ms, with PSNR reductions of only 0.20 and 0.06 dB.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 保真度指标无法代表下游可检索性，面积加权的像素损失是可检索性差距的一个可追溯来源；以冻结VLM概念集合为闭环的集合级损失能有效弥合该差距，并具备良好的跨传感器与跨生成器可迁移性。

Abstract: A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share independent of its area. Measured outside the loop by label-grounded probes, held-out retrievers, language-free evaluators, detectors and human raters, LEDGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in fidelity on four sensors, raises retrieval by seven to nine points within its vocabulary and two to five outside it, closes two thirds of the reduced-resolution gap to the reference, lifts extraction on raw SpaceNet imagery above the vendor product in each of four cities, and transfers to existing generators as a training-only loss at no inference cost.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

Abstract: In NAVSIMv1, the standard benchmark for end-to-end driving, $89.6\%$ of the test scenes lie within 4m of a training scene. We show that this geographic overlap inflates the reported scores. All sensor-based models we test, DiffusionDrive, Latent TransFuser, and DrivoR, lose 3.4 to 6.1 PDMS points on these scenes, mainly by leaving the road and coming close to other objects, against 1.5 points for a baseline without sensors. The loss concentrates where a training drive of the original split passed the same place. At all other places, models trained on the original split are no better than those trained on the geographic split. Models trained on the original split predict road geometry that no camera can see. The gap persists when the auxiliary map loss is removed, so the models memorize locations even without being supervised to. *Baizhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BReD：仅用六相机的前馈式路面高程/外观/语义重建框架，通过LiDAR监督学习粗高程+BEV重投影，再用轻量BEV残差扩散模型以“深度-高程差异”为条件做单步确定性细化，最后时间聚合锚定路面对齐高斯并免测试时优化，nuScenes四场景高程RMSE 7.34cm、语义mIoU 90.92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路面精确重建对自动驾驶建图与仿真至关重要，但现有方法在质量与跨场景推理间取舍：优化类方法需逐场景昂贵优化才能得到细节，前馈类方法缺少道路特定约束、高程误差大。

Method: 六相机标定序列输入；先经LiDAR监督的深度学习与BEV lifting得到粗高程（推理时仅用相机）；再用轻量BEV残差扩散模型，以相机导出的深度-高程差异及高程感知图像特征为条件细化高程，训练时以扩散索引扰动模拟不同差异损坏等级，推理时从“干净”差异出发做一次确定性细化；细化后的高程做时间聚合以锚定路面对齐高斯，其属性由几何先验引导解码器直接预测，无需测试时优化。

Result: 在nuScenes四个留出场景上达到7.34cm高程RMSE与90.92%语义mIoU；对比RoGS无测试时LiDAR为14.43cm、其带测试时LiDAR辅助变体为8.88cm，且两者均需逐场景优化。

Conclusion: 以“粗高程+扩散残差细化+高斯稠密化”的纯前馈流水线，在不使用测试时LiDAR与逐场景优化的情况下显著优于需优化的基线，体现了路面专用先验与推理效率的兼顾。

Abstract: Accurate road surface reconstruction is essential for autonomous-driving mapping and simulation, but existing methods trade reconstruction quality for cross-scene inference. Optimization-based methods recover detailed surfaces through costly per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods lack road-specific constraints and often produce large elevation errors. We propose \textbf{BReD}, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing road elevation, appearance, and semantics from calibrated six-camera sequences. BReD first estimates coarse elevation through LiDAR-supervised depth learning and BEV lifting, using only cameras at inference. A lightweight BEV residual diffusion model then conditions elevation refinement on a camera-derived depth--elevation discrepancy and elevation-aware image features. Diffusion-indexed perturbations expose the model to different discrepancy corruption levels during training, while inference performs one deterministic refinement from the clean discrepancy. The refined elevations are temporally aggregated to anchor road-aligned Gaussians, whose attributes are predicted by a geometry-prior-guided decoder without test-time optimization. On four held-out nuScenes scenes, BReD achieves 7.34 cm elevation RMSE and 90.92\% semantic mIoU, compared with 14.43 cm for RoGS without test-time LiDAR and 8.88 cm for its test-time-LiDAR-assisted variant; both RoGS variants require per-scene optimization.

</details>


### [52] [FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28193)
*Meng Bi,Yili Jin,Kaiyuan Hu,Xize Duan,Jiaxin Huang,Hong Huang,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FastD4RT：免训练加速 query-based 4D 重建，利用时序/空间平滑性只在稀疏锚点编码解码并插值恢复，并复用每段共享 token 集，平均提速约 5 倍，长视频精度还提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: D4RT 类模型虽将编码与解码解耦，但稠密输出需对每帧每像素各做一次 decoder query，长视频还被切分为大量重叠段，推理开销大；作者分析发现后期 decoder block 仅关注一小组被所有 query 共享的 token，存在显著冗余。

Method: 免训练框架：(1) 利用输出在时间与空间上的平滑性，仅在稀疏锚点上编码/解码，其余输出通过插值恢复；(2) 每个 segment 只选一次共享 token 集，所有剩余 query 复用之；(3) 对两部分引入的误差进行理论刻画。

Result: 在所有任务上平均约 5× 加速且精度有竞争力，长视频上精度进一步优于原模型；代码开源。

Conclusion: 稠密解码与重叠分段是 D4RT 推理的主要冗余，稀疏锚点+共享 token 可在不训练的前提下大幅提速，并为 4D 重建的实时化提供可行路径。

Abstract: Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. It decodes the remaining queries against a shared token set selected once per segment. We further characterize the errors introduced by both components. Experimental results show that FastD4RT accelerates D4RT by about 5 times on average across all its tasks with competitive accuracy, and further improves accuracy on long videos. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [53] [Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28221)
*Wentao Zhang,Ian Miao,Chen Qu,Bill Bi,Donna Schut,Yuntian Deng,Yale Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VaW将视频一次性"编译"成冻结解释器VLM的LoRA权重与少量前缀token，实现同模型压缩与强到弱跨规模知识迁移，大幅降低视觉token与KV缓存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频VLM需数千视觉token、KV缓存随长度膨胀；小模型算力受限但理解力弱，现有token压缩无法弥补固定权重带来的能力鸿沟。

Method: 编译器VLM观看视频，单个权重解码器从每个编译器层联合生成解释器的LoRA权重与可选前缀token；解释器权重冻结，支持同模型编译及跨尺寸/跨深度强弱迁移。

Result: 六个视频QA基准上，0.8B解释器自编译超全上下文1.7分、9B编译器迁移超4.3分；上下文8192 token降至64前缀token，内存比KV缓存省5.5倍；权重额外带来3.9分，全层解码优于逐层2.9分；机制分析显示权重主要调整注意力query与MLP down投影，无token时转向attention输出投影。

Conclusion: 参数化记忆可作为视觉token压缩的强补充，且具备跨模型规模的知识迁移性，为高效视频理解提供新范式。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap. To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths. Across six video QA benchmarks, a 0.8B interpreter beats full in-context reading by 1.7 points when compiled by itself and by 4.3 points with a 9B compiler, reducing context from up to 8,192 visual tokens to 64 prefix tokens while using 5.5x less memory than the video's key-value cache. Generated weights add 3.9 points over token compression alone, and all-layer decoding outperforms layer-wise generation by 2.9 points. Mechanistic analysis shows that with prefix tokens, the weights mainly alter attention queries and MLP down projections to guide retrieval and store a baseline summary, whereas without tokens, they shift to attention output projections to write video content directly into the residual stream.

</details>


### [54] [A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28240)
*Lemar Abdi,Amaan Valiuddin,Fida Mohammad Thoker,Karen Sanchez,Bernard Ghanem,Fons van der Sommen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STRIDE：一种后处理时序读出模块，通过多窗口特征/逻辑值平均+岭回归闭式解，为任意已训练的手术三元组识别器注入时序上下文，显著提升AP_IVT并降低误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术三元组识别（器械-动作-解剖目标）需处理多三元组并发、组件时长差异大、单帧证据不完整等问题；现有识别器缺乏时序建模且不易改造。

Method: 提出STRIDE后处理模块：对识别器的特征与logits在若干固定时间窗上做平均，再与当前帧特征通过岭回归（CPU闭式解）融合；并给出"适配的基础视觉编码器+线性分类器+STRIDE"的简洁基线流程。

Result: 在9种现有方法的27组方法-数据集配对中24组提升AP_IVT，最高+7.4；在13种编码器的39组配对中37组提升，最高+7.2；误报降低41%，代价是交互边界处响应变慢。

Conclusion: 轻量、即插即用的时序读出可有效增强手术场景理解，通用性强、成本极低；但仅限医学手术领域，非核心具身/3D/VLA方向。

Abstract: Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [55] [DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28265)
*Zeeshan Khan,Xin Yu,Shizhe Chen,Cordelia Schmid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeFlowCritic：面向文生图流匹配模型的在线强化学习框架，用扩散模型内部特征构建 critic，在中间噪声潜变量上提供密集奖励监督，兼顾提示词对齐与视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线 RL 对齐文生图流匹配模型仅依赖最终解码图像的稀疏奖励，导致去噪轨迹上的信用分配延迟、训练昂贵；且多奖励简单加权难以获得帕累托权衡（构图准确性提升常损害美学质量）。

Method: 提出 Dense Latent Reward Alignment：在去噪轨迹的中间潜变量上施加密集监督，实现早期引导；引入内部 critic，直接复用扩散模型提取的特征评估含噪潜变量（比标准图像编码器更适配潜空间奖励估计）；构建带连续分数的高质量奖励建模数据集训练 critic，密集奖励同时支持高效在线 RL 训练与推理时扩展（test-time scaling）。

Result: 在 GenEval2 与 T2I-CompBench++ 上于提示忠实度与视觉质量之间取得更优平衡；可泛化至 SD3.5-Medium、SD3.5-Large 与 FLUX.1-dev 等流匹配模型。

Conclusion: 将奖励从图像空间前移至潜空间密集监督是提升文生图 RL 对齐效率与多目标平衡的有效路径，并具备跨模型泛化与推理时扩展价值。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning text-to-image flow matching models with complex user intent. However, existing methods typically rely on sparse rewards computed only from final decoded images. This delays credit assignment across the denoising trajectory and makes training computationally expensive. Moreover, simply combining multiple rewards does not reliably produce a Pareto trade-off, where gains in compositional accuracy often degrade aesthetic quality. In this work, we propose DeFlowCritic, an efficient online RL framework based on Dense Latent Reward Alignment. Unlike prior work, our method provides dense supervision on intermediate latents, enabling early-stage guidance for the denoising trajectory. To achieve this, we introduce an internal critic that evaluates noisy latents using features extracted directly from the diffusion model, a representation inherently better suited for latent-space reward estimation than standard image encoders. We construct a high-quality reward-modeling dataset with continuous scores for critic training, capturing compositional correctness on high-quality reference images. The resulting dense reward enables efficient online RL training and inference-time scaling. Experiments show that our method achieves a superior balance between prompt faithfulness and visual quality on GenEval2 and T2I-CompBench++ benchmarks. The approach also generalizes across text-to-image flow matching models, including SD3.5-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and FLUX.1-dev.

</details>


### [56] [eSPG: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Event Speckle Plethysmography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28275)
*Aniket Dashpute,Anirudh Bindiganavale Harish,Bhargav Ghanekar,Alankar Kotwal,Andrew Negrut,Syna Gupta,Pablo A. Valdes,Ashok Veeraraghavan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用低功率激光照射身体部位并以事件相机捕捉动态散斑，提出事件散斑体积描记术(eSPG)，在1 km距离实现心率估计(MAE 5 bpm)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非接触心率测量对监护与救援有价值，但现有方法受环境光照与运动干扰，且仅在数十米量级被验证，缺乏远距离鲁棒方案。

Method: 0.5–5 mW激光产生皮肤动态散斑，事件相机凭借高动态范围、高时间分辨率与对强度变化的敏感性捕获快速散斑起伏；对事件流做理论建模与信号处理以提取脉动信号，并分析运动与环境光照的鲁棒性。

Result: 1 km处心率估计MAE为5 bpm，90%估计满足AAMI标准；距离较此前远程体积描记术提升一个数量级，较散斑体积描记术提升三个数量级以上，并给出运动与光照鲁棒性表征。

Conclusion: 分辨动态散斑起伏可在公里级距离实现准确心率估计，为鲁棒非接触生理监测开辟新方向。

Abstract: Non-contact measurement of vital signs such as heart rate (HR) is valuable for patient monitoring and rescue operations. However, existing methods struggle with ambient illumination and motion, and have been demonstrated only at distances of tens of meters. Here we introduce event speckle plethysmography (eSPG), which illuminates a body part with a low-power (0.5-5 mW) laser and captures the resulting dynamic speckle pattern using an event camera. Event cameras, with their high dynamic range, temporal resolution, and sensitivity to intensity changes, are well-suited to capturing rapid speckle fluctuations that encode the physiological signal, even under challenging illumination and imaging conditions. We demonstrate HR estimation at 1 km with a mean absolute error of 5 beats per minute, and 90% of estimates satisfy an AAMI-defined HR estimation criterion. This distance exceeds previous remote plethysmography demonstrations by an order of magnitude and previous speckle plethysmography demonstrations by over three orders of magnitude. We also study and characterize robustness to motion and ambient illumination. Our theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate that resolving dynamic speckle fluctuations enables accurate heart rate estimation even at kilometer-scale distances, establishing a new direction toward robust, non-contact physiological monitoring.

</details>


### [57] [Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28281)
*Renjie Liang,Mengxian Lyu,Zijian Xu,Boxin Zhao,Yang Yang,Jinqian Pan,Zhengkang Fan,Mei Liu,Yonghui Wu,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行规则库形式的修订策略，利用独立分类器预测与定量图像测量指导局部编辑而不重训报告模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型可从3D胸部CT生成流畅报告，但仍会遗漏异常或误述发现；引入独立图像分析虽有补充价值，但不确定证据可能引入新错误，需受控地使用证据。

Method: 智能体在开发集上通过修订结果提出并精炼规则，形成规则库；推理时依规则做局部编辑，未编辑句子保留，每处改动可溯源到触发规则。

Result: CT-RATE上CE-F1对SelfCue-KD提升11.5点、NV-Reason-CT提升0.9点，五个采样种子均有增益；CT-FineBench提升15.2点；仅用草稿学规则收益有限，两类图像证据互补。

Conclusion: 支持学习模型特定规则以控制独立图像证据如何影响报告修订。

Abstract: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [58] [HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28283)
*Yuxi Long,Ganlin Feng,Lianghong Chen,Liam J. O'Neil,Carol A. Hitchon,Pingzhao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HandXFM：通过多专家蒸馏（BiomedCLIP 语义先验 + 胸片 ViT 结构先验）构建手部X线专用基础模型，统一支持骨龄、SvH评分、异常检测、关节定位、骨分割与VQA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部X线涉及骨龄评估、类风湿评分、异常筛查、解剖定位等多任务，但现有模型按任务/数据集分别训练，缺乏跨任务共享的通用医学先验，且可解释性与跨数据集泛化不足。

Method: 提出 HandXFM：以统一对齐框架同时蒸馏两类专家知识——BiomedCLIP 提供语义先验（临床术语-图像对齐），胸片 ViT 提供结构先验（解剖结构表征）；预训练后在六类肌骨任务上做轻量适配（骨龄回归、SvH 评分、异常分类、关节定位、骨分割、VQA）。

Result: 一致优于任务专用与单专家基线；骨龄预测 PCC 提升最高 0.11，异常分类准确率提升 12%；在未见数据集上具备泛化能力，并可输出将临床术语映射到解剖区域的 cross-attention 图。

Conclusion: 多专家蒸馏可在单一预训练模型中融合语义与结构监督，使 HandXFM 成为可解释、可泛化的手部影像基础模型；该范式对其他单模态医学基础模型构建具参考价值。

Abstract: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) for bone age prediction and a 12\% accuracy gain in abnormality classification. Moreover, HandXFM generalizes to unseen datasets and yields cross-attention maps linking clinical terms to anatomical regions. These results demonstrate that multi-expert distillation effectively unifies semantic and structural supervision within a single pretrained model, establishing HandXFM as an interpretable and generalizable foundation model for hand radiograph analysis.

</details>


### [59] [When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28287)
*Charles Weng,Zixi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频验证器（video verifier）的评测分数高度依赖两个测试设定：负样本类型（端态匹配 vs. 拒绝事件）与判断接口（直接读分数 vs. 先写推理），这种依赖强到足以反转"模型能力结论"和"去部署哪个验证器"的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频验证器评测用单一标量分数排名模型与验证器，但该分数可能反映的是测试构造（负样本类型、接口形式）而非模型/验证器真实能力，导致误判"模型能做什么"以及选错验证器部署。

Method: 用具备精确真值条件的受控构造分离两个变量：(1) endpoint-matched negatives（起止端点一致、仅内部状态错误的负样本）；(2) truth-switch test（同一对候选在两个视频间交换正确性）。对比"直接判断"（从答案分数读判定）与"先写推理再作答"两种接口；再用分阶段输入定位失败步骤；最后在人工校验的自然视频上做跨模型统一协议验证，并比较不同负样本类型下选出的验证器在下游 rerank 中的表现。

Result: 直接判断下，能识别"明显错误起点"的模型在端态匹配负样本上接近随机；帧级信息显式给出事件时，先写推理使4个模型中3个在 truth-switch 测试上从<10%提升到70–100%；分阶段输入显示失败集中于"把事件合成为状态"这一步。但在需先定位事件的真实自然视频上，该改动无显著增益，且当候选否认事件发生时可能降低准确率。事件拒绝型负样本选出的验证器，在"保留事件、改动细节"负样本上低 8.9 个点，rerank 时只能恢复约一半准确率增益。

Conclusion: 验证器应在它实际会遇到的错误分布上评测；低直接分数或"推理带来增益"都不能视为模型本身的属性，而是测试构造的产物。

Abstract: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs. The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.

</details>


### [60] [Task-Agnostic Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection via Prompt Augmentation and Distribution-Aware Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28291)
*Yonghan Jiang,Zhengyuan Xie,Wenchu Liu,Linlan Huang,Fei Yang,Xialei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无任务标识的增量视觉-语言目标检测设定TA-IVLOD，并用随机提示增强+测试时分布感知融合的模块化框架TADA解决跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有增量视觉-语言目标检测（IVLOD）方法在推理时依赖oracle任务身份，脱离开放世界实用场景；去掉该先验后，跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突导致性能大幅下降。

Method: 形式化TA-IVLOD设定；模块化框架TADA：训练期噪声注入的Stochastic Prompt Augmentation缓解语义干扰；Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion在测试时动态加权类特定LoRA专家以化解参数冲突。

Result: 在ODinW-13上标准IVLOD显著优于基线，严格的TA-IVLOD设定下提升明显；MS COCO上保持零样本泛化能力；代码开源。

Conclusion: 面向开放词汇检测器的持续学习可在无任务先验下工作，提示增强与专家融合是有效手段，但验证集中于检测基准，未涉及具身或三维任务。

Abstract: Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection (IVLOD) empowers pre-trained open-vocabulary detectors to continuously learn new visual concepts from sequential tasks without forgetting foundational knowledge. However, existing methods predominantly rely on oracle task identities during inference, severely limiting their open-world practicality. In this paper, we formalize Task-Agnostic IVLOD (TA-IVLOD), a more realistic setting where such priors are unavailable, requiring the model to simultaneously recognize classes from all learned tasks. This unconstrained setting exposes severe performance degradation due to cross-task semantic interference and parameter conflicts. To tackle these challenges, we propose TADA, a novel modular framework. Specifically, TADA introduces Stochastic Prompt Augmentation to mitigate semantic interference via training-time noise injection, and Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion to dynamically weight class-specific LoRA experts, effectively resolving parameter conflicts. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in standard IVLOD and yields substantial improvements in the rigorous TA-IVLOD setting on the ODinW-13 benchmark, while effectively preserving zero-shot generalization on the MS COCO dataset. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [61] [Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28321)
*Amani Aifi,Wassim Bouachir,Ahmed Zgaren,Nizar Bouguila*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态、类别无关的密度估计目标计数框架：用单次点击经冻结视觉提示分割模型扩展为精确物体掩码，作为视觉范例，并在迭代原型细化每一步融合文本描述，实现文本+视觉联合提示的点击式计数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计数方法分为两类：融合框+文本的双模态方法与仅用框范例或仅用文本的单模态方法；部分新方法用点击替代框，但缺少精准掩码与多模态在细化过程中的持续融合，因此希望去除边界框依赖并提升计数精度。

Method: 1) 点击驱动的范例提取模块：将单次点击输入冻结的视觉提示分割模型，得到精确物体掩码作为视觉范例，替代手绘边界框；2) 逐步文本融合机制：在迭代原型细化的每个步骤都将文本描述与视觉提示融合，形成统一的多模态类别无关密度计数流程。

Result: 结合文本引导后达到SOTA计数精度；在所有指标上优于先前的点击式计数方法，并在平均绝对误差（MAE）上超过框范例基线架构。

Conclusion: 点击+掩码范例与逐步文本融合可在无需边界框的情况下实现高精度多模态目标计数，为交互更轻量的类别无关计数提供可行范式。

Abstract: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at this http URL .

</details>


### [62] [GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28332)
*Ahammed Sakir Nabil,Sadia Siraz,Nikita Chincholkar,Atalie C. Thompson,Jason Xiao,Theodore Leng,Jennifer I. Lim,Minhaj Nur Alam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GlaucomaMarker框架，将公开分割掩码转换为描述11种视网膜生物标志物的文本句子，用这些图像-文本对训练视觉-语言模型，使模型能"读出"青光眼结构标志物并提升诊断性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青光眼诊断依赖视盘凹陷与不对称性等结构标志物，但现有视觉-语言模型多基于固定模板或AI生成caption训练，缺少公开描述这些标志物的文本，导致模型无法真正理解结构证据。

Method: 利用公开分割掩码自动生成描述11类生物标志物的句子，构建图像-文本对齐监督；在RETFound（GlaucomaMarker-R）与FLAIR（GlaucomaMarker-F）两个视网膜基础模型上微调，数据规模9,778张图像、45,190个图像-文本对；在真实临床队列上评估青光眼分类与标志物读取能力。

Result: 真实临床队列上GlaucomaMarker-F达到AUROC 0.905，显著优于FLAIR的0.848；两个模型均能正确读取生物标志物，而基线模型接近随机水平；标志物文本由已有掩码计算获得，无额外标注成本。

Conclusion: 基于结构生物标志物文本的视觉-语言接地是提升青光眼诊断VLM可解释性与性能的有效、低成本方案。

Abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

</details>


### [63] [Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28336)
*Charles Weng,Alexander Martin,Sandra Arcos-Holzinger,Andrew Yates,Dixin Zheng,Yue Zhang,Landi Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过"硬负例重配"实验证明CKA与邻域一致性等跨模态对齐诊断指标对配对错误不敏感：它们在多邻居上池化，却常被误用于判断单对图文匹配与模型选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CKA与邻域一致性(neighborhood agreement)原本衡量两个模态的整体表征收敛，但匹配检索与模型选择流程把它们当作"能识别单个图文对"的证据；作者要检验这一误用是否成立。

Method: 提出 hard negative re-pairing：为每张图换成相似图片的caption，其余不变；在22个图文模型上比较CKA、邻域一致性与top-1检索的变化，并给出CKA的精确分解以分析近邻对贡献；再用CKA精确最大化求解检验是否返回原配对，并在COCO/Flickr30k上比较诊断值选模与验证集recall选模的泛化。

Result: 即使无一对保持原caption且多数替换caption被判错，CKA仍高于保留80%原配对的随机重配；所有22个模型中邻域一致性下降甚微而top-1检索崩溃。分解显示近邻对几乎不贡献CKA，精确CKA最大化不返回原配对；最高诊断值模型在留出数据上检索弱于验证recall选出的模型。被重配"移除"的信息量本身与检索性能相关，可排序编码器对。

Conclusion: 诊断指标必须同时报告其回答的问题与尺度，并以硬负例重配作为必需检验；整体对齐结构度量不能替代实例级匹配评估与模型选择。

Abstract: Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

</details>


### [64] [Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28350)
*Yihao Wu,Runjia Zeng,Tongyan Wang,Renzhong Huang,Chongzhou Fang,Qifan Wang,Fan Heng,Dongfang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Fork-JEPA 通过在同一恢复状态下执行两条动作的"分叉未来"（fork futures），利用结果差分抵消状态项，从而在行为数据仅覆盖单一动作时仍可辨识动作响应，并在三个视觉控制任务上将规划成功率较 LeWM 提升至多 14%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA 世界模型用日志转移训练，却要在同一状态下比较反事实动作；日志数据在每个状态只出现一个动作，导致在策略从未变动的方向上动作响应不可辨识（作者在局部线性近似下给出证明）。

Method: 用同状态恢复后执行两条不同动作的实测结果作为补充数据（fork futures），其差分消去状态项，在采样张成的空间上辨识动作响应；由此构建 Fork-JEPA，训练目标包含预测差值与实测差值对齐、用行为预测锚定日志后继状态、以及保持前驱可恢复的 lookback head，全部在训练期完成，不改变规划流程。

Result: 在三个视觉控制任务上，纯行为训练的预测动作效应不优于常数猜测；Fork-JEPA 使其可读，规划成功率较基座 LeWM 提升最多 14%，在动作响应随隐藏区域变化处跨区域成功率近乎翻倍；1024 对 fork 样本优于额外 1.2M 行为步。

Conclusion: 反事实动作辨识的关键瓶颈在数据（动作覆盖）而非模型容量，少量同状态多动作的差分监督即可显著改善世界模型的可规划性。

Abstract: JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [65] [TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28397)
*Yixuan Luo,Jose Caballero,Yanjing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TOGO：利用共享潜空间的图像编辑器与视频生成器，在采样时通过"编辑速度"引导实现零训练的视频编辑，并提出噪声/空间/时间约束的引导算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频编辑器依赖大量编辑对训练，指令遵循能力弱于图像编辑器；作者观察到部分图像编辑器与视频生成器共享同一潜空间，因此希望把图像编辑能力免训练迁移到视频。

Method: 定义"编辑速度"= 图像编辑器在指令下与中性提示下的速度场之差；分析其特性（仅粗尺度与高噪声下可靠、不集中于编辑对象、帧间不相关）；据此设计引导算子，对编辑速度进行放大并在噪声层级、空间、时间维度上加以约束；在推理阶段将 Qwen-Image-Edit 接入 Wan2.1 采样器。

Result: FiVE-Bench 上编辑成功率由 47.0%（无编辑器的同视频模型）提升至 65.6%，超过已发表最佳方法 59.2%；背景 PSNR 保持，LPIPS 与 SSIM 均为最优。

Conclusion: 视频编辑能力可在推理时"组装"，无需训练或微调；可随共享潜空间的更新图像编辑器零成本升级。

Abstract: Instruction-based image editors are trained on millions of edit pairs and follow instructions far more reliably than current video editors. We show that this ability can be transferred to video editing without any training. Our key observation is that a growing number of image editors and video generators share the same latent space. Their velocity fields can therefore be combined at sampling time: the difference between the editor's velocity under the instruction and under a neutral prompt, which we call the \emph{edit velocity}, can be added to the sampler of a video model. Added naively, however, it blurs the video, alters the background and flickers. An analysis of the edit velocity explains why. It is small and reliable only at coarse scales and high noise levels, not concentrated on the edited object, and uncorrelated across frames. From these properties, we derive a simple guidance operator that amplifies the edit velocity and restricts it in noise level, space, and time. The video model then turns the incoherent per-frame signal into a temporally coherent edit. Our method, TOGO, combines Qwen-Image-Edit with the Wan2.1 video model without training or fine-tuning. On FiVE-Bench, it raises the edit success rate from 47.0\% (the same video model without the editor) to 65.6\%, above the best published method (59.2\%). At the same time, it maintains the background PSNR and obtains the best LPIPS and SSIM of all methods. Because the video editor is assembled at inference time, it can be upgraded to any newer image editor that shares the latent space with no cost.

</details>


### [66] [Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28402)
*Yixuan Luo,Yanjing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BigSmall：将14B AR视频扩散模型仅用于规划首个chunk及内容变化chunk，1.3B模型负责渲染其余部分，训练免费，配跨模型近似/窗口/惰性KV cache，实现3.02×加速且语义与运动不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散逐chunk流式生成，但大模型推理过慢难以实时；作者追问AR rollout中究竟哪一步真正需要大模型。

Method: 共享latent空间与去噪调度的Krea-Realtime-14B与Self-Forcing-1.3B配对；14B生成首chunk并对内容变化chunk做草图，1.3B渲染其余chunk；设计近似、窗口化、惰性跨模型KV cache使大模型低成本进出rollout。

Result: 14B仅做首chunk时保留95%语义优势，反向分配仅16%且成本约10倍；VBench上3.02×加速且语义/运动不变，比SDVG快1.55×；BigSmall^f达3.77×、运动损失10%；LoCoT2V-Bench分钟级视频3.14×加速且+1.78分。

Conclusion: 大模型决定"生成什么"，小模型负责"延续下去"；训练免费的规划器—渲染器级联与跨模型KV cache可高效复用大模型语义先验。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

</details>


### [67] [Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28419)
*Mohammad Mahdi Abootorabi,Parvin Mousavi,Purang Abolmaesumi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 面向多中心前列腺癌WISI分级，提出"中心感知序数学习"框架：预训练病理编码器+ABMIL，联合EMD序数损失、序数监督对比损失与课程学习，显著提升跨中心线性探针迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISUP分级本身有序，且存在类别不平衡（良性样本主导）与跨中心染色/制片/扫描域偏移；多数弱监督MIL把分级当作独立类别，学到跨机构不易迁移的表示。

Method: 冻结/预训练病理基础编码器 + 注意力多示例学习（ABMIL）聚合切片表示；(1) Earth Mover's Distance损失建模序数误差；(2) 序数监督对比损失：拉近跨中心同级别切片、按疾病严重程度分离不同级别；(3) 课程学习缓解良性样本主导问题。在PANDA双中心约9,100张穿刺WSI上评测，并以线性探针检验表示迁移性（Karolinska↔Radboud），UMAP可视化不同中心混合度与序数轨迹。

Result: 留出测试集准确率0.842、二次加权kappa 0.958；跨中心迁移：Karolinska训练→Radboud测试，线性探针准确率0.643→0.823、QWK 0.899→0.930，反向方向稳定；UMAP显示中心间更好混合且保留序数梯度。

Conclusion: 将序数目标与中心感知对比目标结合，可得到更具跨机构可迁移性的全切片表示，对多中心病理分级有实用价值；方法思路（序数+域对齐+课程学习）可迁移到其他有序分级任务。

Abstract: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. We evaluate the framework on approximately 9,100 biopsy WSIs from the two-center PANDA dataset. The proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 0.842 and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.958 on the held-out test set. Its main benefit is observed in cross-center transfer: when a linear probe is trained on Karolinska representations and evaluated on Radboud, accuracy increases from 0.643 to 0.823 and quadratic weighted kappa from 0.899 to 0.930. Performance remains stable in the reverse direction. UMAP projections further show improved mixing between centers while preserving an ordinal grade trajectory. These results suggest that combining ordinal and center-aware objectives produces more transferable slide representations for multi-center prostate cancer grading.

</details>


### [68] [Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28442)
*Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez,Danny Xie-Li,Fabian Fallas-Moya,Camile Lendering,Joaquín Figueira,Erkut Akdag,Giacomo D'Amicantonio,Egor Bondarev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练农业小样本目标检测器：基于冻结视觉基础模型稠密特征，由支持样本估计白化前景-背景方向逐块打分，自适应阈值与支持几何解码；并检验预测深度输入RGB预训练编码器的可行性，发布菠萝种植园航拍数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业航拍图像存在密集植被、重复纹理与标注稀缺，传统微调式小样本检测难以适用；同时探索深度模态能否直接复用RGB预训练冻结编码器。

Method: 无需微调、无学习检测头、无外部候选框：(1) 用标注支持图像估计白化的前景-背景判别方向，对查询图像每个patch打分；(2) 结合自适应阈值与支持集导出的几何先验解码为检测框；(3) 将预测相对深度输入RGB预训练的冻结编码器；(4) RGB-深度特征融合；构建含4,908帧航拍（1,995帧标注、17,609框）的菠萝种植园数据集，采用防泄漏划分。

Result: 在航拍菠萝数据上，所有评估支持集规模下均优于PET-DINO与GeCo2；K=40时仅用预测深度即可达DINOv2 RGB性能的92%；RGB-深度融合对两种编码器均降低计数误差；并在两个额外农业数据集上分析迁移性。

Conclusion: 冻结基础模型的稠密特征经白化方向打分即可直接支撑小样本检测，预测深度是有效且可与RGB互补的模态，数据集公开可推动农业小样本检测研究。

Abstract: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

</details>


### [69] [CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28461)
*Jinho Kang,Yunhui Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TTA 目标 CAMA：以批互信息最大化替代熵最小化，并早期估计参考类分布进行预测对齐，证明其可避免 VLM 特征压缩导致的坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在图像损坏下出现特征压缩（不同图像特征趋同），而最常用的熵最小化 TTA 目标会放大该偏置、导致类别坍缩，性能反而低于适应前；既有工作缺乏对失败机制的细致分析与有效对策。

Method: 先分析熵最小化在 VLM 上的失效机制（特征压缩→预测偏置→坍缩）；再提出 CAMA：最大化批级互信息（单样本预测置信 + 批内预测多样性），并在测试流早期估计参考类分布、约束每批平均预测与之对齐；给出理论证明：特征压缩必然偏置预测、熵最小化放大为坍缩，而 CAMA 保证各类别不被丢弃。

Result: 在标准损坏基准上，几乎每个评估的 VLM 骨干都出现坍缩；CAMA 在所有观测情形下阻止坍缩，并在每个骨干上取得最佳准确率；定量与定性分析显示其逆转了导致坍缩的特征压缩，消融验证各组件均有贡献。

Conclusion: 批互信息最大化 + 参考分布对齐是应对 VLM 测试时适应坍缩的有效且具理论保证的策略，可作为熵最小化的稳健替代目标。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model using unlabeled test data to help it handle distribution shifts. However, prior work has found that image corruption causes a vision-language model (VLM) to produce more similar features for different images, a phenomenon known as feature compression. Under compression, entropy minimization, the most common TTA objective, can cause the model to favor a few classes and perform worse than before adaptation. Despite these observations, a detailed analysis of how these failures are connected and an effective strategy for preventing them are still lacking. In this paper, we first analyze why entropy minimization fails for VLMs. We then propose CAMA, a new test-time adaptation objective that maximizes batch mutual information to encourage confident predictions for individual images while maintaining diverse predictions across the batch. CAMA also estimates a reference class distribution early in the test stream and aligns each batch's average prediction with this reference during adaptation. We prove that feature compression biases the predictions and that entropy minimization amplifies this bias into collapse, whereas CAMA is guaranteed to preserve every class. Across standard corruption benchmarks, we observe collapse on nearly every VLM backbone evaluated. CAMA prevents collapse in every observed case and, in turn, achieves the best accuracy on every backbone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses confirm that CAMA reverses the feature compression behind the collapse, and ablations show that each of its components contributes.

</details>


### [70] [VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28485)
*Runheng Lin,Jialiang Shen,Jiyang Zheng,Ruiqi Liu,Zonglin He,Yu Yao,Huajie Chen,Chris Russell,Runqi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VICA 用冻结的 V-JEPA 对视频区域做互补掩码，由时空上下文预测区域表征，并与观测表征比对得到空间与双向时间残差，统一完成 AIGC 视频检测与篡改定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIGC 视频生成/编辑使数字视频真实性受质疑。现有检测方法依赖整体帧级表示捕捉时间不一致，可能因全局特征聚合掩盖局部伪影；篡改定位方法只看单个空间区域的伪影，忽略该区域与周围时空上下文之间的不一致。两类方法割裂且各有盲区。

Method: 提出 VICA 统一框架：(1) 对视频区域施加互补掩码以保证区域全覆盖；(2) 使用冻结的 V-JEPA 从周围时空上下文预测被掩码区域的表征，作为"上下文期望"参照；(3) 比较预测与观测表征，导出刻画帧内差异的空间残差，以及刻画前后帧不一致的双向时间残差；(4) 以"上下文不一致度"作为两个任务共享的取证表征，替代对孤立伪影的识别。

Result: 在多基准上两项任务均达 SOTA，并对未见过的视频生成器与编辑方法表现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将取证问题重构为"区域与上下文推断期望的一致性评估"，可绕开全局聚合掩盖局部伪影与区域方法忽视上下文的双重局限，并提供检测与定位共享的统一表征；方法依赖冻结自监督视频模型，无需任务特定微调亦可跨生成器泛化。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

</details>


### [71] [Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28489)
*Xu Lin,Ruilin Yao,Haoran Xu,Zixiang Wang,Ming Ma,Yu Zhao,Pu Miao,Chonghan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Open Vision Banana (OVB) 把 Qwen-Image-2.1 的 7B 扩散生成器用单一共享 LoRA 指令微调为通用视觉模型，统一处理度量深度与三类分割，并系统分析开放生成器相对闭源系统的失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证「把感知输出渲染为 RGB 图像的指令微调生成器即通用视觉模型」这一结论能否迁移到开放生成器，并定位迁移失败的具体环节。

Method: 以 Qwen-Image-2.1 扩散生成为基座，设计统一任务契约（RGB 编码器+指令+解码器 + 训练前校验），用一个共享低秩适配器适配深度/语义/实例/指代分割；分析 42 个外部评测 checkpoint、6 次精确权重空间合并、8 次受控短训练、10 种子集成消融。

Result: 几何早学到但绝对尺度未学得：中位对齐 NYUv2 δ1 稳定在 0.89–0.93，而非对齐 δ1 在 0.11–0.50 间漂移；10 种子集成将非对齐 δ1 从 0.348 提升到 0.516（免重训）。深度与 2D 分割争用共享适配器，权重合并在权衡曲线上移动但无法脱离。验证流损失与 Cityscapes mIoU 呈 ρ≈−0.9 负相关，损失无法用于选点。

Conclusion: 开放扩散生成器的通用视觉化可以复现，但差距具体可测：尺度不确定、多任务容量冲突、验证损失与下游精度解耦。作者开源代码、任务契约、训练数据与全部评测输出。

Abstract: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to \emph{open} generators, and if not, what fails? We answer with \textbf{Open Vision Banana (OVB)}, an open framework that adapts the 7B diffusion generator of Qwen-Image-2.1 into one instruction-driven model for metric depth, semantic, instance, and referring segmentation, using a single shared low-rank adapter and public data. Each task is a \emph{task contract} whose RGB encoder, instruction, and decoder share one specification and are checked before training. Studying 42 externally evaluated checkpoints from two 100k-update runs, six exact weight-space merges, and eight controlled shorter runs, we find that the gap to the closed system is specific and measurable. Geometry is learned early while absolute scale is not: median-aligned NYUv2 $\delta_1$ stays at 0.89--0.93 throughout training as unaligned $\delta_1$ wanders between 0.11 and 0.50. The scale is not committed by a single sample: a ten-seed ensemble lifts unaligned $\delta_1$ from 0.348 to 0.516 without retraining. Depth and 2D segmentation compete for the shared adapter, and weight merging moves along this trade-off without escaping it. Finally, lower validation flow loss comes with lower Cityscapes accuracy (Spearman $\rho\approx-0.9$ between loss reduction and mIoU), so the loss cannot select checkpoints. We release code, contracts, training data, and all evaluation outputs.

</details>


### [72] [Simple Baselines for Fetal Brain Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28505)
*Hongjia Yang,Mingxuan Liu,Yingqi Hao,Xiaotian Hu,Siyao Li,Xuguang Bai,Fenglin Jia,Yijin Li,Yifei Chen,Zihan Li,Juncheng Zhu,Jing Liu,Yi Liao,Ziyu Li,Haibo Qu,Qiyuan Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FetalBUAD：基于体素级脑龄估计的无监督胎儿脑MRI异常检测框架，联合预测全局脑龄、体素级脑龄图与脑分割构建内部生理参考，并用不确定性感知的体素级脑龄差图定位异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胎儿脑MRI病理数据稀缺，现有无监督异常检测依赖噪声大的孕周（GA）标签、缺乏病灶定位能力或跨域泛化差。

Method: 多任务网络同时预测全局脑龄、体素级脑龄图和脑分割，建立内部生物学脑龄参考以减少对临床GA的依赖；基于不确定性加权的体素级脑龄差图实现异常定位。

Result: 在1317例内部胎儿脑MRI体积及一个外部基准上取得SOTA异常检测性能，跨域泛化更优，并生成解剖可解释的异常定位图。

Conclusion: 体素级脑龄估计是一种可定位、可跨域泛化的胎儿脑无监督异常检测范式，代码已开源。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) offers a promising approach to fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) analysis, where pathological data are scarce. Existing methods rely mainly on brain age prediction or image reconstruction, but are limited by noisy gestational age (GA) labels, lack of lesion localization, or poor cross-domain generalization. We propose FetalBUAD, a UAD framework based on voxel-level brain age estimation. A joint multi-task network predicts global brain age, voxel-level brain age maps, and brain segmentation to establish an internal biological brain age reference, reducing reliance on clinically recorded GA. Uncertainty-aware voxel-level brain age gap maps are then used for anomaly localization. Experiments on 1,317 internal fetal brain MRI volumes and an external benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance and improved cross-domain generalization. FetalBUAD also generates anatomically interpretable maps that localize diverse fetal brain abnormalities. Our code is publicly available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [73] [VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28520)
*Jingong Chen,Qingwen Zhang,Lin Lian,Xinxin Zuo,Yang Wang,Chulwoo Pack,Kyle Gao,Patric Jensfelt,Kwanghee Won*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将预训练视频生成模型（Wan2.1）改造为前馈式3D重建器，通过clip级shift预测校正逆深度偏移、多层相机头预测逐帧相机，无需迭代去噪即可重建场景与相机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有把视频生成模型用于3D重建的方法要么只预测深度不含相机，要么依赖多步迭代去噪同时生成几何并估计相机，速度慢。作者观察到视频扩散模型内部已隐含深度与相机运动信息，只是解码形式不适配重建。

Method: 以Wan2.1为视频骨干，引入两个模块：(1) clip-level shift prediction，修正解码逆深度中未知平移导致的深度畸变；(2) multi-layer camera head，融合多个transformer块特征回归每帧相机参数。整个流程为单次前馈推理，不做迭代去噪。

Result: 在基于视频生成模型的方法中取得最低ATE与重建误差，比Aether快约4倍、比Geo4D快约14倍；深度估计与3D重建性能与几何基础模型相比具备竞争力。

Conclusion: 预训练视频生成模型的隐式几何先验可直接转为前馈3D重建能力，兼顾精度与实时性，为视频到3D的高效重建提供了可行路线。

Abstract: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [74] [Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28535)
*Youzhi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究Jev风格（单次prefill读取选项概率）的system-1决策模型对图像-文本token顺序的敏感性，发现后缀放置导致41%决策翻转、准确率降18.6点，曲线单调而非U型，并提出P+Q双前向平均读出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明生成式视觉语言模型对图像与文本token的相对顺序敏感；作者想检验这种敏感性是否会传递到不生成、不解析、直接从prefill读出选项分布的Jev式判别读出上。

Method: 固定选项列表，仅改变图像位置（prefix、pre-question、pre-options、suffix），度量argmax翻转率、总变差、准确率、校准与标签边际分布，并做多项控制实验；提出prefix–question averaging（P+Q）：对prefix与pre-question两种放置的分布做两次前向平均。

Result: suffix放置使41.0%决策翻转、准确率下降18.6个百分点；四种槽位平均后呈单调曲线而非U型，与生成式VLM的既有结论不同；效应在多项控制下稳健；P+Q准确率不低于prefix且优于既有baseline。

Conclusion: 图像-文本顺序敏感性同样影响无生成的Jev式读出，且呈现与生成式模型不同的单调趋势；简单的双前向平均读出可缓解该问题，提示多模态判别评测需报告图像放置方式。

Abstract: Jev-style system-1 decision models read a choice from a single prefill. They restrict the next-token distribution to the supplied option labels and return a distribution over the options, with no generation and no parsing. Recent work shows that generative vision-language models are sensitive to the relative order of image and text tokens. We ask whether that sensitivity reaches this Jev-style readout. The answer is always read at the end of the prompt, so moving the image changes the distance from the visual evidence to the decision, but never the position at which the decision is read. Using four placements---prefix, pre-question, pre-options, and suffix---and holding the option listing fixed, we measure argmax flips, total variation, accuracy, calibration, and label marginals. Suffix placement flips 41.0% of decisions and lowers accuracy by 18.6 points. Averaged over the four slots, the curve is monotone, not U-shaped. That shape differs from prior results on generative vision-language models. The effect survives a battery of controls. We also introduce prefix--question averaging (P+Q), a two-forward readout that averages the prefix and pre-question distributions. It is at least as accurate as prefix and outperforms the prior baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [75] [Centerline-Guided Multi-Class Road Surface Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28544)
*Xu Ouyang,Lin Gan,Di Ma,Sonnie Chen,Sanjay Boddhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出中心线引导的多类道路分割框架：共享层级编码器 + 中心线特征/软概率条件化的常规路面、交叉口、立交解码器 + 双分量宽度分支，实现四语义输出，CHN6-CUG 上完整路面 IoU 65.53%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值道路掩码丢失了道路轴线、横向宽度与路口结构等几何信息；窄走廊、汇流路口、遮挡分别需要不同几何线索，需在解码阶段显式建模这些依赖而非独立预测头或固定并集。

Method: 层级编码器提供共享特征；以预测的中心线特征与软概率作为条件，驱动常规路面/交叉口/立交三个专门解码器；双分量宽度分支为常规路面解码提供横向几何；可学习特征融合生成完整道路掩码，各分量输出仍可单独检查。

Result: CHN6-CUG 四语义输出配置下完整路面 IoU 65.53%，较二值 SegFormer-B4 基线提升 1.01 个百分点，假阳性像素减少 11.94%。

Conclusion: 几何感知的引导式多类分割可有效细化路面结构，并提供比二值栅格更丰富、可检查的道路表示；但增益幅度有限，属于遥感制图任务的增量改进。

Abstract: Road-surface extraction from satellite imagery supports geo- graphic mapping, but a binary mask leaves road axes, transverse extent, and junction structure implicit. Learning these proper- ties together is challenging because narrow corridors, merging roads, and occlusions require different geometric cues. We present a centerline-guided multi-class segmentation framework that makes these dependencies explicit. A hierarchical encoder sup- plies shared features, while predicted centerline features and soft probabilities condition specialized regular, intersection, and over- pass decoders. A two-component width branch supplies transverse geometry to regular-surface decoding, and learned feature fusion produces the complete road mask. Unlike independent prediction heads or a fixed union of component masks, this design exchanges geometric information during decoding while retaining separately inspectable outputs. Evaluation of the four-semantic-output con- figuration on CHN6-CUG achieves 65.53% complete-surface IoU, improving on a binary SegFormer-B4 baseline by 1.01 percentage points and reducing false-positive pixels by 11.94%. The results support geometry-aware surface refinement and a richer raster representation for road-map inspection.

</details>


### [76] [Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch Learning for LiDAR Anomalous Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28545)
*Guanyu Jiang,Junjie Cao,Jinshan Pan,Zhixun Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结构化残差推理(SRR)，从特征通道、时间序列与几何空间的残差结构中挖掘额外异常证据，并证明语义判别与正常模式重建的互补性；进而提出重建引导双分支(RGDB)学习框架，在STU验证集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR异常检测器多依赖语义判别，只捕捉类别可分特征，忽略正常场景中更广泛特征关系的偏离；而逐点重建误差在复杂室外点云中难以区分异常与正常变异性，两类证据各有局限，需互补利用。

Method: SRR模块对残差进行结构化建模，分别在特征通道、时序、几何空间维度提取异常证据；理论上区分语义判别（类别兼容性）与重建（与正常模式一致性）两类互补证据；RGDB用SRR导出的正常模式一致性线索引导语义条件异常解码器训练，推理时双分支联合决策。

Result: 在匹配的背景误报率下，SRR能找回语义分支完全漏检的更多目标，且在纯正常场景中误报更少；单独SRR无需目标场景训练数据的语义标签即构成强重建基线；RGDB在STU验证集取得SOTA。

Conclusion: 语义判别与正常模式重建提供根本不同且互补的异常证据，双分支联合利用可显著提升LiDAR异常检测的召回与误报平衡，为自动驾驶安全感知提供新思路。

Abstract: Detecting unexpected objects is essential for autonomous driving safety. Most existing LiDAR anomaly detectors rely on semantic discrimination, which primarily captures category-discriminative features but may overlook deviations from broader feature relationships in normal scenes. Reconstruction offers a complementary perspective by assessing consistency with learned normal patterns. However, pointwise reconstruction errors alone struggle to distinguish anomalies from normal variability in complex outdoor point clouds. We propose Structured Residual Reasoning (SRR) to extract additional anomaly evidence from residual structure across feature channels, time sequences, and geometric space. We further establish that semantic discrimination and normal-pattern reconstruction capture fundamentally different yet complementary anomaly evidence: category compatibility and consistency with learned normal patterns, respectively. At matched background false-positive rates, SRR recovers more objects missed entirely by the semantic branch while producing fewer false positives in normal-only scenes. Building on this finding, we propose Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch (RGDB) learning, in which SRR-derived normal-pattern consistency cues guide a semantic-conditioned anomaly decoder to complement reconstruction-based predictions during training. At inference, the two branches jointly exploit their complementary anomaly evidence. Experiments show that standalone SRR establishes a strong reconstruction-based baseline without semantic labels from the target-scene training data, while RGDB achieves state-of-the-art performance on the STU validation set.

</details>


### [77] [Analyzing Atypical Local Features in Museum Artifacts using Generative Image Inpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28549)
*Maho Kinoshita,Wakana Kuwata,Ryota Mibayashi,Hiroaki Ohshima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"排除区域"的LoRA生成模型修补方法：若某区域器物图像的局部细节无法被其他区域训练出的模型重建（LPIPS差异大），则该细节具有区域特异性。在民博藏小芥子、鼓、面具图像上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 博物馆器物同类器物整体形状相似，局部纹样、装饰、表情等细节承载区域/文化特征，但缺乏自动发现"非典型/意外局部视觉特征"的手段，人工甄别成本高且主观。

Method: 以图像生成模型学到的外观分布作为类别内"预期外观"参照；对每个目标区域，剔除该区域图像、仅用其余区域图像微调LoRA（region-excluded model），再对目标区域器物图像的预设局部进行掩码inpainting，用LPIPS度量重建结果与原图差异，作为重建难度指标。

Result: 在民族学博物馆的小芥子、鼓、面具三类藏品上，为各区域构建排除式LoRA并修补局部：典型形状与简单装饰常被一致重建；部分区域特有颜色、纹样、绳结排布与彩绘细节被替换为更普遍的外观，产生高重建难度。

Conclusion: 排除区域inpainting可作为一种探索性工具，用于发现博物馆器物图像中区域特异的局部视觉特征；但方法为定性/探索性分析，缺乏定量基准与标注验证。

Abstract: This study proposes a method for analyzing local visual features in museum artifacts that may appear atypical or unexpected. Objects in the same category often share a similar overall shape, while local details such as patterns, decorations, and facial expressions may reflect regional or cultural characteristics. We use the appearance distribution learned by an image generation model as a reference for what is generally expected within an artifact category. For each target region, we exclude images from that region and fine-tune a generative model using only images from the remaining regions. We then mask selected parts of artifact images from the target region and ask the region-excluded model to complete them. If the completed result differs greatly from the original image, the masked part may contain features that are difficult to predict from the appearance learned from other regions. We measure this difference using LPIPS and treat it as reconstruction difficulty for the generative model. We conduct experiments on images of kokeshi dolls, drums, and masks from the collection of the National Museum of Ethnology. For each category, we select several target regions, build region-excluded LoRA models, and perform inpainting on predefined local parts. The results show that typical shapes and simple decorations are often reconstructed consistently, whereas some region-specific colors, patterns, cord arrangements, and painted details are replaced with more common appearances. These results suggest that region-excluded inpainting can serve as an exploratory tool for finding region-specific local visual features in museum artifact images.

</details>


### [78] [WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28553)
*Xuan Yao,Jiahao Zhang,Rongjunchen Zhang,Kaixuan Huang,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldWeave：跨任务世界模型，将VLN（导航至静止目标）与EVT（跟踪运动目标）通过逆-前向动力学学到的潜动作统一为共享状态转移表示，并自适应注入任务特定表征以支持下游决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动具身智能体的观测演化同时由自身运动与外部动态驱动，不同移动具身任务（导航、跟踪）蕴含互补的状态演化模式；但跨此类交互联合学习世界动力学仍少有人研究，且异构物理动作空间难以直接共享。

Method: 以状态变化为监督，用逆动力学从观测差分推断潜动作、再以前向动力学预测下一状态，从而回避异构动作空间差异，形成跨任务共享的转移表示；潜动作驱动的未来状态预测通过自适应机制融合进各任务专用表征，供下游策略/决策使用。

Result: 在多个VLN与EVT基准上取得相对专用基线的一致提升；摘要未给出具体数值、真机验证或开源信息。

Conclusion: 潜动作空间是跨移动具身任务共享世界动力学的可行桥梁，共享预测+任务特化适配的组合优于各自为战的专用模型；但证据限于仿真基准数据，缺少实机部署与量化细节。

Abstract: Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

</details>


### [79] [LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28575)
*Zhaozhi Wang,Mingrui Wu,Jiaming Zhao,An-Syu Li,Jun Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopSight：循环视觉Transformer中用门控预测记忆(GPM)分离读出的持久预测状态与核心演化状态，以交叉注意力门控在patch/channel级控制写入，配合渐近循环编码与截断高斯采样循环数监督训练，在ARC-AGI-1/2上优于LoopViT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环ViT重复应用共享Transformer核心以扩展视觉推理计算量，难点在于既要让计算状态持续演化，又要在多次循环间保留有用的预测信息。

Method: 引入门控预测记忆(GPM)维护与核心演化状态分离的持久预测状态；每轮迭代用交叉注意力门控结合核心候选特征、上一轮预测状态与当前任务状态，在patch与channel级控制写入；从更新后的记忆解码预测；用渐近循环编码让共享核心感知当前迭代序号；训练时对从截断高斯分布采样的循环次数进行监督。

Result: 在三个模型规模上均超过LoopViT；ARC-AGI-1上LoopSight-Small达67.4% pass@2，较参数量与FLOPs相当的LoopViT-Small提升6.6个百分点；并在Visual Sudoku与ImageNet分类上优于LoopViT；分析显示其能保持更多已正确预测，读特征更稳定。

Conclusion: 将预测读出与循环计算状态解耦是提升循环ViT视觉推理性价比的有效设计，且带来更稳定的读出表征与更好的预测保持能力。

Abstract: Looped vision transformers extend computation for visual reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer core. A challenge is to preserve useful prediction information across loop iterations while allowing the computation state to evolve. In this paper we introduce LoopSight, a looped vision transformer that uses Gated Prediction Memory (GPM) to maintain a persistent prediction state for readout, separate from the core's evolving computation state. At each iteration, a cross-attention gate uses the core's candidate features, the previous prediction state, and the current task state to control writes at the patch and channel level. The model decodes its prediction from the updated memory. We condition the shared core on the current iteration using asymptotic loop encoding and train the model by supervising its prediction at loop counts sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution. LoopSight outperforms LoopViT across three model scales on ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2.
