On ARC-AGI-1, LoopSight-Small achieves 67.4% pass@2, a gain of 6.6 percentage points over LoopViT-Small with comparable parameter counts and FLOPs. LoopSight also outperforms LoopViT on Visual Sudoku and ImageNet classification. Further analyses on ARC-AGI-1 show that LoopSight preserves more already-correct predictions and maintains more stable readout features as its computation state continues to evolve. The code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [80] [CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28576)
*Ziaullah Khan,Rashadul Islam Sumon,Md Ariful Islam Mozumder,Duc-Son Pham,Moon-Il Joo,Hee-Cheol*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLASP是一个"先决策后解码"的全切片病理报告生成器：用相似图像病例的报告给出句子结构与长度先验，用校准后的切片后验做发现项取舍，再把发现项分配到计划句子中，最后在计划条件下解码报告；仅35M参数即超过7B级切片级多模态LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理报告生成把"报告长度、组织结构、陈述哪些发现及其位置"全部交给解码器隐式决定。作者发现这些报告级选择对n-gram指标影响巨大：不做任何学习、仅按查询所属医院检索报告的"非学习基线"就接近SOTA，而解码器倾向欠生成并退回高频发现，说明瓶颈在结构化决策而非语言建模能力。

Method: 提出CLASP（先决策后解码）：解码前对每张切片一次性显式决定报告级选择。ESP（Exemplar Structure Prior）从图像相似病例报告中提取句子计划与长度；CCD（Calibrated Claim Decision）基于校准的切片后验选择要陈述的发现项；CSP（Claim-to-Sentence Placement）将各发现项分配到计划句子；PCD（Plan-Conditioned Decoder）经结构锚定的序列训练精调，在既定计划约束下生成文本。

Result: 在PathText-BRCA上优于重训练的报告生成器与最大7B参数的切片级LLM，匹配已发表最强结果；可泛化到未见医院的肺癌数据；决策改变的是"陈述什么"而非仅长度，且可迁移到LLM解码器；通过"扣留"HE染色无法呈现的受体状态，与临床记录矛盾数减少23%。

Conclusion: 报告级结构决策应作为显式可控变量而非解码器隐式产物；以极小参数量的决策模块即可超越大规模多模态LLM，并支持按成像能力约束"不该说什么"的可靠性控制。

Abstract: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.

</details>


### [81] [CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28589)
*Zhaoxi Wang,Jiahao Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLOSE：用分位数阈值+在线记忆+伪标签自训练打分器+回溯封禁的免标注在线自评估验证器，在生成过程中抑制视觉语言模型的物体幻觉，CHAIRs降低42%-87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM因语言先验常描述图中不存在的物体；模型自身其实具备判别能力（自问检测可拒绝44%-62%幻觉，AUROC 0.90-0.95），但该判断不可直接用：跨模型概率尺度不一致，且剩余部分与真实物体概率分布重叠，任何阈值都不可分。

Method: CLOSE将阈值定义为记忆库的分位数（仅依赖秩，规避概率标定问题），记忆由无标注图像冷启动并在线更新；用四个隐状态信号生成伪标签自训练一个打分器，与自问结果按秩融合以分离自问无法区分的样本；被拒绝的物体通过阶梯式back-off回滚并在生成中封禁，再用识别表拦截其换词重现。

Result: COCO上，拒绝20%/40%物体提及使LLaVA-1.5-7B的CHAIRs分别降42%/87%（F1 +1.9/-6.1）；拒绝20%/35%使Qwen3-VL-8B可达幻觉降79%/96%（F1 +0.5/-5.3）；外部词表可扩展检测超出官方词表范围。

Conclusion: 将模型内在判别力转为可用的在线生成约束，仅靠排序与无标注数据即可实现跨模型可迁移的幻觉抑制，代价是较高拒绝率下F1下降，存在精度-召回权衡。

Abstract: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.

</details>


### [82] [CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28591)
*Lan Wei,Haosong Peng,Sicheng Tian,Tianyu Qi,Wenchao Xu,Lei Xue,Yufeng Zhan,Yuanqing Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAR3T：面向前馈多视角3D重建的免训练推理加速框架，通过复用参考视角注意力输出（在标定预算下在线动态选层），将选中层跨视角注意力从二次降为线性，在VGGT/DA3/π³上实现最高1.41×（≤100视角）和1.75×（长序列）加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈多视角3D重建依赖全局注意力做跨视角聚合，代价随视角数二次增长，大输入推理昂贵。已有加速方法（token压缩、注意力稀疏化）可能丢失几何细节或限制跨视角聚合，且忽视了注意力输出之间的冗余。作者观察到某些层跨视角注意力分布相似，具备"输出复用"的潜力；但适用层随输入变化，且单层复用会改变后续层输入特征，逐层相似度无法刻画多次复用决策的累积漂移。

Method: 免训练框架：1）参考视角注意力输出复用（保留全部输入token，仍对所有视角的K/V做注意力）；2）离线风险标定，建模多次复用的累积风险；3）在线动态选层，在标定预算内按输入自适应决定复用层组合。核心效果是把选中层的注意力计算由二次降为线性。

Result: 在VGGT、DA3、π³三个backbone上，≤100视角时前向加速最高1.41×，更长序列最高1.75×；精度存在跨backbone、跨数据集的权衡（精度损失程度不一）。

Conclusion: 注意力输出复用是前馈多视角3D重建中一条无需训练、即插即用的加速路径，关键在于以累积风险标定加在线选层替代启发式稀疏化/压缩；代价是精度与速度的权衡需按场景调节，且需要离线标定开销。

Abstract: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $\pi^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.

</details>


### [83] [When Fog Becomes a Weapon: Atmospheric Attacks on Visible-Infrared Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28592)
*Chengyin Hu,Dehe Zhao,Dingyi Lu,Qike Zhang,Jiaju Han,Banglong Nong,Xu Kang,Jiujiang Guo,Kalibinuer Tiliwalidi,Jiahuan Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Fog Manipulation Attack (FMA)，以零梯度方式优化一个共享的三维雾状态，同时让可见光与红外VLMs产生语义失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对VLM和跨光谱感知的对抗攻击依赖显眼、不自然的伪影（贴片、主动光束），缺乏物理隐蔽性；而此前的天气攻击忽视了同一大气环境如何同时影响异质传感器。核心问题：纯粹自然的共享雾环境能否在无表面改动下同时破坏可见光与热红外的互补线索。

Method: FMA将沿场景路径的共享、深度与分层感知的大气传播与分波段成像物理（可见光airlight散射、热红外路径辐射）耦合，在零梯度条件下优化一个共同的3D雾状态，从而侵蚀两种模态各自的独特线索；与保真度匹配的随机雾对比。

Result: 同时失效概率较保真度匹配随机雾提升一倍以上；可迁移至图像描述与VQA任务；消除了跨模态补偿——恢复干净伴随视图可挽回64%–74%的双输入VQA答案。

Conclusion: 自然共享雾可作为物理隐蔽的多模态联合攻击载体，暴露了可见光-红外VLMs依赖跨模态补偿的脆弱性。

Abstract: Existing adversarial attacks on vision-language models (VLMs) and cross-spectral perception primarily rely on conspicuous, unnatural artifacts, such as vivid adversarial patches or active light beams, that lack physical stealthiness, whereas prior weather attacks largely overlook how one atmosphere simultaneously affects heterogeneous sensors. This raises a key scientific question: can a purely natural, shared fog environment simultaneously disrupt complementary visible and thermal infrared cues without artificial surface modifications? We introduce Fog Manipulation Attack (FMA), a zero-gradient attack that optimizes a common 3D fog state to induce simultaneous semantic failures in visible-infrared VLMs. FMA links shared, depth- and layer-aware atmospheric propagation along scene paths with band-specific imaging physics---visible airlight scattering and thermal path radiance---allowing one realistic fog state to erode both modalities' distinct cues. Experiments show that FMA more than doubles simultaneous failure rates over fidelity-matched random fog, transfers to captioning and VQA, and removes cross-modal compensation, where restoring a clean companion view recovers 64%--74% of lost dual-input VQA answers.

</details>


### [84] [OKB-CFM: Observation-Keyed Barycentric Conditional Flow Matching for Unpaired Sparse-to-Dense Cardiac Shape Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28600)
*Kangneng Zhou,Shuang Song,Yitian Zhao,Dian Song,Yujia Wang,Xinghua Zhang,Li Wang,Xi Li,Hao Dai,Feng Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"观测键控重心条件流匹配"（observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching），在临床非配对队列间完成稀疏心脏电影MRI标签到密集多层分割的补全：用独立VAE编码稀疏观测与密集形状，固定记忆库以模拟稀疏键检索源密集编码，匹配网络聚合为查询相关的重心端点并驱动端点条件流传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏电影MRI层面不能唯一确定心脏解剖结构，且与患者匹配的密集标注稀缺，因此需要在非配对队列之间实现分割补全（跨模态/跨队列的形状补全）。

Method: 稀疏观测与密集形状各用独立训练的VAE编码；固定记忆库将模拟稀疏键与源密集编码关联，在稀疏隐空间做候选检索；匹配网络将检索到的值聚合为查询相关的重心端点，用端点条件流匹配把稀疏编码输运到该端点；各候选值可作为替代补全结果。

Result: 327例真实非配对输入上，FID式特征距离与平方MMD（缩放后）为7.93与2.02，相对CUT分别降低47.0%与94.2%；34例模拟测试集上对密集VAE重建参考，五类平均Dice 0.889，平方Chamfer距离6.15平方体素，95%表面距离3.88体素，平均对称表面距离1.50体素。

Conclusion: 方法刻画了队列级特征一致性、观测标签一致性与既定参考下的重建质量；可为常规电影功能评估补充推断的多腔室解剖上下文。

Abstract: Completing cardiac segmentations from sparse cine magnetic resonance labels is challenging because acquired planes do not uniquely determine the underlying anatomy and patient-matched dense annotations are rarely available. We propose observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching for completion between clinically unpaired cohorts. Independently trained variational autoencoders represent sparse observations and dense shapes. A fixed memory associates simulated sparse keys with their source dense encodings, enabling candidate retrieval within the sparse latent space. A matching network aggregates the retrieved values into a query-dependent barycentric endpoint, toward which an endpoint-conditioned flow transports the sparse encoding. Individual candidate values provide alternative completion endpoints. On 327 real unpaired inputs, the method obtains encoder-feature Fréchet and squared maximum mean discrepancy scores of 7.93 and 2.02 after scaling by 10,000 and 10,000,000, respectively, corresponding to reductions of 47.0\% and 94.2\% relative to contrastive unpaired translation. On a 34-file simulated test partition, evaluation against dense-VAE-reconstructed references yields a five-class mean Dice of 0.889, squared Chamfer distance of 6.15 square voxels, 95th-percentile surface distance of 3.88 voxels, and average symmetric surface distance of 1.50 voxels. These results characterize cohort-level feature agreement, observed-label consistency, and reconstruction under the stated reference construction. By complementing routine cine-based functional assessment with inferred multi-chamber anatomical context, this framework provides a basis for investigating how chamber morphology and spatial relationships relate to cardiac function.

</details>


### [85] [VUOD: A Versatile Unsupervised Outlier Detection Framework for Natural, Industrial, Medical Images and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28608)
*Zhonghang Liu,Siyuan Chen,Jingwen Yu,Changshuo Wang,Kunyang Li,Jiangbo Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出通用无监督离群检测框架，利用内在分布先验提升特征判别性，摆脱对冻结预训练特征提取器的依赖，在3个领域14个基准上达到SOTA，并可即插即用地增强分类与3D重建等任务的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督离群检测方法依赖冻结的预训练特征提取器，多在自然图像上有效，但在工业质检、医学影像等实际场景中性能难以维持，且跨领域通用性差。

Method: 构建通用无监督离群检测框架，核心是借助内在分布先验（intrinsic distribution priors）提升特征判别性；框架具备即插即用特性，可嵌入多种视觉应用，而非仅依赖固定的预训练特征。

Result: 在3个领域、14个基准数据集上取得SOTA，显著优于现有方法；并验证其即插即用性，可提升图像分类、3D重建等应用的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作将无监督离群检测拓展至工业、医学等更广泛领域，提示以分布先验驱动的特征判别性优化是提升跨域泛化的有效途径，且方法具有较强可迁移性。

Abstract: Unsupervised outlier detection that automatically identifies whether visual systems involve anomalous images is a significant research topic. However, most approaches are limited to natural images because they rely on frozen and pre-trained feature extractors. So that their performance cannot be maintained in practical scenarios, especially for industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this work, we first revisit this task and then introduce a versatile unsupervised outlier detection framework to enrich the application domains. The core idea of this framework is to improve feature discriminativess via exploiting intrinsic distribution priors. Evaluated on 3 domains and 14 benchmark datasets, our proposed solution achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly outperforms existing methods. More importantly, we show its plug-and-play property that can be integrated into diverse visual applications to improve their robustness, such as image classification and 3D reconstruction.

</details>


### [86] [Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28629)
*Yuan Wu,Zhiqiang Yan,Zhengxue Wang,Guangfa Wang,Jun Li,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAP: 利用冻结深度模型预测的度量深度图作为几何先验，构造场景自适应投影编码器（先验引导参考点生成 + 径向结构特征聚合），改进视觉3D占用预测中的2D-to-3D视角变换采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有backward-projection范式将均匀分布的3D参考点投到图像平面聚合多视图特征，采样模式与场景无关，忽视几何非均匀性，在固定采样预算下把大量参考点分配到空白区域，采样效率低。

Method: 将冻结深度模型预测的度量深度图反投影到3D空间得到几何先验；设计Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder，含两部分：(1) Prior-Guided Reference Generation，在先验支撑的高度区域内部署参考点，无有效支撑时保留全范围采样，形成混合参考集；(2) Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation，用可学习径向偏移探索多个候选位置，聚合因深度误差而位移的特征证据。

Result: 在Occ3D上取得SOTA，并在多种占用框架下给出一致性提升。

Conclusion: 以即插即用的深度先验驱动参考点分布与偏移聚合，可在不增加采样预算的情况下提升视角变换效率，且对不同占用框架具通用性。

Abstract: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

</details>


### [87] [Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28632)
*Enhao Cui,Junzhi Yang,Yaoshun Lin,Yuhan Feng,Zijian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"自预测残差"(隐藏态线性读出框与写出框的差异)作为单次前向的免费信号,用于检出"框到别的物体上"的错误;仅带来误差重排而非更多检出,增益限于RefCOCOg。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: grounded VLM 以文本形式输出框,坐标token平均概率对框是否正确信息量很低;且只关心"是否框对物体"时,需要一种不依赖标签、单次前向即可获得的置信信号。

Method: 为每个模型无标签拟合一个线性映射,从写框前的隐藏状态读出框;将其与已写出框的不一致量化(需少量标签固定权重)。在1200条RefCOCOg测试项上,与15种单次评分用AUROC对比,并评估成本加权召回。

Result: 残差在六模型上把每种评分的错误检出AUROC提升0.026–0.049;但对全部错误AUROC变动<0.02;审查1/5答案时,总错误召回0.518→0.524,框错物召回0.505→0.607(事后分析);成本加权下仅在框错物成本≈0.86倍其他错误时打平。

Conclusion: 该残差是有效的补充信号,但主要作用在于改变被发现的错误类型而非提升整体检出量;结论仅限MS-COCO图像的RefCOCOg列表,泛化性未验证。

Abstract: Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. Over all errors, adding it to the label-free probe moves AUROC, averaged over the models, by less than 0.02 (95% interval). With a fifth of answers reviewed, the share of all errors caught moves from 0.518 to 0.524, that of boxes on another object from 0.505 to 0.607 (post hoc): the residual changes which errors are found, not how many, and in cost-weighted recall it breaks even when such a box costs about 0.86 times another error, and its gain is positive in point estimate at equal costs. These gains come from RefCOCOg lists of MS-COCO images.

</details>


### [88] [LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28635)
*Chengzhong Wang,Lang Lin,Xinyang Liu,YueQin Yin,Mingyuan Zhou,Shengwei An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopSeek将长视频问答中的证据搜索与答案生成解耦：由非生成式的System I（四个角色智能体在视频窗口树上做类型化小决策）负责选帧与证据评估，冻结的System II（Qwen3-VL-8B，32帧）只回答一次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在有限帧预算下，单遍选帧易漏掉关键证据；而现有自适应搜索依赖反复文本生成来决定"看哪里"，开销大、延迟高。

Method: 把搜索表述为一系列小规模、类型化的决策，使非思考型System I可在不生成文本的情况下完成搜索。四个System I角色智能体在视频窗口树上导航，通过概率输出协同完成选帧、证据评估与搜索修正；System I仅从"System II 仅凭该证据即可答对"的问题上的标注证据中学习对齐，并用验证器的证据估计驱动搜索（不调用System II）。

Result: 在5个长视频基准上，冻结Qwen3-VL-8B读32帧，平均准确率由均匀采样的53.5提升至63.9，每题GPU时间比智能体式方法少32–80%。

Conclusion: 显式的"搜索—生成分工"可显著改善长视频QA的证据定位效率与精度，且无需让大模型反复生成文本；但该范式面向视频QA，未涉及具身导航或3D重建。

Abstract: Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search without calling System II, which stays frozen and answers once from the selected frames. On five long-video benchmarks, with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B reading 32 frames, LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32--80\% less GPU time per question than agentic methods.

</details>


### [89] [SemGuard: Semantics-Decoupled Watermarking for Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28636)
*Yingying Shi,Zhong Zhou,Bin Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemGuard：通过"语义解耦"的渐进式课程预训练通用消息解码器，抑制场景语义干扰，实现高斯泼溅资产的鲁棒水印提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP引导的高斯水印中，通用消息解码器仅在文本水印表示上预训练，未显式建模提取阶段遇到的场景相关语义干扰，导致解码鲁棒性受限。作者目标是让解码器在预训练阶段就学会抑制场景语义干扰。

Method: 构造"消息相关CLIP文本特征 + 消息无关的未加水印场景图像视觉特征"的混合训练表示，形成与目标高斯资产语义可控相关的干扰；采用渐进式语义干扰课程，逐步提高视觉特征贡献比重，使解码器先学到可靠消息表示，再适应递增的场景语义干扰。预训练完成后冻结解码器，在同一消息长度与语义图像池覆盖范围内跨多个高斯资产复用。

Result: 在静态与动态高斯泼溅资产上，渲染保真度提升且水印提取可靠；静态资产上对图像空间畸变的鲁棒性亦有增强。

Conclusion: 语义解耦 + 渐进干扰课程的预训练策略，可在不牺牲渲染质量的前提下提升高斯资产水印解码的鲁棒性，并支持解码器跨资产复用，为3DGS资产版权保护提供了一种简单有效的方案。

Abstract: Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for high-fidelity rendering of static and dynamic 3D scenes, motivating the copyright protection of Gaussian assets. In CLIP-guided Gaussian watermarking, a universal message decoder pretrained on textual watermark representations is subsequently applied to visual features containing both watermark information and scene-dependent semantics. However, text-only pretraining does not explicitly account for the semantic interference encountered during watermark extraction. To address this challenge, we propose SemGuard, a simple yet effective semantics-decoupled watermarking framework that learns to suppress scene-dependent semantic interference during universal message decoder pretraining. Specifically, SemGuard combines message-related CLIP text features with message-independent visual features extracted from unwatermarked scene images, constructing training representations with controllable semantic interference relevant to the target Gaussian assets. A progressive semantic interference curriculum gradually increases the contribution of visual features, allowing the decoder to first learn reliable message representations and then adapt to increasingly strong scene-dependent semantic interference. After pretraining for a given message length and semantic image pool, the decoder is frozen and reused across multiple Gaussian assets whose visual semantics are covered by the pretraining data. Experiments on static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting assets demonstrate improved rendering fidelity alongside reliable watermark extraction, while evaluations on static assets further show enhanced robustness against image-space distortions.

</details>


### [90] [CrossPanel: Exposing the Answer-Evidence Gap in Scientific Figure Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28641)
*Zhengyang Lu,QianhongWen,Chenpeng Wang,Qiang Huang,Ziyang Ling,Huan Li,Chenziao,Yibo Qiu,Xiaojie Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrossPanel构建了2650条人工审核的科学图表问答基准，用于揭示"答案正确但证据归因错误"的鸿沟，并通过15个VLM的审计与干预实验量化该失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学图表问答中，模型可能给出正确答案却对实验本身作出错误描述；跨面板阅读要求每条观察都与对应物体和实验条件绑定。现有评测只看最终答案准确率，无法暴露答案-证据不一致问题。

Method: 提出CrossPanel基准（2650条人工审核问题），任务包括并行观察组合与依赖式查询；设计响应审计，将错误分解为物体选择、实验条件、跨面板绑定与局部读数四类；在251道诊断题上评测15个VLM，并进行受控干预（经验证的物体-条件提示、增加图像切片）。

Result: 8.42%–56.64%的正确答案包含显式事实错误；审计可区分"对错目标的连贯解读"与"对正确目标的错误解读"；在57题上，经验证的物体-条件提示使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的目标查询成功率提升22.81个百分点，而单纯增加图像切片改进有限，部分模型需两者结合。

Conclusion: 实验归因是独立于局部感知的能力需求，CrossPanel使答案-证据鸿沟可测量，超越最终答案准确率的评测范式。

Abstract: A correct answer to a scientific-figure question can conceal an incorrect account of the experiment. Reading evidence across panels requires keeping each observation attached to the object and conditions that give it meaning. We introduce CrossPanel, a benchmark of 2,650 human-reviewed questions that exposes this answer-evidence gap. Its tasks combine parallel observations or follow dependent queries, while a response audit separates object selection, experimental conditions, cross-panel binding, and local readout. Across 15 vision-language models on 251 diagnostic questions, 8.42%-56.64% of correct answers contain explicit factual errors. The audit distinguishes coherent readings of the wrong target from incorrect readings of the right one. Controlled interventions then test how these failures can be repaired: verified object-condition hints, which withhold the requested measurement, raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's target-query success by 22.81 percentage points on 57 questions, while additional image tiles alone yield little improvement. Other models benefit most from combining both forms of assistance. These findings identify experimental attribution as a distinct requirement alongside local perception, and make both measurable beyond final-answer accuracy.

</details>


### [91] [OrthoLatentCAD: Orthographic Spatial Latents for Hand-Drawn CAD Program Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28646)
*Xiaolei Zhou,Xinjie Zhu,Chuangjie Fang,Chenyu Wang,Jianwei Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Hand2CAD 基准（215K 合成三视图–CAD 程序对 + 1,000 组真人手绘三视图）与 OrthoLatentCAD 模型，从栅格正/右/俯视图恢复有序草图-拉伸 CAD 程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手绘正交图承载早期设计意图，但从无标注、带噪声的三视图光栅图反推可执行的 sketch-extrude 参数化程序，需要跨视图几何推理与视觉-程序表征对齐，现有方法缺乏数据与专门架构。

Method: 构建 ABC 派生的 215K 合成正交图–CAD 程序对及 1,000 组 CAD 受训者真实三视图；OrthoLatentCAD 在规范平面上融合局部几何与全局上下文，通过共享轴坐标索引的成对平面线之间交换证据，并借助冻结 CAD 自编码器的 query 将空间表征映射到有序程序隐变量。

Result: 在一至三视图各配置下，于程序级精度、编译后几何与 CAD 内核有效性指标上均优于同协议基线，且视图增加带来增益；不经真实数据微调即在留出真实手绘图上超过基线。

Conclusion: 三视图正交图到参数化 CAD 程序的逆向建模可由跨视图证据交换 + 冻结潜空间解码有效实现，并具备向真实手绘的零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: Freehand orthographic drawings capture early design intent, yet recovering executable sketch--extrude CAD programs from raster front, right, and top views remains challenging: noisy, dimension-free 2D layouts must be reconciled into an ordered construction history. We introduce Hand2CAD, a benchmark of 215K ABC-derived synthetic orthographic-drawing--CAD program pairs and 1,000 real three-view sets drawn by CAD-trained participants. Recovering CAD programs from orthographic drawings requires both cross-view geometric reasoning and alignment between visual features and program representations. We propose OrthoLatentCAD to address these two challenges. It fuses local geometry with global context on canonical planes, exchanges evidence between paired plane lines indexed by the same shared-axis coordinate, and maps the spatial representation to ordered program latents through queries inherited from a frozen CAD autoencoder. Across the evaluated one- to three-view configurations, OrthoLatentCAD outperforms protocol-matched baselines in procedural accuracy, compiled geometry, and CAD-kernel validity while benefiting from additional views. Without real-data fine-tuning, it also outperforms the baselines on held-out real drawings. We will release the dataset, code, and evaluation scripts.

</details>


### [92] [Beyond Full-Context Accuracy: Context-Marginalized Evaluation of Test-Time Structure-Aware Inference in EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28648)
*Ke Xiao,Banghua Yang,Yingjie Li,Hang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Context-Marginalized Retrieval Evaluation (CMRE)，在随机采样的查询上下文下重复评估同一目标查询，将"结构可利用性"（相对独立检索的增益）与"上下文鲁棒性"（同查询 Top-1 一致性）解耦。在 THINGS-EEG2 上跨 6 种冻结表征与 6 种结构感知推理规则，全上下文下最优规则在 70.8% 的 (表征, 上下文规模) 条件下不再最优，平均损失 2.70pp、最大 8.29pp。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构感知的测试时推理（利用无标签测试查询间关系）可提升跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索，但也使预测依赖查询集组成。现有评测只在单一"全查询"上下文下报告准确率，无法判断增益与规则/表征比较结论是否随上下文变化，且结构增益与预测稳定性被混为一谈。

Method: 固定查询-库相似度矩阵，对其行进行采样构造多个缩减上下文（CMRE），对每个目标查询重复评估。定义两个指标：(1) 结构可利用性 = 相对独立检索（逐查询）的 Top-1 增益；(2) 上下文鲁棒性 = 同一查询在不同上下文下 Top-1 预测的一致性。实验：THINGS-EEG2 留一被试，6 种冻结表征 × 6 种结构感知推理规则 × 多种上下文规模，共 24 个 (表征, 上下文规模) 条件。

Result: 结构感知推理在全上下文下相较独立检索最高提升 20.40pp Top-1；但全上下文选出的最优规则在 17/24（70.8%）条件下不再最优，沿用该规则平均损失 2.70pp、最大 8.29pp。表征排序随推理规则与上下文而变，独立检索下的排序不能稳定延续；更大的检索增益并不必然对应更强的上下文鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 全上下文准确率只刻画了上下文依赖推理的一个工作点；增益、稳定性与规则/表征比较结论均随查询上下文显著漂移，需用 CMRE 补充报告。属于评测方法学工作，不提供新模型或真实机器人/3D 证据。

Abstract: Test-time structure-aware inference can improve cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval by exploiting relations among unlabeled test queries, but it also makes predictions depend on query-set composition. Existing evaluations typically report accuracy under a single full-query context, leaving unclear whether gains and comparative conclusions hold as context changes. We introduce Context-Marginalized Retrieval Evaluation (CMRE), which repeatedly evaluates each target query in sampled contexts using the corresponding rows of a fixed query-gallery similarity matrix. CMRE distinguishes structural exploitability, quantified by gains over independent retrieval, from context robustness, measured by same-query Top-1 context consistency. Under leave-one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2 across six frozen representations and six structure-aware inference rules, structure-aware inference improves full-context Top-1 accuracy by up to 20.40 percentage points over independent retrieval. However, the rule selected under full-context evaluation is no longer optimal in 17 of 24 representation-context-size conditions (70.8%). Selecting the full-context winner incurs an average loss of 2.70 percentage points and a maximum loss of 8.29 percentage points under reduced contexts. Representation rankings are likewise inference- and context-dependent: the ordering under independent retrieval is not consistently preserved under structure-aware inference. Moreover, larger retrieval gains do not necessarily imply greater context robustness, showing that retrieval effectiveness and prediction stability provide complementary views of structure-aware inference. Full-context accuracy captures one operating point of context-dependent inference. CMRE complements it by characterizing how structural gains, context consistency, and comparisons of rules and representations change with query context.

</details>


### [93] [S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28649)
*Muxin Fu,Peike Yu,Guibin Zhang,Wenrui Zhou,Runze Liu,Lang Feng,Fuchao Yang,Feng Chen,Yixuan Li,Mengao Zhang,Shiying Zhang,Wen Shen,Ling Pan,Shuicheng Yan,Bo An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S-Mind 通过一组紧凑的"空间 token"把多视角几何内化进 MLLM：训练时监督这些 token 承载融合后的 3D 场景，并在推理每一步视角变换时重新发射这些 token 以从新视角重新表达该场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 进入物理世界需要空间智能，其两大认知基石是：多视角融合为一致 3D 场景、以及随推理过程对新视角做心理变换。作者的探测实验表明现有 MLLM（即使做过空间微调）普遍缺失这两种能力。

Method: 以 Qwen3.5 为骨干，引入紧凑空间 token 作为场景表征：监督这些 token 编码融合的多视角 3D 场景，并在推理采纳新视角时重新发射 token 来重述该场景（隐含视角变换），实现几何内化而非外挂工具。

Result: 四个空间基准上较 Qwen3.5 骨干最高提升 22.26 分，平均准确率超过 GPT-6-Astra(+0.45)、Kimi-K3.1-Pro(+1.97)、GLM-5.3-Flash(+7.80)；融合与变换准确率达 65.11%/82.17%，基线最多仅 16.02%/37.28%；推理比同骨干工具型智能体快约 100 倍。

Conclusion: 空间能力通过空间 token 被"内化"为骨干的固有属性，即使在推理时移除这些 token 仍能保持，为 MLLM 的空间智能提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

</details>


### [94] [UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28655)
*Yiwei Li,Qiyang Chen,Zheming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UACR：面向可解释工业异常检测的不确定性感知协同路由框架，离线训练模块并标定不确定性估计器，在线按样本不确定性自适应分配计算路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测对所有样本使用固定计算路径，难以兼顾精度、延迟与可解释性；在线检测有严格时延预算，同时又需要向操作员提供可信解释。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段一离线训练异常检测模块并标定驱动路由的不确定性估计器，同时搜索路由超参数；阶段二不确定性感知自适应路由，依据估计不确定性将每个输入协同分派到不同检测路径，模糊样本获得更深计算。

Result: 多个公开数据集上相比基线精度提升超过5.16%，延迟降低超过31.5%，工业检测可解释性提升超过15%。

Conclusion: 不确定性驱动的自适应计算分配能够同时改善工业异常检测的精度、时延与可解释性，为在线可解释质检提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection requires not only accurate anomaly discrimination but also trustworthy explanations for operators, while satisfying the strict latency constraints of online inspection. Existing methods, however, typically apply a fixed computational path to all samples, making it difficult to strike a good balance among detection accuracy, inference efficiency, and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose UACR, an uncertainty-aware collaborative routing framework for explainable industrial anomaly inspection. UACR aims to deliver reliable anomaly decisions together with operator-facing explanations under the online inspection budget, while adaptively allocating computation so that ambiguous cases receive deeper scrutiny. The framework consists of two stages. Stage I, Offline Training and Routing Hyperparameter Search, learns the anomaly inspection modules and calibrates the uncertainty estimator that drives routing. Stage II, Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Routing, collaboratively dispatches each input across inspection paths according to its estimated uncertainty. Experimental results on multiple public datasets show that UACR achieves over 5.16% improvement in accuracy compared to the baseline method, while reducing latency by over 31.5%. It also enhances the interpretability of industrial detection by over 15%.

</details>


### [95] [Dual-Stream Event-to-Video Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28656)
*Lei Sun,Zhendong Li,Chenxin Shao,Weilun Li,Ruibo Ming,Kaiwei Wang,Jinjin Gu,Danda Pani Paudel,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvDualDiff 用双流扩散模型从事件相机流中重建视频：一路提供亮度参考（时间映射事件），一路提供运动事件线索，模仿人类视觉小细胞/大细胞通路的分工，并用自生成 rollout 微调抑制漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件流只记录亮度变化、缺少绝对强度信息，事件到视频的转换本质上是不适定的；需要引入一个与事件互补的亮度参考来消除歧义。

Method: 在事件相机镜头前加装简易光强调制装置，同时采集"时间映射事件"（提供亮度参考）与"运动事件"；构建双流条件化的视频扩散模型，以单张时间映射为条件自回归重建长序列；结合光度约束与在自生成 rollout 上微调来减少累积漂移；并采集同步 RGB 真值的 EvDual 数据集。

Result: 在公开基准与自建 EvDual 数据集上，EvDualDiff 在保真度、感知质量和视频级真实感上均优于现有事件到视频重建方法。

Conclusion: 通过硬件级的低成本光强调制获得亮度参考，并与运动事件双流融合的扩散式自回归框架，可有效缓解事件视频重建的不适定性与长序列漂移问题，为事件相机视频重建提供了软硬结合的新范式。

Abstract: Event cameras capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but converting event streams into videos remains fundamentally ill-posed due to the lack of absolute intensity information. Resolving this ambiguity calls for a brightness reference that complements the intensity changes recorded by events. Inspired by the complementary spatial and temporal processing of the parvocellular and magnocellular pathways in human vision, we propose EvDualDiff, a dual-stream framework that combines a brightness reference from temporal-mapping events with motion-event cues for video reconstruction. Conditioned on both streams, our video diffusion model autoregressively reconstructs long sequences from a single temporal map. Photometric constraints and finetuning on self-generated rollouts reduce accumulated drift. At the hardware level, our approach requires only a minimal light-modulation mechanism on the lens of an event camera. We build this setup and collect a dataset comprising temporal-mapping events, motion events and synchronised ground-truth RGB frames. Experiments on a public benchmark and on our collected EvDual dataset demonstrate that EvDualDiff outperforms existing event-to-video reconstruction methods in fidelity, perceptual quality and video-level realism. The code and dataset will be released.

</details>


### [96] [Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28665)
*Chenhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示VLM在空间问题上"逐步思考反而变差"的机制：短CoT把感知问题转化为"转写"问题，模型一旦写下空间关系就依据该句子而非图像作答，成败取决于写出的关系是否比直接作答更准确。作者在15个开源VLM（2B–38B）与6个前沿闭源模型上，通过三阶段分析定位失效环节：写推理重加权视觉线索（削弱"越低越近"捷径并丢弃有效线索，产生错误关系）、文本接管答案（固定模型自身去掉结论的理由后，换入深度相反的图像仅使答案变化2–9个点，而直接作答时可达77点）、结论句在逆向问题上可反转真实关系；错误关系与结论错配合计占CoT损失的8成。闭源前沿模型不受损，因为写关系与作答同样准确，且6个中3个在写完后重新检视图像；关闭推理的模型则与开源模型一样"锁定"。作者据此指出开源VLM缺失的是"答案步重新落地（re-grounding）"，并用固定理由微调的单模型试点实验恢复该能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在空间推理上使用逐步思考（CoT）常反而表现更差，但原因不明：图像仍在上下文中。作者希望厘清CoT对空间问题究竟何时有益、何时有害，并定位失效的具体环节，而非仅报告现象。

Method: 大规模行为学+因果干预分析：15个开源VLM（2B–38B）与6个前沿闭源模型；排除token数、轮次格式、视觉遗忘等解释；用"渲染孪生图"（深度相反的配对图像）和自然照片做反事实替换，固定模型自生成的无结论理由以隔离文本对答案的影响；将失效分解为书写阶段的线索重加权、文本接管阶段、结论句映射三阶段；对比闭源模型的做法（写后重检图像、关闭推理后的表现）；最后用固定理由+图像确定标签做单模型微调试点。

Result: 所有13个受测开源模型均出现"越低越近"捷径被削弱且有效线索被丢弃（错误关系）；固定理由后换入反向深度图像，答案仅移动2–9点（渲染孪生）与平均3.0–3.4点（自然照片），而直接作答分别可达77点与20.5–69.6点，说明文本主导答案；逆向问题上结论句可反转真实关系；错误关系+结论错配解释约80%的CoT损失；规模无改善（Qwen3-VL-32B同样）；闭源前沿模型不退化，3/6写后重检图像，关闭推理则与开源模型同样"锁定"；单模型微调试点可在自然照片上恢复重落地。

Conclusion: CoT对空间问题的收益取决于书写关系的准确性，开源VLM的瓶颈在于缺少"答案步重新落地"，而非模型规模；重落地与答案轮推理共现，可通过固定理由+图像确定标签的微调获得。研究为VLM空间推理中的CoT失效提供了机制性解释与可操作的改进方向。

Abstract: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem. Once a VLM writes a spatial relation, its answer follows that sentence instead of the image, so whether CoT helps or hurts depends largely on whether the written relation is more accurate than answering directly. Studying 15 open VLMs (2B-38B) and six frontier closed models, we rule out token count, turn format, and visual forgetting in open models and trace the failure through three stages. First, writing re-weights visual cues, weakening a "lower is closer" shortcut in all 13 open models tested but also discarding valid cues, which produces false relations. Second, the written text takes over. With the model's own conclusion-removed rationale held fixed, swapping in an opposite-depth image moves the answer by 2-9 points on rendered twins (vs. up to 77 for direct answers) and by 3.0-3.4 points on average on natural photographs (vs. 20.5-69.6). Third, the concluding sentence can invert even a true relation, mainly on converse questions. Together, false relations and conclusion mis-mapping account for four in five CoT losses. Scale does not remove this bottleneck: Qwen3-VL-32B shows the same pattern. Frontier closed models are not hurt: they write relations as accurately as they answer, and three of six re-check the image after writing. The three queried with reasoning off lock in like open models, so re-grounding co-occurs with answer-turn reasoning; we identify answer-step re-grounding as the step open VLMs lack. In a single-model pilot, fine-tuning on fixed rationales with image-determined labels restores it on natural photographs. We open-sourced all our datasets and code at this https URL .

</details>


### [97] [RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28666)
*Sarosij Bose,Gitika Karumuri,Chenqi Li,Allen Tu,Srikumar Sastry,Mellon Zhang,Avinash Ravichandran,Alexander Schwing,Konstantinos Karydis,Amit K. Roy Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RecallWorld：以Scenelet为记忆单元的持久化具身视频世界模型，短多视角片段联合重建、跨片段几何独立，配合覆盖度检索与几何可见性解算实现回访一致生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型生成的视角虽合理但缺乏持久记忆，智能体回访同一场景时无法保持几何与外观一致。核心问题在于如何利用历史视角构建记忆：独立重建浪费近邻视角间几何约束，而对不断增长的历史反复重建会把后期预测误差回灌到早期几何中。

Method: 提出RecallWorld：从单张源图出发，用相机感知的射线抬升将透视与原生鱼眼图像统一到世界坐标系（保留宽视场内容用于透视生成）；将短多视角片段联合重建为Scenelet，各片段几何保持独立，每个生成段扩展Scenelet记忆并条件化后续生成；基于覆盖度的检索从全历史中挑选互补Scenelet，并在外观融合前用几何方式求解目标视角可见性，从而提供一致的记忆条件。

Result: 在四个数据集上，部分回访PSNR较最强基线提升2.6 dB，完整巡回场景提升3.9 dB，显著增强探索与返回过程中的场景身份保持能力。

Conclusion: 以"分段联合重建+跨段几何解耦+检索式记忆条件"替代整体式历史重建，可有效缓解误差传播并提升长程回访一致性，为持久化具身世界模型提供了可扩展的记忆组织范式。

Abstract: Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation. Across four datasets, RecallWorld improves revisit PSNR over the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.6 dB on partial revisits and 3.9 dB on full cycles, demonstrating substantially stronger preservation of scene identity across exploration and return.

</details>


### [98] [Learning Continuous Scene Depth Representations via Cross-Modal Gaussian Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28670)
*Zhiwei Zhong,Lingyu Zhu,Baoliang Chen,Peilin Chen,Shiqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨模态高斯渲染框架（层级高斯表征 + 结构感知高斯聚合 + 尺度自适应高斯渲染 + 渐进高频引导训练），实现任意倍率带引导深度超分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB-D系统中深度与彩色分辨率差异不固定，需要灵活上采样倍率；现有方法多针对预设整数倍率，隐式方法虽支持任意尺度但逐像素神经解码计算昂贵，且难以恢复锐利深度边界与细节结构。

Method: 以可学习高斯图元构建层级高斯深度表征，逐级渐进重建；设计Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation，将空间权重与跨模态特征亲和度结合，减少跨深度不连续处的聚合；设计Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering，使高斯空间核适配目标像素足迹；并采用训练中逐步引入高频引导信息的策略促进跨模态学习。

Result: 在基准数据集上，面向分布内与分布外上采样倍率均验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。

Conclusion: 将显式高斯表征与跨模态结构引导融合，可作为一种无需逐像素神经解码的任意尺度深度超分方案，兼顾灵活性与边界保真度。

Abstract: Depth super-resolution with color guidance is a fundamental problem in geometric scene understanding that aims to reconstruct high-resolution depth using structural cues from color images. In practical RGB-D systems, the resolution gap between depth and color images often varies, requiring flexible upsampling factors. However, many existing methods are designed for predefined integer scales. Although implicit methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, they typically rely on computationally demanding per-pixel neural decoding and may struggle to recover sharp depth boundaries and fine structures. To this end, we propose a cross-modal Gaussian rendering framework that learns continuous depth representations for arbitrary-scale depth super-resolution. Specifically, we first construct hierarchical Gaussian representations for progressive depth reconstruction, with explicit spatial support defined by learnable Gaussian primitives. Building on this representation, we design a Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation module that combines spatial weights with cross-modal feature affinities to reduce aggregation across depth discontinuities. We then develop a Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering module that adapts Gaussian spatial kernels to the target pixel footprint. To further facilitate cross-modal learning, we propose a training strategy that gradually introduces higher-frequency guidance information during training. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method at both in-distribution and out-of-distribution upsampling scales.

</details>


### [99] [ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28673)
*Sarosij Bose,Arindam Dutta,Konstantinos Karydis,Amit K. Roy Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练、查询条件的多视图选帧流水线：将查询分解为概念→粗检索打分→多样性去冗余→按可见性/可答性重排→可选定位→自校验，仅用2D图像和推理期工具完成3D场景理解，在3D VQA上约+10%、密集描述与具身问答约+5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为许多3D场景理解查询的瓶颈不是缺少更强的3D表征（点云/体素/场景图），而是没有选出一小撮使查询可回答的多视图RGB。故以"证据选择"为互补视角，避免任务特化训练与显式3D表征。

Method: 训练无关、查询条件化的多视图管线：1) 查询分解为若干独特属性概念，指导推理；2) 粗到细证据选择——粗检索对所有视角打分，多样性感知选择器降低冗余，重排阶段按目标可见性/可答性筛选候选；3) 对受益于显式定位的查询进行证据grounding；4) 自校验步骤精炼开放式回答。另提出judge式评估体系，容忍语义正确或部分正确的多解。

Result: 无任务特化训练、推理期不用显式3D表征，3D VQA约提升10%，密集描述与Embodied QA约提升5%，可跨不同场景适用；judge式评测更全面反映场景理解质量。

Conclusion: "选对视图"可替代"建更强3D表征"，为3D场景理解提供低成本、可迁移的推理期工具化范式；但其证据仅限基准分数，缺少真实机器人部署与开源/实时性验证，属于有价值的邻近方法而非核心具身系统。

Abstract: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

</details>


### [100] [CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28682)
*Yi Wang,Yubo Zhao,Chi-Keung Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CHORD是一个两阶段rectified-flow框架，用12个部位token的紧凑计划先“敲定”交互（物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态、各运动链末梢与中间关节），并在生成过程中以闭式干净估计对照物体表面进行零额外网络评估的反馈引导，再填充其余身体与手指关节，从而在InterAct上降低FID 33%、手部接触F1从0.730升至0.834，并可即插即用于现有HOI生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本驱动的全身人-物交互生成需人与物在接触中保持耦合，但现有方法要么把物体位姿、接触区域、肢体姿态等核心变量与数十个从属关节纠缠在一起，要么只规划末端执行器或粗糙轨迹；生成过程没有任何阶段以“既确定又可观测”的形式持有交互，导致接触只能依赖外部引导、事后精修或无表面测量的内部引导。

Method: 提出两阶段rectified-flow框架CHORD。第一阶段Draft在每个时间patch上用12个部位token联合规划6-DoF物体轨迹、接触状态以及每条运动链的末端与中间关节；在每个flow step从闭式干净估计中解码期望交互，与物体表面做度量，并把反馈以零额外网络评估的方式路由到相应的部位token。第二阶段Full保持该计划不变，补全剩余身体与手指关节。

Result: 在InterAct数据集上，FID降低33%，手部接触F1由0.730提升至0.834；接触反馈机制对未见物体同样有改善，并可即插即用地迁移到已有HOI生成器。

Conclusion: 以紧凑可观测的交互计划为核心、在生成中用表面度量闭环修正接触，是提升文本驱动全身人-物交互生成质量与接触准确性的有效路径，且具备良好可迁移性。

Abstract: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

</details>


### [101] [Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28684)
*Fawaz Sammani,Nikos Deligiannis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文分析自回归大型视觉语言模型在多模态推理中对视觉token的依赖是否在生成时间与Transformer深度上持续必要，并据此提出跨解码步和跨层的大幅视觉token剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在每个生成步、每一层都保留上百至上千个视觉token，计算与显存开销大，但"持续访问视觉token是否必要"缺乏系统理解，需要量化视觉信息在生成时间和网络深度上的作用结构。

Method: 在长程视觉推理基准与多个模型规模上分析视觉注意力随生成步和层深的变化；再用因果干预（按生成时间、按层彻底移除全部视觉token）验证依赖程度；最后基于该结构在提示词维度与层维度做视觉token剪枝。

Result: 视觉注意力在初始生成步达到峰值后迅速下降并转向已生成推理token；层深上集中于中间层、末层极弱。因果干预确认依赖既非时间持续也非层间均匀。剪枝可在生成过程中移除完整输入提示最多59%的token、跨全部Transformer层移除11%，性能仅轻微下降；视频基准上生成过程中可移除最多65%的输入token而不损失性能。

Conclusion: 多模态推理中的视觉token依赖具有时间与深度上的稀疏结构，每层每步保留完整视觉上下文并非必要，为LVLM推理加速提供了可操作的token调度依据。

Abstract: Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.

</details>


### [102] [CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28710)
*Zengle Zhu,Zhen Li,Tianyi Huai,Xinhu Zheng,Liuqing Yang,Rongqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoopOcc：面向多智能体 3D 语义占据感知的跨智能体注意力与跨模态双向融合框架，并提出 SemanticVVSim 仿真数据集与 CHORD 分层/关系蒸馏用于仿真到真实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一智能体的语义占据表征无法弥补遮挡与传感器覆盖带来的信息缺失；多智能体协同虽可缓解，但不同智能体信息在空间上效用不均；同时跨模态（语义+几何）互补特征的融合需要可靠的 3D 对应关系并保持模态特有结构，二者兼顾困难。

Method: 1) ego-query cross-agent attention (EQCA)：以自车查询为锚，选择性聚合同一空间区域的对齐特征，缓解异构视角下的特征错位；2) anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI)：在匹配坐标处做锚点式双向跨模态交互，保持模态特异结构；3) 构建 SemanticVVSim 仿真数据集并建立统一基准；4) 提出 confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD)，用置信度加权的分层占据蒸馏与关系蒸馏实现 sim-to-real 迁移。

Result: 在 SemanticVVSim 上，CoopOcc 在 10 种对比方法中综合性能最优；在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，CHORD 借助 SemanticVVSim 的知识带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 该工作表明“多智能体协同 + 跨模态融合”是提升 3D 语义占据感知覆盖度与鲁棒性的有效路径，且配合仿真数据与置信度感知蒸馏可向真实域迁移；主要局限是真实车端协同部署证据有限，基准依赖自建仿真数据集。

Abstract: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [103] [When Local Semantics Disagree: Learning to Detect Fake News through Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28711)
*Zeheng Wang,Hao Zhang,Yige Wang,Xi Xiao,Hao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DMIL将多模态假新闻检测形式化为弱监督多示例学习问题，双分支分别聚合全局语义与建模局部-全局跨模态不一致，并用检索增强的领域自适应路由器融合多级线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖图文粗粒度全局相似度，忽略情感-场景错配、物体级篡改、语义失谐等细微且不均衡的跨模态不一致；且将所有不一致等权重对待，忽视领域差异，导致泛化性与可解释性受限。

Method: 提出DMIL双分支多示例学习框架：每篇新闻视为图文实例构成的"包"；嵌入空间分支通过专家引导的模态融合聚合全局语义，实例空间分支在局部到全局粒度上建模跨模态不一致；并引入检索增强、领域自适应路由器，利用检索到的领域范例进行场景化并动态融合多层次线索。

Result: 在公开虚假信息基准上取得有竞争力的SOTA性能，并在跨领域场景下展现出对假新闻的强判别能力。

Conclusion: 以弱监督多示例学习替代粗粒度全局相似度，可有效捕捉细粒度跨模态不一致并提升跨域泛化与可解释性。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of multimodal social media content has made fake news detection a pressing challenge for the vision-language community. Most existing approaches rely on coarse global similarity between text and images, which overlooks subtle, uneven cross-modal inconsistencies -- such as sentiment-scene mismatches, object-level manipulations, or semantic dissonance between visual and textual cues. Moreover, these models treat all inconsistencies as equally informative, ignoring domain-specific variation in how such conflicts manifest, which limits both generalization and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose DMIL, a dual-branch multiple instance learning framework that formulates multimodal fake news detection as a weakly supervised learning problem. Each news article is treated as a bag of visual and textual instances processed through two complementary branches: an embedding-space branch that aggregates global semantics via expert-guided modality fusion, and an instance-space branch that models cross-modal inconsistencies across local-to-global granularities. A retrieval-augmented, domain-adaptive router further contextualizes inconsistencies using retrieved domain exemplars and dynamically fuses multi-level cues. Extensive experiments on public misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that DMIL achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong discriminative capability against fake news across different domains.

</details>


### [104] [Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Cuneiform Sign Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28712)
*Asim Niaz,Morris Alper,Shai Gordin,Enrique Jiménez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在90万+无标注楔形文字符号图上预训练CuneiMAE掩码自编码器，冻结表征线性探针43.7%（ImageNet-MAE为25.2%），微调后外部基准top-1达69.9%，优于先前ResNet-18约8pp，标签稀缺时收益最大；显式结构先验（边缘引导掩码、部件瓶颈）无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 楔形文字符号识别受跨时期字形变化、书写惯例与保存条件影响，且专家标注极其稀缺；作者想验证领域特定自监督预训练是否比通用自然图像预训练（ImageNet/CLIP/DINOv2）产生更好的印章表征，从而缓解标注瓶颈。

Method: 构建CuneiMAE：在900K+无标注符号裁片上做标准掩码重建自监督预训练。与ImageNet预训练MAE、CLIP、DINOv2在218类符号识别基准上对比，评测冻结线性探针、跨时期迁移、全量微调与1%标签低资源微调；并消融边缘引导掩码（edge-guided masking）与部件瓶颈（part bottleneck）等结构先验。

Result: 冻结线性探针43.7% vs ImageNet-MAE 25.2%；跨时期迁移优于ImageNet-MAE；微调后优于ImageNet预训练基线，1%标签时较ImageNet-MAE提升20.4pp；外部基准微调后top-1 69.9%，超先前ResNet-18基线约8pp；结构化先验无提升。

Conclusion: 领域特定自监督预训练在楔形文字识别上显著优于通用自然图像预训练，尤其在标注有限时；简单标准掩码重建已足够，额外结构先验并非必要。

Abstract: Recognizing cuneiform signs is challenging: sign shapes vary across historical periods, scribal practices, and preservation conditions, while expert annotations are scarce. We study whether domain-specific self-supervised pretraining yields better cuneiform sign representations than generic natural-image pretraining. We pretrain a masked autoencoder, CuneiMAE, on over 900K unlabeled sign crops and compare it with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, CLIP, and DINOv2 on a 218-class sign recognition benchmark. CuneiMAE learns substantially stronger frozen representations (43.7% linear-probe accuracy vs. 25.2% for ImageNet-MAE), with gains over ImageNet-MAE on cross-period transfer. Under fine-tuning, CuneiMAE outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines on our internal benchmark, with the largest gains when labels are scarce (+20.4 pp over ImageNet-MAE with 1% of labels). On an external benchmark, CuneiMAE reaches 69.9% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning, about 8 pp above the ResNet-18 baseline from prior work. Explicit structural priors, such as edge-guided masking and part bottlenecks, do not improve over standard masked reconstruction. Overall, domain-specific self-supervision shows strong performance on cuneiform recognition tasks, particularly when labels are limited.

</details>


### [105] [DynFlux: Learning to Dynamically Balance Consensus and Conflict in Multimodal Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28716)
*Zeheng Wang,Hao Zhang,Yige Wang,Xi Xiao,Hao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynFlux：用时间异构图显式建模跨模态一致性与冲突，并在特征提取、特征聚合、融合三阶段对多模态情感识别流程做动态调制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态情感识别中模态异质性强，跨模态共识与冲突共同提供互补线索；传统方法存在语义模糊问题，且很少显式建模二者的动态交互。

Method: 提出由时间异构图引导的 DynFlux，增加专用稀疏时间图分支显式捕获跨模态依赖，在三个层级阶段调制常规流水线：特征提取期的自适应特征调制、特征整合期的引导聚合调制、多模态融合期的融合策略调制，从而动态平衡共识与冲突。

Result: 在基准数据集上实验表明 DynFlux 持续优于 SOTA；并在多模态意图识别与多模态讽刺检测任务上验证了泛化性。

Conclusion: 显式的共识/冲突图建模与多阶段调制能有效提升多模态情感理解，且方法具备跨任务通用性，但实验限于分类基准，缺乏真实部署或物理交互证据。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition remains challenging due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of different modalities. Effectively leveraging both cross-modal consensus (consistency) and conflict (inconsistency) is essential, as they jointly provide complementary cues that enhance emotion understanding from diverse perspectives. Traditional multimodal methods often suffer from semantic ambiguity and rarely explicitly model the interplay between cross-modal consensus and conflict. Moreover, existing approaches struggle to capture and exploit the dynamic interactions between these two complementary factors. To overcome these limitations, we propose DynFlux, a model guided by a temporal heterogeneous graph that encodes both consensus and conflict relationships across modalities. DynFlux introduces a dedicated graph branch that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies through sparse temporal graphs, and modulates the conventional multimodal emotion recognition pipeline at three hierarchical stages: adaptive feature modulation during feature extraction, guided aggregation modulation during feature integration, and fusion strategy modulation at the multimodal fusion stage. Through this design, DynFlux dynamically balances cross-modal consensus and conflict, enabling richer and more robust emotion understanding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that DynFlux consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and its generality is further validated on multimodal intent recognition and multimodal sarcasm detection tasks.

</details>


### [106] [ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28717)
*Runzhe Li,Zhaocheng Yu,Binbin Song,Kui Jiang,Junjun Jiang,Xianming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReCoRain：以RGB外观、区间事件证据与前后向运动一致性共同评估跨帧对应可靠性，用同一可靠性同时门控内容聚合与潜变量初始噪声共享的残差视频扩散去雨框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件引导视频去雨依赖可靠跨帧对应，但场景运动、雨滴与传感器噪声产生的事件会造成匹配歧义；在扩散模型中，错误匹配会搬运无关内容，并在无关场景位置间错误关联初始噪声。

Method: 构建可靠性评估（RGB外观+区间事件证据+前向-后向运动一致性）；内容路径按对齐可靠性聚合邻帧特征；噪声路径用组合后向运动场及其可靠性调节潜变量序列的初始噪声共享；训练与推理采用相同的条件噪声构造以衔接残差 flow-matching；监督采用教师估计光流与可见性掩码下的运动补偿帧差一致性损失。

Result: NTURain-Syn 达 32.09 dB PSNR，RainSynLight25 达 28.73 dB；两路径同时启用可靠性门控相比全部关闭，warping error 降低 33.0%。

Conclusion: 将对应可靠性评估统一用于内容传递与噪声相关，可在扩散式事件引导视频复原中抑制错误匹配带来的内容泄漏与噪声错配，提升定量指标与几何一致性。

Abstract: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

</details>


### [107] [AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28723)
*Zhenzhen Jiao,Rui Tian,Zhineng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AERIN: 一种以动作为条件的视觉世界模型,用于无人机高空图像目标搜索与接近,通过紧凑的定长目标条件隐状态同时编码目标细节与场景可见性上下文,实现高效动作评估与视角调整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高空搜索覆盖广但目标像素极少,导致实例验证与动作选择困难;而反复预测稠密视觉表示来获取细节与场景上下文代价高昂,需要兼顾效率与信息充分性的方法。

Method: 在动作为条件的世界模型中引入定长、目标条件的紧凑隐状态,分别表示细粒度目标细节与影响可见性的场景上下文,用于低成本地评估候选动作并能动调整视点以获得高质量观测。

Result: 在目标接近与观测质量两项指标上优于所评估的基线,且决策时间显著少于同类世界模型。

Conclusion: 以目标条件紧凑隐状态替代稠密视觉预测,可在高空无人机目标搜索导航中同时提升性能与推理效率,具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

</details>


### [108] [Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28726)
*Siyuan Li,Ethan Lin,Xiang Li,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Railbound-Bench，用铁路谜题（一次性提交完整布局、模拟器同步移动全部车厢）评估视觉世界中的**时空规划**与**计划修复**两项能力；9 个模型中最好者五次尝试内仅解出 59.5%，且视觉反馈修复成功率很低，显示当前模型"知道规则"不等于"会用规则"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉世界中的规划需要同时读取布局、预判状态演化并遵守任务规则，而失败后还应能利用错误信息修正计划。现有基准缺少对"时空规划+计划修复"这一组合能力的直接检验，作者因此构建 Railbound-Bench。

Method: 模型观察铁路谜题并在预算内铺设轨道，一次性提交完整布局；模拟器同步移动所有车厢并判定成败。失败后可看到运行结果并重新提交，最多 5 次。构建 200 题主集与 1000 题扩展集，并在 180 道固定题目上做控制实验，考察规则理解、未来状态预测、布局复制能力与首轮布局成功率、路线交互复杂度的影响，以及等 token 预算下"视觉反馈修正"与"全新重试"的对比。

Result: 200 题主集上，最佳模型五次内解出 59.5%，第二名 39.5%，其余七个≤10.0%；1000 题扩展集最佳达 90.9%。控制实验中 GPT-6.1 Terra 精确复制 97.2% 棋盘、给定文本正确布局时预测 4 个未来状态达 91.3%，但自身首轮布局仅 22.8% 有效。车厢路线交互越多越易失败，即使搜索求解器认为难度相同。视觉反馈在 417 次首次修改中有 175 次消除了所指出的错误，但仅 43 次最终解出谜题；40k token 等预算下不优于直接重试。

Conclusion: 现有模型具备规则知识与状态推演能力，却难以在联合约束下生成可执行计划，且对反馈的利用效率低；Railbound-Bench 揭示了"知行分离"与修复能力薄弱两个核心缺口，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at this https URL .

</details>


### [109] [Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28736)
*Zhiyan Zhou,Hailong Yan,Hanlin Liu,Yongrui Zhang,Xiangtao Zhang,Le Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DSRC：将卷积核分解为频带并施加可学习高低通调制＋轻量残差分支，训练时可分析性融合为标准卷积核，推理零额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像增强面向的退化具有不同频谱特性；标准卷积核固定不具适应性，动态卷积虽自适应但增加推理成本。目标是训练时获得任务自适应的频谱响应、推理时保持标准卷积的效率。

Method: 提出 Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC) 即插即用模块：把卷积核分解到不同频段，施加可学习的高通/低通调制，并加入轻量残差分支；利用这些操作的线性性，训练期组件全部解析地融合为单一卷积核用于推理。

Result: 在低光增强、水下增强、图像超分辨率三类任务、共12个骨干-任务配置上取得一致的PSNR提升，SSIM与LPIPS总体改善或保持，部署参数量与理论FLOPs不变，无额外推理算子。

Conclusion: 结构化重参数化（频域调制＋残差分支）是一种低成本提升增强网络性能的通用手段，兼顾适应性与部署效率。

Abstract: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.

</details>


### [110] [Learning Optical Flow with Task-Oriented Feature Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28744)
*Mengtan Zhang,Dazhong Wang,Haoran Zhang,Hongbo Zhao,Yuhang Ming,Weihao Yuan,Wei Ye,Hanli Wang,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TO-Flow：面向光流任务的特征适配框架，用亲和度软划分指导通道调制与空间重组，分别提升匹配特征的判别性和上下文特征的运动边界区分度，跨多种迭代细化架构与监督/无监督范式均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用图像编码器提取的特征并不天然适配光流估计的两类角色：计算帧间相似度时，强激活但弱判别性的通道可能压过更有信息量的通道；上下文特征的亲和度在运动一致区域内部偏低、却跨越运动边界偏高，造成匹配歧义与边界模糊。

Method: 提出任务导向特征适配框架TO-Flow。先用基于亲和度的软划分区分运动区域内部与边界邻域；通道调制借鉴模拟光流细化，评估每个通道对估计对应的相似度是否高于邻近竞争候选，按区域类型聚合相似度差异并跨迭代平均得到通道权重，强调信息通道、抑制歧义通道；空间重组在由粗到细过程中结合亲和度引导的特征吸引与排斥，增强区域内部一致性与边界可区分性，并用特征重采样缓解跨尺度融合的边界模糊。

Result: 在MPI Sintel、KITTI 2015、Spring、LayeredFlow上实验，验证了方法在多种迭代细化架构及监督、无监督训练范式下的有效性与通用性。

Conclusion: 对通用编码器特征做任务导向的通道与空间适配，是提升光流精度的有效且可插拔的途径，具备跨架构、跨数据集的泛化性。

Abstract: Learning-based optical flow estimation approaches generally rely on both inter-frame correspondence evidence and intra-frame contextual guidance, yet features from general-purpose image encoders may not fully support these roles. Strongly activated but weakly discriminative channels can outweigh more informative ones when computing inter-frame feature similarity, while context feature affinities can be low within motion-coherent regions yet high across motion boundaries. To address these mismatches, this study proposes TO-Flow, a task-oriented feature adaptation framework that aligns matching and context features with their respective requirements through dedicated channel modulation and spatial reorganization approaches. An affinity-based soft partition distinguishes motion-region interiors from boundary-adjacent regions to guide both processes. Channel modulation uses simulated flow refinement to assess whether each channel assigns higher similarity to estimated correspondences than to nearby competing candidates. The resulting similarity differences are aggregated within each region type and averaged across iterations to derive channel weights that emphasize informative channels and suppress ambiguous ones. Spatial reorganization combines affinity-guided feature attraction and repulsion from coarse to fine to simultaneously improve consistency within motion-coherent regions and distinctiveness across motion boundaries, with feature resampling mitigating boundary blurring during cross-scale fusion. Extensive experiments on the MPI Sintel, KITTI 2015, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of TO-Flow across diverse iterative refinement architectures as well as supervised and unsupervised training paradigms. The source code will be publicly available at this https URL upon publication.

</details>


### [111] [UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28746)
*Shaharyar Ahmed Khan Tareen,Xiaojing Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UNIFY通过批归一化切换(BNS)实现单模型多数据集联合学习：共享骨干参数，保留数据集专用BN统计量与分类头，在5个数据集、6种CNN上验证，ResNet-34单模型精度超越独立模型均值且显存降约4.94倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统训练为每个数据集/任务单独建模，导致模型冗余，增加内存占用、部署成本与能耗，限制可扩展性；本文希望用单一模型整合K个模型并借助数据集间互补知识提升效果。

Method: 提出UNIFY统一学习框架，核心为Batch Normalization Switching(BNS)：共享参数密集的骨干网络，为每个数据集维护专属BN统计量与仿射参数，并配置数据集专用分类头；通过推理时按数据集切换BN与head实现单模型多任务推理。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet上，用SqueezeNet 1.1、WideResNet-40-2、WideResNet-16-8、ResNet-18/34/50验证。

Result: 单个UNIFIED ResNet-34在上述五个数据集上分别达到99.53%、94.84%、96.12%、80.32%、67.67%，优于各独立任务专用模型的平均性能；内存从428.30 MB（5个模型）降至86.71 MB（1个模型），约4.94倍压缩。

Conclusion: UNIFY证明通过共享骨干+数据集特异BN/分类头可在单模型内高效完成多数据集联合训练与推理，兼具精度提升与内存节省，为可扩展的统一图像分类学习提供可行路径。

Abstract: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). Notably, a single UNIFIED ResNet-34 trained on these datasets achieves accuracies of 99.53%, 94.84%, 96.12%, 80.32%, and 67.67%, respectively, outperforming the average performance of the corresponding independently trained task-specific models while reducing the memory footprint by approximately 4.94x, from 428.30 MB (five separate models) to 86.71 MB (one unified model). UNIFY aims not only to consolidate (K) models into a single model but also to enhance model-effectiveness by leveraging complementary knowledge across datasets. It paves the way for scalable, efficient, and unified learning capable of handling diverse image classification tasks. Code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [112] [From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28753)
*Xuanhua Yin,Shunqi Mao,Chuanzhi Xu,Boyu Wei,Wei Guo,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConsensusAlign: align multiple independently trained vision-only and text-only encoders without paired data by pooling each modality into a shared space, fitting a single unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transferring it in closed form to every encoder pair.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Paired image-text data are often unavailable, yet connecting independently trained vision and text encoders requires cross-modal alignment. Existing unpaired methods fit each encoder pair separately, causing fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality.

Method: Exploit exact within-modality correspondences across a collection of encoders (all vision encoders embed the same images, all text encoders the same texts): pool each modality into a shared space, fit one unpaired cross-modal bridge (with WP construction), and transfer it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join by same-modality fitting only; new corpora reuse the bridge via native maps fitted to unlabeled target features.

Result: On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds: pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68/105 pair-seed cells. Mean FOSCTTM drops from 0.1457 to 0.0099; zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains hold across tested within-modality pooling constructions. Failure detection on COCO correlates with separately fitted reference maps.

Conclusion: Pooling a collection of same-modality encoders converts scarce cross-modal supervision into a single reusable bridge, giving robust, efficient and extensible unpaired vision-text alignment relative to naive pairwise fitting.

Abstract: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.

</details>


### [113] [PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28756)
*Wonsik Shin,Jinju Jang,Junhoo Lee,Yeonjin Chang,Jimyeong Kim,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PSC-Gen：免训练框架，用Agent式"物理状态迭代规划+关键帧验证"生成视觉条件，仅注入其低频分量引导视频扩散模型，产生物理合理视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型虽在大规模数据上训练，仍难以理解物理规律、生成物理合理的动态；现有物理条件注入方式过于粗糙，缺少细粒度物理引导，导致运动不合理或视觉伪影。

Method: 免训练（training-free）pipeline：(1) Physics Agent 迭代规划物理状态并验证生成的关键帧，得到视觉与物理一致的关键帧序列；(2) 将关键帧插值为连续物理序列；(3) 对该序列做低频滤波，仅将其低频分量注入视频生成模型作为条件，从而约束全局物理动态而保留高频视觉细节。

Result: 在物理理解类基准与机器人操作基准上的定性与定量评估表明，方法能忠实遵循指令并生成物理合理的视频。

Conclusion: "Agent规划+低频动态注入"是免训练条件下把物理先验有效引入视频生成的一种轻量可控方案，为物理一致视频生成与下游机器人/世界模型应用提供参考。

Abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos.
