However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

</details>


### [114] [Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28762)
*Xuanhua Yin,Boyu Wei,Chengkun Yue,Shunqi Mao,Chuanzhi Xu,Wei Guo,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: THAW：训练无关的视频扩散采样技巧，在预热窗口内对 CFG 预测差的时间变化分量做独立加权放大，以相对剂量控制额外引导预算，提升运动幅度而避免饱和与偏色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量 CFG 对预测差中的均值分量与帧间变化分量赋同一系数，无法独立调控时间变化，导致运动不足或过度引导饱和、偏色。

Method: 保留原 CFG，在初始去噪窗口内叠加一个单独加权的残差；剂量定义为额外范数相对当前 CFG 差的比值，使额外引导在各步具有一致的相对预算；无需训练，复用 CFG 的两次模型预测，网络评估次数不变。

Result: 在五个视频模型上，成本匹配的运动幅度优于标量 CFG 与调度式 CFG，其中三个模型上相对现有引导方法的点估计为正；VBench 上动态度较原始 CFG 提升约 14–15 分，并在另外三个模型上提升总分。

Conclusion: 通过解耦时间变化分量的引导强度，可在不增加计算与训练成本的前提下改善视频生成的运动可控性，并有助缓解 CFG 饱和问题。

Abstract: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

</details>


### [115] [Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28764)
*Po-Yi Lu,Jui-Chao Lu,Paul Kuo-Ming Huang,Shih-Hsin Wang,Chun-Liang Li,Hsuan-Tien Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出对比梯度引导（CGG），将多偏好对齐重构为分布组合：每个偏好用"偏好专家/反专家"对比对表示，其分数差构成引导信号，在采样时组合多个现成扩散模型的去噪方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多上下文相关偏好的对齐若依赖离线微调，则每个偏好权衡都需重新调超参并训练；现有方法把多样偏好压成单一标量奖励，无法直接复用已发布的、由不同微调方式得到的生成专家。

Method: 测试时组合式生成框架：把每个偏好建模为一对对比模型（favored expert 与 unfavored anti-expert），以二者得分差作为对比梯度引导信号，在扩散采样过程中融合多个现成模型的去噪梯度；每对仅需一个固定尺度，可与基于奖励的引导结合。

Result: 复用预训练与微调模型作为专家/反专家以控制风格与安全性；单尺度下同时组合五类偏好，在文图偏好、概念控制、照片真实感与安全性上取得比离线微调、权重空间合并和奖励引导更均衡的权衡。

Conclusion: 无需逐偏好重训的测试时分布组合是一种可扩展、可插拔的多偏好对齐范式，能系统复用既有生成模型资产。

Abstract: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. CGG represents each preference as a contrastive preference pair of favored experts and unfavored anti-experts, whose score difference forms a contrastive gradient guidance signal that combines denoising directions (gradients) from off-the-shelf diffusion models during sampling. Experiments show that CGG reuses pre-trained and fine-tuned models as favored experts or anti-experts to control output style and safety, and that it can be combined with existing sampling-based reward guidance. With a single fixed scale per pair, CGG composes five preferences at once and gives a more balanced trade-off across text-image preference, concept control, photographic fidelity, and safety than offline fine-tuning, weight-space merging, and reward steering.

</details>


### [116] [JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28766)
*Yonghuang Wu,Zhenyang Liang,Pengfei Wang,Yize Ma,Guoqing Wu,Jinhua Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JevNavAgent 用2B参数"System One"式解码器（单次前向预测动作分布、0生成token）替代VLM多步导航智能体的自回归动作解码，配合Stage-1离线反事实轨迹对齐 + Stage-2轨迹级Traj-GRPO在线强化，在WSI-VQA与CAMELYON16上超越前沿VLM智能体且快约12倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 十亿像素WSI超出VLM单次处理能力；MIL需query无关离线切patch、无交互推理；多步VLM导航智能体虽可按需查看区域，但自回归动作解码延迟高（阻碍探索与在线多轨迹RL），离线蒸馏又存在"存在性vs全称"停止不对称，导致缩略图/平移捷径与漏检转移灶。

Method: 提出Jev式解码范式：单次前向输出预定义决策空间上的分布（0生成token），导航由确定性代码执行。JevNavAgent含分解式停止头、空间候选头、上下文双线性答案头及overview模态dropout；训练为两阶段：Stage-1离线反事实轨迹对齐（抑制深度与平移捷径）+ Stage-2轨迹级GRPO，用无需解码的rollout优化分支级病灶发现、多边形内停止与逐步置信增益。

Result: Clean Visual WSI-VQA：多尺度51.57%（终步50.43%）总体、51.39%病灶准确率，超过前沿VLM智能体与4B–11B开源级联，推理约快12倍（5.63s vs 66.64–70.04s）。CAMELYON16官方测试：Traj-GRPO定位22.45%，12个已访问肿瘤中11个（91.7%）转为有依据停止，特异性93.75%、切片准确率69.77%，在同停止规则下优于Stage-1 SFT，并具备零样本预算扩展性。

Conclusion: 以"一次前向即决策+代码执行导航"替代自回归动作解码，可同时获得低延迟与可在线RL训练；反事实对齐+轨迹级GRPO有效缓解捷径与停止不对称。但证据限于医学病理WSI的VQA/定位任务，属特定领域智能体系统，跨域（尤其实体/机器人导航）泛化性尚待验证。

Abstract: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.

</details>


### [117] [AdapToC: A Unified Framework for Multi-Task Visual Token Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28775)
*Zhicheng Liu,Chenliang Wu,Zhouxiang Zhao,Zhaohui Yang,Zhaoyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdapToC：面向预训练离散视觉token的无线流式传输单遍收发机，通过Pseudo-Gray重标号+Halton散布对齐码本几何、单位门控AdaLN调度保护层级、导频校准的ConvNeXt-attention潜空间恢复器绕过硬CRC擦除，在冻结tokenizer下实现多级率失真权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉tokenizer提供了紧凑潜变量，但无线token流传输脆弱：衰落与导频噪声下，硬CRC擦除把损坏块变为缺失token，冻结解码器放大了边缘错误，使UEP退化为"强编码或直接丢弃"的二元选择。

Method: 1) 离线频率加权Pseudo-Gray重标号+Halton色散，零开销压缩比特/突发错误；2) 软比特后验恢复使中间速率落在三级凸包上；3) 单位门控AdaLN发送端按信道预算调度保护层级；4) 导频校准接收端将因子化码本后验送入ConvNeXt-attention恢复器并启用CRC bypass；5) 仅潜空间共训练，采用反事实效用估计与码本交叉熵正则，不改tokenizer权重、不对像素解码器求导。

Result: 相同VQGAN-f16 token下优于TONIC与自适应TokenCom+AMC；多SNR Rayleigh LPIPS由0.6551降至0.3312（在冻结tokenizer的PSNR上限内）；Rician-K6在等质量下节省43.8%符号；单遍恢复比迭代重采样快8.3倍；无解码器识别加速20.6倍且精度提升；对TiTok、VAR与零样本NuPlan可即插即用。

Conclusion: 用软后验+潜空间恢复替代硬擦除，将UEP从二值退化为连续多级率失真调度，是离散视觉token无线传输的有效单遍方案，但主要验证于图像重构/识别指标，未涉及机器人闭环任务。

Abstract: Pretrained discrete visual tokenizers supply compact latents for synthesis, recognition, and embodied perception, yet wireless token streaming remains fragile. Under fading and noisy pilots, hard cyclic redundancy check (CRC) erasures turn corrupted blocks into missing tokens while frozen decoders amplify edge errors, which can collapse unequal error protection (UEP) into a binary choice between strong coding and omission under severe fading. Soft bit posteriors break this collapse. We present AdapToC, a single-pass transceiver that restores multi-tier rate-distortion tradeoffs without altering tokenizer weights or differentiating through pixel decoders. We align codebook geometry to the channel via offline frequency-weighted Pseudo-Gray relabeling and Halton dispersion to contract bit and burst errors with zero overhead. Because soft recovery pulls intermediate rates onto the three-tier convex hull, our unit-gated AdaLN sender schedules protection tiers across channel budgets, while our pilot-calibrated receiver feeds factorized codebook posteriors into a ConvNeXt-attention restorer with CRC bypass. We co-train AdapToC solely in latent space via counterfactual utility estimation and codebook cross-entropy regularization. On identical VQGAN-f16 tokens, AdapToC outperforms TONIC and adaptive TokenCom+AMC, cuts multi-SNR Rayleigh LPIPS from 0.6551 to 0.3312 within the frozen-tokenizer PSNR ceiling, and saves 43.8% Rician-K6 symbols at matched quality. Our single-pass restorer runs 8.3x faster than iterative resampling, raises accuracy while accelerating decoder-free recognition 20.6x, and improves fidelity plug-and-play across TiTok, VAR, and zero-shot NuPlan.

</details>


### [118] [Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28779)
*Feiyang Jia,Lin Liu,Zhicheng Bao,Caiyan Jia,Ziying Song,Shengkai Zhang,Lina Han,Yan Zhao,Xiaoshuai Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FastWorld：无需蒸馏或领域预训练的原生轻量世界模型，通过紧凑场景表示、短时域动作条件预测与选择性候选验证/分数精修实现高效未来感知规划。NAVSIMv1 92.2 PDMS@132FPS(4090)，NAVSIMv2 89.4 EPDMS，nuScenes 3s平均L2 0.40@17FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型对自动驾驶规划很有前景，但"想象未来"的计算开销巨大；现有蒸馏与领域预训练把负担转移给昂贵教师模型或训练管线，轻量世界建模仍是开放问题。

Method: 原生轻量化框架：紧凑场景表示、短时域动作条件预测（缩短rollout）、选择性候选验证与分数精修，三者协同降低推理计算量；不依赖教师蒸馏或额外领域预训练。

Result: NAVSIMv1 达92.2 PDMS、132 FPS（单张4090）；NAVSIMv2 89.4 EPDMS；nuScenes 3秒平均L2 0.40、17 FPS。均为benchmark（仿真/开环）结果，未提供实车部署证据。

Conclusion: 表明轻量世界模型可在无蒸馏条件下兼顾规划精度与实时性，为车载端世界模型规划提供可行路径；应用侧验证仍待补充。

Abstract: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [119] [Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28781)
*Zhuangzi Li,Shilv Cai,Jian Jin,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究"语言模型智能体仅通过前向传播读取并编辑权重来修复故障模型"这一范式：在已知答案的受控设定下，与事后编写脚本对比，发现脚本不劣于智能体，但智能体无需被告知故障类型即可泛化到脚本未覆盖的故障，且不外溢到无故障模型；其能力边界可预测（需可信的逐层激活参考 + 可逆结构变换）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重级智能体修复被宣传为新的模型修复方式，但缺少"有已知答案"的对照评估，无法判断其相对传统脚本化修复真正增加了什么。

Method: 将视觉模型迁移到新系统并由预处理、权重转换、输出约定三类故障破坏；限定智能体只能做前向传播，要求其判断是否存在故障、命名故障并编辑权重消除。在分类/分割/检测上共183次运行，以无故障模型为基准评分，并与"知晓故障类型后编写的专用脚本"和"脚本未覆盖的故障类型"进行对比。

Result: 已知故障类型时脚本修复48例中30例，智能体33例，差距不大；在5种脚本未覆盖的故障类型上智能体修复15/15而脚本仅4；智能体对21个无故障模型的编辑为零（无误伤）。局限：缺少可信的逐层激活参考或故障非可逆结构变换时，小故障被漏检、修复不完整。

Conclusion: 权重级智能体并非替代脚本，而是提供"无需先验故障知识"的泛化修复与低误伤风险；其适用条件为存在可信逐层参考激活与可逆结构化故障。给出何时用智能体、何时用脚本的决策指导。

Abstract: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.

</details>


### [120] [3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28783)
*Zhaoyu Wang,Xueru Wen,XingYu Li,Jie Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 3DCodeFactory：从原始文本自动合成3D参考图与建模规格/交互需求，构建视觉-规格-功能多维评分准则过滤多轮智能体轨迹，发布5,045条3D代码任务数据，微调Qwen模型在三个3D代码基准上超越现有开源数据训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体的任务范围已从生成静态3D网格扩展到构建结构完整、可交互的复杂3D场景，但现有数据集多由已有3D资产转换或打标而来，以单轮、单物体静态代码为主，任务多样性与场景复杂度难以扩展，训练数据稀缺。

Method: 以原始文本（扩散提示词、商品描述）为起点，先用图像生成器合成3D参考图作为视觉锚点，据此推导具体建模规格与交互功能需求；同时从参考图与需求共同构建视觉、规格、功能三类评分准则（rubric），自动打分并过滤多轮智能体rollout，形成高质量数据与轨迹。

Result: 发布3DCodeFactory-Data，含5,045个高质量任务实例及多轮交互轨迹；在其上微调Qwen3.5-9B与Qwen3.8-27B，在BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench、3DCodeBench上均显著提升，稳定优于用现有开源3D代码数据集训练的模型，27B模型总体表现超过同系列2.4T旗舰Qwen3.8-Max。

Conclusion: 该工作表明可扩展地由文本合成3D代码训练数据、并以多准则自动评分筛选多轮轨迹是有效路径，能显著提升代码智能体构建复杂可交互3D场景的能力，并为后续规模化数据生成提供框架。

Abstract: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

</details>


### [121] [ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28792)
*Weiming Chen,Shuaiyan Liu,Xinyu Shao,Zhewen Chen,Tian Guan,Yonghong He,Xitong Ling*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ArgsWorld: autoregressive diffusion world model that jointly generates RGB views and an explicit 3DGS scene, using 3D Self-Forcing Distillation with single/multi-view data and distribution matching on both image latents and Gaussian-rendered latents, unifying posed-image reconstruction, prompt-based scene generation, and cross-segment extrapolation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Autoregressive diffusion world models output only 2D RGB frames, lacking explicit 3D asset representations, so learned dynamics cannot be directly consumed by robotics, simulation, or rendering pipelines.

Method: Diffusion transformer jointly denoises new-view latents conditioned on fixed clean historical image latents, while refreshing 3DGS scene features so Gaussians are revised as new regions appear; trained via 3D Self-Forcing Distillation on self-generated histories with mixed single-/multi-view data and distribution matching on direct image latents and Gaussian-rendered latents at generation and auxiliary cameras.

Result: Reported state-of-the-art across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks (posed-image reconstruction, image/text-to-scene generation, and extrapolation across discontinuous camera segments); only qualitative claims of SOTA, no numbers in abstract.

Conclusion: Autoregressive video world models can be jointly trained to emit usable explicit 3DGS scenes, unifying reconstruction, generation, and extrapolation in one framework, bridging video world modeling and downstream 3D asset use.

Abstract: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [122] [Inference Dynamics: Image Classifiers Keep Using Visual Cues After They Are Removed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28795)
*Ruiqi Wang,Mingming Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"推理动力学"(Inference Dynamics)框架,通过逐层将原始分支中与线索对齐的状态替换为去线索参考分支的状态,追踪线索影响在网络深度上的可撤销性,发现"局部性先衰减、可撤销性后崩溃"的两阶段现象(证据锁定),并据此提出可在锁定期前自适应选择干预层的Evidence Reset方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像分类器通常只按最终预测评估,把推理视为静态的图像到标签映射。但可靠性还取决于模型能否在证据消失后放弃该证据。作者发现反直觉现象:去掉某个局部视觉线索后,其影响仍残留在预测中——早层捕获的信息会扩散到后续表示中,"不可见"并不等于"不再依赖"。因此需要一个过程级框架刻画证据影响如何随深度演化并可被撤销。

Method: 给定原图与匹配的去线索参考图,在连续层上将原分支中与线索对齐的状态替换为参考分支的对应状态,测量预测向"无线索预测"的恢复程度,由此得到一条轨迹,将证据的局部性(locality)与决策层可撤销性(withdrawability)分离。基于该分析提出Evidence Reset:选择依赖输入、位于"证据锁定"阶段之前的层,将线索对齐状态向无线索对应状态重建。在多个数据集与架构上进行验证。

Result: 跨数据集与架构一致观察到:局部性先于可撤销性下降——线索诱发的信息不再集中于其原始支撑区域,但其效应仍然活跃,随后进入"证据锁定"阶段。由此,固定的晚期纠偏可能只改变最终读出而无法消除累积的线索依赖;而Evidence Reset在锁定期前干预可更有效地撤销证据影响。

Conclusion: 论文将"证据可撤销性"确立为分类器可靠性的过程级维度,并提出新的干预原则:纠偏深度应随证据的动力学变化而定,而非事先固定。该框架为理解深度网络中的证据传播与失效机制提供了可解释的过程视角。

Abstract: Image classifiers are typically evaluated by their final predictions, treating inference as a static image-to-label mapping. Reliability, however, also depends on whether a model can relinquish evidence after that evidence disappears. We reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: removing a local visual cue from its original location may not remove its influence on the prediction. Once captured by early layers, the cue can become distributed across later representations, making ``no longer visible'' different from ``no longer relied upon.'' We introduce Inference Dynamics, a process-level framework for tracing how cue influence evolves and remains withdrawable across network depth. Given an image and a matched cue-removed reference, we replace cue-aligned states in the original branch with their reference counterparts at successive layers and measure recovery toward the cue-free prediction. The resulting trajectory separates evidence locality from decision-level withdrawability. Across datasets and architectures, we find locality declines before withdrawability collapses: cue-induced information becomes less concentrated at its original support while its effect remains active, before entering an evidence lock-in stage. Consequently, fixed late-stage correction may alter the final readout without removing accumulated cue dependence. We therefore propose Evidence Reset, which selects an input-dependent layer before lock-in and reconstructs cue-aligned states toward their cue-free counterparts. Our results establish evidence withdrawability as a process-level dimension of classifier reliability and suggest a new intervention principle: correction depth should follow the dynamics of evidence rather than be fixed in advance.

</details>


### [123] [NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28796)
*Kai Wu,Yufan Hu,Quan Fang,Boning Zhang,Junyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NavDecision：面向VLN的高效多步决策模型，用并行多步动作预测（PMAP）从共享视觉-语言状态一次输出多个动作分布，并用记忆增强自参照策略优化（M-SRPO）借助成功轨迹作为参照从失败轨迹中学习；4B骨干在R2R-CE/RxR-CE上达64.60%/64.57% SR，推理加速最高22.28×/18.96×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归VLN模型逐token生成动作描述，推理开销大；而直接用决策模型替代又难以兼顾短时域动作连贯性与长时域目标一致性。

Method: 并行多步动作预测（PMAP）：在共享视觉-语言表示上并行预测多步动作分布；记忆增强自参照策略优化（M-SRPO）：以成功轨迹为参照、从失败轨迹中学习；跨迭代成功记忆累积历史成功轨迹提供训练反馈。

Result: R2R-CE SR 64.60%、RxR-CE SR 64.57%（4B骨干）；相比现有自回归VLN方法最高22.28×与18.96×推理加速，导航性能相当。

Conclusion: 将VLN从逐token自回归生成改造为高效多步决策范式，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟，为实时具身导航部署提供可行路径。主要局限：仅验证于仿真基准，缺乏真实机器人部署证据。

Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires timely decisions based on instructions and visual observations. However, autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, introducing substantial inference overhead. Decision models offer an efficient alternative but face challenges in maintaining short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. To address these challenges, we propose NavDecision, an efficient multi-step VLN decision model. We introduce parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) to learn from unsuccessful trajectories using successful trajectories as references. A cross-iteration success memory further accumulates historical successful trajectories to provide informative training feedback. NavDecision achieves success rates of 64.60% on R2R-CE and 64.57% on RxR-CE with a 4B backbone. Compared with existing autoregressive VLN methods, it delivers significant inference speedups of up to $22.28\times$ and $18.96\times$ while maintaining comparable navigation performance.

</details>


### [124] [HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28800)
*Junyi Yang,Zheng Si,Yilin Zhai,Pengpeng Ouyang,Hongxi Wang,Kangze Li,Mo Chen,Sicong Zhang,Hua Wang,Dongyuan Wu,Dong Chen,Mingliang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HIIP-Chain（异常检测→识别→状况分析→养护决策）四阶段渐进式公路基础设施巡检基准HighwayVerse，含14,143条地面/UAV实检记录、84,858条专家审核问答；12个MLLM评测显示初始判断准确率高但链式Final分数显著偏低；并给出免训练检索增强框架LaneRAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准局限于孤立任务，无法评测MLLM在顺序巡检全流程上的诊断推理能力；且数据集多只覆盖路面病害，缺少护栏、防眩板、排水系统等多元公路构件，与真实巡检不符。

Method: 形式化HIIP-Chain四阶段链路；构建HighwayVerse多模态数据（地面100类、UAV 17类异常，专家标注QA）；用链式指标Final评测12个开源/闭源MLLM；提出免训练检索增强框架LaneRAG，注入分层参考知识作为引导。

Result: 模型在“是否存在异常”初判上准确率较高，但Final分数大幅下降，暴露下游识别、分析与决策能力薄弱；LaneRAG在多种MLLM上带来一致性能提升。

Conclusion: 当前MLLM对具体公路异常模式理解停留在表层判断，缺乏跨阶段诊断推理；检索增强的分层参考引导是有效且通用的低成本改进方向。数据集、基准与代码将公开。

Abstract: Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. HighwayVerse comprises 14,143 real-world Ground and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection records spanning 100 and 17 anomaly categories, respectively, with 84,858 expert-reviewed question-answer pairs. We evaluate 12 open-source and closed-source MLLMs using the chained metric Final, which credits a correct maintenance decision only when all preceding diagnostic stages are completed correctly. Results show that although models achieve relatively high accuracy when initially judging whether an anomaly is present, their markedly lower Final scores expose struggles across downstream recognition, analysis, and decision-making. This discrepancy indicates that current MLLMs do not fully comprehend specific highway anomaly patterns beyond superficial initial judgments. Furthermore, we propose LaneRAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that provides hierarchical reference guidance achieving consistent performance improvements across diverse MLLMs. Our dataset, evaluation benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [125] [Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28802)
*Ungbae Yoon,Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DecoFlat：将稀疏视图3DGS的梯度分解为平行/正交分量，发现沿正交方向扰动可提升泛化，据此提出正交扰动+冲突感知修正+SH颜色重调度的即插即用优化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏输入视图下3DGS易过拟合训练视角、在新视角退化；现有平坦极小值优化用随机噪声或沿训练梯度扰动高斯，但忽略了扰动方向相对于其他训练视角的关系。作者发现扰动方向本身决定了泛化是否改善。

Method: 把每个训练视图的梯度分解为与全局平均梯度平行的分量（视角间一致）和正交分量（视角间分歧）；实验表明沿正交分量扰动可提升泛化而沿平行分量不能。进一步发现平坦性修正常与重建梯度相反，导致重建步缩小甚至反转。基于此提出DecoFlat：对每个高斯沿正交分量叠加随机噪声扰动；冲突感知修正，剔除与重建梯度对立的平坦性修正部分；并重调度球谐颜色以减少视角相关外观的过拟合。作为插件式优化器使用。

Result: 在大量实验中，DecoFlat作为即插即用优化器，一致地提升原版3DGS及多种稀疏视图3DGS方法的性能。

Conclusion: 梯度扰动的方向性对稀疏视图泛化至关重要，正交方向扰动+冲突感知修正+外观重调度可有效缓解3DGS稀疏视角过拟合，且具良好通用性。

Abstract: Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. Perturbing along the orthogonal component improves generalization, whereas perturbing along the parallel component does not. We further find that the flatness correction often opposes the reconstruction gradient, shrinking or even reversing the reconstruction step. Based on these findings, we propose DecoFlat, which perturbs each Gaussian along the orthogonal component together with random noise. Furthermore, we introduce a conflict-aware correction, which removes the part of the flatness correction that opposes the reconstruction gradient, and a rescheduling of the spherical-harmonics color, which suppresses the overfitting of view-dependent appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoFlat, as a plug-in optimizer, consistently improves vanilla 3DGS and a wide range of sparse-view 3DGS methods.

</details>


### [126] [ViTrust: Learning 3D Observation Trust for Deformable Physical World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28815)
*Zhihao Guo,Zhihao Li,Xu Ge,Lijian Zhong,Yu Lu,Haitao Wu,Longqing Zhao,Yue Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViTrust 学习"3D观测信任度"，用视觉-接触信任适配器在持久接触图上结合逐点时空证据与交互历史，预测时变观测权重，并与物理参数单阶段联合优化，从而提升可变形物体物理辨识与未来预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠准确重建不能保证准确未来预测；而视觉可靠性本身不能决定某观测对物理动力学辨识的信息量，因此需要显式学习"每个跟踪点对物理辨识的影响强度"。

Method: 提出 visual-contact trust adapter：在持久接触图上融合逐点时空证据与交互历史，输出时变观测权重；单阶段共享前向目标，用加权几何损失与对应损失联合优化权重与物理参数，并加约束防止权重塌缩；仅用观测前缀学习，拟合物理固定后用于给定控制下的未来预测。

Result: 真实世界序列实验显示未来预测优于所评估基线；并给出新控制轨迹 rollout 与跨物体迁移的定性结果。

Conclusion: 将观测可信度建模为可学习的、接触感知的时变权重，可有效连接视觉跟踪与可变形物理参数辨识，改善泛化预测；实验以定性为主，定量规模与开源情况未说明。

Abstract: Learning deformable physical world models requires dynamics that generalize beyond observed motion. Accurate reconstruction alone does not ensure accurate future prediction, motivating us to learn how observations should influence physical identification. However, visual reliability alone does not determine how informative an observation is about physical dynamics. We propose ViTrust to learn 3D observation trust, determining how strongly each tracked point influences physical identification. Its key design is a visual-contact trust adapter that combines pointwise spatiotemporal evidence with interaction history on a persistent contact graph to predict time-varying observation weights. A single-stage, shared-forward objective jointly optimizes these weights and physical parameters through weighted geometry and correspondence losses, with constraints to prevent observation-weight collapse. All learning uses only the observed prefix. The fitted physics remains fixed for future prediction under supplied controls. Experiments on real-world sequences demonstrate improved future prediction over the evaluated baselines, alongside qualitative demonstrations of novel-control rollouts and cross-object transfer.

</details>


### [127] [PointNeXt Adapter Improved Model for BIM Component Defect Association under Construction Images and Design Model Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28820)
*Na Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PointNeXt+Adapter 模型，将施工现场图像裁剪、局部点云、BIM 构件属性（几何、材料、安装阶段、视角质量、来源可靠性）对齐到构件级巡检窗口，实现缺陷与 BIM 构件的可追溯关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现场缺陷（裂缝、剥落、缺套管、错位支座）只有绑定构件身份、位置、责任方与设计意图才具质控价值，而现有图像或点云方法缺乏 BIM 属性语义注入。

Method: 将图像裁剪、局部点云块与 BIM 标识/几何/材料/工序/检查距离/视点质量/来源可靠性标签组织为构件级巡检窗口；PointNeXt 学局部几何与实建偏差，Adapter 注入 BIM 属性使同类几何异常在结构、围护、机电、预埋构件中语义不同；融合头输出构件链接、缺陷类别、概率、置信度、主导证据与复核建议。在合成多源数据集上测试重复布局、遮挡、稀疏点云、配准误差与未见构件排布。

Result: 属性感知点学习相比纯图像、纯点云、简单融合与无 Adapter 基线，在关联准确率、缺陷召回与置信度校准上均更优；但证据仅来自合成数据集。

Conclusion: 框架定位为可追溯的 BIM 问题复核辅助工具，需人工确认与分阶段现场验证后方可部署；离真实工地泛化与自动化闭环尚有距离。

Abstract: Construction site defect analysis increasingly requires linking field evidence to the correct BIM object, because a crack, spalling area, missing sleeve or misaligned support is useful for quality control only when it is connected with component identity, location, responsibility and design intent. This paper proposes a PointNeXt Adapter improved model for BIM component defect association under construction images and design model attributes. The method aligns site image crops, local point cloud patches, BIM component identifiers, geometry attributes, material categories, installation stage, inspection distance, viewpoint quality and source reliability tags into component level inspection windows. PointNeXt learns local geometry and deviation from as built point evidence, while the adapter injects BIM attributes so the same geometric irregularity can be interpreted differently for structural, envelope, MEP and embedded components. The fusion head outputs component link, defect class, defect probability, confidence, dominant evidence and recommended review action. A synthetic multisource BIM inspection dataset is used to evaluate repeated layouts, occlusion, sparse point clouds, registration errors and unseen component arrangements. Results show that attribute aware point learning improves association accuracy, defect recall and confidence calibration compared with image only, point only, simple fusion and adapter free baselines. The framework is positioned as traceable BIM issue review support, requiring manual confirmation and staged field validation before operational deployment.

</details>


### [128] [Omni-H3-Image: Constrained Foundation Priors Usher in a New Era of All-in-One Blind Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28836)
*Zihao He,Songhua Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Omni-H3，在冻结的 MiniMax-H3-Image 与 Qwen3-VL-32B 之上做三阶段约束后验投影（气象预条件 + 32px 栅格锚定 + YCbCr 仿射-Wiener-Butterworth 联合投影 + 闭环文本校验/亚奈奎斯特弃权），仅需 0.92M 辅助参数，将退化场景 PSNR 从 16.74 dB 提升到 21.47 dB 并取得多项指标第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用统一图像模型能生成锐利纹理，但在真实退化复原场景中存在空间漂移、色度幻觉与语义捏造，PSNR 仅 11–17 dB。作者希望在不改动百亿级主干权重的前提下，用极小开销的约束投影把生成式先验"拉回"到物理与几何一致的解空间。

Method: 三阶段近似约束后验投影框架：(1) 盲物理-VLM 感知，通过 0.92M 参数的天气预条件器与 Qwen3-VL-32B 进行退化感知；(2) 精确 32 px 栅格锚定 + 在对抗性 YCbCr 空间中的仿射-Wiener-Butterworth 联合投影；(3) 闭环 Z=4 文本验证与亚奈奎斯特弃权机制。仅在原始 MiniMax-H3-Image 与 Qwen3-VL-32B 之上外挂，不改主干。

Result: 在 925 个盲任务、11 个外部 SOTA 基线上：退化场景 PSNR 21.47 dB（Base H3 16.74 dB，+4.73 dB；较其他 omni 主干 +6.27–10.14 dB）；429 个退化公共场景上 DISTS 0.207、NIQE 4.45、Edge-F1 0.807 均第一，MUSIQ 66.8（判别式 SOTA 为 40–44）；CBSD68 Clean 76.59 dB；Urban100 色度漂移降低 91.6%；2K Dev Non-Clean DISTS 0.202、locked_test 2K DISTS 0.173 均第一；PP-OCRv4 下 132-ROI SubCER 由 0.456 降至 0.319（TrOCR-large-str 下有依赖识别器的权衡）。

Conclusion: 以极轻量外挂式后验投影即可显著修复大规模统一图像模型的保真度缺陷，在多项感知与结构指标上超越专判别式复原 SOTA；但增益主要来自测试时约束与多模型编排，未涉及具身/3D/世界模型等本文核心方向，且结果高度依赖指标组合与识别器选择，需审慎看待 PSNR 类比较口径。

Abstract: Off-the-shelf unified image models such as 33B MiniMax-H3-Image, FLUX.1-Kontext, and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 synthesize crisp textures yet collapse to 11.33-16.74 dB PSNR across 429 degraded public restoration scenes due to spatial drift, chromatic hallucination, and semantic fabrication. We present Omni-H3-Image (Omni-H3), an approximate three-stage constrained posterior projection framework over unmodified MiniMax-H3-Image and Qwen3-VL-32B using only a 0.92M-parameter auxiliary weather pre-conditioner (<0.003% of backbone weights). Omni-H3 unifies blind physics-VLM sensing with exact-32 px lattice anchoring, joint affine-Wiener-Butterworth projection in opponent YCbCr space, and closed-loop Z=4 text verification with sub-Nyquist abstention. Across 925 blind tasks against 11 external SOTA baselines -- five public benchmarks (N=647), Dev-160, and a held-out locked_test suite (N=118) -- Omni-H3 recovers +4.73 dB degraded-scene PSNR over Base H3 (21.47 vs. 16.74 dB; +6.27-10.14 dB over other omni backbones) while winning overall #1 DISTS (0.207), #1 NIQE (4.45), and #1 Edge-F1 (0.807) on all 429 degraded public scenes (MUSIQ 66.8 vs. 40-44 for discriminative SOTA), 76.59 dB on CBSD68 Clean, -91.6% Urban100 chroma drift, #1 2K Dev Non-Clean DISTS (0.202), and #1 locked_test 2K DISTS (0.173) and 132-ROI SubCER, cutting pre-annotated 132-ROI SubCER from 0.456 to 0.319 under non-Qwen RapidOCR (PP-OCRv4) (with recognizer-dependent tradeoffs under TrOCR-large-str).

</details>


### [129] [Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28839)
*Qihang Chen,Tengjie Li,Hongwei Lu,Jason Wu,Chyna Qu,Shikui Tu,Lei Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SG-LL 将"接地空间状态"作为预测参照：冻结空间教师蒸馏几何先验到空间 token，再用当前条件瓶颈学习相对当前场景的可操作近未来隐表示，并从当前策略上下文与初始 Action Expert 特征预测该隐表示，零初始化残差融合回 Action Expert 以改进动作生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型语义表征强但缺乏精确空间定位与场景演化估计；现有几何感知方法只显式化当前场景，预测类方法虽建模未来观测/表示，但未来信息既未锚定在控制相关的空间状态上，也未被直接用于指导动作生成。

Method: 三阶段：(1) 冻结空间教师向策略侧空间 token 蒸馏几何先验；(2) 当前条件瓶颈学习紧凑隐变量，编码"相对于当前场景"的未来信息；(3) 仅由当前策略上下文与初始 Action Expert 特征预测该隐变量（不使用未来观测或教师），经零初始化残差融合注入 Action Expert 精化动作生成。

Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN 及三个真实机器人操作任务上，相较基线在仿真与真机设置下均有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 以"接地现在"为参照的隐空间前瞻是可用的动作条件化机制，避免了对未来观测或教师的推理期依赖，真机验证支持其实际部署价值。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from strong semantic representations that support object recognition and instruction understanding. However, precise manipulation also depends on resolving object locations and workspace relations, and on selecting actions with an estimate of how the scene will evolve. Existing geometry-aware methods make the current scene more explicit, while predictive methods model future observations or representations. Yet future information is often neither grounded in a control-relevant spatial state nor directly used to guide action generation. We introduce Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead (SG-LL), which uses the grounded present as the reference for predicting an actionable near-future representation. A frozen spatial teacher first distills geometric priors into policy-connected spatial tokens. A current-conditioned bottleneck then learns a compact latent that captures future information relative to the present scene. This latent is predicted from the current policy context and initial Action Expert features, without access to future observations or the spatial teacher. Finally, zero-initialized residual fusion incorporates the predicted latent into the Action Expert to refine action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and three real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements over in both simulation and real-robot settings.

</details>


### [130] [Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation for Synthetic Segmentation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28841)
*Chunming He,Dingming Zhang,Jifan Zhang,Yuhan Dong,Longxiang Tang,Youwei Pang,Xiaoqi Zhao,Fengyang Xiao,Sina Farsiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TCDA：用小任务参考模型的类别响应在模糊前后的变化与标注区域的对齐程度，给合成图像打"细节分配分数"，据此筛选候选并指导局部修复，用原标签与同一下游分割器训练，在COD10K与ACDC上优于随机与标签一致子集挑选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成图像即使共享同一分割标签，其训练价值也不同；作者想验证标注区域内的图像细节是否提供类别特定线索，并据此挑选、修复对下游分割真正有用的候选样本。

Method: 在冻结的真实图像特征上训练小任务参考模型；对每个候选图做模糊扰动，比较其类别响应前后变化，计算响应变化与标注区域的对齐度得到 detail allocation score，用于同源候选排序；将该分数与真实源图像的响应-标签对齐度比较，指导是否修复及多类任务中修复哪些区域；入选与修复后的图像沿用原标签训练，下游分割器结构不变。

Result: 在伪装目标检测、退化显著目标检测、恶劣条件语义分割三类任务上，选择子集优于同规模随机子集与标签一致子集；选择加修复相比只用真实数据训练，COD10K 的 S_α 提升至多 0.019，ACDC 的 mIoU 提升 2.86 点。

Conclusion: 细节对齐度可作为合成数据训练价值的有效代理指标，选择与局部修复互补，可低成本提升下游分割性能，且无需改动分割器或标签。

Abstract: Synthetic images sharing a segmentation label can differ in their training value. We propose Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation (TCDA) to select useful candidates and locally edit some remaining images. We ask whether image details provide class-specific cues in the regions marked by the label. We train a small task reference on frozen image features from real training images. We compare its class responses before and after blurring each candidate, and score how well these response changes align with the labeled regions. This detail allocation score ranks candidates from the same source. Comparing their response--label alignment with that of the real source image also guides repair decisions and, in multiclass tasks, the choice of regions to edit. Selected candidates and accepted repairs are used for training with the original labels and the unchanged downstream segmenter. Experiments on camouflaged object detection, degraded salient object detection, and adverse-condition semantic segmentation show that our selection outperforms equally sized random and label-agreement subsets. Combining selection and repair improves over real-only training by up to 0.019 in $S_\alpha$ on COD10K and 2.86 mIoU points on ACDC.

</details>


### [131] [Learning How a Body Moves: Few-Shot Body Inference for Visual World Models of Animated Characters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28842)
*Amarnath R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 in-context 世界模型：用角色其他动作片段编码"身体表征"，配合对比损失区分外观相同但动力学不同的角色；并发布 ToonTwins 基准（144 个 2D 卡通角色）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭首帧和动作指令，视觉世界模型无法区分外观完全一致但刚/弹动力学不同的"双胞胎"角色，需要从其他动作片段中推断身体动力学属性。

Method: 以角色其他动作片段作为 in-context 输入，编码为 body code（身体表征）注入隐像素世界模型；用对比损失推动相似外观角色的表征分离；构建 ToonTwins 基准（144 个 2D 卡通角色，按动力学分为 4 个外观相同组，动作含跑/跳/落/转/蹲），并在 DeformingThings4D 的 32 个动画动物上评测。

Result: 隐像素世界模型最多仅还原 25% 的双胞胎跳跃高度差异；新形状上正确识别双胞胎比例 85.9%（transformer 基线 76.7%），对比损失贡献超过一半增益；DeformingThings4D 上平均路径预测误差相对无身体信息模型降低 8.5%。

Conclusion: 从上下文动作片段推断身体动力学表征可显著提升世界模型对同外观不同动力学对象的辨识能力，但像素级动力学一致性仍远未解决；基准与对比损失设计为后续研究提供可评测平台。

Abstract: Two visually identical animated characters can respond differently to the same action command because their body dynamics differ. For example, a stiff blob and its bouncy twin reach different heights when both receive the jump command. Given only the first frame and the action command, a visual world model has no information to distinguish these twins, because their initial appearances are identical. We therefore propose an in-context world model that encodes clips of a character's other actions into a body representation, using a contrastive loss to separate look-alike characters. We introduce ToonTwins, a benchmark of 144 2D cartoon characters that run, jump, fall, turn and crouch. Its characters form look-alike groups of four that differ only in their dynamics profile, and we also evaluate the model on 32 animated animals from DeformingThings4D. Even with a body code from these clips, the latent pixel world model we tested recovered at most 25 percent of the twins' jump height difference. On new shapes, our model identified the correct twin in 85.9 percent of cases, compared with 76.7 percent for a transformer baseline that reads the same clips without a body summary, and in a controlled ablation the contrastive loss gave more than half of this gain. On the animated animals, it reduced the mean path prediction error by 8.5 percent against a model without body information.

</details>


### [132] [MQCODet: Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization for UAV-Based RGB-T Tiny Pedestrian Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28850)
*Hui Li,Jianbo Ma,Hui Luo,Guanglin Qi,Zhixing Wang,Haorui Zuo,Jianlin Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MQCODet无人机RGB-T微小行人检测器，将模态质量从融合先验升级为定位监督线索，通过DCRF动态校准与区域感知融合、ECI上下文交互编码器、MAA模态感知自适应损失，在边缘平台实时运行并超越两个基准SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV RGB-T微小行人检测面临跨模态空间异构问题：模态质量不平衡与空间位置错位。现有RGB-T检测器仅在特征融合阶段处理这些问题，未建立特征融合与目标定位之间的有效耦合，导致检测性能次优。

Method: MQCODet框架包含三部分：(1) Dynamic Calibration and Region-Aware Fusion (DCRF) 模块，渐进细化跨模态空间对齐并做区域感知融合，输出可靠多尺度特征与场景级模态质量先验；(2) Efficient Contextual Interaction (ECI) 编码器，增强多尺度特征交互同时保留细粒度空间细节；(3) Modality-Aware Adaptive (MAA) 损失，结合模态先验与目标尺度自适应平衡空间一致性与几何相似性用于定位监督。

Result: 在两个UAV RGB-T微小行人检测基准上超过现有SOTA方法，并在边缘计算平台实现实时推理。

Conclusion: 将模态质量先验同时用于融合与定位监督是提升跨模态微小目标检测的有效范式；方法在精度与边缘实时性上取得兼顾，但属特定航空遥感场景的任务专用检测改进。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based RGB-thermal (RGB-T) remote sensing provides complementary visual and thermal information for pedestrian perception under complex aerial observation conditions. However, detecting tiny pedestrians in UAV-based RGB-T imagery remains challenging due to cross-modal spatial heterogeneity, manifested as modality quality imbalance and spatial position misalignment. Existing RGB-T detectors primarily address these challenges at the feature fusion stage, without establishing an effective coupling between feature fusion and object localization, potentially resulting in suboptimal detection performance. To address this limitation, we introduce a Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization Detector (MQCODet), which extends modality quality from a fusion prior to a localization supervision cue. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Calibration and Region-Aware Fusion (DCRF) module that progressively refines cross-modal spatial alignment and performs region-aware fusion to generate reliable multi-scale features and a scene-level modality quality prior. We further design an Efficient Contextual Interaction (ECI) encoder to enhance multi-scale feature interaction while preserving fine-grained spatial details. Moreover, we propose a Modality-Aware Adaptive (MAA) loss that incorporates the modality prior and object scale to adaptively balance spatial consistency and geometric similarity for localization supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MQCODet surpasses state-of-the-art methods on two UAV-based RGB-T tiny pedestrian detection benchmarks while achieving real-time inference on the edge platform.

</details>


### [133] [CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28853)
*Zelin Zheng,Difei Wu,Xinyan Liu,Minghong Chen,Antoni B. Chan,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CivilCADBench——基于真实土木工程图纸与源 CAD 文件（>25 万 CAD 实体）的多模态大模型基准，覆盖图纸理解、重建（单页/整套转换为可编辑 CAD）与设计三类任务，用确定性评分器对比几何、图层、文字与标注；七个前沿 MLLM 在理解与单页重绘上超 90%，但图层归属仅约 60%、设计仅 48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 土木基础设施的建造与维护依赖工程图纸集，其绘制与修改高度人工密集、亟需自动化；MLLM 是潜在候选，但缺少扎根真实工程实践的评测基准，且打印件是丢失图层信息的投影，导致"打印正确但文件组织错误"的隐性缺陷无法被现有评测发现。

Method: 以真实基础设施图纸及源 CAD 文件构建基准；设计三类难度递增任务：（1）理解（2,183 道专家审核问题，单页至整套）；（2）重建（智能体式，将打印页还原为可编辑 CAD，分单页与整套）；（3）设计（生成新方案）；覆盖 232 页、28 套图、19 个设计任务；采用确定性评分器，在几何、图层、文本、尺寸四个维度与设计师源文件逐项比对。

Result: 七个前沿 MLLM 能准确读取与重绘打印内容，但文件结构恢复能力差：最佳模型在理解与单页重建上超过 90%，图层分配仅约 60%，设计任务仅 48%。

Conclusion: CivilCADBench 以真实工程实践为锚，揭示了前沿模型在专业土木工程中的能力边界（感知强、结构化表征弱），为下一代智能土木工程的模型与智能体系统提供评测基础。

Abstract: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

</details>


### [134] [KineState-SWAM: A Surgical World Action Model with Explicit Kinematics and Causal Interaction Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28871)
*Rulin Zhou,Yujie Ma,Rui Tang,Qiujie Song,Wanhao Liu,Guoheng Ma,Liangjing Shao,An Wang,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KineState-SWAM：以外科手术为场景的世界-动作模型，用持久交互状态解耦"运动学决定的器械运动"与"学习得到的场景演化"，通过流匹配策略+几何条件+因果交互动态实现动作预测与视频生成耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术世界模型隐式处理两件事：器械运动如何驱动局部组织响应、交互历史如何影响后续动作。二者未被显式建模，导致长时序预测与动作精度受限。

Method: 1) 流匹配策略以交互状态、机器人构型、任务指令为条件预测关节轨迹；2) Kinematic Geometry Conditioning 用标定 URDF 将轨迹转为表面运动 token 与空间对齐的器械渲染；3) Causal Interaction Dynamics 通过几何引导注意力与运动对齐特征传输递归更新状态，无需中间视频合成即可把历史带入后续动作预测；4) State-Geometry Adapter 以状态相关空间调制+局部几何残差引导视频生成；5) 交互感知监督聚焦器械工作区附近组织响应。构建 dVRK-Chole5.2k 数据集（5,255 视频，17 任务）。

Result: 在匹配动作条件的设定下，动作精度与视频保真度均优于评估基线；消融实验支持"保留并传输交互状态"对长时序预测的必要性。

Conclusion: 显式分离运动学确定分量与学习演化分量、并以持久状态承载交互历史，是提升手术世界-动作模型长时序一致性的有效范式。

Abstract: Existing surgical world models often leave implicit how instrument motion drives localized tissue responses and how interaction history informs subsequent actions. We introduce KineState-SWAM, a surgical world-action model coupling action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, separating kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution. A flow-matching policy predicts joint trajectories conditioned on interaction state, robot configuration, and task instruction. Kinematic Geometry Conditioning converts these trajectories into surface-motion tokens and spatially aligned instrument renderings using calibrated URDF kinematics. Causal Interaction Dynamics recurrently updates the state through geometry-guided attention and motion-aligned feature transport, carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis. The State-Geometry Adapter combines state-dependent spatial modulation with localized geometric residuals to guide video generation. Interaction-aware supervision emphasizes tissue responses near instrument working regions. We introduce dVRK-Chole5.2k, comprising 5,255 videos spanning 17 surgical tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved action accuracy and video fidelity over evaluated baselines within matched action-conditioning settings. Ablations support preserving and transporting interaction states for long-horizon prediction.

</details>


### [135] [SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28872)
*Yihang Zou,Chunmei Qing,Ruixi Liang,Haichuan Wei,Junpeng Tan,Qifan Yang,Wanxiang Luo,Haodong Li,Xiangmin Xu,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SENSA：用“共享响应先验+图像特异残差”解耦视觉到大脑的编码框架，仅需400对校准数据即可实现跨被试EEG/NSD响应生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉到大脑编码受三类问题制约：共享活动与图像特异活动难以解耦、被试间分布偏移、表征异质性，导致少校准数据下编码精度与跨被试泛化差。

Method: 独立响应先验建模共享活动；互补视觉描述子驱动可分离的传感器-时间基与共享Response Refiner；Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport调节共享基的时空表达，Source-Grounded Residual Memory在源响应坐标中预测图像相关修正；以少量配对支持集个性化冻结生成器。

Result: 骨干生成器在三个数据集上优于近期生成器；图像身份扰动实验验证刺激特异性；仅400对图像校准下EEG与NSD的残差Pearson相关达0.1091与0.2995。

Conclusion: 结构化分解+紧凑被试状态是解决少样本跨被试神经响应生成的有效路线，但其验证限于感知编码，未涉及具身/3D任务。

Abstract: Visual-to-brain encoding predicts neural responses to visual stimuli, supporting visual cognition research and neural decoding. However, challenges in disentangling shared from image-specific activity, together with inter-subject distribution shifts and representational heterogeneity, limit accurate encoding and cross-subject generalization with limited calibration data. We introduce SENSA, a structured continuous neural response generation framework that separates shared activity from image-dependent responses and calibrates a compact subject state. An independent response prior captures shared activity, while complementary visual descriptors drive separable sensor-time bases and a shared Response Refiner. Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport adjusts the spatiotemporal expression of shared bases, while Source-Grounded Residual Memory predicts image-dependent corrections in source-response coordinates. Together, they personalize a frozen generator using limited paired support. Experiments demonstrate that the generation backbone outperforms recent generators across three datasets, with image-identity perturbations confirming stimulus specificity. Using only 400 paired images, electroencephalography (EEG) and the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) calibration achieve residual Pearson correlations of 0.1091 and 0.2995, respectively, demonstrating effective brain-response generation and cross-subject adaptation.

</details>


### [136] [Eidetic Code World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28878)
*Wenqing Tian,Zijian Zhang,Qiang Liu,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Paintress：代码条件的世界模型，将可执行几何代理与独立参数化的3D高斯外观记忆耦合于统一度量坐标系，通过"写读分离"实现持久外观保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成式世界模型在相机离开已访问区域后，会篡改先前场景的外观，即使可执行代码代理能保持结构布局，视觉一致性仍难维持。

Method: 用可执行几何代理约束结构与可见性，3D高斯承载视觉外观；新帧经置信度门控写入持久原始高斯图，克隆的reader副本对照观测档案全局精修并经覆盖掩码渲染以条件化生成。另构建Expedition-33基准（11场景×5路线族×15/30/60s缺席，共165设置/系统），目标不入首帧、在共享前缀中合成、以各系统自身首次访问为参照评分。

Result: 10个系统共1650段视频，Paintress达ROI-LPIPS 0.1220、MAE 0.0613、细节保持率52.12%（CWM为0.2731/0.1401/10.91%）；60s缺席时误差0.1630，仍低于CWM、AgentGarten、Lyra 2.0在15s时的表现。

Conclusion: 写读分离的几何-外观解耦是维持长时序生成式场景重访一致性的有效范式，并提供了可复用的外观保持评测基准。

Abstract: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

</details>


### [137] [Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28890)
*Wang-Chi-Shiun,Wei-Huan Hu,Liu-En-Chi,Liu Zhi Shun,ChengYi Peng,Shin-Jye Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出支持感知重校准模块SAR，在MultiverSeg支持-查询融合后加入大核空间门控与SE通道重校准，并在受控一键式协议下评估医学分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏提示（one-click）医学分割中，提示、支持集、阈值与数据划分不一致使方法难以公平比较；作者希望建立无泄漏的受控评估协议并在此协议下提升支持-查询融合效果。

Method: 受控一键协议：每张测试图仅给一个前景正点击，支持集仅用训练集，用验证集选择checkpoint，测试时不做阈值调优；在MultiverSeg的支持-查询晚期融合之后加入SAR重校准块，由大核空间门控和squeeze-and-excitation通道重校准组成。在BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present、Kvasir-SEG上以697个前景样本预算、共享划分与点击、无阈值Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC评估。

Result: 与协议匹配的raw-support MultiverSeg基线相比，主SAR配置在三个数据集上均值Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC表现更优，同时在本实现中记录的训练时间减少。

Conclusion: 在泄漏受控的一键协议下，融合后晚期重校准有效，但增益幅度与统计显著性未充分报告，属医学域CV的增量模块。

Abstract: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.

</details>


### [138] [Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28901)
*Séraphin Baributsa,Keqi Chen,Vinkle Srivastav,Nicolas Padoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EgoExOR-Gaze 基准与多视角注视图（gaze graph）生成架构，仅用外视角相机联合估计 3D 注视目标与关注场景实体，并用于细粒度手术动作识别与语义场景图生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术室 gaze-following 研究仅估计 2D 注视点，无法识别所关注的实体或在 3D 空间中定位注视目标；作者希望用场景级表征（gaze graph）在外视角条件下刻画临床医生视觉注意力。

Method: 扩展 EgoExOR 数据集构建首个手术室多视角 gaze graph 生成基准；利用 3D 注视几何在多视角上采样局部视觉特征以预测关注实体；联合估计 3D 注视目标，并将预测的 gaze graph 接入手术动作识别与 SSG 生成。

Result: gaze graph 生成优于纯外视角与内外视角融合基线；手术动作识别在所有指标上超越外视角与内视角基线，时序指标提升尤为明显；SSG 生成 macro-F1 从 0.42 提升至 0.52，但仍低于内视角输入。

Conclusion: gaze graph 对手术动作识别与场景图生成有价值，说明即使缺少内视角视频，显式建模场景级视觉注意力仍然重要。

Abstract: Purpose: Analyzing clinicians' visual attention from exocentric camera views can support surgical scene understanding without requiring wearable eye trackers. However, existing gaze-following research in the operating room (OR) estimates only 2D gaze locations without identifying attended scene entities or localizing gaze targets in 3D space. In this work, we investigate gaze graphs as a scene-level representation of visual attention that connects clinicians to attended scene entities, and evaluate their utility for fine-grained surgical action recognition and semantic scene graph (SSG) generation. Methods: We extend the public EgoExOR dataset with gaze annotations to create EgoExOR-Gaze, the first benchmark for multi-view gaze graph generation in the OR. We propose a novel architecture that jointly estimates 3D gaze targets and predicts attended entities using only exocentric camera views. Specifically, our approach exploits 3D gaze geometry to sample local visual features across multiple views for attended entity prediction. We further utilize predicted gaze graphs for fine-grained surgical action recognition and SSG generation. Results: For gaze graph generation, our model outperforms both exocentric-only and combined exocentric-egocentric baselines. For surgical action recognition, our model incorporating predicted gaze graphs outperforms both exocentric and egocentric baselines across all evaluated metrics, with particularly strong gains in temporal metrics. For SSG generation, incorporating gaze graphs improves macro-F1 from 0.42 to 0.52 compared to exocentric inputs alone, although performance remains below that achieved with egocentric inputs. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate the value of gaze graphs for surgical action recognition and SSG generation, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling scene-level visual attention even when egocentric views are unavailable.

</details>


### [139] [From Dense to Sparse: Morton-Ordered Sparse Mapping for Efficient 3D Mesh Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28913)
*Junjie Yang,Rui Qian,Yijiang Li,Jinyi Xu,Yuhao Yan,Xinjian Yi,Yanfeng Li,Mingxuan Li,Xiang Wan,Jicong Fan,Siqi Liu,Ahmed Elazab,Changmiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPAC 提出共享稀疏 SDF 词表，将稀疏 SDF VQ-VAE（保留近表面特征与显式坐标）与可逆的 3D-BPE 空间合并结合，在 Morton 序列化后用同一 LLM 同时做 3D 描述生成与文本条件网格生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一 3D 理解与生成需要紧凑且保序的序列表示：稠密体素网格序列过长，而简单序列化会割裂空间邻居关系，因此需要一种压缩后仍保持空间邻近结构与精确可逆解码的表示。

Method: 1) Sparse SDF VQ-VAE：仅在近表面区域量化特征并保留显式坐标，以重建监督保证表面精度与细节；2) 3D-BPE：在序列化前按相对偏移合并重复的面邻接模式，宏 token 可精确展开为叶 token 与坐标；3) Morton 序列化后由共享 LLM 统一建模，几何 token 用于 captioning，预测 token 解码为 mesh 用于文本条件生成；并给出固定带宽下稀疏编码器开销随分辨率近似二次增长的复杂度分析。

Result: 3D-BPE 使平均完整 LLM 序列长度（含坐标、文本、控制 token）降低 45.4%；3D captioning 与文本条件 mesh 生成均取得强结果；消融显示相对叶 token 与 Morton 1D-BPE 在两任务上均有提升。

Conclusion: 稀疏+可逆空间合并的共享 3D token 词表可同时支撑理解与生成，验证了保留空间结构对统一 3D 多模态建模的价值；但评估为数据集级指标，缺乏真实部署或野外泛化证据。

Abstract: Unified 3D understanding and generation require compact sequences preserving spatial structure. Dense grids yield long sequences, while serialization can separate spatial neighbors. We propose Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC), a shared sparse SDF vocabulary combining sparse encoding with reversible spatial merging. A Sparse SDF VQ-VAE quantizes near-surface features while retaining explicit coordinates, using reconstruction supervision for surface fidelity and detail. 3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) merges recurring face-adjacent patterns using relative offsets before serialization. Macro tokens expand exactly into leaf tokens and coordinates. After Morton serialization, a shared LLM reads geometry for captioning and predicts tokens that decode into meshes for text-conditioned generation. With fixed geometry, architecture, and band width in voxels, sparse encoder cost grows approximately quadratically with resolution. 3D-BPE reduces mean complete LLM sequence length by 45.4 percent, including coordinates, text, and control tokens. SPAC achieves strong results in both 3D captioning and text-conditioned mesh generation. Ablations show gains over leaf tokens and Morton 1D-BPE in both tasks. The project page at this https URL .

</details>


### [140] [Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28917)
*Haomeng Zhang,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多样3D可供性定位新任务与Div3DAffordNet集合预测模型，并用2D生成+3D重建自动合成数据构建Div3DAfford基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D可供性定位只预测单一掩码，忽略了人-物交互的多样性；同时缺少多样的3D可供性数据。

Method: 基于Transformer的集合预测（set prediction）模型输出多掩码可供性区域；用2D生成模型结合3D重建的自动化流程合成可供性数据，辅以轻量人工校验（标注时间降至1/72）。

Result: 多掩码设定下GED-SIM从0.745降至0.492，单掩码标准基准保持19.0 mIoU，SOTA。

Conclusion: 多样性3D可供性定位是更贴近真实交互的任务设定；自动合成数据可低成本扩展该类训练数据。

Abstract: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

</details>


### [141] [PIAE: Physics-Informed Continuous Autoencoding for Compact 3D Human Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28922)
*Osama Alshammari,Omar Mohammed,Kerven Durdymyradov,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PIAE 是一种物理信息驱动的连续自编码器，在固定 token 预算下将 32 维显式物理载体（根速度/朝向）与 224 维学习特征分离编码，显著提升压缩运动重建的全局轨迹与关节精度，并可直接接入文生动作生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间压缩虽缩短序列长度，却破坏关节细节与全局轨迹；而根速度与朝向误差会经轨迹恢复传播，影响全身空间定位，因此需在压缩表示中对不同信号进行非等权保留。

Method: 在 8× 时间压缩下，每个 256 维 token 拆分为 224 维学习值与 32 维物理解释载体（根速度、朝向等运动学信号）；完整 token 用于神经解码条件，并设并行恢复路径约束特定输出。通过 frozen-checkpoint 诊断、仅根与显式根混合对照、不同载体（躯干参考 vs 支撑锚点）消融，以及在冻结 8× AE 上训练文生动作生成器验证可预测性。

Result: HumanML3D 上全局 MPJPE 8.936 mm，较同宽度纯学习模型降低 82.0%；冻结检查点诊断中朝向-局部误差下降 76.6%，且给定相同真值轨迹仍保持身体质量优势；文生动作 FID 由 0.506 降至 0.163；冻结重建无需适配迁移至 AIST++；生成耗时相对 1× 版本降低 27.8%。

Conclusion: 选择性保留物理量可在固定表示预算下更高效地分配信息，同时改善关节化重建与下游生成；载体设计存在权衡——躯干参考利于位置精度，支撑锚点利于支撑质量。

Abstract: Temporal compression reduces the sequence length that motion generators must model, but can damage articulated detail and global trajectory. These errors have unequal consequences: root-velocity and heading errors propagate through trajectory recovery and affect the placement of the entire body. We propose PIAE, a physics-informed continuous autoencoder that allocates a fixed token budget between explicitly retained kinematic signals and complementary learned features. At 8 x temporal compression, each 256-dimensional token contains 224 learned values and a 32-dimensional physical carrier. The complete token conditions neural decoding, while a parallel recovery path constrains selected outputs. On the official HumanML3D benchmark, PIAE achieves 8.936 mm global MPJPE, an 82.0% reduction relative to a same-width learned-only model. The benefit extends beyond trajectory restoration: facing-local neural-body error before analytical correction decreases by 76.6% in a frozen-checkpoint validation diagnostic, and supplying the same true trajectory to both models preserves the body-quality advantage. Targeted root-only and explicit-root hybrid controls establish strong trajectory-aware comparisons; alternative carriers reveal that torso references favor position accuracy, whereas stance anchors favor support quality. With the original 8 x AEs frozen, matched text-to-motion generators predict every carrier value and improve FID from 0.506 to 0.163. Frozen reconstruction also transfers to AIST++ without adaptation. The compressed carrier interface reduces measured generation time by 27.8% relative to its 1 x counterpart. Together, these findings demonstrate that selective preservation can use a fixed representation budget more effectively, improving neural articulated reconstruction and downstream generation in compact human motion.

</details>


### [142] [XShot: Cross-Shot Video Object Insertion from a Reference Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28942)
*Bangxun Tang,Chen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XShot 提出跨镜头视频物体插入框架：以另一镜头的参考视频同时提供物体外观与位置，基于视频 DiT 做 in-context 生成，并用几何感知跨镜头注意力（自估计极线几何）引导参考读取，配合 erase-and-restore 数据引擎训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影视/多机位场景由多个镜头共同呈现，插入到某一镜头的物体须在其他镜头中保持一致。现有视频编辑工具从参考图取外观、从文本/掩码/编辑帧取位置，跨镜头一致性完全交给用户，且往往需要对齐、掩码、框或相机位姿。

Method: 构建于视频 Diffusion Transformer 之上，将任务形式化为对“参考视频 + 若干物体图像 + 目标视频”的 in-context 生成；提出 geometry-aware cross-shot attention，利用模型自身对应关系估计两镜头间极线几何，并据此引导目标镜头从参考视频与 exemplar 的读取位置；无需掩码、框或相机位姿。训练采用 erase-and-restore 数据引擎：从影片或多机位录制的一个镜头中擦除物体，再从同场景另一镜头恢复。

Result: 实验显示 XShot 在物体放置准确度与渲染保真度上优于开源与商业视频编辑器，同时保持镜头其余内容不变。

Conclusion: 以几何感知的跨镜头注意力把多视图一致性显式注入视频生成模型，是实现无位姿、无掩码跨镜头物体插入的可行路径，并为该任务提供了可扩展的自监督训练数据构造方式。

Abstract: We present XShot, a framework for cross-shot video object insertion, which adds objects to a shot by watching another shot of the same scene. Video productions show a scene through many shots, and objects added to one shot must appear consistently in the others. Most video editors take the appearance of new objects from reference images and their location from a text prompt, a mask or an edited keyframe, leaving this consistency to the user. XShot reads both from a reference video of another shot, which need not be aligned with the target, and needs no mask, box or camera pose. We build on a video Diffusion Transformer and formulate the task as in-context generation over the reference video, a few images of the objects and the target video. A geometry-aware cross-shot attention estimates the epipolar geometry between the two shots from the model's own correspondences and uses it to guide where the target reads the reference and the exemplars. We train XShot with an erase-and-restore data engine: objects are erased from one shot of a film or a multi-camera recording and restored from another shot of the scene. Experiments show that XShot places objects more accurately and renders them more faithfully than open-source and commercial video editors, while leaving the rest of the shot intact.

</details>


### [143] [Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28963)
*Suya Li,Zekun Qi,Xiaochong Xu,Duo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LandWM：以降雨为"动作"、由SMAP与CYGNSS观测学习的地表水世界模型，用物理观测算子与质量守恒转移约束潜状态；未见过土壤湿度标签即可匹配SMAP L-4，且"加风暴"干预能复现探针式增湿，但替换神经算子或通用循环转移后预测仍好、语义失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测精度高并不代表潜状态有物理意义或能对动作/驱动变化做出正确响应；作者希望构建一个"可读"的世界模型，使其状态语义（土壤水）与对降雨这一外源驱动的因果响应都被显式约束，从而可用干预实验检验。

Method: 以7年SMAP（亮度温度/土壤湿度）与CYGNSS（L波段反射率）观测为数据；潜状态经物理观测算子映射到土壤水（grounding），状态演化由质量守恒水量平衡方程支配；以降雨为动作输入；在美南大平原与28个地面探针及SMAP L-4做对比；通过"单格点风暴注入"与"全区风暴"两类干预，对比替换为神经算子观测模型或通用循环转移后的表现。

Result: 无监督（从未见土壤湿度值）条件下，模型对28个探针的跟踪精度与业务化SMAP L-4相当，仅用CYGNSS亦可达；对站点格点人为加入风暴后，土壤增湿模式与自然风暴下探针响应一致。消融显示：替换任一部件，预测技巧基本保持但状态语义漂移——神经算子仅在拟合站点的探针下才能读出土壤水；通用循环转移对单格点降雨几乎无响应。而全区一致性降雨下二者角色互换，守恒转移反而响应过弱。

Conclusion: 物理grounding使世界模型"可读"，但可读性不等于动作响应的正确性；对动作/驱动的响应必须在多种干预尺度下检验，单一预测指标或单一干预类型都不足以验证世界模型。

Abstract: A world model should tell us not only what will happen, but what would happen under a different action. Learned Earth models now forecast remarkably well, yet forecast skill says little about what their state means or how it responds to a changed driver. We build LandWM, a world model of land-surface water in which rain is the action, learned from seven years of SMAP and CYGNSS observations: physical observation operators tie its latent state to soil water, and a mass-conserving balance governs how that state responds to rain. Over the U.S. Southern Great Plains, the model, never shown a soil-moisture value, tracks 28 in-situ probes as well as the operational SMAP Level-4 product, even from CYGNSS alone, and a storm added to the forcing of a station's cell wets its soil as natural storms wet the probes. Replace either piece and the forecasts stay, but the meaning goes: with neural operators, only a probe fitted to the stations finds the soil water; with a generic recurrent transition, rain on a single cell barely moves it. Yet when the same rain covers the whole region the two transitions swap roles, and the conserving one responds too weakly. Grounding makes a world model readable; its response to actions must be tested under more than one kind of intervention.

</details>


### [144] [What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28966)
*Wendong Yao,Binhua Huang,Soumyabrata Dev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 审计13个免训练开放词表语义分割(OVSS)方法的背景类处理配置，发现官方mIoU依赖未统一的每数据集阈值与背景词表，与严格统一协议差距在VOC21达22.8分、ADE20K仅0.1分，且改变方法排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免训练OVSS以mIoU排名，但含背景类数据集上的实现依赖鲜有文档化的每数据集阈值和背景词表（13个方法中11个如此配置），导致基准数字不可比、结论可能失真，作者希望量化这一"协议鸿沟"。

Method: 审计13个方法的配置与论文，复跑其中7个官方代码；在预注册契约下对比官方设置与严格统一协议；分解官方背景处理（数值阈值 vs 类名词表），并分析背景词与目标类名的精确冲突（如"bed"）及语言模型生成词表造成的逐类下降。

Result: 协议差距随基准强烈变化：VOC21达22.8 mIoU，ADE20K为0.1；方法两两排序被改变；但后续CLIP-only方法相对SCLIP的提升仍有约79%在统一协议下保留；官方背景处理中阈值与词表的主导成分在不同基准上反转，无免调规则可跨数据集迁移；7个官方COCO-Object配置中6个存在"bed"词冲突。

Conclusion: 免训练OVSS的基准比较受未文档化背景配置显著污染，需统一协议与透明报告；作者给出报告规范建议，并开源评测代码、冻结配置、契约与冲突检测工具。

Abstract: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) built on CLIP has advanced rapidly, with methods typically ranked by mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) across standard benchmarks. On datasets with a background class, however, implementations rely on per-dataset thresholds and background word lists that are rarely documented or unified (11 of 13 surveyed methods configure per-dataset background decisions). We audit configurations and papers of 13 training-free OVSS methods, re-run seven from official codebases, and compare official settings against a strict unified protocol under pre-registered contracts. The protocol gap depends strongly on the benchmark---ranging from 22.8 mIoU points on PASCAL VOC (VOC21) to 0.1 points (indistinguishable from zero) on ADE20K---and alters pairwise method rankings. Despite large shifts in absolute mIoU, most of the reported improvement of later CLIP-only methods over SCLIP remains under the unified protocol (roughly 79% of the published gain). Decomposing official background handling shows that it combines numeric settings and class-name files whose dominant component reverses across benchmarks, while no tested tuning-free rule transfers reliably across all datasets. Moreover, exact collisions between background words and target names---present in six of seven official COCO-Object configurations through "bed"---make affected classes unpredictable under official post-processing, while the main per-class drops under language-model-generated vocabularies on VOC21 are largely attributable to a few generated terms. We offer reporting recommendations and release our evaluation code, frozen configurations, contracts, and a collision-check tool.

</details>


### [145] [AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28979)
*Zhilu Yang,Kun Yang,Shiyan Wang,Anqi Xu,Xinran Huang,Yizheng Jiao,Huan Yang,Rolandos Alexandros Potamias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlignHand：基于冻结单目手部重建先验的标定多视图手部网格对齐与融合框架，先建立共享度量参考对齐跨视图网格，再按解剖区域选择性融合表面证据并进行像素对齐的残差细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目手部重建器能输出细节丰富的3D网格，但多视图独立预测在尺度、位姿与关节姿态上不一致，难以直接整合互补信息，从而限制了多视图融合带来的精度提升。

Method: 以冻结的单目手部重建模型为prior；先细化跨视图关节观测并估计其可靠性，建立共享度量参考完成全局对齐；在共同坐标系下按解剖区域选择性融合互补表面证据；最后用像素对齐的局部图像特征预测有界残差位移做细化，实现全局到局部的集成。

Result: 在DexYCB-MV、HanCo、HO3D-Eval-MV上按各自评测协议取得最低MPVPE与MPJPE，相较匹配几何基线MPVPE分别降低30.1%、29.1%、8.0%。

Conclusion: 在不重训单目先验的前提下，通过跨视图对齐与分区域融合可有效利用互补多视图证据；与基线相比段进一步提升了多视图手部重建精度。

Abstract: Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

</details>


### [146] [CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28986)
*Saahil Islam,Adarsh Bhandary Panambur,Teodora Spasojevic,Eduardo Castaneda,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLASP：仅用ID数据的医学VLM OOD检测框架，用高斯条件互信息排序编码器层并以锚定谱选择挑层，将层-提示响应与PCA压缩视觉特征拼接后拟合单个收缩正则高斯，用马氏距离打分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学VLM零样本OOD检测依赖末层置信度或熵驱动层选择，可能遗漏互补信息；作者指出ID置信度熵低并不能可靠预测OOD判别能力。

Method: 联合建模层—提示响应与视觉特征；以高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器层排序，用锚定谱选择选出紧凑子集且不预设层数；将选中层-提示画像与PCA压缩视觉嵌入拼接，拟合单一收缩正则高斯；以平方马氏距离作为OOD分数，无需微调、OOD训练数据或测试时自适应。

Result: 在组织病理、胸片、脑MRI基准上配合UniMedCLIP与BioMedCLIP表现较强；MIDOG近OOD上UniMedCLIP达87.54% AUROC，优于置信度基线；BioMedCLIP下仍有竞争力但不及纯视觉马氏建模。消融显示层-提示交互与跨特征依赖有效，但贡献随分布偏移变化，语义偏移下存在局限。

Conclusion: 多层互补信息的选择与联合建模可提升医学VLM零样本OOD检测，但效果依赖分布偏移类型，需按骨干与偏移性质谨慎选层与特征组合。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

</details>


### [147] [Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28993)
*Anay Sinhal,Amit Sinhal,Ashish Pandey,Arpana Sinhal*

Main category: cs.CV
