TL;DR: 该研究检验开源医疗视觉语言模型 MedGemma-27b-it 的口头置信度是否可用于病理切片的不确定性标记（送专家复核）。结果显示 MedGemma 置信度几乎恒定、校准极差（AUROC≈0.50），而基座 Gemma-3 反而有可用校准（AUROC≈0.70）；失败与提示词设计有关，重构提示后 MedGemma 也能路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床部署中，模型需在不确定时主动标记样本交由专家复核；这要求置信度在模型正确时更高。作者质疑医疗微调模型是否具备这种"可信置信度"，并考察其是否因指令微调而丧失基座的校准能力。

Method: 零样本、单一提示词下在 PathMNIST 验证集（10,004 patch）与病人不重叠的外部队列（7,180 patch）上评测 MedGemma-27b-it 与基座 Gemma-3-27b-it。比较口头置信度（校准 AUROC、选择性准确率 AUC 增益）；分析标签 token 概率（top-20 备选含全部类别时优势反转）；在按正确性分层的 1,800-patch 子集上做重加权，比较五种提示变体的自一致性路由；并测试仅改措辞的复述与结构性重构提示；外部结果用切片级聚类检验。

Result: 两模型准确率均不可部署（40.6% / 35.5%）。MedGemma 口头置信度 96% 的 patch 落在同一数值，置信-正确 AUROC 为 0.499 / 0.528，按置信路由的选择性准确率 AUC 变化 -0.004 / +0.037；Gemma-3 置信度分布跨 9 个值，AUROC 0.70，增益 +0.114 / +0.115。标签概率无法补救，验证集优势在 top-20 备选覆盖全部类别时反转。五种提示变体的自一致性优于随机（+0.123 / +0.106）；仅改措辞的复述为 +0.100，外部仅方向一致（+0.054）；自一致性相对置信度的外部优势在切片级聚类下不显著。结构重构提示下，MedGemma 置信度路由达 +0.112 / +0.141。

Conclusion: MedGemma 的"置信度坍缩"不是固有的医疗模型缺陷，而与该类调优所偏好的提示（面向 macro-F1）耦合；简单改写提示即可恢复一定路由能力，提示措辞需与置信度使用方式配套设计。研究样本规模与外部队列验证尚有限，且外部优势在聚类校正后不稳健。

Abstract: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.

</details>


### [148] [Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28997)
*Anay Sinhal,Amit Sinhal,Arpana Sinhal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedGemma-27b-it 在结直肠病理九分类任务中，要求输出全部九类概率（禁用推理与选定答案）较 top-3 排序格式在两个数据集上准确率下降约 14 个百分点；该代价主要由“禁止给出答案”的指令造成，而非输出基数变化。首 token logit 熵的筛选效果优于任何模型自述置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将医疗视觉语言模型输出的言语化置信度视为可独立评价的信号，检验“响应格式”本身是否会改变分类预测，并厘清是输出基数（九类分布的负载）还是指令措辞（禁止作答）在起作用；同时对比显式置信度与内部 logit 信号的可靠性。

Method: 固定提示词，仅改变要求的响应格式，在 MedGemma-27b-it 上评测 10,004 张内部验证集与 7,180 张外中心 PathMNIST 切片（九类结直肠组织病理）。设计预注册终点、随机打破平局、按每个切片集重算随机基线。做消融：在匹配的输出基数与 token 预算下移除“禁止评论/推理/给出选定答案”的约束；以及在无该禁令时改变输出基数。另用四种视觉能力模型比较准确率与代价关系，并以首 token logit 熵作为选择性预测的排序信号。

Result: 九类概率格式相比 top-3 排序：验证集准确率降 14.8 点（−0.1475 [−0.1594, −0.1353]），外中心降 13.4 点（−0.1341 [−0.1484, −0.1196]），随机基线 0.1111。匹配基数与 token 预算下解除禁令后恢复 +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] 与 +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]；无禁令时改变基数仅 −0.0013 [−0.0300, +0.0280] 与 −0.0214 [−0.0494, +0.0071]。九类格式在 7.6%/7.7% 切片上无可解析分布，多为纹理最弱的两个类别的零向量，剔除这些失败即解释其选择性预测增益。准确率不能预测代价：两个准确率相同的模型代价相差 5–7 倍。首 token logit 熵优于任何自述信号（相对各自随机底 +0.1820 vs +0.0493）。

Conclusion: 响应格式会实质性改变医疗 VLM 分类器的性能，关键操控变量是“抑制作答”的指令（而非输出维度）。实践建议：可用 logits 时优先用 logit 熵做选择性预测；否则请求简短排序列表，且不要禁止推理或指定答案。

Abstract: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.

</details>


### [149] [Demystifying Classifier-Free Guidance for Auto-Regressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29002)
*Zhiling Zhou,Jiachun Pan,Fengzhuo Zhang,Dirk Bergemann,Zhuoran Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过实证与理论研究揭示自回归图像生成中CFG的作用机制：纹理信息编码于条件与无条件logits之差，而二者共享的"重复上文token"语义掩盖了纹理信息；并据此提出AttnReuse，复用条件分支注意力计算加速无条件分支，减少约25%注意力计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG在自回归图像生成中广泛使用且效果显著，但其内在机制尚不清楚，缺乏理论解释；同时CFG需要额外一次无条件前向计算，带来推理开销。

Method: 1) 实证分析CFG各分量的top-ranked语义，发现纹理主要编码在条件/无条件logits差值中，而两者共享前序token重复这一主导语义；2) 对浅层Transformer进行训练动力学分析，证明共享重复语义源于图像纹理稀疏性而非预训练缺陷；3) 论证CFG通过推理期校正重复偏置提升质量；4) 基于共享语义提出AttnReuse，复用条件logits前向中的中间注意力计算以加速无条件分支。

Result: 阐明CFG的校正机制，解释仅用条件logits贪心解码会产生近乎纯色图像的现象；AttnReuse在不同模型上减少约25%注意力计算，性能退化很小。

Conclusion: CFG本质是推理期对由图像纹理稀疏性导致的重复偏置进行校正；条件与无条件分支共享语义为计算复用提供了依据，可在几乎不损失质量的前提下显著降低推理开销。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) has been widely adopted in autoregressive (AR) models for high-quality image generation. Despite its strong empirical performance, its mechanism in AR models remains unclear. This paper demystifies the mechanism of CFG through both empirical and theoretical studies. By examining the top-ranked semantics of different components in CFG, we show that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between the conditional and unconditional logits, whereas both logits share previous-token repetition as their leading semantics. This strong repetition semantics obscures the desired texture information, causing greedy decoding from the conditional logits alone to produce nearly pure-color images. Through a training-dynamics analysis of shallow transformers, we prove that this shared repetition semantics does not arise from limitations or failures of pretraining, but instead originates from the texture sparsity of images. We further show that CFG improves generation quality by rectifying this repetition bias during inference. Motivated by the shared semantics between conditional and unconditional logits, we propose Attention Weight Reuse (AttnReuse), which reuses intermediate attention computations from the conditional-logit forward pass to accelerate the unconditional-logit computation. AttnReuse reduces about $25\%$ of attention computation with little performance degradation across different models.

</details>


### [150] [RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29026)
*Sadia Mubashshira,John Quarles,Kevin Desai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAGA 将单照片生成的全身体 Gaussian 头像变为可"刷新"表示：新观测按可见性与角度加权累积到 canonical UV 空间，用同一解码器重解码，约 1 秒建头像，无需重训练即可融合后续图像补全未见区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图头像一旦生成即固定，照片未覆盖区域（如衣服背面）只能靠幻觉生成且永久错误。作者希望在不重训练、不做梯度优化的前提下，利用后续获得的同一人新图像增量修正这些区域。

Method: 将每张新观测投影到 canonical UV 空间，以可见性与视角角度为权重做 running sum 累积；再用与单图阶段相同的解码器对融合后的 UV 图重解码；解码器虽仅用单图训练，但能利用融合证据。创建含 body fitting 与 matting，动画含姿态估计。

Result: 在 5 个数据集 163 段视频上，单图创建即超过 LHM、LHM++、IDOL，含 3 个训练未见数据集；后续帧刷新整体 +0.49 dB PSNR，转向 ≥135° 视角 +0.68 dB，SSIM/LPIPS 同升；同等 16 张图时 LHM++ +0.15 dB，RAGA +0.48 dB。创建 1.08 s，动画 48.1 ms/帧（RTX 3080 笔记本）。

Conclusion: 无需优化的可刷新 Gaussian 头像框架有效，能持续把新视角证据并入固定表示，实现快速创建、实时渲染与对未见区域的可控修正；代码将开源。

Abstract: Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.

</details>


### [151] [T2ISpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29029)
*Yifan Zhang,Shatong Zhu,Hui Shen,Yunta Hsieh,Jianing Ma,Muxin Fu,Xin Wang,Ping Zhang,Qian Chen,Chaofan Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: T2ISpec: 1,400 prompts on seven rendering topics × two difficulty levels to benchmark speculative decoding for T2I; findings show aggregate metrics hide topic gaps, alignment≠constraint satisfaction, and target-work cuts ≠ latency cuts; TopicRoute (prompt routing + speculative/cache control) gives 1.0308× geo-mean speedup.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Speculative decoding can accelerate text-to-image generators, but how it behaves across heterogeneous rendering requirements (prompt topics, difficulty) is poorly understood; aggregate evaluations may mask topic-specific trade-offs and latency–quality inconsistencies.

Method: Construct T2ISpec, a 1,400-prompt benchmark balanced over 7 rendering topics and 2 difficulty levels; evaluate autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators along latency, target-model work, and image quality. Then propose TopicRoute, a training-free plugin combining prompt routing with speculative decoding and cache control.

Result: Three findings: (1) aggregate results hide large inter-topic differences; (2) alignment/preference scores can contradict prompt constraint satisfaction; (3) large reductions in target work yield limited latency gains. TopicRoute achieves 1.0308× geo-mean speedup over native methods on six model–method pairs, transfers to external prompts, with configuration-dependent quality changes.

Conclusion: Topic-aware routing plus speculative/cache control yields modest but transferable T2I speedups; evaluation should be topic-stratified and constraint-aware rather than aggregate-only.

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generators produce detailed images but remain slow at inference. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost, yet its behavior across the rendering requirements of T2I prompts remains insufficiently understood. We introduce T2ISpec, a benchmark of 1,400 prompts balanced across seven rendering topics and two difficulty levels. It evaluates autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators by latency, work performed by the target model, and image quality. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) aggregate results hide large differences between topics, (2) alignment and preference scores can disagree with prompt constraint satisfaction, and (3) large reductions in target work can yield limited latency gains. Motivated by these findings, we propose TopicRoute, a plugin that combines prompt routing with speculative and cache controls without retraining the generator. Across six model--method pairs, it achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.0308x over the native methods, and the speedup carries over to external prompts with the same settings, while quality gains and losses vary across configurations.

</details>


### [152] [Recurrent Point Transformer via Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29059)
*Wentao Zhou,Xuweiyi Chen,Charles Saunders,Aruni RoyChowdhury,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PoinTTT 将任意范围点云分割建模为「分块循环序列处理」，在 PTv3 编解码器中插入带残差的 LaCT（Large Chunk Test-Time Training）层，用紧凑 fast weights 作为循环状态跨块传递，从而在固定大小块上训练、却能处理任意空间/时间范围序列，激活内存受块大小约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实点云天然无边界（房间级扫描、林区 LiDAR、数千帧 4D 捕捉），而多数点云编码器只支持定长输入，推理时需裁剪或分块，损失长程上下文并需要后处理拼接。论文希望以统一、可扩展的循环式测试时训练原语替代这种临时工程。

Method: 以 Point Transformer V3 为骨干，在编码器与解码器中加入残差 LaCT 层：每层维护紧凑 fast weights 作为循环状态，当前块 token 更新 fast weights，再作用于本块产生特征并传给下一块；训练仅需定长块，推理可流式处理任意长度序列，内存随块大小而非序列长度增长。

Result: ScanNet 与 nuScenes 试点显示循环 TTT 优于 PTv3 基线；FOR-instanceV2 森林语义分割达 87.9 mIoU（SOTA）且内存近恒定；HOI4D 上在线全序列循环推理跨片段携带状态，达 42.6 mIoU，匹配的全序列 Mamba 对照约 39.9。

Conclusion: 测试时训练可作为可扩展空间与时间点云理解的实用原语，兼顾任意范围输入、有界内存与精度提升，避免推理期裁剪/拼接与基准边界处的状态重置。

Abstract: Real-world point clouds are not naturally bounded: 3D scans grow as sensors move through rooms, LiDAR surveys extend across forest plots, and 4D captures can span thousands of frames. Yet most point-cloud encoders are designed for fixed-size inputs, forcing inference-time cropping or tiling that loses long-range context and requires ad-hoc output stitching. We formulate arbitrary-extent point-cloud segmentation as recurrent sequence-of-chunks processing and introduce PoinTTT, a recurrent point-cloud encoder built on Point Transformer V3 (PTv3). PoinTTT augments PTv3 with residual Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT) layers in both the encoder and decoder. Each LaCT layer maintains compact fast weights as recurrent state: tokens from each chunk update the fast weights, which are then applied to produce chunk features and passed to the next chunk. This design allows PoinTTT to train on fixed-size chunks while processing scenes of arbitrary spatial or temporal extent, with activation memory bounded by the chunk size. A pilot study on ScanNet and nuScenes shows that recurrent TTT improves segmentation over PTv3 baselines. On FOR-instanceV2, PoinTTT achieves state-of-the-art forest semantic segmentation of 87.9 mIoU with nearly constant memory. On HOI4D, online full-sequence recurrent inference carries state across clips rather than resetting at benchmark boundaries, reaching 42.6 mIoU; a matched full-sequence Mamba control reaches approximately 39.9. These results suggest that test-time training is a practical primitive for scalable spatial and temporal point-cloud understanding.

</details>


### [153] [Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29064)
*Hao-Yu Hsu,Shenlong Wang,Alexander G. Schwing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UNIFIED 将编码器、生成器、解码器三者折叠进同一个扩散 Transformer，仅用模式 token 与时间步区分三种模式，单阶段端到端训练即可同时完成编码、生成与解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜变量生成模型通常由三个独立网络组成（像素 tokenizer、潜在分布生成器、解码器）。UNITE 已把前两者合并为单阶段训练的生成式编码器，但解码器仍是独立网络。作者追问解码器能否也被折叠进来，使单一扩散 Transformer 同时承担编码、生成与解码；并指出直接让共享骨干解码无效，需要改变建模方式。

Method: 把所有三种模式统一表示为同一完全共享骨干上的位置对齐序列映射，仅用模式 token 与时间步加以区分。模型完全从零单阶段训练，只用重建损失与 flow-matching 损失，不使用对抗损失，也不依赖预训练编码器（如 DINO）。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 256×256 上，参数匹配时统一模型在约 60M、115M、215M 三个规模上 gFID 均优于 UNITE；215M 参数下达到 2.08，是 250M 参数以下对比模型中最低的。文生图任务上 UNIFIED-B（218M）在 512×512 达到 GenEval 0.87，超过参数量约十亿的单阶段像素扩散模型。

Conclusion: 潜变量扩散的完全统一不仅可行而且有益：单一共享骨干可在单阶段从零训练下同时完成编码、生成与解码，并在图像生成与文生图上取得优于分段式方案的效率—质量权衡。

Abstract: Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels. UNITE recently merged the first two into a single generative encoder trained in one stage, but its decoder remains a separate network. We ask whether this last network can be folded in too, so that one diffusion transformer encodes, generates, and decodes. Simply letting the shared backbone decode does not help. What makes it work is to cast all three modes as position-aligned sequence maps over one fully shared backbone, distinguished only by a mode token and the timestep. The resulting model, UNIFIED, is simple: one network trained from scratch in a single stage with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO). On ImageNet-1K 256x256 at matched parameters, UNIFIED improves gFID over UNITE at three sizes (~60M, ~115M, and ~215M) and reaches 2.08 with 215M parameters, the lowest among compared models under 250M parameters. On text-to-image generation, UNIFIED-B (218M) reaches a GenEval score of 0.87 at 512x512, exceeding single-stage pixel diffusion models with around one billion parameters. Full unification of latent diffusion is thus not merely feasible but beneficial.

</details>


### [154] [Projecting Beauty: Transferring Image Aesthetic Analysis onto 3D Heritage and Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29071)
*Sophia Kovalenko,Alexander M. Rusnak,Vittoria Meroni,Yasmine Kroknes-Gomez,Frédéric Kaplan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文考察二维图像美学评估向三维点云"跨维度迁移"的三种无人工标注路线：分数提升、监督回归头、文本查询，结果显示仅视觉-语言文本查询具有稳定信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑与街道美学判断支撑建筑设计、城市规划与遗产保护，但当前自动美学评估几乎局限于二维照片，而实际应用已转向三维扫描模型；大规模人工美学标注成本高且存在伦理争议，因此需要评估何种伪标签迁移路线在跨维度时仍保有有效信号。

Method: 提出可复现的迁移协议，比较三类无标注路线：(1) 将NIMA、SAAN等图像美学标量分数提升至几何点；(2) 在冻结视觉骨干（DINOv3、TIPS、SigLIP2、PE、RADSeg）上训练AVA回归头，或对前馈AVA重建使用通用点编码器的三维原生变体；(3) 用自然语言美学标签查询提升后的视觉-语言特征并以相似度作为分数；同时通过从点特征中投影去除类别-文本方向来解耦语义类别与美学评价，并设计部件感知的人工评分协议。

Result: 两种监督路线迁移效果差：AVA域内拟合的回归头产生互不一致、也不追踪其他信号的建筑类别剖面，三维原生探针因重建几何质量接近随机水平。文本查询显著更连贯：去除类别-文本方向后，建筑部件剖面的平均跨模型一致性由+0.035升至+0.352，逐点由+0.113升至+0.293；通过语义合理性检验的四个骨干相关性为0.31–0.73，未通过者仍为离群点。

Conclusion: 监督式伪标签迁移难以跨维度保持信号，语言锚定的零样本查询是更可靠的稠密美学伪标签来源；但模型间一致性并不等于与人类感知一致，因此发布的稠密美学伪标签应被视为假设而非真值，并需借助部件感知评分协议定位人机分歧。论文同时提供了可复现迁移协议及各路线的信号强弱分析。

Abstract: Judgments about the beauty of buildings and streets inform architectural design, urban planning, and heritage conservation, yet increasingly rely on scanned 3D models over material fabric. Automatic aesthetic assessment remains largely confined to 2D photographs. We ask what survives when image aesthetic assessment crosses this dimensional gap to produce dense, per-point aesthetic descriptions of heritage and urban point clouds. We examine three routes that sidestep costly, and sometimes ethically dubious, human labeling at scale: (1) lifting scalar scores from image aesthetic models (NIMA, SAAN) onto geometry; (2) training Aesthetic Visual Analysis (AVA) regression heads on frozen vision backbones (DINOv3, TIPS, SigLIP2, PE, RADSeg) or, in a 3D-native variant, a generalist point encoder on feed-forward AVA reconstructions; and (3) querying lifted vision-language features with a natural-language aesthetic label, taking similarity as a score. The two supervised routes transfer poorly: heads fitting AVA in-domain produce architectural class profiles that neither reproduce one another nor track other signals, while the 3D-native probe stays near chance due to reconstruction geometry quality. Text querying is markedly more coherent. Projecting out the class-text direction from point features raises mean cross-model agreement on architectural part profiles from +0.035 to +0.352, and from +0.113 to +0.293 per point; the four backbones passing a semantic sanity check correlate at 0.31-0.73, while the failing one remains an outlier. Since model agreement is not agreement with human aesthetic perception, we detail a part-aware rating protocol to clarify where human and automatic ratings disagree. We provide a reproducible transfer protocol, an account of which pseudo-labeling routes carry signal, and dense aesthetic pseudo-labels meant as hypotheses rather than ground truth.

</details>


### [155] [TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29099)
*Atakan Topcu,Mohammadhossein Momeni,Alfredo De Goyeneche,Michael Lustig*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TesseraFlow：复数域像素空间流匹配先验 + ReTile 采样器，用低分辨率全局编码 + 浅解码器分阶段处理时空 tile，实现约 1 帧/秒的 256x256 医学图像重建，比视频/潜空间先验快 20-367 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像重建中生成先验存在明显效率瓶颈：视频先验每帧需数十秒至数分钟；潜空间先验继承自编码器误差；像素空间整帧先验显存随帧尺寸增长；像素空间 patch 先验慢在两点——早期采样步只恢复低频却在全分辨率上跑网络，且采样器在重叠窗口/多轮重噪/反向传播上耗费大量网络评估。

Method: 提出 TesseraFlow：复数域像素空间 flow 先验。全局编码器每步仅读一次低分辨率视图；单一浅解码器在早期步作用于该低分辨率视图、后期步作用于全分辨率时空 tile，使任何网络都不必在全分辨率处理整帧。配套采样器 ReTile：每步随机网格偏移 + 重噪，以随机梯度形式替代重叠 tile 计算，使每步仅需一次网络前向。

Result: ReTile 单独可将现有全局上下文 patch 先验加速 6-9 倍，TesseraFlow 先验再额外带来 3-5 倍加速；整体约 1 帧/256x256/秒，比 patch 与潜空间视频先验快 20-367 倍。在心脏、脑、腹部 MRI 与肺部 CT 上匹配或超越最佳生成基线，且 GPU 时间仅为一小部分。

Conclusion: 通过"低频全局视图→高频局部 tile"的分阶段解码与随机偏移重噪采样，可显著降低像素空间生成先验的推理成本，在不牺牲重建质量的前提下大幅提速，为高维医学成像重建提供实用方案。

Abstract: Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. A single shallow decoder operates on this view during early steps and on full-resolution space-time tiles during later steps, so no network processes a whole frame at full resolution. Our sampler, ReTile, addresses the second reason. We use randomized grid shifting at every sampling step along with re-noising, which acts as a stochastic gradient instead of computing overlapping tiles, so a single network pass per sampling step suffices. On its own, ReTile speeds up an existing global-context patch prior by 6-9x, and our prior adds a further 3-5x speedup. TesseraFlow reconstructs about one 256x256 frame per second, 20-367x faster than patch and latent video priors, and can match or exceed the best generative baseline on cardiac, brain, and abdominal MRI and lung CT, at a fraction of its GPU time.

</details>


### [156] [Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29112)
*Soumyabrata Chaudhuri,Joydeep Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文形式化去中心化多视角空间推理问题（N个智能体各持不同视角、以预算受限的自然语言消息交换信息，使听者回答空间查询），提出新基准隔离需多视角整合的查询，并发现在多智能体下语言瓶颈远小于此前双智能体文献的估计；用带信用分配的强化学习显著缩小与集中式基线的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM正作为协作伙伴用于具身机器人、AR/VR与多用户系统，空间推理常分散在仅有部分环境可见性的智能体之间，需要跨智能体整合；而已有语言中介的空间整合研究仅限简化的双智能体场景，缺乏对通用去中心化多视角空间推理的问题定义与评测。

Method: 1) 形式化去中心化多视角空间推理：N个智能体观察不同视点，交换预算受限的自然语言消息，共同使听者能回答空间查询；2) 构建多视角空间基准，专门隔离需要非平凡多视角整合的查询；3) 开展大规模实证研究，将去中心化语言中介受限表现与集中式性能、oracle best-of-K 上界对比；4) 采用带信用分配的强化学习训练去中心化模型。

Result: 与先前双智能体文献不同，语言+有限预算带来的惩罚远小于预期；但去中心化多智能体空间推理仍有明显提升空间，与集中式性能和 oracle best-of-K 上界间存在显著差距；带信用分配的强化学习可有效增强去中心化模型，基本弥合与集中式基线的差距。

Conclusion: 多智能体语言中介空间整合的实际瓶颈被高估，真正的瓶颈在协调与信息选择；信用分配式强化学习是提升去中心化多视角空间推理的有效手段，为具身协作智能体系统提供了问题形式化与基准。

Abstract: As multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) get increasingly used as collaborative partners across embodied robotics, AR/VR, and multi-user systems, spatial reasoning is now often distributed across agents with partial environment visibility, necessitating spatial reasoning integration. Prior work in language-mediated spatial integration is however strictly limited to simplified two-agent scenarios. To address this gap, we first formalize the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents observe distinct viewpoints, exchange budget-constrained natural language messages, and collaborate to enable a listener to answer spatial queries. We then introduce a novel multi-view spatial benchmark to isolate queries that demand non-trivial multi-view integration. Through an extensive empirical study, we discover that the penalty of restricting decentralized spatial reasoning to natural language with limited budget is far smaller than suggested by prior two-agent literature. Nevertheless, we observe that substantial headroom still remains for multi-agent spatial reasoning in this setting, as evidenced by a significant gap between current centralized performance and an oracle best-of-K ceiling. Moreover, we show that reinforcement learning with credit assignment substantially bolsters the decentralized model, effectively closing the gap with the centralized baseline.

</details>


### [157] [GAG-Net: Graph-Based Anatomical Guidance Network for Pharyngeal Area Segmentation in VFSS Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29118)
*JunYeong Park,Myung Woo Park,Byung Chan Lee,Hyung Jin Chang,Sang-Il Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GAG-Net，用可变形卷积+基于图的地标解剖引导模块，从VFSS静息帧自动测量咽部面积PA_rest，MAPE 8.17%、Dice 0.8862，参数量比两阶段JOINED少67.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌少症性吞咽困难诊断依赖CT/MRI评估肌肉萎缩，成本高且加重老年患者负担；VFSS静息咽部面积PA_rest是有潜力替代的生物标志物，但需反复手工测量；软组织边界模糊且临床规则化勾画准则难以被纯数据驱动模型精确捕获。

Method: 将隐式临床测量显式化为地标规范与标注协议（与康复医学专家共同制定），构建首个PA_rest分割数据集（137例患者、2255帧，含轮廓与7个地标，由资深专家复核）；提出GAG-Net，将可变形卷积（应对不规则咽部边界）与图结构解剖引导模块（建模勾画规则所约束的地标几何依赖）结合，组成自动静息帧测量流水线。

Result: 患者级留出测试集（237帧、67例）上取得最低面积测量误差（MAPE 8.17%，患者级ICC 0.97）与最高Dice 0.8862；相比两阶段JOINED模型参数量减少67.2%、训练显存降低74%。

Conclusion: 将临床医生定义的解剖知识融入网络，可实现仅依赖VFSS图像的自动化PA_rest测量，为肌少症性吞咽困难提供无需额外影像的定量评估手段。

Abstract: Diagnosing sarcopenic dysphagia typically requires costly supplementary imaging such as CT or MRI to assess muscle atrophy, burdening elderly patients. The pharyngeal area at rest (PA_rest), measurable directly from videofluoroscopic swallowing study (VFSS) images, is a promising biomarker that could eliminate this dependency, but repeated manual measurement has limited its adoption. PA_rest segmentation is further complicated by indistinct soft-tissue boundaries and clinical rule-based delineation criteria that data-driven models capture only imprecisely. We formulate automated PA_rest segmentation as a clinically defined measurement task, translating an implicit clinical measurement into an explicit landmark specification and annotation protocol developed with a rehabilitation medicine specialist. Applying this protocol, we constructed, to our knowledge, the first dataset for this task: 2,255 single-center VFSS frames from 137 patients, with PA_rest contours and seven landmarks verified by a senior specialist. We then introduce GAG-Net, an automated rest-frame measurement pipeline combining deformable convolutions, for irregular pharyngeal boundaries, with a graph-based anatomical guidance module that models the geometric dependencies among landmarks prescribed by the delineation rules. On a patient-level held-out test set (237 frames, 67 patients), GAG-Net achieved the lowest area measurement error (mean absolute percentage error: 8.17% against specialist-verified references; patient-level ICC 0.97) and the highest Dice score (0.8862) among all evaluated methods, with 67.2% fewer parameters and 74% less training memory than the two-stage JOINED model. Integrating clinician-defined anatomical knowledge may enable automated PA_rest measurement from VFSS images alone, supporting quantitative assessment of sarcopenic dysphagia without supplementary imaging.

</details>


### [158] [SilentWAM: Planning in the Masked State of a Diffusion World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29125)
*Ziyu Zhao,Casey Sun,Zeyu Wang,Shicong Ma,Emily T Zhang,Cheng Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无帧解码的未来表征规划器，利用掩码未来token的隐状态直接预测轨迹，单目前视相机NAVSIM v1 92.0 PDMS、v2 89.3 EPDMS，端到端延迟60.3ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型依赖未来预测，但测试时直接访问未来表征需生成未来帧：生成式方法额外增加前向开销，联合训练方法在推理时又丢弃显式未来预测。作者希望在推理时"零帧生成成本"地利用未来表征。

Method: 以MMaDA-Parallel-M为基座，在驾驶视频上做帧级掩码世界建模预训练，任务为预测被掩码的未来帧后缀，并显式包含"全部未来帧被掩码"的输入设定。规划查询（planning queries）以注意力读取这些掩码位置的隐状态与观测上下文，连续回归头在同一前向pass中输出轨迹。

Result: 单目前视相机下NAVSIM v1 达92.0 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 达89.3 EPDMS，端到端延迟60.3ms；无需解码未来帧即可获得未来监督的表征增益。

Conclusion: "读隐状态而非解码像素"是获取世界模型未来监督的高性价比路径，兼顾精度与实时性，可推广到其他具身导航/操作任务。

Abstract: World-action models learn from future prediction, but accessing their future representations directly at test time can require costly frame generation. Methods that generate future frames before planning incur additional forward passes, while future co-training methods omit explicit future predictions at inference. We introduce \method, a planner that reads the hidden states of masked future tokens without decoding future frames. We pretrain MMaDA-Parallel-M on driving video using frame-level masked world modeling, which predicts a masked suffix of future frames and explicitly includes inputs with all future frames masked. Learned planning queries attend to these masked positions and the observed context, and a continuous head predicts the trajectory in the same forward pass. With a single front camera, \method reaches 92.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, with an end-to-end latency of 60.3\,ms.

</details>


### [159] [Supply the Global, Supervise the Local: Combining Representation Conditioning and Alignment in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29138)
*Chaojie Ji,Sergio Quiroga-Sandoval,Ruxin Wang,Zheju Zheng,Yankai Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文分析REPA(表征对齐)与图像级条件token在扩散Transformer中的相互关系，发现二者在图像级(全局)表征上协同而非冲突，提出GC-REPA：用REPA目标中的图像级部分作为条件token，显著加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练图像表征在扩散Transformer中可同时充当对齐目标(REPA)和输入条件，二者若共用同一表征空间可能冲突；作者希望实证检验冲突与否，并据此设计更好的结合方式。

Method: 将每个图像块的表征分解为图像级(全局)部分与块内(局部)差值部分；用一个token携带图像级部分作为条件输入，局部部分仅由REPA监督。实验比较可见二者的协同效应，并据此提出GC-REPA：REPA + 该token作为额外输入，token不含超出REPA目标的信息，采样时从单独训练的先验中采样。

Result: 条件token与REPA共同教会模型全局与局部两部分，且效果远超各自单独作用之和，说明是协同而非冲突；GC-REPA在ImageNet 256×256上使SiT-XL/2在200K次迭代达到REPA 4M次迭代的FID，在100K次迭代达到SiT-XL/2基线7M次迭代的FID。

Conclusion: 给出结合REPA与图像级条件的设计准则"全局给条件、局部交监督"，GC-REPA大幅加速训练收敛，且token信息量不超出REPA目标，不引入额外监督信息。

Abstract: A pretrained image representation helps train a diffusion transformer in several roles, including as an alignment target, which the model's hidden states learn to match, as in representation alignment (REPA), and as a condition, an extra input describing the image to be generated. Combined, they would give the model an input and a target, but whether they conflict is unknown. To test this, we let the condition carry only part of REPA's target: we split the representation of each image patch into an image-level (global) part, shared by all patches of the image, and a within-image (local) part, the patch's difference from the image-level part, and use one token carrying the image-level part as the condition. Then, the two roles overlap on the image-level part, where they could conflict, while only REPA supervises the within-image part, where we can see whether the token helps REPA. We find that the token and REPA together teach both the image-level part and the within-image part, the main source of REPA's FID improvement, far more than the sum of what each teaches alone, so they cooperate rather than conflict. These findings give one design rule for combining REPA with an image-level condition, supply the global, supervise the local, which we implement as Global-Condition REPA (GC-REPA): REPA with the token as an extra input; the token carries no information beyond REPA's target and is drawn at sampling from a separately trained token prior. GC-REPA greatly accelerates convergence: on ImageNet 256*256, SiT-XL/2 + GC-REPA reaches REPA's 4M- and SiT-XL/2's 7M-iteration FIDs within 200K and 100K iterations (20 and 70 fewer).

</details>


### [160] [RAVEC: Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29142)
*Junjie Yang,Rui Qian,Xutao Mao,Yuhe Wu,Mingda Zhang,Jiaxuan Luo,Yang Tan,Qiang Huang,Zhisheng Chen,Yanfeng Li,Dawen Tian,Changmiao Wang,Tao Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAVEC 利用同前缀下抑制标注证据区域的对比信号生成带符号的视觉修正方向，再经信用筛选与预算式分配形成视觉损失，增强 GRPO 的多模态推理训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）多为响应级反馈，难以定位需纠正的中间决策；仅凭对图像内容的敏感性并不能说明该敏感性与奖励对齐、或能跨问题泛化。

Method: PVEC：以 EMA 教师在同一采样响应前缀下，比较原图与被抑制证据区域的图像预测，得到有符号修正方向；CRA：用局部奖励对齐与其他问题（排除源问题全部响应）的奖励支持筛选方向，并在响应级预算约束下把额外代价分配给可降低预测熵的方向；所得带符号视觉损失在训练中增广 GRPO，推理仅用原图与问题。

Result: 在十个多模态基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B/7B 均取得最高平均准确率，较 GRPO 提升 2.67 与 1.39 个百分点；消融支持证据对齐、信用筛选与风险感知分配的组合设计。

Conclusion: 将响应级 RLVR 细化到"视觉证据—中间决策"粒度的带符号信用分配是有效方向，但属于多模态推理训练方法，未涉及具身/机器人或三维重建任务。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves multimodal reasoning, but response-level feedback provides limited guidance on which intermediate decisions to correct. Visual interventions reveal sensitivity to image content, yet this sensitivity alone does not establish reward alignment or support across questions. We introduce RAVEC (Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction), which selects visual corrections using local and cross-question reward support and jointly determines their strengths within each response. Paired Visual Evidence Contrast (PVEC) compares predictions from an exponential moving average teacher at the same sampled response prefix under the original image and a version with its annotated evidence region suppressed, yielding signed correction directions. Credit-Risk Allocation (CRA) screens these directions using local reward alignment and reward support from other questions, excluding all responses to the source question. It then solves a response-level budgeted allocation problem, assigning additional cost to directions that locally reduce predictive entropy. The resulting signed visual loss augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during training. Inference uses only the original image and question. Across ten multimodal benchmarks, RAVEC achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared methods with both 3B and 7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct models, outperforming GRPO by 2.67 and 1.39 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations support the combined design of evidence alignment, credit qualification, and risk-aware allocation. The project is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [161] [RVLM: Fewer Tokens, Better Resolution Scaling, Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29146)
*Savya Khosla,Chris Dongjoo Kim,Alex Schwing,Derek Hoiem,Christopher Clark,Sangho Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RVLM 用免训练的 Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher 区域分割替代固定 patch 网格作为视觉单元，将每个 ViT patch 分配给区域并池化为可变长 token 序列，同时保留 patch-to-region 映射支持 coarse-to-fine 解码，在 VQA/指向/计数/分割/深度任务上以更少视觉 token 达到或超过 patch 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 将图像按固定空间网格切分为视觉 token，导致 token 数随像素面积线性增长而非随场景内容变化，在高分辨率下计算代价高；作者希望视觉单元能对应连贯的图像区域而非固定窗口，从而在降低 token 数的同时保留空间精度。

Method: 核心设计要点为：(1) 免训练的 Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher 分割生成区域；(2) 每个 ViT patch 硬分配给所属区域；(3) 区域内 patch 特征池化为变长视觉 token 序列；(4) 保留 patch-to-region 分配图，用于 coarse-to-fine 解码以获得空间精确预测。消融表明区域必须覆盖全图、端到端训练中保持空间连通、保留细结构（如小文字），而语义分组收益有限。方法不增加任何模型参数。

Result: 在 VQA、pointing、counting、分割、深度估计等任务上，相比同训练配置的 patch 基线，RVLM 使用少 21.5% 视觉 token 且任务加权性能持平或更好；优势随分辨率增大，最高分辨率设置下提升 5.3 点并减少 51.8% token；空间密集任务收益最大（此类任务中已有 token 压缩方法退化最严重）；推理吞吐最高提升 35.9%。在未见过的病理与卫星图像、以及无视频训练的视频基准上，与 patch 基线相当，token 少 2–3 倍。

Conclusion: 区域化视觉表示可作为 patch 表示的可扩展替代方案：在显著降低视觉 token 预算的同时保持 grounded 预测所需的空间精度，且具跨域与跨模态（视频）零训练迁移能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tokenize images using fixed spatial grids, so visual token count grows with pixel area rather than scene content. We propose to group neighboring patches based on their visual appearance, allowing tokens to represent coherent image regions rather than fixed spatial windows. We introduce RVLM, a VLM trained to use regions rather than patches as its visual units. Analyzing region construction for general-purpose VLMs, we find that regions must cover the full image, stay spatially connected during end-to-end training, and preserve fine structure such as small text, while semantic grouping adds little. RVLM therefore partitions images using training-free Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher segmentation, assigns each ViT patch to a region, and pools patches within each region into a variable-length sequence of visual tokens. The patch-to-region assignment is retained to support spatially precise prediction through coarse-to-fine decoding. Across tasks spanning VQA, pointing, counting, segmentation, and depth estimation, RVLM matches or improves example-weighted task performance while using 21.5% fewer visual tokens than an identically trained patch baseline. The advantage grows with image resolution, reaching a 5.3-point gain while using 51.8% fewer visual tokens at the highest-resolution setting. The gains are largest on spatially demanding tasks, where prior token-reduction methods degrade most sharply. RVLM adds no model parameters and improves inference throughput by up to 35.9%. On unseen pathology and satellite images and on video benchmarks without any video training, RVLM performs on par with the patch baseline while using 2-3$\times$ fewer visual tokens. These results establish regions as a scalable alternative to patch-based visual representations while preserving the spatial precision required for grounded prediction.

</details>


### [162] [ArborNet: Volume- and skeleton-aware completion of tree quantitative structure models from incomplete point clouds using anchor-conditioned graph learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29148)
*Ge Jiang,Tiangang Yin,Wei Yao,Wai Yeung Yan,Qi Chen,Jinhong Wang,Qihao Weng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ArborNet，在 QSM（定量结构模型）域而非原始点云域完成树木结构补全：将每棵树表示为 TreeQSM 圆柱图，用多关系图编码器与锚定条件解码器生成缺失圆柱，并以几何/存在性/分枝/半径/体积损失及层级缺失体积预算约束推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单站或稀疏采样的 TLS 存在遮挡，导致树枝观测不完整、木材体积估计有偏；现有补全方法只恢复"看起来合理"的几何，不显式保持分枝拓扑、圆柱半径与木材体积。

Method: 树表示为编码圆柱几何、枝级、父子拓扑与枝身份的 TreeQSM 圆柱图；多关系图编码器沿父、子、枝内三类连接传播信息；锚定条件解码器通过末端枝延伸与新枝生成长出缺失圆柱；训练用几何、存在性、分枝、半径、轴向平滑与体积等多项损失；推理时在预测的逐级缺失体积预算下筛选生成圆柱。

Result: 在 DART 仿真 TLS 树与香港城市 TLS 树上评估（单站 QSM 为部分输入、多站 QSM 为参考）：预算约束推理下总体积平均相对误差 0.081%，逐级体积误差 0.676%，骨骼几何误差优于所比较的点云补全基线；消融显示联合体积监督对体积控制尤为关键。作者说明该误差衡量的是与参考 QSM 的一致性，而非对破坏性实测木材体积的精度。

Conclusion: 表明在 QSM 域做补全可同时恢复显式木材结构和约束几何与体积；但体积精度仅对参考 QSM 而言，缺乏真实木材体积真值验证，且任务限于林业 TLS，与具身/机器人感知主线关联较远。

Abstract: Terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) enables 3D reconstruction of trees and quantitative structure models (QSMs) for estimating woody volume and structural traits. However, occlusion in single-station or sparsely sampled TLS causes incomplete branch observations and biased volume estimates. Existing point-cloud completion methods recover plausible geometry but do not explicitly preserve branch topology, cylinder radii, or woody volume. We propose ArborNet, a volume- and skeleton-aware framework for completing tree structures in the QSM domain. Each tree is represented as a TreeQSM cylinder graph encoding cylinder geometry, branch level, parent-child topology, and branch identity. A multi-relation graph encoder propagates information across parent, child, and intra-branch connections. An anchor-conditioned decoder generates missing cylinders through terminal-branch continuation and new-branch generation. Geometry, existence, branch, radius, axis-smoothness, and volume losses encourage structural consistency. During inference, generated cylinders are selected under predicted level-wise missing-volume budgets. We evaluate ArborNet on DART-simulated TLS trees and urban TLS trees from Hong Kong, using single-station QSMs as partial inputs and multi-station QSMs as references. Under budget-constrained inference, ArborNet achieves mean total-volume relative error of 0.081% and mean level-wise volume error of 0.676% against reference QSMs, while reducing skeleton geometry error relative to evaluated point-cloud completion baselines. These errors quantify agreement with reference QSMs, not accuracy against destructively measured woody volume. Ablation results show that joint volume supervision is particularly important for volume control. These results demonstrate the potential of QSM-domain completion to recover explicit woody structure while constraining geometry and volume.

</details>


### [163] [Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29150)
*Yan Wang,Yiran Song,Zizhuo Gong,Jianxiang Qi,Zhongxing Xu,Lingfei Qian,Minquan Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨放大倍率溯源验证任务(CMPV)与PyraFault基准(2200例、5个TCGA队列、306万坐标监督样本)，并给出ZoomTrace验证器，在50余万测试样本上达0.969 AUPRC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体在全切片图像上依赖"声明位置+放大观测"，但视觉上合理的观测未必真的来自其声称的位置（跨倍率、相似组织区域尤甚），存在静默失败风险。

Method: 形式化CMPV：判断视觉证据是否支持声称的空间关联、尽可能恢复真实来源、证据不足时弃权；构建含上下文替换、源缺失、几何扰动三类故障的PyraFault基准；提出与声明无关的ZoomTrace验证器，先估计观测源，再评估与声称位置的一致性，融合物理尺度对齐、视觉检索、几何精化与基于空间不相交竞争匹配的可靠性估计。

Result: 503,320个测试样本上AUPRC 0.969、AUROC 0.987，显著优于Efficient LoFTR(0.789/0.903)；揭示可靠性估计的权衡，以及VLM、跨数据集检索和校准方面的局限。

Conclusion: 将ZoomTrace接入智能体工具路径可降低对损坏观测的暴露与静默失败，下游精度提升依赖具体智能体与验证阈值；方法属医学WSI领域验证机制，非物理AI/具身核心。

Abstract: Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

</details>


### [164] [Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29163)
*Kanglei Zhou,Zikai Hao,Liyuan Wang,Xiaohui Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 IncNYU 结构缺失手部姿态基准与 InsHaPE 框架，通过拓扑感知蒸馏与渐进式运动链推理，在关节结构缺失时保持稳健的手部姿态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手部姿态估计方法假设手部运动学结构完整，当部分关节持续缺失时预测不稳定甚至系统失效，而现实场景中部分观测仍然可用，需要刻画并解决结构不完整问题。

Method: 构建 IncNYU 基准：对完整手模型做形态学修改以模拟结构缺失，并保留完整与移除区域的参考位置；提出 InsHaPE，基于分层运动学建模，包含（1）拓扑感知蒸馏，从完整手表示迁移关节级与关系先验，提供解剖一致的初始化；（2）渐进式运动学推理模块，沿运动链结构化推断。

Result: 在 NYU/IncNYU 及 MSRA 外部验证上，InsHaPE 在结构不完整条件下鲁棒性提升，同时在完整手数据上保持有竞争力性能；系统级评估显示其改善对固定拓扑手部表示有需求的下游应用的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 显式建模运动学拓扑并迁移完整手先验，是应对手部结构缺失的可行途径；为残缺手姿态估计提供了基准与方法基线。

Abstract: Hand pose estimation aims to recover the spatial configuration of hand joints from visual observations and serves as a fundamental perception module for downstream systems that rely on complete and topologically consistent hand representations. Most existing methods are developed under the assumption of fully articulated hand structures and tend to produce unstable or implausible predictions when parts of the kinematic structure are persistently absent, resulting in degraded performance or even system failure despite available partial observations. To study this challenge, we construct IncNYU, a physiologically constrained benchmark that simulates structural incompleteness through morphological modification of complete hand models and retains reference locations for both intact and synthetically removed regions. Based on this benchmark, we propose InsHaPE, an Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation framework designed to remain robust under structural incompleteness while preserving performance on standard, fully articulated hands. Built on hierarchical kinematic modeling, InsHaPE introduces two complementary components. First, a topology-aware distillation strategy transfers joint-level and relational priors from fully articulated hand representations, providing anatomically consistent initialization under missing structures. Second, a progressive kinematic reasoning module performs structured inference along the kinematic chain, enabling complete and anatomically consistent pose estimation under severe structural variations. Extensive experiments on NYU/IncNYU, together with external validation on MSRA, demonstrate that InsHaPE improves robustness under structural incompleteness while maintaining competitive performance on complete hands. System-level evaluations further show that InsHaPE improves robustness for downstream applications that require fixed-topology hand pose representations.

</details>


### [165] [Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29165)
*Tri Ton,Siwoo Lim,Joshua Tian Jin Tee,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusFlow：无分割、两阶段的3D资产编辑框架，先将轨迹分为粗结构形成与精化两阶段，用跨注意力门控速度场实现局部化，再用干净隐变量参考引导消除轨迹欠收敛问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概率流（probability flow）无训练3D编辑依赖全局速度更新，导致两点失效：编辑溢出到应保留区域（spatial bleed），以及轨迹"欠承诺"使编辑中途停滞。目标是在高维潜空间中实现局部、稳定的结构变换。

Method: 将积分轨迹划分为两个不相交阶段。①粗结构形成阶段：Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) 利用固有跨注意力（cross-attention）差异对速度场做空间门控，实现无掩码的定位；②结构成形后：Reference Generation Guidance (RGG) 引入轨迹修正项，将轨迹拉向显式的干净潜变量目标以加速收敛、避免停滞。整体为免训练、免分割流程。

Result: 在 Google Scanned Objects + PartObjaverse-Tiny 联合基准上，取得对比方法中最佳的保持（preservation）分数与最大编辑幅度，显示可缓解"保持-修改"权衡。

Conclusion: 阶段调度 + 注意力门控 + 参考引导的组合提供了无需人工空间标注的稳定局部几何控制，降低合成3D媒体编辑门槛；但证据限于特定基准的定量比较，缺少开放场景泛化与开源/实时性说明。

Abstract: Modifying 3D assets requires enacting targeted structural transformations while strictly preserving the geometric identity of unedited regions. While recent probability flow models enable training-free editing, bounding these modifications within a high-dimensional latent space presents severe mathematical challenges. Current inversion-free trajectories rely on global velocity updates, which often cause spatial bleed into preserved structures and induce trajectory under-commitment, causing edits to stall mid-path. To resolve these dual failures, we introduce FocusFlow, a segmentation-free framework that structures the integration trajectory into two disjoint phases. During early coarse structure formation, FocusFlow applies Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) to spatially gate the velocity field using intrinsic cross-attention. Once coarse structure has formed, FocusFlow applies Reference Generation Guidance (RGG), a trajectory-correction term that drives convergence to the target shape by pulling the trajectory toward an explicit clean-latent target. Evaluated on the joint Google Scanned Objects and PartObjaverse-Tiny benchmarks, FocusFlow obtains the best preservation scores and the largest edit magnitude among compared methods, suggesting that it can reduce the traditional preservation-modification trade-off. By providing stable, localized geometric control without manual spatial annotations, this phase-scheduled approach lowers technical barriers to the modification of synthetic 3D media.

</details>


### [166] [Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29167)
*Chenyu Wang,Mingyu Chen,Wenchao Li,Kayhan Batmanghelich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将胸部CT报告生成重构为LLM智能体调度的视觉问答决策集：Rad-VL-JEPA以视觉-语言联合嵌入预测统一报告检索、病灶识别与细粒度属性刻画，RL智能体获取患者特异视觉证据，独立编辑模块生成报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT报告反复评估相同解剖区域的同类发现（如结节有无及位置），本质是判别式视觉问答而非开放式生成；现有CT报告模型沿用通用视觉-语言建模，在数据有限时易漏检细微异常。

Method: 把报告生成分解为LLM智能体协调的VQA决策序列，实现感知与推理/写作解耦：感知端用JEPA式联合嵌入预测训练判别式非生成模块，覆盖报告检索、发现识别与属性刻画；上层智能体经强化学习学习针对患者提出视觉查询；再由独立编辑模块将证据融合为最终报告。

Result: Rad-VL-JEPA在细粒度CT理解任务上表现强，单查询摊销推理时间低于同CT编码器与VQA数据训练的生成式VLM基线；整体报告系统优于强VLM基线与智能体基线。

Conclusion: 判别式联合嵌入感知+LLM智能体查询+分离式编辑的三段解耦范式，在医疗多模态任务上以更低推理成本获得更优性能，验证"感知不生成"的设计价值。

Abstract: Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.

</details>


### [167] [SpatialDuet: Bayesian task routing between a metric expert and a geometry expert for spatial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29168)
*Duy Tran Thanh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialDuet将训练于大规模空间问答数据的度量专家VLM与带3D几何编码器的几何专家VLM组合，由贝叶斯任务路由器按题型估计各专家更优的概率并加权融合答案，无需训练任何权重即可提升小模型空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身助手和可穿戴设备受硬件限制只能用小规模VLM，而小空间VLM因训练数据不同而各有所长（数据驱动模型擅长尺寸估计，几何编码模型擅长相对方向与绝对距离），现有工作却试图用单一模型覆盖所有空间任务。

Method: 构建包含两个冻结专家的系统：度量专家为数据驱动空间VLM，配备三个免训练模块（训练对齐采样、度量感知最小贝叶斯风险解码、分类型度量校准）；几何专家为带3D几何编码器的VLM；贝叶斯任务路由器在标注的开发集上估计每类问题上各专家更优的概率，并以此为权重在对数空间（数值答案）或选项分布上（选择题）池化答案。

Result: 在覆盖视频与单图四个空间基准上的实验验证了SpatialDuet，在VSI-Bench上超过最佳已发表小VLM 3.17%，在CV-Bench上（排除在CV-Bench类数据上训练的模型）超出1.44%，且未训练任何模型权重。

Conclusion: 异质冻结专家加概率路由是提升小VLM空间推理的高效免训练方案，但其贡献局限于VQA式空间问答与推理层面，未涉及机器人操作、3D重建或世界模型的实际部署验证。

Abstract: Embodied assistants and wearable devices need 3D spatial reasoning, and their limited hardware restricts them to small vision-language models (VLMs). Small spatial VLMs acquire different abilities from their training: a model trained on large spatial question sets estimates object and room sizes well, whereas a model with a 3D geometry encoder is better at relative directions and absolute distances. Instead of training a single model for all spatial tasks, as published methods do, we build one system that uses each frozen model for the tasks it handles best. We propose SpatialDuet, which pairs a metric expert with a geometry expert under a Bayesian task router. The metric expert is a data-driven spatial VLM run with three training-free modules: training-aligned sampling, metric-aware minimum Bayes risk decoding and per-type metric calibration. The geometry expert is a VLM with a 3D geometry encoder. For each question type, the router estimates from labelled development questions how likely each expert is to be better, and pools their answers with that probability as weight, in log space for numeric answers and over the option distributions for multiple-choice answers. Extensive experiments on four spatial benchmarks covering video and single images validate SpatialDuet; it outperforms the best published small VLMs by 3.17% on VSI-Bench and, excluding a model trained on CV-Bench-style data, by 1.44% on CV-Bench, without training any model weight.

</details>


### [168] [loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29180)
*Xiangjing An,Zhibin Jiao,Aiting Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用权重共享的循环交叉注意力解码器替代物理堆叠的深解码器，在冻结DINOv2-Base上以迭代潜空间推理完成密集视觉预测，参数量大幅降低且边界质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准密集预测架构靠堆叠6-16层Transformer解码器扩展容量，带来反向传播激活内存开销、非绑定权重的高带宽需求，以及无法随图像空间复杂度自适应的静态计算分配。

Method: 冻结DINOv2-Base单次前向提取空间特征并缓存KV；紧凑权重绑定Looped Cross-Attention Decoder（核心7.96M，总可训练14.85M）在T次迭代中循环更新query；采用步数条件adaLN、基于LayerNorm的超椭球流形正则、可学习残差收缩阻尼稳定循环；将中间掩码预测反哺为空间注意力偏置、无额外参数；支持ACT自适应计算时间。

Result: Pascal VOC 2012上T=2达85.66% mIoU与65.01% Boundary IoU，比6层DINO-Trans6L（54.06M）mIoU+1.09%、bIoU+7.41%，参数少72.5%；比4层DINO-FCN4L探针（2.43M）边界+6.43% bIoU、60%遮挡下+6.76% mIoU；ACT下87.3 FPS，60%遮挡仍保留29.64% mIoU（较DINO-Trans6L +5.83%）。

Conclusion: 循环潜空间推理可作为深解码器堆叠的高效替代：参数效率、边界精度、遮挡鲁棒性与推理速度同时改善，代码与权重开源。但验证限于VOC语义分割，下游任务（检测/深度/机器人感知）尚未展开。

Abstract: Standard dense visual prediction architectures scale representation capacity by stacking deep feedforward decoders (6-16 transformer layers with 50M-200M parameters). This explicit layer stacking brings substantial activation memory overhead during backpropagation, requires high off-chip memory bandwidth for non-tied weights, and uses static computational allocation that cannot adapt to spatial image complexity. We propose loopxDINO, which replaces physical decoder depth with iterative latent reasoning. It has two decoupled components: (1) a frozen DINOv2-Base backbone extracting spatial features in one forward pass and caching static Key-Value representations in GPU memory; (2) a compact weight-tied Looped Cross-Attention Decoder (7.96M core, 14.85M total trainable parameters) that recurrently updates queries across T iterations. Recurrence is stabilized by step-conditioned adaLN, LayerNorm-based hyper-ellipsoid manifold regularization, and learnable residual contraction damping. Intermediate mask predictions are fed back as spatial attention biases to guide queries toward ambiguous contours with no extra parameters. On Pascal VOC 2012 semantic segmentation with a single RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GPU, loopxDINO (T=2) achieves 85.66% mIoU and 65.01% Boundary IoU. It outperforms 6-layer DINO-Trans6L (54.06M params) by +1.09% mIoU and +7.41% Boundary IoU with 72.5% fewer parameters. Compared to 4-layer DINO-FCN4L probe (2.43M params, 83.82% mIoU), loopxDINO improves boundary delineation by +6.43% bIoU and occlusion resilience by +6.76% mIoU (60% patch masking). With Adaptive Computation Time (ACT), it reaches 87.3 FPS and retains 29.64% mIoU under 60% occlusion (+5.83% over DINO-Trans6L). Source code, pre-trained weights and evaluation suites are open-sourced under Apache 2.0 at this https URL

</details>


### [169] [PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29184)
*Conghan Yue,Yuanjie Chen,Yunyan Xiao,Zeyu Peng,Xingsong Ye,Ya Gao,Yanglin Huang,WeiYao Zhang,Yue Han,Zhineng Chen,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PhyCoVE 基准（110 源视频、533 案例，覆盖刚体/弹性/流体动力学与 5 类交互模式），并给出跨材料通用的反事实保真度指标；评测 7 个开源与商用视频编辑模型，发现最强模型仅复现约 1/7 的物理变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理反事实视频编辑评测仅覆盖物体移除或特定刚体运动，缺乏弹性形变、流体流动及刚-弹-流相互作用的评测手段，无法判断模型是否真正理解被编辑所改变的动力学。

Method: 构建 PhyCoVE 基准：模拟案例由语言模型提出场景设计、编码智能体用适配各材料的求解器搭建并做物理渲染，再从源场景状态模拟每次编辑，全流程人工审核；真实案例用单机位连续拍摄编辑前后。提出 counterfactual fidelity 指标，度量生成视频复现源→目标物理变化的比例。

Result: 对该指标的排序与人类偏好高度一致；最好模型仅复现约七分之一物理变化。模型倾向于改变外观而非演化过程，说明物理反事实视频编辑远未解决。

Conclusion: PhyCoVE 为物理反事实视频编辑提供了可扩展的构建与评测基础，揭示当前视频编辑/生成模型缺乏对物理动力学的理解，是该方向的基准性工作。

Abstract: Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.

</details>


### [170] [Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29194)
*Tailai Chen,Jiawei Yu,Yiming Cheng,Ping Nie,Yongyong Chen,Tao Zhou,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PointTool提出无编码器、工具增强的3D点云语言模型框架：用无对齐补丁分词(AFPT)直接聚合原始点云保留细粒度几何，用解耦点-文本LoRA(DPL)在冻结LLM中做全局聚合与3D知识内化，并以程序监督工具推理(PSTR)让模型通过可执行工具操作原始3D数据与外部资源，配套PointCloud-TR基准(13K物体/39.8K问题/35.6K工具轨迹)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D点云语言模型依赖为预定义任务优化的预训练点编码器，存在表征瓶颈导致与下游3D理解失配；且多为单次闭卷生成，无法主动检视任务相关3D区域或检索外部知识。

Method: AFPT局部聚合原始点云并保持细粒度几何；DPL在冻结LLM中做全局聚合与3D知识内化；PSTR通过可执行工具程序化训练，使模型能显式操作原始3D数据与外部资源，实现基于空间证据的交互式3D推理；构建PointCloud-TR基准用于训练与评测。

Result: 在标准与复杂3D理解任务上均取得强性能，验证去编码器与工具增强设计的有效性；主要证据为基准指标，未报告真实机器人部署。

Conclusion: 去除预训练点编码器瓶颈并引入程序监督的工具调用，是提升3D点云推理能力的有效路径；Agent式工具驱动3D理解方向具备可扩展性。

Abstract: Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [171] [PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29213)
*Hannuo Zhang,Zhixiang Chi,Xuanchen Li,Yiqun Zhou,Yang Wang,Xinxin Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PartPO 提出面向 3D 点云生成结构化形状程序的部件级强化学习方法：利用形状程序自描述的部件代码块结构，将长程序拆解为部件级奖励、类别奖励与整体形状奖励，并通过开放词表分割模型（以模型自身输出提示调优）自动获取部件监督，从而缓解稀疏标量奖励下的信用分配难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有形状到程序的模型依赖在程序化生成数据上的监督学习，泛化性差；而基于执行反馈的强化学习对构建多部件的长程序只给单一标量奖励，导致信用分配困难。作者希望借助形状程序"自描述"这一任务内在结构来提供细粒度奖励信号，同时避免人工部件标注。

Method: PartPO 依据部件对生成程序分段：仅对相应部件的代码施加部件级奖励，对对象名称施加类别奖励，对整个程序施加形状级奖励。所需部件监督无需人工标注，而是用开放词表分割模型将部件名接地到目标网格上，该分割模型使用模型自身输出进行提示调优。方法应用于 MeshCoder。

Result: 在 ShapeNetCore 与 ABO 上，PartPO 相比基线模型、拒绝采样微调与轨迹级 RL，提升了重建精度与执行成功率，并在未见过的 HSSD 数据集上展现出泛化能力。

Conclusion: 任务结构先验（部件自描述）可有效转化为细粒度奖励信号，解决长程序信用分配问题；结合自提示调优的开放词表接地可实现免标注部件监督，且带来跨数据集的泛化收益。代码将开源。

Abstract: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [172] [Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29218)
*Gaoge Han,Yongkang Cheng,Shaoli Huang,Jing Zhang,Mingming Gong,Fakhri Karray,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"自我中心人体运动桥接"(Egocentric Human Motion Bridging)任务：仅凭两张首尾视角的第一人称图像生成连贯3D人体运动序列，并提出统一扩散框架Ego-HMB完成端点姿态估计与运动填充。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统motion in-betweening需要结构化的3D端点姿态，而VR/AR与机器人可穿戴设备只能提供原始第一人称观测。该设定面临视角差异、人体部分可见、跨模态端点约束下的时序歧义三大挑战，现有方法缺失。

Method: Ego-HMB为单模型统一扩散框架，两阶段训练：1) Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining，采用时间跨度递进的分层课程学习，强化端点姿态先验；2) Motion Bridge Diffusion Training，引入端点约束与物理感知，从邻近姿态出发扩散以保证时序连续性并保持全局端点一致性。

Result: 与一阶段（直接由两帧自我中心图像生成运动）和两阶段（端点姿态估计+运动插值）基线相比，Ego-HMB在端点精度与运动生成质量上均稳定更优。

Conclusion: 将端点姿态估计与运动填充统一于扩散模型可有效应对跨模态端点约束下的自我中心人体运动合成，为可穿戴/具身场景下的人体运动生成提供可行范式；但目前缺乏真实设备数据与下游具身应用验证。

Abstract: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [173] [Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29232)
*Tianyu Ding,Jiachen Jiang,Jinxin Zhou,Yong Ma,Zhihui Zhu,Luming Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出大卷积核难以训练源于 Adam 等自适应优化器逐权重归一化导致的核均值梯度放大（放大 k 倍），并证明 DCT 基是唯一能对角化镜像边界平稳梯度统计量的正交基，故提出在 DCT 系数空间训练大核、训练后转换回原空间（DCT-Rep），零参数、零推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大卷积核能以较低计算代价扩大感受野，但训练极不稳定，现有大核网络依赖并行小核分支+BatchNorm 等昂贵训练技巧。作者希望找到训练困难的根因并给出零开销的通用解法。

Method: 理论分析：输入特征均值非零时核内权重共享同一梯度分量，Adam 类优化器逐元素归一化使 k×k 核均值的更新幅度约为单参数的 k 倍，导致最大可用学习率随 1/k² 下降；进而证明在镜像边界假设下，DCT 基唯一地分离均值并同时对角化所有平稳梯度统计量。实现上：将大核权重做 DCT，对低频（含均值）系数使用较小学习率、其余系数正常更新，训练结束做逆 DCT 回到空间域。仅需数行代码，无额外参数、无推理开销、训练开销可忽略。

Result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割、图像复原四类任务上一致提升：大核 ConvNeXt-T 在 ImageNet-1K 上 +0.79% top-1，ViT-S/16 +0.43%；COCO 上 +1.4 box AP；ADE20K 上 +1.2 mIoU；图像去模糊最高 +0.4 dB；增益随核尺寸增大而增大。

Conclusion: 大核训练困难的可归因于自适应优化器下的均值梯度放大，用 DCT 参数化训练即可消除该问题，方法简单、通用、零推理成本，且适用于 ConvNet 与 ViT，可替代部分复杂的大核训练技巧。

Abstract: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mirrored boundaries. We therefore train large kernels through their DCT coefficients and convert them back after training. The resulting method, DCT-Rep, requires only a few lines of code and adds no parameters, no inference cost and negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and image restoration show that DCT-Rep consistently improves large-kernel ConvNets and vision transformers, by $+0.79\%$ top-1 accuracy for a large-kernel ConvNeXt-T and $+0.43\%$ for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K, $+1.4$ box AP on COCO, $+1.2$ mIoU on ADE20K and up to $+0.4$ dB on image deblurring, where the gain grows with the kernel size.

</details>


### [174] [Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29236)
*Mingle Jiang,Jikui Zhou,Chenghan Lyu,Rui Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REVEAL: a plug-in framework that refines frozen Gaussian Splatting novel-view depth by multi-view reprojection consensus plus a learned selection mechanism; also releases RIG, a synchronized RGB-D real-world benchmark for static/dynamic reconstruction.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gaussian Splatting 渲染深度是沿射线的 opacity 加权平均，与真实场景表面不对应；但同一冻结表示在不同视角下的深度误差互补，可用于跨视角修正而无需改动原表示。

Method: 将源视角深度重投影到目标视角并用鲁棒多视图一致性融合；引入基于期望深度误差下降的学习式选择模块，判断候选深度是否优于原预测；构建 RIG 真实世界基准（同步 RGB-D 相机，含静态与动态重建，提供 GT 深度）。

Result: 在 6 个 Gaussian Splatting 骨干、3 个基准上一致提升深度精度，渲染质量基本保持；RIG 提供 GT 深度用于静态与动态模型评估。

Conclusion: 冻结高斯表示的跨视角深度互补误差是可靠信号，可在不重训表示的前提下显著改善几何精度；方法通用、与骨干解耦，适用于静态与动态重建场景。

Abstract: Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

</details>


### [175] [MM-DataLoop: Closing the Data-Side Loop for Recursive Self-Improvement in MLLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29254)
*Likang Peng,Chen Ju,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Wu,Jinsong Lan,Haihong Tang,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MM-DataLoop 将递归自改进用于 MLLM 后训练的数据侧：数据干预归为五类操作族，由"观察-诊断-计划-执行-验证-反思"循环加共享规则记忆串联，在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上跑 34 轮配方搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自改进（RSI）此前多聚焦模型权重/推理侧，而多模态后训练中数据侧决策（异构操作、跨轮证据协调）缺乏可追踪的组织框架与实证依据。

Method: 把异构数据干预组织为五个操作族，通过 O-D-P-E-V-R 六阶段循环迭代，并以共享规则记忆跨轮复用诊断结论；固定基座初始化、训练调度与评测协议，只变数据配方，在 5 个 benchmark 上做 34 轮候选与随机对照（8 组候选比较，含全池基线）。

Result: R33 五 benchmark 均值为 63.04，较零样本基线 +5.32；R29/R32/R33 构成 0.09 分内的顶部簇。引导搜索在 8 组中 6 组命中预设目标并找出最优观测候选，但随机对照均值更高、离散度更低；R29 配方在同 epoch 下优于两个全池基线。

Conclusion: MM-DataLoop 提供了可追踪的数据侧 RSI 工作流，但引导搜索相对随机搜索的收益并不确切（随机臂均值更高），因此核心贡献更偏框架与经验基准，而非已验证的搜索优势。属 MLLM 后训练数据工程，与物理 AI/VLA/3D 重建不直接相关。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a path toward improving models through repeated evaluation and revision. We study its data side in multimodal language model (MLLM) post-training, where heterogeneous operations and cross-round evidence must be coordinated. MMDataLoop organizes data interventions into five operation families and connects them through an Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect cycle with shared rule memory. Across 34 candidate rounds on Qwen3.5-0.8B and five benchmarks, we hold the base initialization, shared training schedule and evaluation protocol fixed while varying data recipes. The five-benchmark mean reaches 63.04 at R33, up 5.32 points from the zero-shot baseline; R29, R32, and R33 form a close top cluster within 0.09 points. In eightcandidate comparisons, guided search reaches the preselected target in six candidates and identifies the top observed candidate, while random arms show higher means and lower dispersion. The selected R29 recipe also scores above two full-pool baselines under the same epoch schedule. Together, these findings establish MM-DataLoop as a traceable workflow and provide an empirical basis for studying how data-side decisions shape outcomes across MLLM post-training recipes.

</details>


### [176] [CFANet: Learning Conflict-Free Weather Adapters for All-Weather Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29257)
*Minglong Xue,Wenchao Yan,Guoan Guan,Palaiahnakote Shivakumara,Yirui Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CFANet：用非互斥天气混合路由+共享/私有天气适配器处理"复合恶劣天气"的全能图像复原，并加轻量自然色彩适配器做色彩校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 all-in-one 去雨/去雾/去雪方法多为统一网络或单标签天气建模，而真实场景天气常是复合的（多种天气基元共存），单标签假设导致天气间冲突。

Method: Weather Mixture Router (WMR) 从浅层特征预测雨/雾/雪的非互斥组合权重；Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) 依权重在每个 Conflict-Free Adapter Block 中把公共适配器与天气私有适配器动态组合，保留共享复原能力并提供天气特定残差适配；轻量 Natural Color Adapter (NCA) 做带约束的颜色校准以提升色彩保真与自然度。

Result: 大量实验显示在恶劣天气图像复原上具有竞争力，并能增益下游视觉任务；摘要未给出具体量化指标或真实复合天气数据上的泛化证据。

Conclusion: 以"开放式天气组合"替代单标签建模是合理的建模方向，适配器路由+共享/私有解耦+色彩校准三者组合成一套可行的全能复原方案；但证据限于复原指标与下游任务，不涉及物理AI/具身场景。

Abstract: All-weather image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse weather degradations such as rain, haze, and snow. Most existing all-in-one methods handle different weather types with a unified network or rely on single-label weather modeling. However, real-world adverse weather is often compositional, where multiple known weather primitives may coexist in a single image. To this end, we propose Conflict-Free Adapter Network (CFANet) for open-compositional all-weather image restoration. CFANet first employs a Weather Mixture Router (WMR) to predict non-exclusive composition weights for rain, haze, and snow from shallow features. Guided by these weights, a Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) dynamically composes a common adapter with weather-private adapters inside each Conflict-Free Adapter Block, preserving shared restoration capability while providing weather-specific residual adaptation. Moreover, a lightweight Natural Color Adapter (NCA) performs constrained color calibration to improve color fidelity and visual naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive adverse weather image restoration performance and benefits downstream visual tasks. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [177] [DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29275)
*Jiaxi Liu,Keshu Wu,Bin Ran,Xiaopeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveOddsBench：预注册基准，用"真实结果在16个生成未来中的秩一致性"检验11个视频世界模型（含驾驶专用模型）的采样是否对齐真实分布，发现无一对齐且全部低估不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型生成的未来样本正被用于规划与仿真，隐含假设是样本频率与真实世界概率一致（概率校准），但现有评测只评估单样本的"逼真度"，缺乏对采样分布对齐性的检验。

Method: 在Argoverse 2真实驾驶数据上构建预注册基准：(1) 若样本服从真实分布，真实未来在16个样本中的秩应服从均匀分布，可无需概率标签地做池化秩检验；(2) 采用统一验证过的测量工具从生成未来与真实未来中读取同一物理量（前车间距、自车运动），真实未来先经同一自编码器以保证读取方式一致；(3) 所有验证性分析在测量前冻结，防止选择性报告。测试200条留出历史、5类场景族、35,200个生成未来。

Result: 11个通用与驾驶世界模型均未对齐，且全部低估不确定性：真实结果落在全部16个样本范围外的比例为28–61%，而真实分布下期望为11.8%。5个模型存在显著偏斜且方向相反，误差最大的是自车运动量。9个模型在非对齐情况下仍优于气候学（climatology）基线，且模型类型与规模均不能预测谁更接近。

Conclusion: "样本逼真"不等于"分布对齐"；视频世界模型的采样存在系统性过度自信，作为规划/仿真替代真实世界时风险不可忽视，需要显式的不确定性校准与秩一致性评测。

Abstract: Video world models predict how a scene will evolve, and their sampled futures are increasingly used in place of the real one, from planning to simulation. These uses assume that the samples are aligned with real-world odds, with each future appearing among them as often as it would follow the same history in reality, yet current evaluations only score how real each sample looks. Testing this assumption on real driving data is hard for three reasons. Each recorded history has only one real future, so the true probabilities are unknown. Physical quantities must be read from video, where reading errors can look like model errors. Finally, the many possible analyses invite selective reporting. We introduce DriveOddsBench, a pre-registered benchmark that addresses all three. First, if the samples follow the real distribution, the rank of the real outcome among them is uniform in every history, so pooled ranks test them without probability labels. Second, one validated instrument reads the same quantities, such as the lead-vehicle gap and the ego motion, from the generated futures and from the real future, which first passes through the world model's autoencoder so that both are read alike. Third, all confirmatory analyses were frozen before any test clip was measured. We test eleven general and driving world models on 200 held-out Argoverse 2 histories in five scenario families, with 35,200 generated futures. None is aligned, and every model underestimates its uncertainty. The real outcome falls outside the range of all 16 samples in 28-61% of cases instead of the 11.8% expected under the real distribution. Five models are significantly skewed, in opposite directions, and the largest errors are in the ego motion. Nine models beat climatology without being aligned, and among these models neither type nor scale predicts which comes closest.

</details>


### [178] [ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29276)
*Weikun Zhou,Jinliang Lin,Yu Zang,Lin Xie,Haiqing Fu,Sheng Ao,Shangshu Yu,Zhiming Luo,Cheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将地理参考地图编码为可连续查询的语义神经场，把跨视角无人机定位转化为在连续4DoF位姿空间（平面位置+航向+视距尺度）上的显式优化，并用层级式搜索完成推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流范式把地图组织为离散2DoF候选库，使地图表示与位姿推断耦合，定位精度被候选采样分辨率所限制（retrieval采样瓶颈）。

Method: 用语义神经场表示地图使其连续可查询，解耦表示与推断；在4DoF连续位姿空间上做显式优化，位姿假设按需由共享语义特征空间中的全局描述子评估；引入ContinuScenes多城市近垂直无人机影像基准提供稠密4DoF位姿监督，学习对4DoF位姿敏感的视觉表示；推理由粗到细，从广覆盖逐步聚焦高兼容区域。

Result: 在逐步收紧的4DoF精度准则下，相较代表性定位范式取得显著提升，突破检索采样分辨率瓶颈。

Conclusion: 地图表示与位姿推断的解耦是跨视角地理定位的有效路径；连续神经场+4DoF位姿优化可作为检索式候选库范式的替代方案，并配套发布基准与代码。

Abstract: Cross-view UAV geo-localization involves three design choices: how to represent the UAV observation, how to represent the geo-referenced map, and how to infer pose from their interaction. The dominant paradigm organizes the map as a discretized 2DoF candidate library, coupling map representation to pose inference and thus bounding spatial localization precision by candidate sampling resolution. We decouple map representation from pose inference by encoding the geo-referenced map as a continuously queryable semantic neural field, enabling localization to be formulated as explicit optimization over a continuous 4DoF pose space parameterized by 2D ground position, in-plane heading, and viewing scale. Pose hypotheses are evaluated on demand using global descriptors in a shared semantic feature space, bypassing the sampling bottleneck of retrieval. We learn 4DoF pose-sensitive visual representations under full 4DoF supervision provided by ContinuScenes, a multi-city benchmark with dense near-nadir UAV imagery and complete pose annotations. Inference proceeds hierarchically, progressing from broad pose-space coverage to adaptive concentration on high-compatibility regions.
