Experiments demonstrate substantial gains over representative localization paradigms under progressively stricter 4DoF accuracy criteria. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [179] [One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29278)
*Guilin Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OB-SAM：面向医学图像分割的单样本（one-shot）SAM增强框架，通过多频解耦、渐进特征融合与选择性上下文过滤三个模块，从结构化建模角度最大化单样本信息利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM等基础模型主要在自然图像上预训练，直接用于医学图像效果差；大量标注医学数据获取成本高，因此单样本（one-shot）范式有吸引力，但SAM在该范式下难以充分挖掘其多粒度信息，性能骤降。

Method: 提出OB-SAM框架，包含三个模块：(1) 多频解耦模块MFD，将特征分解为不同频域分量，使各分支关注不同语义层级的信息表达，缓解过拟合；(2) 渐进特征整合器PFI，促进多层特征互补融合，避免某一层级特征在融合中占据主导；(3) 选择性上下文过滤模块SCF，通过建模前景-背景对比关系自适应选择关键上下文，实现病灶区域精确定位。

Result: 在七个不同医学数据集上的大量实验表明，OB-SAM取得当前最优性能（state-of-the-art）。摘要未给出具体指标数值。

Conclusion: 从结构化建模角度设计频域解耦+渐进融合+上下文过滤，可有效提升SAM在单样本医学分割中的信息利用率，验证了该范式的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [180] [RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29282)
*Hu Zhou,Jiazhou Zhou,Shuowen Zhang,Ying-Chang Liang,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadioWorld：用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（场景理解 Transformer + 场生成 Transformer）把世界模型适配为从3D场景几何与收发机位置直接合成 RF 辐射场的通用框架，推理时无需任何参考 RF 测量；并发布 UrbanRF-Bench（657 场景、32,850 个 RF 辐射场、7 座城市）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经 RF 场方法存在三大局限：(1) 依赖逐场景优化、无法泛化到未见场景；(2) 目标场景需昂贵的参考 RF 实测；(3) 超出参考测量邻域外推时性能严重退化。6G 通信与感知需要可泛化、免测量的 RF 辐射场建模。

Method: 提出 RadioWorld：将“世界模型”适配为前馈式 RF 辐射场合成器。采用双流 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构——Scene-Understanding Transformer 编码 3D 场景几何与收发机坐标，提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer 以该特征为条件、结合局部查询条件合成 RF 辐射场。仅以物理几何与收发机位置为输入，推理阶段零参考 RF 测量。训练/评估基于大规模射线追踪基准 UrbanRF-Bench。

Result: 在 UrbanRF-Bench（657 个城市场景、32,850 个 RF 辐射场、覆盖 7 座全球城市）上显著优于专用基线，并能在未见城市中对任意位置准确合成 RF 场。

Conclusion: RF 辐射场可作为几何条件化的世界模型任务，用 MoT 双流结构实现跨场景泛化与免测量的前馈推断；UrbanRF-Bench 为后续通用电磁场建模提供可扩展评测平台。

Abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [181] [Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models via Simulating Brain Functional Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29288)
*Manyi Li,Yufan Liu,Bing Li,Xia Wu,Ziyu Li,Weiming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出初始潜变量优化攻击IVO来重新激活被擦除概念，并据此提出基于功能定位的CeFlune擦除方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除的再激活攻击多搜索文本或图像输入空间，初始潜空间未被充分挖掘，导致擦除鲁棒性评估存在盲区。

Method: IVO通过优化初始潜变量改变生成起点以再激活概念；CeFlune借鉴脑功能定位，将线性模块定义为Unit Neurons，比较任务态与静息态的响应轨迹以定位概念相关单元，并更新这些单元约束其响应与模型预测。

Result: 8种擦除方法上IVO再激活效果优于基线攻击；CeFlune在U-Net扩散与flow-matching transformer上与多达15个基线相比，在擦除效果与通用生成能力间取得较好平衡，并在IVO等5种攻击下再激活率更低。

Conclusion: 初始潜空间是评估擦除鲁棒性的重要盲点，基于单位神经元功能定位的干预可实现更鲁棒的概念擦除。

Abstract: Concept erasure in text-to-image models aims to prevent a target concept from appearing in generated images while preserving general image generation capability. However, erased concepts can still be reactivated by attacks. Prior attacks mainly search text or image input spaces, leaving the initial latent space underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce IVO (Initial latent Variable Optimization), a new concept reactivation attack that changes the starting point of image generation by optimizing the initial latent. Comprehensive experiments across 8 erasure methods show that IVO reactivates erased concepts more effectively than the attack baselines, revealing a blind spot in erasure robustness evaluation. This motivates us to localize model components associated with the target concept and then treat them as intervention sites for more robust concept erasure. We propose CeFlune (Concept Erasure via Functional Localization of Unit Neurons), which adapts brain functional localization to text-to-image models. CeFlune defines linear modules as Unit Neurons and localizes concept-responsive ones by comparing their response trajectories in the model's task and resting states. It then updates the localized Unit Neurons to constrain their responses and the erased model's predictions. Across U-Net diffusion and flow-matching transformer architectures, CeFlune achieves a favorable balance between concept erasure and general image generation capability in comparisons with up to 15 baseline methods. Under IVO and 4 other evaluated attacks, CeFlune also shows lower concept reactivation.

</details>


### [182] [GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29293)
*Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Galilean transport：在位置编码前，用估计速度与时序偏移把每个 key 的 3D 位置平移到 query 时刻，使 RayRoPE/URoPE 等几何感知位置编码在动态场景中与运动内容对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何感知旋转位置编码（如 RayRoPE）隐含假设场景静态，把每个 key 编码在其观测位置；在时序分离的输入视图下，同一运动物体在不同帧被放在不同位置，导致渲染位置不准。时序编码只告诉“何时观测”，并未解决“query 时刻内容应在何处”。

Method: Galilean transport：利用 key 的估计速度与时间偏移，将其 3D 位置外推到 query 时刻后再做位置编码；仅修改 key 位置，不改编码公式，可即插即用于 RayRoPE、URoPE。速度默认由网络内 token 对应关系估计，也可来自任意来源。

Result: 集成到 LVSM 后在 Syn4D、动态 Objaverse 与真实 Stereo4D 视频上提升动态新视角合成；消融显示将速度作为 token 特征的收益较小；注意力可视化显示其关注运动内容的 query 时刻位置；在预训练 3D 点跟踪器上降低动目标跟踪误差，在视频生成器上改善运动车辆生成。

Conclusion: 一种简单通用的动态位置编码修正，跨视图合成、点跟踪、视频生成多任务有效。

Abstract: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

</details>


### [183] [CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29305)
*Yibing Fu,Huidong Xie,Yihao Niu,Wei Ji,Heming Dong,Ziyue Wang,Jingyu Chen,Jun Zhao,Haoyuan Hu,Hongming Shan,Lai Jiang,Mai Xu,Yueming Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"agentic perception"范式与CT-Navigator框架，用通用MLLM的2D视觉与工具调用能力，通过层级视觉探索与放射学工具调用来实现可追溯的3D CT解读；构建8,904条视觉思维链轨迹冷启动SFT，再用RL在33,219问题优化策略，并提出CTNavi-Bench（7,000题），准确率79.50%、超最强基线17.59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学MLLM把专用3D编码器接在语言模型上，未充分利用通用MLLM的原生2D视觉与智能体能力；且训练于大规模一跳式CT指令数据，缺乏迭代推理与视觉证据显式定位能力，难以支撑可追溯的CT解读。放射科医生的真实阅片流程本身就是渐进式视觉探索（全卷→单层→ROI→按需调用外部工具）。

Method: 1）agentic perception范式：以通用MLLM为策略，做层级视觉探索（逐层/ROI定位）+ 放射学工具调用；2）数据：人工整理8,904条V-CoT轨迹用于冷启动agentic SFT；3）训练：在33,219个问题上做RL优化策略，配合数据筛选与动态rollout采样以优先高信息量学习信号；4）评测：提出CTNavi-Bench，7,000题覆盖全身解剖区域的3D CT VQA。

Result: CTNavi-Bench上79.50%准确率，超过最强基线17.59个百分点；在三个外部CT基准上表现良好泛化；代码、模型与基准将开源。

Conclusion: 将"智能体化感知"引入医学影像理解，用工具调用+层级视觉探索替代单跳3D编码器范式，可显著提升CT问答推理能力并带来可追溯证据，但属医学领域专用工作，对通用Physical AI/机器人方向可借鉴的是"agent工具调用+RL后训练"的范式与动态rollout采样策略。

Abstract: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{ this https URL }{GitHub}.

</details>


### [184] [Where Does Personalization Reside in Photo Editing? Evidence from One Photographer's Lightroom History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29307)
*Dongwu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于单摄影师纵向私人数据集(3193张、41个catalog、批级留出),对比绝对/相对先验目标、图像条件预测器与少样本同批锚点估计;发现残差学习在留出批次上增益不显著,而闭式收缩(EB)在4/8/16个同批锚点时将曝光MAE降至0.466/0.457/0.453 EV,优于仅先验基线0.586-0.592。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化照片编辑系统需同时推断摄影师的长期偏好与单次拍摄意图,但现有工作很少将这两类信号分离评估,且缺乏可解释、可审计的估计方式。

Method: 构建单摄影师纵向Lightroom调整数据集(3193张、41个catalog、批级留出);比较绝对目标与先验相对目标、图像条件预测器、以及接收目标批次少量编辑的估计器;提出基于同批锚点的闭式收缩/经验贝叶斯估计,并与学习式anchor-conditioned head、gating机制对比;采用batch-clustered bootstrap显著性检验,并用383张Lightroom原生导出做渲染空间(ΔE00)校验;附录将动作空间从6个扩展至13个全局控件。

Result: 残差预测在小批次上改善验证误差但在留出批次增益小且不显著(0.592 vs 0.582 EV);同批锚点闭式收缩在k=4/8/16达0.466/0.457/0.453 EV,配对下降在批聚类bootstrap下显著;学习式anchor head无明显增益,负训练先验使冷图误编辑率已很低;渲染空间k=8时EB较先验降低ΔE00 0.41(p=0.042),真参数降低0.78(p=0.034);13控件扩展下同批中位数"look"使渲染色度更接近导出,但逐图残差头仍不迁移。

Conclusion: 推荐采用仅需少量同批编辑的闭式、可审计估计器;研究表明批次级意图信号强于跨批次个性偏好迁移,但结论限于单一摄影师,且滑块精度不等同于美学偏好度量。

Abstract: Personalized photo-editing systems must infer both a photographer's recurring preferences and the intent of a particular shoot, yet these signals are rarely evaluated separately. We study interpretable Lightroom adjustments in a longitudinal, private dataset of 3,193 edited photographs from 41 catalogs by one professional photographer, with holdouts formed at the batch level. We compare absolute and prior-relative targets, image-conditioned predictors, and estimators that receive a small set of edits from the target batch. Residual prediction improves validation error, but its advantage on held-out batches is small and not significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap (0.592 vs 0.582 EV exposure MAE). In a batch-shared protocol, closed-form shrinkage using 4, 8, or 16 same-batch anchors reaches 0.466, 0.457, or 0.453 EV with the best estimator at each k, compared with 0.586-0.592 EV for the prior-only baseline; the paired reductions are significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap. Learned anchor-conditioned heads do not improve on this closed-form estimator, and a negative-trained prior already yields a low cold-image false-edit rate, leaving little benefit for an additional gate. The recommended estimator is closed-form and auditable, and it requires only a handful of same-batch edits. A render-space check against 383 native Lightroom exports reproduces the ranking: at k=8, online EB lowers Delta E00 against the prior by 0.41 (p=0.042), and the photographer's true parameters lower it by 0.78 (p=0.034). An appendix extends the action space from six to thirteen global controls: a same-batch median look lowers rendered chroma toward the export, while a per-photograph residual head again fails to transfer. The study is limited to one photographer and does not claim that slider accuracy measures aesthetic preference.

</details>


### [185] [Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29309)
*Junxian Li,Ruixuan Yang,Zhenhua Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CountDrawBench基准（工程图/电路图/分子结构计数，1,574题）与Code-Verified RL框架，用"计数正确性+实例匹配+局部缩放一致性"三种可执行验证奖励统一进GRPO训练，把Qwen3.5-9B从49.3%提升到54.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在自然图像计数尚可，但在机械图纸中螺栓孔、化学结构中氮原子这类小目标、密集排布或需依制图约定推断的计数任务上明显失效；该问题缺乏系统基准与有效训练信号。

Method: 构建CountDrawBench（平面图、电气原理图、机械图纸、分子结构四类，含实例级标注）。训练侧提出Code-Verified RL：代码可执行验证给出三类互补奖励——最终答案计数奖励、实例位置匹配奖励、局部区域缩放的计数一致性奖励，共同整合到统一GRPO目标中。

Result: 最强评测模型在CountDrawBench上仅59.3%准确率；本方法使Qwen3.5-9B从49.3%→54.3%，超过所有评测开源基线。

Conclusion: 技术图纸计数是当前MLLM的显著短板，CountDrawBench可作为挑战性测试床；可验证（代码）奖励式RL对该类细粒度符号计数任务有实际增益。

Abstract: Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [186] [PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29311)
*Yizhu Chen,Chen Ju,Donghao Zhou,Ziyu Guo,Shuai Xiao,Jinsong Lan,Xiaoyong Zhu,Ying Chen,Haodong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PrimiTok：将码字视为可复用视觉基元，按 token 复杂度自适应分配并加权组合，兼具重建保真与语义对齐的组合式视觉 tokenizer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一视觉理解与生成需要同时保留语义与细粒度细节。连续 tokenizer 偏语义对齐而丢失重建细节；离散 tokenizer 受量化损失；传统多码本对每个 token 分配固定数量码字，忽略局部内容差异。

Method: 提出组合式视觉 tokenizer PrimiTok。含两部分：Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP) 通过增强子码本质心间多样性减少冗余；Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA) 依据 token 复杂度选择基元，并用嵌入量化误差监督每个子码本选择的基元数量，再以输入相关权重聚合。训练结合重建损失与图文对比学习。

Result: 在重建质量与语义对齐上优于 SOTA 基线，并在多模态理解与视觉生成任务上进一步验证有效性。

Conclusion: 自适应、可组合的基元式离散表示可在单一 tokenizer 中兼顾视觉保真与语义对齐，为理解-生成统一建模提供基础表征。

Abstract: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. PrimiTok integrates two complementary components: Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP), which encourages diversity among sub-codebook centroids to reduce redundancy, and a Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA), which selects primitives according to token complexity. Embedding quantization error supervises how many primitives are selected from each sub-codebook, and DPA aggregates them with input-dependent weights. Joint reconstruction and image--text contrastive learning encourage the resulting representations to retain visual fidelity and semantic alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction and semantic alignment over SOTA baselines, with further evaluations on multimodal understanding and visual generation.

</details>


### [187] [Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29312)
*Lingyun Xing,Wenning Hao,Kai Jiang,Dawei Jin,Xiaohan Zhang,Xiaoxiong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文指出跨视角目标地理定位(CVOGL)模型存在"提示不遵从"的过拟合问题，并通过构建多目标数据集CVOGL-MO与跨视角同场景多目标对比损失(CVMCL)加以缓解，同时提出提示敏感性评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CVOGL基准每个任务仅4,343个提示-目标对，规模过小，导致模型记忆场景内固定目标而忽略点击点语义；定量探测显示移动或删除点击点时预测几乎不变，属于捷径学习。

Method: (1) 通过提示敏感性量化评估诊断问题；(2) 构建CVOGL-MO数据集，用多目标标注扩展现有训练/测试集；(3) 提出CVMCL损失，拉大同场景内不同点击点的特征表示差异；(4) 设计带预测偏移指标的提示敏感性评测协议。两者均为架构无关的即插即用模块。

Result: 在三种代表性骨干网络上，多目标测试集提示遵从准确率显著提升，提示敏感性指标明显增强。

Conclusion: CVOGL中的提示不遵从源于小规模数据导致的记忆式捷径学习；数据扩展与场景内多目标对比学习可有效提升模型对提示语义的响应性，且无需修改网络结构。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object indicated by a click point in a ground or drone query image within a satellite reference image. Through a quantitative prompt-sensitivity evaluation, we find that existing CVOGL methods suffer from a prompt-disobeying overfitting problem: when the click point is moved or removed, their predictions barely respond, indicating that the models rely on spurious feature correlations rather than genuinely following the prompt semantics. We trace this behavior to the limited scale of the benchmark dataset, which contains only 4,343 prompt-object pairs per task, so that the models simply memorize the object associated with each scene instead of learning the true prompt-to-object correspondence. To address this, we propose two plug-and-play components. First, we construct the CVOGL-MO dataset by expanding the existing training and test sets with diverse multi-object annotations, mitigating the memorization that induces shortcut learning. Second, we propose the Cross-View Co-Scene Multi-Object Contrastive Loss (CVMCL), which enforces distinct feature representations for different click points within the same scene, compelling the model to follow prompt instructions. We further design a prompt-sensitivity evaluation protocol with prediction-shift metrics, providing the first quantitative measurement of prompt-following capability for CVOGL. Both components are architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing methods without any architectural modification. Experiments on three representative backbones show that our components substantially improve prompt-following accuracy on the new multi-object test sets and markedly increase prompt sensitivity. Our dataset and code will be publicly released at this https URL .

</details>


### [188] [FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29327)
*Haozhe Zhao,Junxiang Zhang,Junxin Wang,Yuan Ge,Xiangchen Song,Dingyang Zhang,JingBo Zhu,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FP-Prune：基于互信息视角的无训练视觉token剪枝方法，理论上证明frame potential可作互信息的代理，迭代剪除信息增益低的token，在3个VLM、8个数据集上提升精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token剪枝的关键难点在于量化候选token相对已保留集合的“增量互补信息”，而基于attention或相似度的常规打分难以直接刻画这一贡献。

Method: 从信息增益视角重构剪枝问题，用互信息刻画候选token的边际价值；理论证明frame potential是互信息的有效代理；据此设计FP-Prune：无需训练，迭代移除低信息增益token，最大化保留互补视觉信息。

Result: 3个主流VLM、8个数据集上，精度与推理效率均优于基线；进一步分析显示代理目标与模型性能高度一致。

Conclusion: 为视觉token剪枝提供了信息论理论依据与简洁有效的无训练方法，验证了frame potential代理的有效性。

Abstract: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. Experiments on three widely used VLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that FP-Prune outperforms baseline methods in both accuracy and inference efficiency. Further analysis shows that the surrogate objective closely aligns with model performance. Our work provides theoretical grounding and an effective method for visual token pruning.

</details>


### [189] [SKIA: Spatial-Knowledge Informed Attention for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography under Lower-Face Motion Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29330)
*Van-Truong Le,Viet-Tham Huynh,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SKIA: 掩膜引导的轻量级rPPG框架，通过抑制面部下区（嘴/下颌）运动干扰、保留额头与面颊生理线索，并用"原图+静态掩膜图+时序运动差分"三流时空网络重建BVP波形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: rPPG可从面部视频无接触估计生理信号，但认知与交流任务中的面部运动（尤其嘴和下颌运动）会严重破坏信号重建质量；作者希望用空间先验+时序稳定性来提升运动鲁棒性。

Method: 先在UBFC-rPPG上于经典CHROM管线验证静态下半脸掩膜的效果；再提出SKIA-Net：紧凑时空架构，融合原始帧、静态掩膜表示与时序运动差分三路输入重建BVP；并做消融，对比静态解剖先验与基于光流的动态掩膜。

Result: CHROM+静态掩膜：波形Pearson相关由0.3507升至0.4166（p<0.001），心率MAE由33.50降至23.44 bpm；SKIA-Net完整模型Pearson 0.7522、心率MAE 3.73 bpm，优于单流变体；消融显示静态掩膜提供互补信息，且静态解剖先验优于测试的光流动态掩膜。

Conclusion: 空间先验引导、时序稳定的掩膜策略能有效提升运动场景下rPPG估计的鲁棒性与精度，轻量三流时空融合是可行方案。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring from facial videos, but facial motion, particularly mouth and jaw movements during cognitive and communicative tasks, can severely degrade signal reconstruction. We present SKIA, a lightweight, mask-guided framework that suppresses motion-prone lower-face regions while preserving physiological cues from the forehead and cheeks. Using the UBFC-rPPG benchmark, we first investigate static lower-face suppression in the classical CHROM pipeline. Static masking improves waveform Pearson correlation from 0.3507 to 0.4166 (p < 0.001) and reduces heart-rate mean absolute error (MAE) from 33.50 to 23.44 bpm. Building on this finding, we introduce SKIA-Net, a compact spatiotemporal architecture that combines raw facial frames, statically masked representations, and temporal motion differences to reconstruct blood volume pulse (BVP) waveforms. The full model achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.7522 and a heart-rate MAE of 3.73 bpm on UBFC-rPPG, outperforming single-stream variants. Ablation studies show that the static mask provides complementary information to raw appearance and that static anatomical priors outperform the tested dynamic optical-flow-based masking strategy. These results suggest that spatially informed, temporally stable masking can improve motion-robust rPPG estimation. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [190] [Probe Before You Learn: Allocating Prompts from Initial Gradients under Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29336)
*Jiazhe Zhang,Zibin Geng,Qiang Ma,Xuefeng Jiang,Yijun Lin,Jingyi Wang,Yu Yan,Xingzhou Zhang,Min Liu,Yuwei Wang,Sheng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GPrompt：在提示优化前用初始化处的损失梯度几何（模态内集中度+跨模态重叠）推导文本/视觉提示预算分配的闭式解，实现免训练的鲁棒提示学习配置选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据中的噪声标签会偏置提示更新，削弱视觉-语言模型适配效果。已有鲁棒提示学习侧重抑制不可靠更新，而"提示分配"（文本提示与视觉提示间参数预算的划分）被忽视——在固定训练目标与总预算下，改变分配即可显著提升鲁棒性。但最优分配随任务而异且先验未知，穷举候选训练代价过高。

Method: 提出GPrompt，一种免训练方法：在提示优化前、于初始化点用小样本图像与生成的伪标签作为共享监督做一次探针，提取成对的文本与视觉提示损失梯度；用迹归一化Gram矩阵刻画其几何特性，包括各模态内的集中度与跨模态的重叠度；据此导出闭式分配解，并在精确参数预算下投影到可行的整数提示数量上，实现任务自适应选择而无需训练候选项。

Result: 在11个数据集上，GPrompt较最强基线最高提升7.75%，且所选配置接近穷举训练得到的最优分配；梯度探针的平均运行时间比穷举候选训练低99.9%。

Conclusion: 提示分配是鲁棒提示学习中一个关键且此前被忽视的自由度，可用初始化梯度几何以近乎零成本的方式先验预测，为参数高效适配提供了新的分析视角与实用选择工具。

Abstract: Prompt learning provides a parameter-efficient way to adapt pretrained vision--language models through text and visual prompts, but noisy labels prevalent in real-world data inevitably bias prompt updates and thereby undermine adaptation effectiveness. Prior work on robust prompt learning focuses on suppressing unreliable updates under noisy supervision. We uncover a pivotal yet overlooked aspect--prompt allocation: shifting the parameter budget between text and visual prompts can substantially enhance robustness while keeping the training objective and total budget fixed. However, suitable prompt allocations vary across tasks and are unknown a priori, rendering brute-force candidate training computationally prohibitive. We propose GPrompt, a training-free method that derives allocation between text and visual prompts using only loss gradients at initialization before prompt optimization. Using a small sample of images and generated pseudo-labels as shared supervision, GPrompt performs an initialization probe to extract paired text and visual loss gradients, and characterizes the geometry of their trace-normalized Gram matrices through both concentration within each modality and overlap between modalities. GPrompt then derives a closed-form allocation, and projects it onto feasible prompt counts under the exact parameter budget, enabling task-specific selection without training candidate configurations. Experiments across eleven datasets show that GPrompt outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 7.75% while selecting configurations close to the best allocation identified through exhaustive training. The average runtime of gradient probe across datasets is 99.9% lower than that of exhaustive candidate training.

</details>


### [191] [MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29341)
*Shizhao Zhang,Yanyan Zhang,Deshui Yu,Jun Pan,Guangyou Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIMORPHEUS：用条件扩散从3D人体姿态生成MIMO雷达回波，用于雷达人体姿态估计的数据增强与跨模态标注迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 穿墙MIMO雷达人体姿态估计缺乏配对雷达-姿态数据；视觉姿态数据集无对应回波；物理仿真依赖散射建模且存在仿真-真实域差。

Method: MIMO-VAE按通道与快时间采样结构压缩回波；SkeleCoder通过对比对齐学习与回波特征一致的姿态表示；以姿态特征为条件在MIMO-VAE潜空间做扩散生成，再由VAE解码器重建回波。

Result: 数据增强实验中四个雷达姿态估计器MPJPE降低6.8%–11.2%；在三份公开姿态数据集上的迁移实验表明视觉姿态标注可提供有效雷达训练数据。

Conclusion: 跨模态生成式数据增强可缓解雷达数据稀缺，并打通视觉姿态标注到雷达模态的迁移路径。

Abstract: Deep learning has shown promise for estimating human pose with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar through walls. Building paired radar and pose datasets demands considerable time and manual effort, while large visual pose datasets provide no corresponding radar echoes. Physical simulation can supply synthetic signals, but requires expertise in scattering models and can leave a gap between simulated and real data. To address this challenge, we introduce MIMORPHEUS, a framework that generates radar echoes from 3D human poses through conditional diffusion. To prepare echo and pose representations, MIMO-VAE compresses the echoes according to their channel and fast time sample structure, while SkeleCoder learns pose features through contrastive alignment with echo features. These pose features then guide diffusion in the MIMO-VAE latent space, and the VAE decoder reconstructs echoes from the generated latents. Once trained, the generator augments radar data by producing different echoes for a recorded pose and supplies the radar modality for pose annotations in existing visual datasets. In data augmentation experiments, our method reduces MPJPE by 6.8%-11.2% across four radar pose estimators. Transfer experiments with three public pose datasets also show that visual pose annotations can supply useful radar training data. Code will be made publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [192] [A Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Color Normalization Methods in Histopathology: Nuclei Preservation, Artifact Sensitivity, Background Fidelity, and Downstream Performanc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29348)
*Falah Jabar,Aria Torkpour,Pasquale Lombardi,Masoud Tafavvoghi,Per Niklas Benzler Waaler,Sigve Andersen,Ilona Urbarova,David J. Pinato,Mehrdad Rakaee,Tom Donnem,Lill-Tove Rasmussen Busund,Elin Richardsen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 跨中心染色/扫描差异导致核检测与分类模型泛化差；本文系统benchmark 11种灰度/深度学习颜色归一化方法与7种输入颜色空间，发现颜色空间影响有限、检测分类性能更多取决于数据集而非归一化方法，图像级指标无法可靠预测下游性能，并开源WSI-QCN流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理全切片图像中存在显著的染色与扫描差异，颜色归一化常被用作预处理，但其对核结构保真、背景保持、伪影敏感度以及下游核检测/分类性能的影响缺乏系统性评估，现有图像级质量指标未必能反映下游收益。

Method: 构建统一benchmark流程：在7个公开与私有核数据集上对比11种经典与深度颜色归一化方法，并考察7种输入颜色空间；从核结构保真度、背景保持、伪影敏感度和下游核检测/分类性能多维度评估；同时发布开源流水线WSI-QCN用于全切片图像质量评估与归一化。

Result: 不同归一化方法在核结构、背景与伪影敏感度上表现差异明显；但检测与分类性能在数据集间的波动大于方法间差异，输入颜色空间影响有限；无单一方法在所有指标上最优，图像级质量指标无法可靠预测下游性能。

Conclusion: 颜色归一化不存在通用最优解，需要面向细胞核与结构感知的归一化方法；图像级指标不应作为下游性能代理。提供WSI-QCN开源工具以便复现与质控。

Abstract: Deep learning models for nuclei detection and classification may generalize poorly across medical centers because of variations in staining and scanning. Although color normalization aims to reduce these variations, its effects on nuclear structure, background preservation, artifact sensitivity, and nuclei detection and classification performance have not been systematically evaluated. We present a procedure to benchmark 11 classical and deep learning normalization methods using 7 public and private nuclei datasets. Additionally, we investigate the effect of 7 input color spaces. The normalization methods differed in their effects on nuclear structure, background, and sensitivity to artifacts. However, detection and classification performance varied more across datasets than across normalization methods, and the input color space had limited influence. No single method performed best on all criteria, and image-level metrics did not reliably predict downstream performance, highlighting the need for nuclei- and structure-aware normalization methods. To support this work, we introduce WSI Quality Control and Normalization (WSI-QCN), a publicly available pipeline for robust whole-slide image quality assessment and color normalization; the source code is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [193] [Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29355)
*Yuechen Jiang,Enze Zhang,Yuyan Wang,Mohsinul Kabir,Chenying Lin,Sijia Li,Qianqian Xie,Stavroula Golfomitsou,Konstantinos Arvanitis,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Polytropos benchmark: converts model-generated cultural object descriptions back into images and compares reconstructions to originals to measure what descriptions retain of the particular object.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-language models increasingly act as describers of cultural objects, and their descriptions typify particular things into cultural stereotypes; the loss in a description reveals what the describer lacks.

Method: 374 objects from the Met and Getty; 1,870 descriptions from 5 models plus 230 curator descriptions; each description is rendered back into an image (text-to-image reconstruction) and compared with the original photograph via identity/recognition judgments.

Result: Reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs (54.55%-59.09% vs 52.14%), yet 16%-21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object; models lose recorded cultures at rates similar to curators but gain more.

Conclusion: Model descriptions produce many culturally typical faces per object, almost none identical to the object itself — a measure of particularity loss in VLMs.

Abstract: Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models. Descriptions of cultures tend to turn particular things into types, and what a description loses shows what its describer lacks. We introduce Polytropos, a benchmark that measures what model descriptions of cultural objects keep of the particular object by turning each description back into an image and comparing it with the original photograph. On 374 objects from the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Getty, with 1,870 descriptions from five models and 230 written by curators, reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs, at 54.55% to 59.09% against 52.14%, yet 16% to 21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object. On the same objects, models lose recorded cultures at a rate similar to curators but gain more. Model descriptions give each object many faces, each typical of its culture and almost none the object itself.

</details>


### [194] [Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29361)
*Yichen Zhao,Fenghe Tang,Wenxin Ma,Rongsheng Wang,Zihao Wan,Shaohua Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出成对非增强/增强医学VQA数据集，实证表明MLLM视觉感知的关键不止空间注意力，视觉value通道检索的内容更重要；据此提出VIVID，用增强图像的视觉value干预来筛选教师纠正，改进CE→NC的on-policy蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型研究隐式地把空间注意力图当作有效视觉感知的核心指标，忽略视觉信息通过value通道被实际检索与利用的程度，该假设缺乏验证。

Method: 构建配对NC/CE医学VQA数据（解剖一致、线索不同）；通过注意力模式对比与双向受控干预（分别干预注意力权重与视觉value）量化二者对预测的影响；在此基础上提出VIVID：以增强图像视觉value作为证据信号，筛选与有用视觉证据一致的教师纠正，用于CE→NC的on-policy蒸馏。

Result: 配对样本上MLLM注意力模式相似却给出相反答案；干预视觉value带来的预测变化显著大于干预注意力权重；VIVID在六个内部/外部测试集上一致优于现有on-policy蒸馏方法，跨模型规模与架构有效，推理仅需NC图像，并保持通用域VQA零样本性能。

Conclusion: 视觉感知瓶颈应从"看哪里"扩展到"取什么"，视觉value层面的蒸馏是可解释且有效的改进路径；但属医学领域VQA，对通用多模态/具身任务的可迁移性尚未验证。

Abstract: Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [195] [Scenario Compliant Indoor Pedestrian Trajectory Reconstruction from Partial Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29366)
*Qi Dang,Luis Quintero,Shibo Zhu,Oskar Juhlin,Xiaodan Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于条件扩散模型的「地图条件生成框架」，用CNN编码器把稠密场景地图作为结构化空间输入引导去噪，并将起终点嵌入地图作为空间锚点，用于室内行人轨迹重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数概率/生成式轨迹补全方法把轨迹视为无约束坐标序列，在受墙壁、走廊等稠密几何约束支配的室内场景中生成物理不可行、碰撞率高的路径。

Method: 条件扩散模型 + CNN 场景地图编码器实现地图条件去噪；endpoint-aware 机制将观测到的起点/终点以图像级特征嵌入地图作为空间锚点；在仿真室内轨迹与真实 Shopper 数据集上、3 个随机种子训练评估。

Result: 在对比的生成式方法中误差最低；场景条件使仿真数据碰撞率与无效率分别下降 19% 与 46%；真实 Shopper 数据收益一致但较小，模型很少学会在端点间绕障。相较永不碰撞的最短路规划器，方法更好地刻画真实运动变异性（CRPS 低 31%），但停顿时机仅部分恢复。

Conclusion: 显式环境上下文可提升物理一致性，但在真实室内空间中重建逼真人类运动仍是开放难题；代码已开源。

Abstract: Pedestrian trajectory reconstruction is vital for applications ranging from security surveillance to indoor navigation. While existing probabilistic and generative frameworks have shown success in outdoor GPS-based trajectory imputation, they often fail in indoor settings where movement is strictly governed by dense geometric constraints such as walls and corridors. Standard models typically treat trajectories as unconstrained coordinate sequences, leading to physically infeasible paths with high collision rates. To address this, we propose a map-conditioned generative framework based on conditional diffusion models. Our approach explicitly integrates dense scenario maps as structured spatial inputs via a CNN-based encoder, allowing environmental geometry to guide the iterative denoising process. Furthermore, we employ an endpoint-aware mechanism by embedding observations (start and end points) directly into the scenario map, providing critical spatial anchors through image-level features. Experiments on simulated indoor trajectories and the real-world Shopper trajectory dataset, with three training seeds, show that our method achieves the lowest errors among the compared generative methods. Scene conditioning reduces the collision and invalid rates by 19\% and 46\% on the simulated dataset, whereas on real shopper data the gains are consistent but small, mainly because the model rarely learns to route around obstacles between the endpoints. Compared with a shortest-path planner, which never collides, our method better captures the variability of real motion (31\% lower CRPS), but the timing of stops is reconstructed only partially. These results show that explicit environmental context improves physical consistency, while reconstructing realistic human motion in real indoor spaces remains challenging. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [196] [ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29369)
*Yushen Hu,Yilong Song,Zhen Zhou,Apurv Kushwaha,Harshvardhan Chandirasekar,Zhu-Tian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClothCast：以夹爪轨迹为运动先验的布料世界模型，单次RGB-D观测+分层点集（含假设遮挡层）+残差点流扩散预测，并发布ClothCastBench数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 衣物形变复杂且自遮挡严重，现有世界模型难以预测布料在规划动作下的演化；但被抓取部分随夹爪运动，可作为强运动先验，仅需学习残差形变。

Method: 输入单帧RGB-D、相机位姿、机器人模型与规划夹爪轨迹（无需网格/材质参数）；将观测提升为含假设遮挡层的分层点集；用由夹爪位姿混合得到的刚体先验带动点集；视频扩散点流模型预测残差运动；点渲染为深度后经几何条件补全模型合成RGB；释放后用人工设计的沉降步骤替换学习运动。

Result: 在492条留出4–11秒、10Hz序列上，可见表面序列平均Chamfer距离14.0mm（Flex-π 35.6mm，低2.5倍）；布料区域PSNR较Cosmos-Predict2.5高3.7dB；50条消融中仅刚体先验+相同后处理即超过两个几何基线，残差学习再降约1/3误差。同时发布含真值网格（含遮挡层）的1万条双臂仿真数据集。

Conclusion: 将刚体运动先验与学习残差解耦，是布料世界建模的高效范式；但证据限于仿真，真实布料泛化与长时物理一致性仍待验证。

Abstract: World models support robotic manipulation by predicting how the scene evolves under a planned action. For garments this prediction is notoriously difficult: deformations are complex, and self-occlusion leaves much of the cloth unobserved. Planned gripper trajectories provide a useful motion prior because cloth held by a gripper moves with it, while the remaining deformation must be predicted. We introduce ClothCast, a world model that applies this prior to the cloth's points and learns the residual motion. ClothCast takes one RGB-D observation, the camera pose, the robot's own model and the planned gripper trajectories, with no cloth mesh or material parameters. It lifts the observation to a layered point set that includes hypothesized occluded layers, carries the points with a blended rigid prior derived from the gripper poses, and predicts the residual motion with a video-diffusion point-flow model. Over entire 4- to 11-second episodes at 10 Hz, the moved points are rendered into depth, from which a geometry-conditioned completion model synthesizes RGB; after release, a hand-designed settling step replaces the learned motion. We further release ClothCastBench, 10,000 simulated dual-arm cloth-manipulation episodes with the ground-truth cloth mesh, including occluded layers, at every frame. On 492 held-out episodes, ClothCast achieves 2.5x lower sequence-averaged visible-surface Chamfer distance than Flex-{\pi}, the strongest baseline in geometry (14.0 mm vs. 35.6 mm), and 3.7 dB higher cloth-region PSNR than Cosmos-Predict2.5, the strongest baseline in cloth PSNR. On a 50-episode ablation subset, the rigid prior alone, applied to ClothCast's learned initial geometry with the same post-processing, already outperforms both geometry-capable baselines, and the learned residual lowers its error by about a third.

</details>


### [197] [SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29388)
*Qiaoying Qu,Bin Pan,Chen Jia,Haiyang Xu,Xia Xu,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpectralGS：用共享谱-空间高斯基元构建连续空间-光谱表示，并用传感器光谱响应函数(SRF)做积分投影渲染RGB，以渲染-观测一致性做无监督监督，实现RGB到高光谱的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB观测中光谱信息极度欠缺，无配对高光谱数据的无监督谱超分难以学到有效的空间-光谱联合表示，需将结构化光谱建模与传感器成像模型结合。

Method: 两部分：(1) 共享光谱高斯表示——共享谱基元+局部空间高斯基元构造连续空间-光谱场，利用高光谱图像的低秩光谱结构；(2) 光谱响应投影渲染——用SRF对连续表示做积分投影混合生成RGB，以渲染RGB与观测RGB的一致性作为训练监督。

Result: 大量实验表明在无监督谱超分任务上优于现有SOTA方法（摘要未给出具体指标）。

Conclusion: 将3DGS式的显式基元表示与成像响应渲染统一到无监督光谱重建框架中，思路可迁移到其他正演成像任务；但缺少真实传感器泛化与下游任务验证。

Abstract: Unsupervised spectral super-resolution aims to recover spectral information from RGB images without paired hyperspectral data. However, the limited spectral information in RGB observations makes learning an effective spatial-spectral representation challenging, requiring the incorporation of structured spectral modeling with sensor imaging. In this paper, we propose SpectralGS, a spectral Gaussian splatting framework comprising two components: Shared Spectral Gaussian Representation and Spectral Response Projection Rendering. The representation module constructs a continuous spatial-spectral representation via shared spectral and local spatial Gaussian primitives, exploiting the low-rank spectral structure of hyperspectral images. The rendering module utilizes the spectral response function (SRF) to apply integral projection to the continuous representation, blending it to generate an RGB image. Consistency between the rendered and observed RGB images provides training supervision. Our main contribution is a Gaussian splatting framework that integrates structured continuous spatial-spectral representation with imaging response-based rendering, enabling unsupervised spectral reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [198] [PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29389)
*Zeyu Ren,Jie Ni,Rui Qian,Jiahao Wei,Hao Tang,Yongtai Liu,Zeyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PINE：单步 Omni Diffusion Transformer，一次前向同时预测点图、表面法向与实例图；以 token 流+流掩码控制跨任务交互，用相机射线编码替代像素位置编码，并在注意力 logits 中注入 DINOv3 特征亲和度。仅用 139K 合成图像训练即达 SOTA 点图与法向，且比 MoGe-3+SAM 快 5.7 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景理解需要几何（空间结构）与语义（物体分割），现有方法通常由分离网络或分离前向多次推理获得，效率低且几何-语义缺乏一致性交互。作者希望用统一模型、单次前向同时输出两者。

Method: (1) 将点图、法向图、实例图各视为一条 token 流，用 stream mask 决定流间是否互相注意力，实现可控的多任务耦合；(2) camera-aware ray encoding：按每个 token 对应的相机射线而非像素坐标进行位置编码，提升跨视角/内参泛化；(3) grounding attention：将预训练 DINOv3 特征的亲和度加到注意力 logits 上，为实例分支注入语义先验；(4) one-step 扩散 Transformer，单步去噪直接出结果。

Result: 仅用 139K 合成图像训练几何；在给内参与不给内参两种设置下均取得 SOTA 点图精度，表面法向取得最佳平均排名；大物体实例分割超过 SAM 而训练图像量不足其 1%；三图联合预测比 MoGe-3+SAM 快 5.7 倍。

Conclusion: 统一流式注意力使几何与语义在一次前向中相互增益，射线编码与 DINOv3 接地注意力兼顾泛化与语义质量；该范式对前馈式 3D 感知与机器人可用的实时场景理解具有直接参考价值，后续值得关注代码/权重开放与真实场景验证。

Abstract: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

</details>


### [199] [AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29396)
*Haocheng Li,Juepeng Zheng,Guilong Xiao,Kaiqi Du,Gengmeng Pu,Haohuan Fu,Jianxi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AgroVG+：由农业专家撰写并审核指代表达的广义视觉定位数据集（7,404图/10,081条查询，覆盖单目标、多目标与无目标情形）；ReSAG 框架将区域证据监督与显式 BOX/END 生成-终止决策耦合，共享语言解码器联合训练区域与序列目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业场景的广义视觉定位需同时完成"定位所有匹配目标"与"判定目标不存在"两项任务，而现有数据集多由非专家标注、缺乏无目标样本与真实农业指代表达，模型难以学会可靠的拒答与多目标枚举。

Method: 构建 AgroVG+ 数据集（六大农业场景族，专家撰写/复核查询，含 target-absent 记录）。提出 ReSAG：(1) 在答案生成前计算共享空间证据分布，对每个目标施加等权监督项（区域级监督）；(2) 采用 BOX/END 协议，在每个 box 边界显式选择续生成或终止；(3) 坐标直接用原始词表 token 生成，无需额外坐标回归头；(4) 区域目标与序列目标联合训练共享语言解码器。

Result: 在 AgroVG+ 上，ReSAG 在单目标与多目标 exact-set accuracy 上均优于仅坐标微调的基线；消融显示其总体准确率高于单独使用区域监督或序列监督的任一组件。

Conclusion: 显式生成-终止决策与区域证据监督的结合，可在统一生成框架中同时改善多目标枚举与无目标拒答，且不牺牲坐标生成的自然性；专家级指代数据对广义定位评测具有必要性。

Abstract: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

</details>


### [200] [MSBench: Benchmarking Script-Controlled Multi-Shot Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29417)
*Tao Huang,ZiHao Liang,Junhao Liu,Junzhe Li,Yuancheng Wei,Sifan Zuo,Beiming Yu,Taojin Liu,Zhuoyang Li,Bing Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MSBench，基于Scene-Entity-Shot结构化mini-script的多镜头文本生视频可控性基准，含四维11子指标评测框架，测了14个系统，发现视觉质量区分度低而多镜头控制是主要瓶颈，系统排名与人类偏好Spearman相关0.87。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V模型能生成可信短片，但多镜头生成需要镜头切换时序、转场风格、镜头语言与跨镜头连续性的控制能力；已有基准要么只评单镜头，要么只检查指定镜头是否出现，而不评"何时切换"与"如何衔接"，导致多镜头可控性无法量化。

Method: 构建Scene-Entity-Shot结构化mini-script，显式指定每个镜头的时间区间、相机状态、内容与出向转场；定义视觉质量、动态质量、语义对齐、跨镜头一致性四维共11个子指标的混合评测框架；在14个商业与开源系统上做实验，并以人类评估做效度验证（Spearman 0.87）。

Result: 视觉质量几乎无法区分各系统，多镜头控制才是主要区分点：多数模型主要在场景变化处切换，并把要求的长渐变转场渲染为硬切；MSBench系统排名与人类偏好达到0.87的Spearman相关。

Conclusion: 多镜头可控性是可测量的关键短板，MSBench提供了可复现、与人类判断高度一致的评测协议，但属基准类工作，未提出生成方法或重建/机器人实证。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) models can now generate visually plausible short clips, but multi-shot generation requires a different set of skills: composing multiple shots with intended cut timing, transition style, camera language, and cross-shot continuity. How far this multi-shot output can be controlled from text remains unmeasured: existing benchmarks either evaluate single shots or, when they provide shot-level scripts, typically check whether the requested shots appear but not when they change or how they are joined. We introduce MSBench, a benchmark for controllable text-driven multi-shot video generation built around structured Scene-Entity-Shot mini-scripts that specify each shot's time span, camera state, content, and outgoing transition. MSBench defines a four-dimensional hybrid evaluation framework spanning Visual Quality, Dynamic Quality, Semantic Alignment, and Cross-Shot Consistency with 11 sub-metrics. Experiments on 14 commercial and open-source systems show that visual quality does little to separate the systems, whereas multi-shot control does: many models cut mainly on scene changes and render requested gradual transitions as hard cuts. Human evaluations further validate MSBench, with its system ranking reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.87 with human preferences. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [201] [A colour-marker tracker for pose estimation of slender surgical instruments: vision-language-model-guided adaptive colour calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29421)
*Jaesung Hong,Dong Won Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用微调的视觉语言模型(VLM)定位彩色条纹标记，从而摆脱对设计色值的依赖，完成自适应颜色校准，实现细小手术器械的相机位姿估计与跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细长手术器械只能用很小的标记；彩色条纹标记虽合适，但图像中颜色会因光照、打印和相机设置而偏离设计值。颜色只能在找到标记之后才能校正，导致依赖设计色的方法陷入循环依赖问题。

Method: 提出VLM引导的自适应颜色校准：用微调VLM不依赖设计色地寻找标记，再用检测到的像素构建颜色分布。与两种规则方法对比——初始颜色更新(跟踪开始后更新一次)与颜色自适应(跟踪中持续更新)，二者均基于设计色检测结果重新测色。

Result: Recall/F1:合成672对图像上三种方法为92.0/95.7、87.8/93.3、98.2/99.1；8段退化实验室视频上为51.3/67.2、48.8/65.0、83.8/87.0；强色偏的da Vinci手术机器人视频上为38.9/55.2、19.7/29.7、100/100，VLM法找到全部234个标记且无假阳性。仿真中曝光增益0.5–2.0时条纹色相边界漂移<0.1像素，固定亮度阈值法则为2.9–4.0像素。

Conclusion: 轻度退化时无需训练、无需GPU的规则方法已足够；颜色剧变时增益来自不依赖设计色的VLM候选搜索。彩色条纹标记结合自适应校准可实现小标记下细长手术器械的跟踪。

Abstract: Slender surgical instruments need small, narrow markers for camera-based pose estimation. A colour-stripe marker fits this requirement, but its colours in the image drift from the design values with lighting, printing and camera settings. Because the colours can only be corrected after the marker has been found, methods that rely on the design colours face a circular problem. We propose vision-language-model (VLM)-based adaptive colour calibration and compare it with two rule-based methods, which re-measure the colours from detections made with the design colours: Initial colour update does so once after tracking starts, and Colour adaptation continuously during tracking. VLM guidance uses a fine-tuned VLM to find the markers without relying on the design colours and builds the colour profile from their pixels. Recall/F1 (%) for Initial colour update, Colour adaptation and VLM guidance were 92.0/95.7, 87.8/93.3 and 98.2/99.1 on 672 synthetic image pairs; 51.3/67.2, 48.8/65.0 and 83.8/87.0 on eight degraded laboratory videos; and 38.9/55.2, 19.7/29.7 and 100/100 on a surgical-robot (da Vinci) video with strongly shifted colours. In that video the rule-based methods never found the purple/cyan marker, whereas VLM guidance found all 234 markers with no false positives. In a simulation, the hue boundary between the two stripes moved by less than 0.1 pixel for exposure gains of 0.5-2.0, compared with 2.9-4.0 pixels for a boundary found with a fixed brightness threshold. When the degradation is mild, the rule-based methods, which need no training and no GPU, are sufficient. When the colours change greatly, the gain comes from a VLM-guided candidate search that does not rely on the design colours. Combining colour-stripe markers with adaptive colour calibration enables tracking of slender surgical instruments with small markers.

</details>


### [202] [HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29431)
*Xianglong Guo,Haobo Xu,Zanyi Wang,Zhen Lei,Chang Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HorizonFlow decouples motion correction from layout correction in DMD-based video distillation by shifting the regression target (Chunk Evenness + Semantic Commitment), distilling Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model in 600 iterations with 8.4k samples.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD-based few-step video distillation suffers from unnatural motion and expensive training. The authors attribute this to the DMD gradient mixing appearance, layout and motion with very different signal-to-noise ratios: static components converge in hundreds of iterations while motion lags; additionally the gradient gives little guidance on spreading motion over frames aggregated into one latent chunk (causing periodic stutter) and does not constrain the last sampling step to preserve layout (causing object merging/drift).

Method: Keep the DMD loss unchanged but shift its regression target with two training-only corrections in the two components: (1) Chunk Evenness — spread each latent chunk's motion evenly over its frames to fix VAE temporal compression induced stutter; (2) Semantic Commitment — anchor the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last denoising step, in the direction orthogonal to motion.

Result: In only 600 iterations and 8.4k samples (4.6–304× fewer than prior work), HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model that outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models on VBench. The recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, surpassing NVIDIA's distilled model.

Conclusion: Gradient-dynamics-aware decomposition of the DMD target yields dramatically cheaper and better few-step video distillation; the approach is model-agnostic and generalizes to a second backbone.

Abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [203] [Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29435)
*Zehang Weng,Ci Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法RoA，在测试时耦合冻结的人体估计器(SAM 3D Body)与马体估计器(4DEquine)，通过共同帧索引、统一像素各向同性相机与马体坐标系下的交互约束(含基于广义缠绕数的非水密网格碰撞项)联合优化有界修正，重建人骑马的单目视频4D网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立应用人与动物估计器时，两者各自可贴合轮廓，但在相机轴向上出现骑手悬空、穿模、沿马背滑动与抖动等错误，且这些误差在输入视角不可见。

Method: 测试时耦合冻结估计器：统一帧索引对齐、由马体估计器初始化单一像素各向同性相机并共同投影；在马体局部坐标系中定义交互项(含广义缠绕数碰撞项，适用于非水密网格)进行有界联合优化；用背景相机旋转与MoGe-2视场角将结果提升至水平世界坐标系。

Result: 骑手骨盆与马背平均间距由15cm降至1cm，沿/横跨脊椎的座位漂移分别降低64%与89%，90百分位穿透深度降低57%，骑手陷入马体表面占比由12.1%降至7.9%；相对运动加速度降低94%，马体jerk降低80%；代价是骑手轮廓IoU从0.59降至0.52。

Conclusion: RoA可作为通用免训练框架重建人与动物交互，定性上骑手稳定坐于马背并随马同步运动；尚缺标定录像下的三维精度定量评估，且对步行牵马等任务外片段存在失效模式。

Abstract: We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

</details>


### [204] [Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29436)
*Pulkit Bansal,Vivek Srivastava,Shirish Karande*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PrefLens 从稀疏人类偏好标注中"还原"局部偏好邻域：在人类偏好图像周围生成保持语义的受控感知扰动，并在预训练奖励模型诱导的偏好空间中挑选紧凑的信息性邻居集合，把每条偏好标注扩增为结构化比较集合，从而在无需额外人工标注的情况下丰富监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I 扩散模型的人类偏好对齐依赖大规模成对标注，成本高且监督稀疏；同时并非所有比较都有信息量——语义相距很远的图像对比对人类细粒度感知判断提供的信号很少。作者主张信息量来自"人类偏好图像周围的局部偏好邻域"，其中语义对齐但存在感知/结构差异的候选才揭示有价值的偏好因素，因此需要从稀疏反馈中恢复这种邻域。

Method: 提出 PrefLens 框架：1) 在人类偏好图像周围生成受控感知变化，使其基本保留语义身份；2) 借助预训练奖励模型构建"奖励定义的偏好空间"，在该空间中选取紧凑的信息性邻居集合；3) 将每条人类偏好标注转化为一个结构化邻域（一组信息性比较），用于偏好对齐训练，无需新增人工标注。

Result: 实验与诊断性评估表明，恢复出的偏好邻域能够捕获与人类相关的偏好特征，并在多种设置下为偏好对齐提供有效监督。

Conclusion: 稀疏偏好标注可通过局部邻域恢复被有效放大：围绕偏好图像的受控扰动加上奖励空间中的邻域筛选，能在零额外标注成本下获得更丰富的对齐监督，为 T2I 偏好优化提供了一种数据高效的思路。摘要未给出具体量化增益与代码/模型可用性信息。

Abstract: Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

</details>


### [205] [Exploring Attention-Driven Deep Learning for Accurate Lung Nodule Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29450)
*Nima Shafiei Rezvani Nezhad,Meysam Mansouri,Saeid Ghayour,Ruhollah Abolhasani,Shahla Azizi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文在LIDC-IDRI数据集上比较多种深度学习模型进行肺结节分割，提出仅用356例过滤子集训练，并以带Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50取得Dice 0.86的最佳结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法通常使用LIDC-IDRI全量数据训练分割模型，计算与标注成本高；作者希望验证在小规模过滤子集上训练的有效性，并通过注意力机制与改进预处理提升分割精度。

Method: 基于LIDC-IDRI的过滤子集（356个样本）训练多种深度学习分割模型；引入注意力机制与多组预处理策略的对比配置；主要模型为带Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50，并与传统架构进行对照评估，以Dice系数为主要指标。

Result: DPL nkNet50（Channel Attention Bridge + ResNet主干）取得最高Dice 0.86，显著优于常规架构；表明在过滤小样本上也能获得较强分割性能。

Conclusion: 数据效率与定制化架构相结合可在有限数据下实现较稳健的肺结节分割，为临床计算机辅助诊断提供参考；但方法通用性、外部验证与实际部署效果尚待验证。

Abstract: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.

</details>


### [206] [Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29460)
*Shaked Perek,Avihu Dekel,Ben Wiesel,Sivan Harary,Eli Schwartz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出非自回归结构化信息抽取器：利用schema直接写出JSON结构与列表长度（count pass），并行解码全部value，并用CTC为每个value分配slot block，实现固定前向次数（4–6次）的文档KIE，速度较扩散VLM快3.5倍且更准，并可作为自回归基模型的投机解码草稿器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM做文档关键信息抽取时逐token生成JSON，解码步数随答案长度增长；但KIE中结构（键、嵌套、列表）由schema预先确定，只有取值未知，自回归式的串行生成存在大量冗余计算。

Method: 非自回归抽取器：按schema直接铺设输出结构与列表长度（额外count pass确定每个列表大小）；所有value在固定数量的并行前向pass中预测，pass数不随文档长度增长；每个value在专属slot block中用CTC解码，无需预测长度，若block结束时仍未闭合则增大token预算；同时该抽取器可作为自身自回归基模型的投机解码草稿。

Result: 零样本在VAREX、CORD、FUNSD上，4B模型平均比扩散VLM竞品快3.5×（最高5.6×）且更准确，每文档仅4–6次前向（block diffusion需12–74次）；投机解码下比自回归解码快8.3×（最高10.4×），精度仅差0.4分，比投机扩散解码快3.3×且高13.0分。

Conclusion: 利用KIE输出的强结构先验可把生成从串行改为固定次数的并行解码，显著降低延迟并保持/提升精度，同时可复用为投机解码草稿器；模型与代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

</details>


### [207] [RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29468)
*Pengzhen Chen,Yanwei Liu,Xiaoyan Gu,Jinxia Liu,Siwei Ma,Weiping Wang,Wu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RSWP，基于二十面体群I60分解SO(3)旋转为局部平面旋转与面片置换，配合等变特征提取器与置换不变排序模块，实现全景图像水印在SO(3)旋转和视口变换下的鲁棒盲提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景/球面图像与平面表示存在拓扑失配，传统水印在SO(3)视角旋转下因非线性几何畸变失效，且视口提取通常依赖昂贵的逆映射与几何标定。

Method: 利用二十面体群为SO(3)最大离散子群的性质，将球面旋转变换解耦为可处理的局部平面旋转与二十面体面片组合置换；设计解耦架构将水印嵌入离散面片，并提出"等变到不变"解码范式：等变特征提取器 + 置换不变排序模块同步旋转畸变特征；双提取器设计支持从部分2D渲染视口直接盲提取。

Result: 大量实验显示在连续SO(3)旋转与视口变换下达到SOTA鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 将群论等变结构引入水印嵌入与解码，可自然消解球面-平面拓扑失配，为全景内容提供无需几何标定的鲁棒盲水印方案。

Abstract: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

</details>


### [208] [Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29477)
*Chenxi Wang,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作将自适应视觉token路由器的平均得分解耦为“图像-动作匹配质量”与“高分辨率动作使用频率”两个因素，并通过固定各任务动作数、与同动作同图像的随机配对比较来度量二者贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应视觉token路由器的平均指标提升来源不明：既可能来自对单图更优的分辨率决策，也可能仅来自在难任务上更频繁地使用高分辨率。需区分二者以正确评估路由器的真实能力。

Method: 在各任务内固定动作（分辨率选择）计数，将路由器的图像-动作分配与相同动作、相同图像的随机配对进行比较；在ChartQA与TextVQA等权设置下评估Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B；并以外部选择器CARES的连续分辨率方案做交换实验，同时比较带任务标签时查表策略与离散路由器。

Result: 等权ChartQA与TextVQA上，3B与7B均从匹配中获益，但相对任务查表因动作频率分布而净损失；7B上匹配带来+1.71分、频率带来−3.95分。交换CARES的连续分辨率亦使7B质量下降。带任务标签时，查表比离散路由器高1.92分，且每个完整7B请求平均节省31.76 ms。

Conclusion: 现有自适应视觉token路由器的收益主要来自任务级的分辨率频率分配而非细粒度匹配；简单任务查表在已知任务标签时可同时优于路由器并降低延迟，提示路由学习与任务先验应显式分离。

Abstract: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

</details>


### [209] [Neutron Imaging Enhancement for Lithium Batteries Based on Swin-Transformer and Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29479)
*Hansheng Ding,Fanxu Meng,Tian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出改进Swin-Transformer（引入MDTA与GRN）结合空域图像融合的锂电池中子图像增强方法，抑制混合噪声并提升对比度与边缘清晰度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中子成像对锂等轻元素敏感，适合锂电池无损检测与内部结构演化分析，但中子源通量有限、探测器性能受限，导致图像混合噪声、低对比度、边缘模糊，影响电池内部状态评估。

Method: 1) 改进Swin-Transformer，引入Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA)与Global Response Normalization (GRN)进行特征提取与重建，抑制高密度白斑与高斯-泊松混合噪声；2) 引导滤波+梯度自适应掩膜做选择性边缘增强，CLAHE提升局部对比度；3) 基于空间频率(SF)的局部分块加权融合机制自适应组合两路增强结果。

Result: 与BM3D、DnCNN、GAN相比，在全参考与无参考指标上均表现较好：PSNR 33.0517 dB、SSIM 0.9637，NR-IQA 0.1794、NIQE 4.0974；减少伪影与过平滑。

Conclusion: 该方法能提升锂电池中子图像的视觉保真度与结构可辨识度，为电池内部状态的非破坏性评估提供更可靠影像基础。

Abstract: Neutron imaging is highly sensitive to light elements such as lithium and is therefore valuable for non-destructive testing (NDT) and analyzing internal structural evolution in lithium batteries. However, limited neutron-source flux and detector performance often result in images with mixed noise, low contrast, and blurred edges, hindering accurate assessment of battery internal states. To address these issues, this paper proposes a lithium-battery neutron image enhancement method combining an improved Swin-Transformer with spatial-domain image fusion. First, an improved Swin-Transformer incorporating Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) and Global Response Normalization (GRN) extracts and reconstructs image features to suppress high-density white spots and Gaussian-Poisson mixed noise. Second, guided filtering and a gradient-adaptive mask are used for selective edge enhancement, while Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improves local contrast. Finally, a spatial-frequency (SF)-based local block-weighted fusion mechanism adaptively combines the edge-enhanced and contrast-equalized images to preserve microscopic details while suppressing noise. Experiments show that, compared with BM3D, DnCNN, and GAN, the proposed method achieves strong performance in full-reference and no-reference evaluations. Its best PSNR and SSIM reach 33.0517 dB and 0.9637, respectively, while the NR-IQA and Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores are as low as 0.1794 and 4.0974. The method reduces artifacts and over smoothing, improving the visual fidelity and structural identifiability of lithium-battery neutron images.

</details>


### [210] [CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29489)
*Xixi Jiang,Pingcheng Dong,Chen Yang,Xin Yang,Kwang-Ting Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAR将剪枝引起的解码器输出偏移闭式分解为“图像摘要误差”与“注意力分配误差”，分别用覆盖式选择（显著性+非冗余）与闭式logit偏置重分配注意力来抑制，在90%剪枝率下Qwen2.5-VL-7B保留VQA 93.0%、VG 77.9%的原始精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM中视觉token剪枝可加速推理，但在激进剪枝下性能显著退化，尤其视觉定位（VG）任务；作者希望从解码层输出偏移的角度定量解释退化来源，从而设计有针对性的补偿机制。

Method: 对剪枝导致的解码层输出偏移做闭式分解，得到两项误差：视觉信息丢失引起的摘要误差（summary error）与视觉token注意力份额下降引起的分配误差（allocation error）。据此提出CAR框架：(1) 覆盖选择——用无标签探针挑选编码器头计算显著性，保留既显著又非冗余、能更好覆盖全部视觉token的子集，以收紧摘要误差上界；(2) 注意力重分配——通过闭式logit偏置把被丢弃token的注意力重新分配给保留token，弥补注意力份额损失；该偏置可单独作为插件使用。

Result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B在剪掉90%视觉token时，VQA保留未剪枝精度的93.0%，VG保留77.9%，而最佳已有方法在VG上仅26.5%；仅加入logit偏置即使已有方法的VG精度最高提升24个点。在多个MLLM上的VQA、VG与视频理解实验显示方法泛化性良好且一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过在剪枝中同时控制信息覆盖与注意力分配误差，可显著缓解激进剪枝下的MLLM性能退化，尤其改善视觉定位；注意力重分配偏置具有即插即用的通用性。

Abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

</details>


### [211] [STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29538)
*Yihang Zou,Ruixi Liang,Chunmei Qing,Junpeng Tan,Haichuan Wei,Wanxiang Luo,Gao Wu,Haodong Li,Xiangmin Xu,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STAGE：面向跨被试脑到图像检索的结构化测试时自适应框架，用矩校准、耦合加权初始化、耦合引导自适应与软耦合排序，在冻结编码器、无标签目标批条件下恢复脑-图对齐并缓解查询排名过度集中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨被试脑信号到图像检索受个体差异困扰，脑-图表征难以对齐；同时独立查询排名会把预测集中于少数候选，缺乏目标标签时难以准确检索。

Method: 提出STAGE结构化测试时自适应：1) 矩校准缩小特征统计差异；2) 耦合加权初始化建立初始对齐；3) 耦合引导自适应修正残余特征失配；4) 软耦合排序在查询间协调候选竞争，抑制匹配过度集中。仅用无标签目标批次，两个编码器均冻结。

Result: 三个公开数据集验证有效；THINGS-EEG2上Top-1 68.25%、Top-5 90.47%，在相同冻结NICE特征上较SCORE恢复+CSLS的Top-1提升18.52个百分点；在200查询、200图库上校准后，冻结变换条件下检索1,854张图仍保持42.05% Top-1。

Conclusion: 无标签测试时自适应可在特征校准到图像检索全流程保持匹配一致性，显著改善跨被试脑-图检索，且无需微调编码器。

Abstract: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance.
