First, a conversation state manager driven solely by audio handles speaking, listening, idling, barge-in, and proactive turns on one timeline, while role, voice, motion style, and 3D appearance are set independently. Second, to run an offline 2 s flow-matching gesture model on live audio, we reformulate inference as sliding-window continuation with overlapped look-ahead ensembling, which removes seam jitter. Third, we show that the remaining streaming gap comes from errors accumulating in the self-generated motion history rather than missing future speech; our Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP) reduces this gap in about 50 min on one GPU by injecting inference-like drift into ground-truth training histories, and transfers to a second generator. On BEAT2, streaming BASE reaches an FGD of 0.342, on par with the tightly coupled MIBURI (0.333), and viewers prefer its body motion over MIBURI's in 82% of forced-choice judgments. Without retraining, the same layer drives a cascaded pipeline, three open full-duplex models, and a cloud API in real time.

</details>


### [313] [LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30392)
*Himanshu Kumar,Sanjay Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiquidGazeNet：仅用事件相机的近眼注视估计框架，采用极性感知脉冲延迟(时间衰减面)编码+两层LTC(液态时间常数)循环单元，在低光夜间Gaze-FELL上跨被试/跨场景平均误差3.75°/2.41°。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光夜间近眼注视估计中，传统强度帧的质量与有效时间分辨率下降，事件相机具备高时间分辨率与高动态范围，但事件稀疏、异步，需有效的时间表征与时间积分机制。

Method: 1) 正/负极性事件分通道表示，并用指数衰减时间面保留跨事件窗口的逐像素时间新近度；2) 共享卷积编码器逐窗口提取空间特征；3) 两层LTC启发式循环单元对短时序列做因果积分；4) 混合损失=屏幕空间坐标回归+以中心为参考的方向一致性约束。另做事件表示、时间模块、窗口时长与计算量消融。

Result: Gaze-FELL上跨被试平均误差3.75°，跨场景2.41°；消融表明极性感知时间新近度编码与循环积分对性能均有贡献。

Conclusion: 极性感知时间编码结合LTC循环积分可有效实现仅事件输入的注视估计，在评估的低光夜间条件下验证有效；无代码/真机部署信息，属于人眼注视估计这一邻域任务。

Abstract: Near-eye gaze estimation under low-light nighttime conditions is challenging because the quality and effective temporal resolution of conventional intensity frames can be reduced. This paper presents LiquidGazeNet, an event-only gaze-estimation framework that combines polarity-aware spike-latency encoding with a custom LTC-based recurrent module. Positive- and negative-polarity events are represented in separate channels, while exponentially decayed time surfaces retain per-pixel temporal recency across successive event windows. A shared convolutional encoder extracts spatial features from each window, and a two-layer recurrent module composed of LTC-inspired cells integrates them causally over short temporal sequences. The network is trained using a hybrid objective that combines screen-space coordinate regression with centre-referenced directional consistency. The framework is evaluated on Gaze-FELL under cross-subject and cross-scene protocols and is further assessed through event-representation, temporal-module, window-duration, and computational ablations. LiquidGazeNet achieves mean errors of 3.75 degrees and 2.41 degrees under cross-subject and cross-scene evaluation, respectively. The results indicate that polarity-aware temporal-recency encoding, together with recurrent integration, is effective for event-only gaze estimation under the evaluated low-light nighttime conditions.

</details>


### [314] [GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30402)
*Nikolaos Stathoulopoulos,George Nikolakopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeLiFiSH：一种无需学习的序列假设检验滤波，在滚动体素图上以扫描帧率递归估计持久关键点，融合地面分割与动态物体剔除，实现跨传感器、跨会话的高可重复性LiDAR关键点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR配准与回环依赖稀疏关键点，但关键点需跨会话、视角与传感器保持可重复性。累积子图检测带来延迟且逐子图独立处理、不融合重复观测；基于高度的检测器依赖估计地面，地面不一致会传播到关键点；动态物体留下拖影被误作静态结构。

Method: 1) 高度-结构检测器运行于滚动体素图，避免子图累积延迟；2) 检测初始化带位置、协方差与存在概率的轨迹，由序列概率比检验（SPRT）接受或拒绝，实现重复观测的递归融合；3) 地面分割提供与传感器无关的高度参考；4) 移动物体分割在入图前剔除动态点。全程无学习、单套参数、无需传感器高度先验。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS、HeLiPR上（覆盖5种LiDAR、多会话），平均关键点可重复性最高；仅用关键点的跨会话配准召回率第二，仅次于提取4倍关键点数的ISS。地面分割与移动物体分割模块在平均指标上均优于各自基线。

Conclusion: 以序列滤波统一关键点持久性、地面参考与动态剔除，是构建传感器无关、可跨会话复用LiDAR关键点的有效低成本方案；其上限受限于绝对关键点数量而非质量。

Abstract: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

</details>


### [315] [Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30424)
*Yutong Li,Haoyu Zhao,Daoguo Dong,Ziyi Ye,Yugang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spatial-Zero提出零外部数据的VLM自进化训练框架：Proposer设计物体配置与问题，Coder转为可执行场景程序生成多视图图像与显式几何，Geometric Oracle校验空间约束/可见性/答案唯一性并导出真值标签，用于监督Solver并回馈难度，从而迭代自生成高质量空间推理任务。六个基准、三个骨干上稳定提升，Qwen3.5-9B经三轮迭代平均提升3.23个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM的空间推理（度量距离、三维关系、视角相关几何）通常依赖外部人工策展训练数据，成本高且难以规模化；而自主空间探索面临两大难题：难以可靠生成有效空间交互任务，以及难以为这些任务提供准确监督。

Method: 四模块闭环自进化：Proposer(指定物体配置与问题)→Coder(将任务编译为可执行场景程序，渲染多视图图像并给出显式场景几何)→Geometric Oracle(检查空间约束、可见性与答案唯一性，并由执行几何导出真值标签)→Solver(用标签监督训练，验证结果反馈难度并引导后续任务生成)，三轮迭代自进化。

Result: 在六个空间推理基准与三个VLM骨干上迭代均带来一致增益；Qwen3.5-9B三轮迭代后平均准确率提升3.23个百分点；Qwen3.5-4B上亦优于现有VLM自进化方法；代码开源。

Conclusion: 以程序化可执行场景+几何Oracle自动生成并验证空间任务，可实现零数据、可验证、难度自适应的VLM空间能力自进化，为视觉-语言模型的空间智能提供可扩展数据与监督范式。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [316] [Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30458)
*Zhisong Wang,Wanxing Chang,Weiwei Cao,Fenghe Tang,Bowen Shi,Ruifeng Yuan,Yong Xia,Jianpeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"诊断到报告差距"(diagnosis-to-report gap)：同为CT图像与病种评估下，MedVLM的VQA诊断宏F1显著高于自由报告。提出DeCAD，按"诊断→区域文本→区域视觉"三级渐进分解CT报告生成，显著提升五款MedVLM的报告诊断性能并近闭合差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型(MedVLM)生成的自由形式放射报告常遗漏诊断性发现，而自动化3D CT报告对放射科工作流有实用价值。作者追问：模型内在的诊断能力能否迁移到自由报告任务上，并试图量化与弥合这一任务依赖的落差。

Method: 先在5个MedVLM上对比诊断VQA与同一CT研究生成的报告（同一病种集、同一宏F1口径）以定义差距；再提出DeCAD三级分解：(1)诊断级——先识别阳性发现再撰写；(2)区域文本级——把诊断与描述组织成分区域子任务；(3)区域视觉级——每个子任务仅允许关注对应区域的视觉token。另做消融：普通VLM无医学VQA预训练、以及区域级对比预训练编码器两种设定。

Result: 五模型上诊断VQA的宏F1均高于报告；常规Report Adaptation（报告适配）多数模型有效但未闭合差距。诊断分解与区域文本分解在五模型上均提升报告级诊断性能；区域视觉分解增益有限，仅在区域级对比预训练编码器下带来额外提升。完整DeCAD在CT-RATE与Merlin上达到SOTA；分析显示诊断阶段对CT token注意力更高，诊断输出与最终报告对参考阳性发现的召回提升。

Conclusion: 显式组织诊断过程（先诊断、再分区域描述、按区域门控视觉token）可改善诊断性报告质量并缩小VQA与报告间的能力落差；增益主要来自任务分解的信号结构，而非单纯视觉定位约束。

Abstract: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.

</details>


### [317] [LiveMirror: Real-Time Diffusion Virtual Try-On on a Consumer GPU and Its Self-Supervised Adaptation to Indian Ethnic Wear](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30461)
*Jigyansha Jeevan Rout,Sukanta Kumar Sabut*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiveMirror 用单张 16GB 消费级 GPU 实现直播摄像头虚拟试穿：异步关键帧生成 + 光流 warp 显示，720p 25FPS 实时播放、每 370-490ms 更新一次关键帧；并通过大腿遮盖 mask、2.49 万张电商图自监督配对和 3.2 GPU 小时 attention-only 微调修复南亚长袍（kurta/sherwani）被渲染成短上衣或连衣裙的文化偏见，LPIPS 减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散 VTO 单图推理需数百毫秒到数秒，只能离线部署或退化为需要每件商品配 3D rig 资产的 AR 镜；同时 VITON-HD/DressCode 训练的模型系统性渲染错误南亚民族服饰（长袍被画成及腰上衣或裸腿连衣裙），既是性能瓶颈也是数据偏见问题。

Method: 1) 异步关键帧 VTO：生成不阻塞显示，屏幕每帧为最新关键帧的光流 warp，关键帧仅通过 cross-fade 替换；2) 阶段级延迟预算与加速（步数裁剪、一致性 LoRA、tiny decoder、编译）并评估印花保真度；3) 对 CatVTON 做 attention-only 微调，配合 thigh-covering mask 与自动构建的自监督配对；4) 两遍 hem-aware mask 处理下摆以下重着色裤子。

Result: 720p 显示达 25FPS、关键帧 370-490ms 更新；民族服饰感知误差减半（IndoFashion LPIPS 0.137→0.077，Atlas 0.135→0.073，各 200 对留出样本），西式上衣无退化；下摆失败率降至 3-4% 且零额外训练成本；综合指标超过 FASHN VTON 1.5，推理成本约低 20 倍，权重可直接嵌入镜像系统。

Conclusion: 该工作把实时性与数据公平性结合在单一消费级 GPU 上，方法简洁可落地（光流 warp + 关键帧 + 掩码微调），开源权重可直接部署；但其属于 2D 图像生成应用，不涉及三维重建、机器人或世界模型，对物理 AI 主线仅为间接参考。

Abstract: Diffusion virtual try-on (VTO) models produce convincing garment transfers from a single product photograph, but at hundreds of milliseconds to seconds per image every deployment today is offline or falls back to AR mirrors that need a rigged 3D asset per product. We present LiveMirror, a live-camera try-on mirror that renders a flat garment photograph onto a moving person with a diffusion model on one 16 GB consumer GPU. Its core is asynchronous keyframe try-on: generation never blocks the display, every displayed frame is an optical-flow warp of the latest generated keyframe, and keyframes are replaced only through a cross-fade. The display runs at camera rate (25 FPS at 720p) while a new try-on arrives every 370-490 ms; we measure the residual flicker, give a stage-by-stage latency budget, and report which accelerations (step count, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation) keep garment prints intact. We then show that the same GPU fixes the model's biggest cultural blind spot: try-on models trained on VITON-HD and DressCode render a knee-length kurta or sherwani as a torso-length top or a dress over bare legs. A thigh-covering mask, self-supervised pairs built automatically from 24.9k on-model e-commerce photographs, and 3.2 GPU-hours of attention-only fine-tuning of CatVTON halve the perceptual error on ethnic wear (LPIPS 0.137 to 0.077 on IndoFashion, 0.135 to 0.073 on Atlas; 200 held-out pairs per source) with no regression on Western tops. A two-pass hem-aware mask then removes the remaining failure, recoloured trousers below the hem, on all but 3-4% of pairs at no training cost; in the mirror the hem comes from the previous keyframe for free. The adapted model beats FASHN VTON 1.5 on every aggregate ethnic-wear metric at about $20\times$ lower inference cost, and its weights drop straight into the mirror.

</details>


### [318] [Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30469)
*Kaixuan Chang,Huabing Zhou,Yanduo Zhang,Tao Lu,Liwei Wang,Zhongyuan Wang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Struct2Det 利用类别的结构化图（部件+关系）引导少样本目标检测：将类别图编码为部件嵌入与全局条件，用部件查询检索多尺度证据来调制文本嵌入，并在候选与预期部件匹配可靠时校正区域特征，在工程图纸符号数据集 InduSym 上少样本类别 AP 提升 6.02。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本检测器难以区分外观相似但局部部件不同的类别，因为少量样本难以揭示哪些差异决定类别身份；类别描述虽给出部件与关系，却不能确认这些部件是否在图像中出现。

Method: 三阶段结构引导检测：(1) 关系结构编码将类别图映射为部件嵌入与全局条件；(2) 部件落地检测用部件查询检索多尺度图像证据，结合全局条件调制类别文本嵌入做初始检测；(3) 验证引导精化将候选区域与其最高分类别所期望的部件进行匹配，当类别分数接近且匹配置信时，用匹配对修正区域特征后由共享检测器再预测。同时构建 InduSym 数据集（674 张工程图纸、275 类、88,912 个符号实例，每类含结构图）。

Result: 少样本类别 AP 较最强基线在 InduSym 上提升 6.02 点，Digitize-PID 上提升 9.68 点，且两数据集基础类别 AP 亦最高；消融显示增益来自正确的类别结构、图像级检索与候选验证；在少样本自然物体检测与零样本汉字识别上亦有增益。

Conclusion: 类别结构可同时作用于分类的两路输入（文本嵌入融合图像级部件证据、区域特征融合候选级匹配），是提升少样本细粒度检测的有效且可扩展的信号；但评测集中于工程图纸符号与自然物体二维检测，尚未涉及机器人感知或三维场景。

Abstract: Few-shot detectors struggle to distinguish categories that look alike but differ in local components, because a few examples rarely reveal which differences determine category identity. Category descriptions specify components and relations but do not establish their presence in an image. We propose Struct2Det, which uses category structure to guide detection and verify candidates in three stages. Relational Structure Encoding maps category graphs to component embeddings and a global condition. Component-Grounded Detection uses component queries to retrieve multi-scale image evidence that, with the global condition, modulates category text embeddings for initial detection. Verification-Guided Refinement matches candidate regions with components expected by their top-scoring categories; when class scores are close and matches are reliable, matched pairs correct region features before the shared detector predicts again. Category structure informs both classification inputs: text embeddings integrate image-wide component evidence, while region features incorporate candidate-specific matches. We also construct InduSym, with 88,912 symbol instances across 275 categories from 674 engineering drawings and a structural graph per category. Struct2Det improves few-shot-category AP over the strongest baseline by 6.02 points on InduSym and 9.68 on Digitize-PID, with the highest base-category AP on both. InduSym ablations show few-shot gains from correct category structure, image-level retrieval, and candidate verification. Further tests show gains in few-shot natural-object detection and zero-shot Chinese character recognition.

</details>


### [319] [Inclusion of obstacles in ground point classification in ALS data for terrain models used for analysis of vehicle traversability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30471)
*Mikael Lundbäck,Erik Wallin,Sima Mohtasami,Martin Servin,Mattias Nyström,Henrik Persson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 评估多种ALS机载激光点云地面点分类算法（含障碍物归入地面类），用点级Precision/Recall/F1与地形模型RMSE、差异图对比，CSF最优，平均RMSE约0.08 m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林场景下地形、传感器、飞行参数与点密度差异大，近年点密度显著提升使旧有低密度算法可能失效；且多数算法难以同时把巨石等障碍物与灌木/下层植被区分开。面向越野机械路径规划与导航，需要生成将障碍物计入地表面的地形模型并考察算法可行性。

Method: 在ALS数据上将障碍物纳入地面类，横向评测多种地面点滤波/分类算法；参数敏感性分析；评价指标分两层：点级Precision、Recall、F1，以及由分类结果插值得到的地形模型RMSE与差异图。

Result: 多个算法表现良好但性能对参数高度敏感；地形模型RMSE最优为CSF（Cloth Simulation Filter）算法，平均RMSE 0.08 m。

Conclusion: 在所测条件下，现有地面滤波算法可通过参数调优适配“障碍物计入地面”的需求，为越野导航地形建模提供可行基线；但缺乏统一鲁棒参数，工程部署需针对数据调参。

Abstract: Classification of ALS point clouds has been studied for decades, but it remains challenging in forest contexts due to the great variety of terrain types, sensor equipment, flight parameters, and resulting point densities. Point cloud density has increased significantly in recent years, and existing algorithms, developed for lower density point clouds, may no longer be effective. It is beyond the scope of most existing algorithms to classify obstacles, such as boulders, while also distinguishing non-obstacles, such as bushes and undergrowth. We evaluate the performance of different algorithms for ground point classification in ALS data in a context where obstacles are included in the ground class, resulting in terrain models useful for offroad machinery route planning and navigation. The evaluation is performed using metrics directly on the point clouds (Precision, Recall, $F_1$-score) and on resulting terrain models (RMSE and maps of differences). The results show that there are several algorithms that perform well, but performance is highly affected by the parameters used. The best results in terms of terrain model RMSE are obtained with the CSF-algorithm, with an average RMSE of 0.08 meters. The results indicate that existing algorithms can be adapted to include obstacles in the ground class under the tested conditions.

</details>


### [320] [Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30472)
*Zishan Qin,Rui Li,Zeyu Zhang,Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi,Lina Yao,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过FlowDPO式偏好微调，用少量部件标注数据将预训练部件感知3D生成器的DiT适配到更高质量的部件分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部件感知3D生成需要全局合理且完整、分离良好的语义部件，但高质量部件分解数据稀缺，难以支撑大规模监督微调。

Method: 用不同随机种子生成候选，并按GT几何指标排序，挑选跨种子质量差距最大的(object, target-part)样本；每样本存储共享同一干净GT组合潜变量、仅高斯噪声不同的两条流轨迹。基于FlowDPO构建参考相对的target-block偏好损失（与冻结参考模型对比），并用target block与完整部件集上的GT flow-matching损失提供绝对监督，仅更新DiT。辅以人类排序对照与合成裁剪构造的"不完整"负样本。

Result: 三种训练集规模中，中等规模在留出Objaverse上表现最佳，在多部件聚合指标上超过预训练生成器与报告的直接监督微调基线；对配对顺序、目标部件覆盖率及成对/GT监督平衡敏感；跨数据集迁移增益不一致。

Conclusion: DPO式偏好微调可在不改架构、仅用有限部件标注的前提下提升部件感知3D生成质量，但效果依赖数据规模与超参平衡，分布偏移下泛化有限。

Abstract: Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) geometric metrics, and select the (object, target-part) examples with the largest across-seed quality gap. Each selected example stores a seed pair whose two flow trajectories share one clean GT compositional latent and differ only in Gaussian noise. We derive a reference-relative target-block preference loss from FlowDPO that compares the two trajectories against a frozen reference model. GT flow-matching losses on the target block and complete part set provide absolute supervision, while only the diffusion transformer (DiT) is updated. Human-ranked controls test an alternative ordering source, and synthetic cropping provides controlled loser targets that are incomplete by construction. Among the three training-set scales, the medium-scale setting gives the strongest result on held-out Objaverse and outperforms both the pretrained generator and the reported direct supervised fine-tuning baseline on the multi-part aggregate. Further analysis shows sensitivity to pair ordering, target-part coverage, and the balance between pairwise and GT supervision. Cross-dataset experiments show less consistent gains under distribution shift.

</details>


### [321] [Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30480)
*Chen Yang,Zheng Fang,Wenqi Fan,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练解码方法 Lobals：识别视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口并在潜空间中重新前向，让 MLLM 在测试时"回看"视觉证据，提升通用视觉语言、幻觉与视觉中心任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受 LLM 测试时可在潜空间做额外计算增强推理的启发，探究 MLLM 能否通过潜空间额外计算在测试时改善视觉感知。

Method: 先验证 MLLM 存在可复用、重复前向不破坏正常生成的稳定层；据此选出对视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口，在推理时对该窗口再次前向（latent-space revisit），无需训练。

Result: 在通用 vision-language 任务、视觉幻觉任务与 vision-centric 任务上均有性能提升，表明潜空间回看策略可跨多种多模态设置生效。

Conclusion: 潜空间额外计算可作为提升 MLLM 视觉感知的免费测试时增益手段；方法免训练、即插即用，但缺少与具体机器人/3D任务的结合验证，计算开销与窗口选择鲁棒性待评估。

Abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

</details>


### [322] [Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30488)
*Xiaochen Zhang,Jin Li,Chunlong Xia,Longjiang Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文审计了 Polaris、Nebula、Spica 三个图像描述评测指标数据集的人工判断基准，揭示了训练/测试集像素级重复、重复样本虚高指标、Kendall τ 主要由“最低分检测”项贡献等问题，并提出只用以无测试样本训练的模型排序指标的新协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型图像描述指标（如 Polos、DENEB、Pearl）的高相关性常被当作泛化能力的证据，但若测试图像出现在训练集中，该结论可能来自记忆而非泛化，因此需要严格审计数据泄漏与相关性构成。

Method: 对三个最新人工判断数据集做像素级图像匹配，检测训练/测试重复；对 Pearl、DENEB 等进行控制性重训练（不同学习器、不同重复率、逐 epoch）量化重复带来的增益；将 Kendall τ 分解为“最低分检测”与“其余排序”两项；用冻结特征上的岭回归作为基线；提出排名协议：仅使用不含测试样本训练的模型、同时报告两个分量、采用配对显著性检验。

Result: Spica 训练集约含 Polaris 测试集三分之二且评分完全相同；Pearl 的增益仅限于重复样本并随 epoch 增长，DENEB 增益低于 1 分；Kendall τ 主要由近乎饱和的“最低分检测”项贡献；三个近期测试集无法一致地区分 Polos、DENEB、Pearl，而冻结特征岭回归可匹敌或超越三者。新协议下，零样本视觉-语言评审模型在三个新测试集上排名第一，微调评审模型在三个早期基准上排名第一。

Conclusion: 现有学习型描述指标的“泛化”主张存在数据泄漏与相关性度量结构性缺陷，应以无泄漏训练模型、双分量报告和配对检验作为标准评测协议；该分析框架可推广到任何由人工判断学习的评测器，并公开过滤列表与代码。

Abstract: Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. We audit this claim for the three most recent collections of such judgments, Polaris, Nebula, and Spica, matching images at the pixel level. First, test samples reappear in training sets: the Spica training set contains about two-thirds of the Polaris test set, with identical human ratings. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall's $\tau$ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. The recent test sets cannot order Polos, DENEB and Pearl consistently, and a ridge regression on frozen features matches or exceeds all three. Fourth, we propose a protocol that ranks a learned metric only with a model trained without test samples, reports both terms, and compares metrics by paired tests. Under it, zero-shot vision--language judges rank first on the three recent test sets, and a fine-tuned judge ranks first on the three earlier benchmarks. The same analysis applies to any evaluator learned from human judgments; filter lists and code are released at this https URL .

</details>


### [323] [When Do Spatial Plans Help Text-to-Image Generation? Causal Control, System Utility, and Text Responsiveness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30514)
*Lu Han,Jingyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 控制实验表明：对文本到图像生成器而言，显式空间布局/最小间隔指令的收益高度依赖条件通路与文本先验，文本接口在许多设置下已足够或对指令精度不敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"给生成器提供空间计划（布局、坐标、间隔指令）"相比纯文本条件的真实增益，并区分增益来源是模型本身能力还是布局信息。

Method: 18 组配对训练种子的受控实验，比较修正预测位置/尺寸的布局条件与直接文本条件（匹配训练算力）；在预训练生成器上对比固定规则布局与同文本适配器；在 288 个新任务族上加入"最小间隔"指令，比较文本适配器、宽间隔区域与紧间隔区域三种条件通路，并统计基线图像中物体与方向正确但间隔不满足的比例。

Result: 布局修正使空间 IoU 提升 0.030，但直接文本在匹配算力下非劣；固定规则布局使双物体任务成功率较纯文本适配器高 12.50 个百分点，主要来自分离已按正确顺序出现的物体；最小间隔指令使文本适配器成功率提升 37.15 点，宽间隔区域最多仅 0.69 点，紧间隔区域 6.94 点；紧区域下 288 幅基线图像中 230 幅物体与方向正确但缺失间隔，排除了高基线成功率作为文本响应弱的唯一解释。

Conclusion: 空间计划的价值取决于文本通路能否表达该约束；当文本可承载细粒度关系指令时布局增益被吸收，紧约束区域则对间隙指令钝化，说明条件通路–指令精度匹配是该类生成系统的关键设计问题。

Abstract: A generator can follow a spatial plan, but the benefit of supplying that plan depends on what the model can already do from text. In a controlled study with 18 paired training seeds, correcting predicted positions and sizes improves spatial intersection-over-union by 0.030, yet direct text is non-inferior at matched training compute. In a pretrained generator, a fixed rule layout improves two-object task success over the same text-only adapter by 12.50 percentage points, mostly by separating objects that already appear in the correct order. We then ask whether a more precise instruction can achieve the same separation across conditioning paths. On 288 new task families, adding a minimum-gap instruction improves success by 37.15 points with the text-only adapter, by at most 0.69 points with widely spaced regions, and by 6.94 points with tightly spaced regions. Under tight regions, 230 of 288 baseline images have the correct objects and direction yet miss the required gap, ruling out a high baseline success rate as the sole explanation for the weak text response.

</details>


### [324] [Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30515)
*Raul Lomonte Figueiredo,João Rebouças Dorea,Dário Augusto Borges Oliveira*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需新标注即可用含噪公共土地覆盖产品训练大尺度作物分类模型的框架：以相似度聚类实现组级监督以抑制标签语义不一致，以光学分割场界+多数投票提升预测空间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带地区持续云覆盖限制光学观测，SAR可全生育期连续观测；但全国尺度土地覆盖产品存在系统偏差，低估稀少作物，直接训练会继承并放大错误，而野外调查或人工纠错成本过高。

Method: 方法含两机制：(1) 语义一致性——用基于SAR时序相似度的聚类模型分成同质组，仅用含噪标签为每个组分配最具代表性的类别，将监督从样本级转为组级；(2) 空间一致性——用光学影像分割模型勾画田块边界，将地块内patch预测按多数投票融合。

Result: 两个研究区聚类纯度达89.0%与91.2%；在Campo Verde与Luís Eduardo Magalhães两市中，平均类别精度较含噪基线最多提升10.14个百分点，少数作物受益更明显；跨州尺度无需再调参即稳定，且推导的市域作物面积与模型从未观测的官方IBGE/PAM统计一致。

Conclusion: 组级弱监督与场块级后处理可有效将低质量公共标签转化为可用的区域-州尺度SAR作物制图模型，具备跨区泛化性与独立统计可验证性。

Abstract: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.

</details>


### [325] [GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30519)
*Zhangcheng Hou,Kevin Tonkich,Tomoaki Ohtsuki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何读出监督 GRS：以观测点上的可学习权重加权质心定位部件，弥合分割掩码与部件几何之间的差距，并在 GeoRead3D 系统中结合语言模型与双路部件证据完成指向与重定向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言常以部件指代物体（指到某部件、将任意姿态物体旋转使两部件处于给定方向），这两类任务真正需要的是"物体中心→部件中心"的方向，而非部件自身朝向。掩码重叠度高并不意味着指向方向准确，尤其当部件相对物体中心较分散时；而语言引导部件分割以掩码重叠为训练与评测指标，与其下游任务所用的部件几何之间存在目标错位。

Method: 用点证据（观测点的权重）表示部件，以其加权质心作为部件位置；GRS 通过质心位置对权重进行几何读出监督，并对重定向指令涉及的部件额外施加方向监督。GeoRead3D 系统：语言模型将部件描述映射为已知部件名；双路部件证据将精化后的分割证据与直接预测的点证据融合以定位部件。

Result: 在 PartNeXt 与 Artiverse 上，指向准确率（22.5° 内）分别为 74.1% 与 60.0%，较最强基线高 5.8 与 7.3 个百分点；重定向成功率较最强基线高 10.4 与 7.8 个百分点。仅用单一冻结编码器和单一输入位姿即可取得该提升。

Conclusion: 将监督信号从掩码重叠转向几何读出（质心与方向）可有效对齐分割输出与部件几何，显著提升语言引导的指向与重定向性能，且无需多视角或多编码器。

Abstract: Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.

</details>


### [326] [VeriOrigin: A Proactive Image Protection Framework for Provenance, Tamper Localization, and Lossless Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30523)
*Jiale Chen,Wei William Wang,Junnan Yin,Chongyang Shi,Li Dong,Yuanman Li,Xiping Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VeriOrigin：基于CNN可逆编码器XOnet的统一图像保护框架，通过交叉残差预测实现可逆水印，兼具鲁棒溯源、高精度篡改定位与无损原图恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用水印（versatile watermarking）多在复杂失真下难以同时兼顾鲁棒溯源与精确定位，且基于flow的可逆架构存在局限；需要在无损信道中保证原图完全恢复以支持完整性认证。

Method: 抛弃flow式架构，设计XOnet——由两个标准CNN水印子网络Xnet与Onet组成，通过交叉残差预测（cross residual prediction）实现可逆性；采用两阶段训练：先优化水印分支，再优化篡改定位分支；推理时对载体图像依次施加水印与篡改残差嵌入。

Result: 在四个数据集上实验表明，VeriOrigin实现精确篡改定位与强鲁棒性，并在完整性认证中保证载体图像无损恢复。

Conclusion: 该框架以CNN可逆编码替代flow架构，统一了溯源、篡改定位与无损恢复三项能力，为图像内容保护提供了一体化方案。

Abstract: Versatile watermarking, which seamlessly integrates provenance and tamper detection, has recently attracted widespread attention. In this paper, we propose \textbf{VeriOrigin}, a comprehensive and unified image protection framework that not only robustly achieves provenance and highly precise tamper localization under various complex distortions, but also guarantees perfect recovery of the original cover in lossless channels. To realize this framework, we depart from conventional flow based architectures. Instead, we design \textbf{XOnet}, a CNN based invertible encoder. XOnet comprises two standard CNN based watermarking sub networks, Xnet and Onet, which achieve reversibility through cross residual prediction. Based on XOnet, we train the proactive protection scheme via a two stage strategy: first optimizing the watermarking branch, followed by the tamper localization branch. During inference, the cover image undergoes sequential watermarking and tamper residual embedding. Extensive experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that VeriOrigin achieves precise tamper localization and strong robustness, while guaranteeing lossless cover recovery for integrity authentication. Project page is available at this https URL

</details>


### [327] [Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30530)
*Michael Hollmer,Andreas Fischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于 JEPA 的自监督工业装配验证框架，将装配验证建模为前后观测的预测式世界模型任务，AUROC 达 86.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业装配自动验证面临视觉变化大、缺陷标注稀缺、错误粒度细等难题；现有目标检测/CAD 模型/监督分类方法难以跨产品与装配配置泛化。

Method: 以 JEPA 世界模型 LeWorldModel 为基础，改造联合嵌入预测架构，将装配验证形式化为基于装配过程前后观测的预测式世界建模任务（自监督，无需缺陷标注）。

Result: 在新构建的装配验证数据集上 AUROC 86.9%，可检测细粒度错误装配状态与动作-状态不匹配。

Conclusion: JEPA 式预测表征可作为鲁棒、数据高效的工业装配验证基础。

Abstract: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

</details>


### [328] [ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30531)
*Zeyu Ding,Yong Zhou,Jiaqi Zhao,Hancheng Zhu,Wen-Liang Du,Rui Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReDiffDet：把旋转目标检测建模为旋转等变去噪扩散过程，用2D高斯表示有向框、条件框条件编码与对齐解码器解决任意旋转编码、随机框不可控与框-特征错位问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型用于有向目标检测存在三方面问题：任意旋转物体需编码朝向信息；随机初始框在密集排布与极端长宽比场景下定位不准；有向框与图像特征错位。

Method: 将有向框表示为2D高斯分布作为去噪范式基础，证明反向过程在该表示下具备旋转等变性；设计带条件框的条件编码器限制框的放置范围；提出对齐解码器实现有向框与图像特征的对齐。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验显示性能良好，显著优于扩散模型基线。

Conclusion: 通过高斯表示+等变扩散+条件框+对齐解码的组合，可有效提升基于扩散的有向目标检测，但仍属遥感/通用旋转框检测范畴，对具身与3D重建等核心方向为间接参考。

Abstract: The diffusion model has been successfully applied to various detection tasks. However, it still faces several challenges when used for oriented object detection: objects that are arbitrarily rotated require the diffusion model to encode their orientation information; uncontrollable random boxes inaccurately locate objects with dense arrangements and extreme aspect ratios; oriented boxes result in the misalignment between them and image features. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReDiffDet, a framework that formulates oriented object detection as a rotation-equivariant denoising diffusion process. First, we represent an oriented box as a 2D Gaussian distribution, forming the basis of the denoising paradigm. The reverse process can be proven to be rotation-equivariant within this representation and model framework. Second, we design a conditional encoder with conditional boxes to prevent boxes from being randomly placed across the entire image. Third, we propose an aligned decoder for alignment between oriented boxes and image features. The extensive experiments demonstrate ReDiffDet achieves promising performance and significantly outperforms the diffusion model baseline.

</details>


### [329] [BEND: Spectral Bregman Losses for Multi-Image Unlearning in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30532)
*Mohamed-Hicham Leghettas,Markus Püschel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BEND首次将Bregman散度族引入扩散模型数据遗忘，用双层优化搜索谱域Bregman散度损失，在Stable Diffusion上一次性遗忘48张可验证记忆图像，遗忘效果与图像质量均优于ReTrack。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型会近乎逐字复现训练图像，带来版权与隐私风险。数据遗忘需同时"忘记目标"与"保持其余生成质量"，是双向约束。已有方法均使用平方L2扩散损失（至多人工设定频域掩码），但理论上任意Bregman散度都是合法选择，损失函数族远未被探索。

Method: 提出BEND：通过双层循环（bilevel loop）为遗忘任务自动拟合一个谱域Bregman散度（spectral Bregman divergence），使损失本身被"塑形"以彻底遗忘并保护质量；同时将被记忆图像的生成目标重定向到其保留集图像的均值，而非ReTrack那样指向单一近邻副本。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion上用单一BEND模型同时遗忘全部48张可验证记忆基准图像；遗忘程度至少不弱于逐目标/序贯/联合训练的ReTrack（SSCD 0.084 vs 0.094–0.120），且生成质量保持在遗忘前水平（CLIP-IQA 0.81 vs 0.64–0.69）。在CelebA-HQ三项指标上全面超越SOTA，在MNIST、CIFAR-10上持平或超过。

Conclusion: 损失函数形式本身是可学习的遗忘设计变量：搜索Bregman散度族显著优于固定L2损失与启发式频域掩码，并支持单模型批量遗忘多目标而不牺牲生成质量。但工作范围限于图像生成模型的版权/隐私移除，与具身智能、3D重建、世界模型等物理AI方向无关。

Abstract: Diffusion models memorize training images and reproduce them almost verbatim when prompted, creating copyright and privacy liabilities. Data unlearning erases the influence of specific training samples from a trained model without retraining, and is two-sided: it must forget the targets while preserving generation quality on everything else. Prior methods use the squared-L2 diffusion loss, at most with a hand-set frequency mask; however, it is known that every Bregman divergence is a mathematically valid choice and the squared-L2 is only the simplest example. BEND is the first to search this family: it fits a spectral Bregman divergence to the unlearning task through a bilevel loop, so the loss itself is shaped to forget thoroughly while protecting quality. It also redirects a memorized image to the mean of its retain images, where ReTrack, the state of the art, redirects it to a single near-copy. On Stable Diffusion, a single BEND model erases all 48 verifiably memorized benchmark images at once. It forgets at least as much as per-target, sequential, and jointly trained ReTrack (SSCD 0.084 versus 0.094-0.120), at the quality of the model before unlearning (CLIP-IQA 0.81 versus 0.64-0.69). BEND also outperforms the state of the art on CelebA-HQ in all three measures of the benchmark, and matches or exceeds it on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

</details>


### [330] [Where Compositionality Hides: Shared-Content Interference in Vision-Language Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30538)
*Chimata Anudeep,Harsh Vardhan Poddar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出配对组合基准（如Winoground）的Group Score混合了两种失败来源，提出"均值擦除"投影，在冻结嵌入上证明其保持图像内caption排序、使Group Score等于Text Score，将CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score从9%提升至31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Winoground等配对组合基准上，Group决策失败可能源于caption偏好错误，也可能仅源于跨图像比较本身，而Group Score将二者合并；因此无法判断应重训练编码器还是改变评分规则。作者希望先分解这两种失败来源，评估仅靠评分规则修正能恢复多少Group损失。

Method: 提出mean-erasure：将每个冻结图像嵌入向远离两张归一化候选caption均值的方向投影。理论上证明该投影保持所有图像内caption排序，并使Group Score等于基线Text Score。随后做分数分解分析，比较固定修正、学习式双线性打分器，以及由检索caption估计方向（2个与16个caption设置）。

Result: Winoground上CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score由9%升至31%，五个CLIP与SigLIP检查点提升21–27个百分点；ColorSwap在颜色-物体绑定上有类似增益。分数分解显示约60%的Image失败其正确联合分配的分数已高于交换版，仅因两图像间偏移而失败。固定修正与学习双线性打分器提升不足1点；检索caption估计方向在2个caption时约提升5点，16个时低于基线。

Conclusion: 在重训编码器用于配对检索之前，应先测量mean-erasure可恢复的Group损失；超出基线Text Score的增益必须来自改变caption决策本身，即编码器语义能力，而非评分规则。

Abstract: Paired compositional benchmarks such as Winoground ask each image to prefer its matching caption and each caption to prefer its matching image. A failed Group decision can come from a wrong caption preference or from the cross-image comparison alone, and Group Score merges the two. Choosing between retraining the encoder and changing the scoring rule therefore requires separating them. We study mean-erasure, which projects each frozen image embedding away from the mean of the two normalized candidate captions. We prove that the projection preserves every within-image caption ranking and makes Group Score equal baseline Text Score. On Winoground, mean-erasure raises CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score from 9% to 31%, and five CLIP and SigLIP checkpoints gain 21 to 27 percentage points. ColorSwap shows a similar gain for color-object binding. A score decomposition shows that about 60% of Image failures already score the correct joint assignment above the swapped one and fail only on an offset between the two images. Fixed corrections and a learned bilinear scorer gain under one point. A direction estimated from retrieved captions gains about five points with two captions and falls below baseline with sixteen. Before retraining an encoder for paired retrieval, measure the Group loss that mean-erasure recovers: gains beyond baseline Text Score require changing the caption decisions themselves.

</details>


### [331] [SVUBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30541)
*Yuxuan Liang,Bohan Zhang,Haiyang Yu,Bocheng Hu,Ke Niu,Xu Li,Zhengtao Yao,Yan Wen,Haotian Chen,Xiaolei Chen,Jiacong Wang,Zhe Liu,Jingqun Tang,Benlei Cui,Fan Shi,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SVUBench主动式流式视频理解基准：含12,131道题、62,881个答案点、10项任务（感知/理解/推理），设Basic与Trajectory两种交互模式及四档时长分层，并提出Proactive Response Score (PRS)联合评估正确性、及时性、历史一致性与内容质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解评测多为离线、全视频可见设定，无法衡量模型在视频流中实时解读事件、及时响应并回溯历史证据的主动能力。

Method: 构建SVUBench：模型辅助标注+人工校验生成12,131题；任务分感知、理解、推理三类共10项；Basic模式考察自视频起点持续主动响应，Trajectory模式要求在流中任务激活后回溯历史并持续更新回答；引入Duration-Scaled Challenge按四档时长分层；设计带任务自适应答案窗口的PRS指标。

Result: 对现有模型的系统实验揭示了其在及时性、历史一致性和长视频场景下的优势与不足，为主动流式视频理解指明改进方向。

Conclusion: SVUBench提供了细粒度、可量化的主动流式视频理解评测框架，但属于基准/数据集类工作，未提出新的模型方法或物理AI/VLA相关技术贡献。

Abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires models to interpret unfolding events, respond timely, and retrieve relevant historical evidence. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce SVUBench, a comprehensive proactive streaming video benchmark comprising 12,131 questions and 62,881 answer points across ten proactive tasks spanning Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning. Constructed through model-assisted annotation and human verification, SVUBench introduces two complementary interaction modes. Basic evaluates sustained proactive responses from video onset, while Trajectory requires historical recovery and continuous response updates following task activation during streaming. A Duration-Scaled Challenge further evaluates these capabilities across four video duration tiers. We develop the Proactive Response Score (PRS) with task-adaptive answer windows to jointly assess answer correctness, response timeliness, historical consistency, and content quality. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal the strengths and limitations of existing models, highlighting directions for advancing proactive streaming video understanding.

</details>


### [332] [RAPID: Codec-Aware Video Decoding for Efficient Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30557)
*Yuna Lee,Yulhwa Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAPID是一个codec-aware的长视频VLM推理加速框架，利用压缩码流中的参考帧信息与随机访问点，同时加速视频解码与关键帧选择，实现小时级视频最高4.9x TTFT加速且精度基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频VLM高效推理工作主要关注帧选择与LLM prefill，忽略了视频解码本身的开销（可超过LLM prefill时间）；而编码器压缩码流中已包含帧依赖与随机访问点等结构信息，可被用来避免冗余解码与稠密候选打分。

Method: 提出RAPID（Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding）框架，含两个组件：(1) RAPID-Dec利用参考帧依赖关系与随机访问点跳过不必要帧、并行解码保留帧，且保证目标帧的精确重建；(2) RAPID-Sel以关键帧作为视频片段的粗粒度代表，规避现有帧选择方法所需的稠密候选解码与打分。

Result: 在H.264/AVC视频上，RAPID-Dec相比最快baseline解码器最高3.7x解码加速；RAPID-Sel在精度相当的情况下带来最高3.0x预处理加速；两者结合在小时级视频上相比SOTA帧选择方法（配最快baseline解码器）实现4.9x TTFT加速。

Conclusion: 将视频编解码结构信息纳入长视频VLM推理流程，是降低解码与选择开销的有效且互补的优化维度；该方法无需重新编码、不改变目标帧重建质量，可作为现有帧选择方案的前置加速层。

Abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can process hour-long videos, but the large number of input frames incurs substantial inference overhead. Existing approaches to efficient long-video understanding largely overlook video decoding, which can take longer than LLM prefill. We propose RAPID (Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding), a codec-aware framework that exploits information embedded in compressed bitstreams to reduce both frame decoding and selection costs. RAPID consists of two components. RAPID-Dec exploits reference-frame information and random access points to skip unnecessary frames and decode the retained frames in parallel while preserving exact reconstruction of the target frames. It achieves up to a 3.7x decoding speedup over the fastest baseline on H.264/AVC videos. RAPID-Sel uses keyframes as coarse representatives of video segments, avoiding the dense candidate decoding and scoring required by existing frame selection methods. It achieves comparable accuracy with up to a 3.0x preprocessing speedup. Together, RAPID achieves a 4.9x time to first token (TTFT) speedup on hour-long videos over a state-of-the-art frame selection method using the fastest baseline decoder.

</details>


### [333] [JONES-19: A Cultural Image Dataset Based on The Grammar of Ornament](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30558)
*Linh Pham,Stuart Shieber,David Alvarez-Melis,Alexandros Haridis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JONES-19：基于《装饰法则》(1856) 的1,901幅、19个文化装饰图案数据集，含分类基线及基于误分类错误的文化相似性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为细粒度、小样本、类别不均衡的人造设计图像提供可复现基准，服务于视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史与建筑风格研究。

Method: 从开放获取档案整理图像并标注19类文化归属，构建数据集；训练分类器作基线，通过误分类混淆模式刻画类间（文化间）关系。

Result: 给出分类基线性能，并借错误模式揭示类别间聚类关系，尤其反映文化风格相似性；未涉及具体量化指标。

Conclusion: 该数据集可作为细粒度小样本分类与艺术/文化遗产交叉研究的基准，但本研究仅提供数据集与基线，无新算法贡献。

Abstract: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. This paper describes the curation of the JONES-19 dataset and reports a baseline classification benchmark that evaluates the suitability of the dataset for training classifiers and exposes insights into inter-class relationships--particularly cultural similarities--by examining patterns in misclassification errors. The dataset and its accompanying documentation are available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [334] [Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30564)
*Wilson Wongso,Hada Melino Muhammad,Xiachong Lin,Hao Xue,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoDecisions 多模态基准，评测决策模型（输出标签概率分布的模型）的空间感知能力与地理偏见，涵盖地理感知图像分类与地点评分两项任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型越来越多被用作真实世界地点相关输入的分类器与评估器，但其能否利用空间上下文、预测是否存在地理偏见仍不清楚。

Method: 构建包含两任务的多模态基准：(1) 地理感知图像分类；(2) 在客观与主观主题上进行地点评分。将 6 个决策模型与有监督任务专用模型对比，并分析错误的空间聚集性与社会经济条件相关性；另提出一种免训练方法，将决策模型与位置先验结合以提升空间感知。

Result: 空间感知依赖视觉：仅文本坐标不足以提供分类日常照片与卫星图像的上下文。存在显著地理偏见：日常照片上开放权重决策模型虽准确率更高，错误的空间聚集性强于有监督模型；在全部五个主观主题上，所有决策模型对低社会经济条件地区的评分都更低。位置先验方法可在不明显加剧性能偏见的前提下提升空间感知。

Conclusion: 决策模型的空间能力受限于模态，并携带系统性地理偏见；引入位置先验的免训练方案可部分缓解，提示需在真实地理场景中审慎部署此类模型。

Abstract: Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. We introduce GeoDecisions, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating the spatial awareness and geographic bias of decision models. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models against supervised task-specific models, we find that spatial awareness requires vision: textual coordinates alone provide insufficient context for classifying everyday photos and satellite images. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [335] [Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30568)
*Tong Wang,Wenbo Peng,Yaolei Qi,Yuting He,Yutong Xie,Guanyu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STREAM: 将因果多尺度聚合(CMA)从固定片段扩展到在线流的视频息肉分割框架，用常数大小槽记忆(RSM)提供长程历史，并用可靠性感知槽写入(RASW)抑制局部退化帧的污染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VPS 中息肉与黏膜相似、尺度变化快，需要超出短片段的长期历史；同时模糊、镜面高光和遮挡往往只退化帧的局部区域。现有方法以整帧保存历史，开销随历史长度增长，且把局部退化内容带入后续预测。

Method: 递归槽记忆(RSM)：将多尺度特征与软前景/背景线索汇总为固定数量的槽，当前特征读取并传入 CMA；可靠性感知槽写入(RASW)：由当前帧估计像素级质量图，以局部误差监督，控制哪些位置写入 RSM 以及各槽的更新幅度。

Result: 在 SUN-SEG 与 CVC-ClinicDB 上达到 SOTA；在最难子集上 Dice 由会议版 81.3% 提升至 85.7%；以 48 FPS 运行，状态恒定为 0.32 MB。

Conclusion: 常数代价的长程记忆加可靠性门控写入可有效提升流式医学视频分割的精度与效率，思路可迁移到其他在线视频分割/跟踪任务。

Abstract: Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [336] [Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30573)
*ZiAn Wang,Tianyi Wang,Zhihao Chen,Manni Cui,Junkai Chen,ZhiJin Chen,Ruiqi Liu,Junfei Wu,Huanyu Zhang,Shu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PersistWorld 提出一种持久化 3D 世界状态的世界模型，将相机流逐帧写入场景锚定的状态而非重建历史，端到端联合学习并与演化器预测未来占用；在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上 1–3s IoU 提升 19 点，8s 内提升 18–24 点，且速度提升 2 倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于相机的世界模型在 4D 占用预测中主要缺陷不在"预测变化"，而在"保持已见空间"：未来空间可划分为不变、变化与未见三类，模型在不变区域的保持能力显著不足。

Method: 将模型已观测内容作为显式状态：构建以场景为锚点的持久 3D 世界状态，每帧仅写入一次而非从历史帧重建；状态与预测端到端联合优化；由 evolver 沿自车轨迹在任意查询时刻预测该状态。

Result: Occ3D-nuScenes 上相对最佳相机世界模型，1–3 s IoU 提升 19 点，至 8 s 提升 18–24 点，推理速度提升超过 2 倍。

Conclusion: 以持久化场景锚定状态替代历史重建是提升长时程 4D 占用预测精度与效率的有效范式。

Abstract: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: this https URL . Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [337] [A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30578)
*Danilo Danese,Angela Lombardi,Tommaso Di Noia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WaFR：自适应层次搜索+稀疏多尺度回归的模型无关扰动归因方法，计算量随证据空间分布自适应，8192像素分辨率下Pointing Game≥0.995，千兆像素WSI中位176次前向传播、patch级AUROC 0.949。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扰动式归因无需访问模型内部表示，但高分辨率图像上存在粒度与计算成本的矛盾：细粒度扰动需大量前向评估，粗掩码会漏掉小而关键的证据。

Method: 提出Wavelet Find-and-Refine（WaFR）：先用小波域多尺度分解进行自适应层次搜索定位影响预测的区域，再对候选区域做稀疏多尺度回归得到细粒度归因；仅在证据密集处细化，故成本依赖证据的空间分布而非图像分辨率。属model-agnostic黑盒方法。

Result: 受控定位实验中，图像边长增至8192像素时仍保持≥0.995的Pointing Game分数，且在相同前向次数预算下亦然；千兆像素全切片图像（WSI）上中位仅需176次前向传播，patch级平均AUROC达0.949，为所评测扰动式方法中最高。

Conclusion: 通过层次搜索与稀疏回归结合，WaFR在极高分辨率场景下以可控黑盒查询成本实现精细定位，为可扩展的扰动式可解释性提供了可行路径；但验证集中于定位实验与医学WSI，未涉及具身智能相关任务。

Abstract: Perturbation-based attribution methods explain model predictions without accessing their internal representations, but scaling them to high-resolution images requires balancing perturbation granularity and computational cost. Fine-grained perturbations require many model evaluations, whereas coarse masks may overlook small but relevant evidence. We introduce Wavelet Find-and-Refine (WaFR), a model-agnostic attribution method combining adaptive hierarchical search with sparse multiscale regression. By selectively refining regions that influence the prediction, WaFR maintains fine-grained localisation with a computational cost that depends on the spatial distribution of the evidence. As image resolution increases to 8,192 pixels per side, WaFR maintains a Pointing Game score of at least .995 in controlled localisation experiments, including at matched forward-pass budgets. On gigapixel whole-slide images, it requires a median of 176 forward passes and achieves the highest mean patch-level AUROC among the evaluated perturbation-based methods (.949).

</details>


### [338] [Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30582)
*Simon Johannes Joham,Gianluca Guglielmo,Mateusz Kozinski,Martin Urschler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两个基于马氏距离的医学图像分割"静默失败"事后检测评分：一个用预测掩膜的影像组学形状特征，另一个用冻结DINOv3基础模型特征（掩膜叠加后做掩膜加权池化），均不需配准或访问模型内部，并揭示"全局排序"评测会奖励按站点难度排序而非检测单例失败，建议同时报告站点内评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署的医学分割模型在临床数据分布偏移时会静默出错，且很少附带质量控制；现有事后失败检测方法依赖额外回归/分割模型、配准或模型内部访问，配准本身也可能静默失败。

Method: 以标注参考集为基准计算马氏距离得到失败分数：(1) 基于预测掩膜的影像组学形状特征；(2) 基于冻结DINOv3特征，将掩膜叠加到图像上使特征"掩膜感知"，并采用掩膜区域加权池化patch特征。在多站点前列腺与海马MRI上，测试成像协议偏移与人群偏移两种情形；在每个站点内按预测失败风险排序评估，与基于配准的Atlas-RCA和基于集成的pairwise Dice比较。

Result: 站点内排序下，两个评分与两类基线具竞争力；同时发现将所有测试案例合并为单一排序（先前做法）会奖励"按站点难度排序"，使得检测器能在站点层面排序良好却漏检站内失败案例，仍显得性能很强。

Conclusion: 不需配准与模型内部信息的简单马氏距离失败分数可作为有效的事后QC基线；站点内评测才能反映真实的逐例失败检测能力，两种评测激励不同行为，建议同时报告。代码已开源。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [339] [DARE: Dual-Level Adversarial Learning with Domain-Aware Regularization for Whole Slide Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30589)
*Yuxuan Jiang,Haichuan Dong,Manning Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DARE，一种用于病理全切片图像(WSI)分类的即插即用无监督域适应框架，结合教师-学生自适应伪标签、patch级与slide级双层次对抗对齐，以及域感知注意力掩码正则化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同医院的扫描设备、染色协议与组织制备差异导致WSI存在显著域偏移，模型跨源迁移性能严重下降；现有自然图像UDA方法在高分辨率WSI上因切片间与切片内异质性强而不稳定，易发生负迁移。

Method: DARE框架：1) 教师-学生架构中引入自适应伪标签，为目标域提供稳定监督；2) 在patch级和slide级嵌入上同时进行对抗对齐，实现双层次语义表示的联合优化；3) 引入域感知注意力掩码，正则化注意力以提升跨域泛化；框架即插即用。

Result: 在四个公开WSI数据集上的大量实验表明，DARE在多种域偏移设定下持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 双层次对抗对齐与域感知正则化可有效缓解WSI域偏移与负迁移问题，为病理图像跨域分类提供通用UDA方案。

Abstract: Pathological whole slide images (WSIs) exhibit substantial domain shifts across hospitals due to variations in scanning devices, staining protocols, and tissue preparation procedures, leading to significant performance degradation when models are applied to data from different sources. Although unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has shown strong performance in transferring models from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain in natural images, it remains relatively underexplored in computational pathology. The ultra-high resolution of WSIs and their pronounced inter-slide and intra-slide heterogeneity pose unique challenges for domain adaptation, often rendering existing UDA methods unstable and susceptible to negative transfer. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization (DARE), a plug-and-play UDA framework for WSI classification. DARE incorporates adaptive pseudo-labeling within a teacher-student architecture to provide stable supervision for the target domain, alongside adversarial alignment of both patch-level and slide-level embeddings. Together, these components enable the joint optimization of semantic representations at both levels for cross-domain alignment. We further introduce domain-aware attention masking to regularize attention and improve cross-domain generalization. Extensive experiments on four public WSI datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various domain shifts.

</details>


### [340] [HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30592)
*Xiaoqi Wei,Li Li,Kejiang Chen,Hanzhou Wu,Xinpeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分层正交子空间擦除（HOSE），通过将参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间并结合U-Net分层自适应子空间，实现扩散模型中有害概念的精准擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生图扩散模型可能生成色情、暴力等敏感内容，带来安全隐患；现有模型编辑方法因概念表示纠缠而干扰非目标概念，且U-Net层次异构性使统一策略难以兼顾擦除效果与图像质量。

Method: 将参数更新投影至与通用知识正交的子空间以消除对非目标概念的干扰；针对U-Net各层表示差异，构建分层自适应的差异化正交子空间投影，缓解擦除与质量的固有权衡。

Result: 相比未编辑模型有害内容生成降低约80%；虽仍有图像质量下降，但在质量保持上优于其他编辑类基线，并在抑制效果与质量损失之间取得更优权衡；对抗鲁棒性优于现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 分层正交子空间约束是一种有效且较彻底的敏感概念擦除策略，代码已开源，但该工作面向扩散模型安全编辑，与具身智能/3D感知核心方向无直接关联。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [341] [Advancements in Diabetic Retinopathy Classification Using Novel Multi-Stacked U-Net Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30593)
*Ameya Uppina,S Navaneetha Krishnan,Talluri Krishna Sai Teja,Joe Dhanith P R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将UNET及其堆叠（Stacked）变体用于糖网（DR）五级分类，在多个公开数据集上比较不同堆叠层数的表现，得出三层堆叠效果最佳的“软结论”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 糖尿病患者基数庞大，DR筛查需求催生全自动计算机辅助诊断；但高质量标注数据稀缺、图像质量差异大、类别不平衡，使得可靠模型构建困难，作者希望评估UNET及其堆叠结构在不同数据集上的稳健性。

Method: 以UNET为基干，构建多级堆叠（stacked）UNET变体，调整堆叠层数（stack数量）作为主要消融变量，在多个眼底图像数据集上进行五分类（0=无DR，4=增殖期DR），比较不同堆栈深度下的分类性能。

Result: 多数据集实验显示，堆叠层数增加并非单调提升性能：在3个堆叠时性能最佳，继续增加堆叠会导致性能下降（作者自称“软结论”）。

Conclusion: UNET+堆叠结构在DR分级中堆叠深度存在最优值（约3层），过深会造成退化；但实验规模有限，结论偏经验性，缺乏与主流DR专用方法及强基线（如EfficientNet集成、预训练迁移）的系统对比。

Abstract: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels' structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. Building a reliable model faces considerable challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality annotated datasets and issues with varying image quality and class imbalances. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture's performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. The model aims at classifying the images into five categories, 0 to 4, where 0 is no DR, and 4 is proliferative DR.

</details>


### [342] [ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30597)
*Yuxi Wang,Yufei Liu,Chengkai Jin,Qingyue Chen,Wenqi Ouyang,Tianyi Wei,Kerui Ren,Siyuan Huang,Zhiqi Shen,Hongsheng Li,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViDiHand2将基于VDM的手部度量深度估计从直接回归重构为几何约束求解（Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting + Clip-Level Ray Fitting），并配合Confidence-Gated Fusion提升遮挡鲁棒性，在7个数据集上超越18个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自我中心人类视频学习机器人操作需要准确的度量3D手部运动；现有利用预训练视频扩散模型直接从全帧视频恢复被遮挡手部的方法依赖基于外观的深度回归，对未见相机泛化差。

Method: 1) Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting：利用像素对齐2D关节与MANO手部度量结构之间的几何一致性求解度量深度；2) Clip-Level Ray Fitting：跨片段时间观测进行射线拟合；3) Confidence-Gated Fusion：按定位置信度自适应融合几何提升关节与MANO预测，应对遮挡与图像截断；4) 增强VDM骨干以捕捉时空表征，输出每帧2D关节与MANO预测。

Result: 在7个公开数据集上稳定优于18个基线：野外场景绝对关节误差降低42%，检测失败减少8.82倍，运行速度57 FPS。

Conclusion: 以几何约束求解替代外观深度回归可显著提升跨相机泛化与遮挡鲁棒性，为ego-centric人类视频到机器人操作的度量手部运动重建提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [343] [GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30602)
*Zeyu Ding,Jiaqi Zhao,Yong Zhou,Wen-liang Du,Hancheng Zhu,Rui Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSDet 将旋转目标检测建模为 3D 高斯泼溅：在图像特征构建的 3D 特征空间中以 3D 高斯表示目标，投影为 2D 高斯并转换为定向框，通过含 3D 高斯采样的解码器优化均值、各向异性协方差与置信度，并支持推理时动态高斯数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有旋转检测器依赖预定义候选（CNN 的 anchor、Transformer 的 query），难以有效捕捉空间信息，作者希望以显式 3D 高斯表示替代固定候选，提升定向目标的空间建模能力。

Method: 把定向目标检测表述为高斯泼溅：由图像特征构造 3D 特征空间，随机初始化 3D 高斯（均值、各向异性协方差、置信度）；3D 高斯投影到图像平面得到 2D 高斯，再解析转换为定向框；使用带 3D 高斯采样的解码器进行优化；推理阶段可自适应控制并动态改变高斯数量。

Result: 在 DIOR-R、DOTA-v1.0、DOTA-v1.5 三个数据集上，在自适应控制设置下 AP50 分别提升 0.7%、0.3%、0.55%，优于主流检测器。

Conclusion: 高斯泼溅可作为旋转检测的候选表示范式，兼顾空间建模与推理灵活性；但增益幅度较小、主要在遥感基准验证，尚属检测器结构改动的增量工作。

Abstract: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.

</details>


### [344] [Towards an Armenian Epigraphic Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30603)
*Chahan Vidal-Gor{è}ne,Arpine Avetisyan,Edita Matevosyan,Seda Kirakosyan,Victoria Khurshudyan,Pollet Samvelian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发布Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum，用版面检测、OCR与视觉语言模型将十卷亚美尼亚铭文印刷集数字化为开放语料，并由专家在校对平台复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亚美尼亚铭文长期缺乏类似希腊语、拉丁语、格鲁吉亚语的数字资源，且部分铭文实物已损毁，仅存于纸质卷册中，亟需数字化保存与结构化。

Method: 流水线式文档理解：版面检测定位每条铭文记录，OCR识别字符，视觉语言模型生成结构化初读，再由专家在在线校对平台逐条核验修正；面向古典与中古亚美尼亚语提供"银标"数据。

Result: 首批校订显示字母识别可靠，残余错误集中于编辑符号（editorial signs）；语料覆盖近7,600条记录、10卷内容。

Conclusion: 构建了可持续的亚美尼亚铭文数字语料平台，兼具文献保存与语言模型/计算语言学训练数据价值，属人文学科数字化的实用工具与资源型工作。

Abstract: The Divan hay vimagrut'yan (1960-2017), the printed corpus of Armenian inscriptions, comprises nearly 7,600 records; a growing number of the inscriptions they describe, damaged or destroyed in recent decades, survive only in its pages. Armenian epigraphy nevertheless lacks a digital resource of the kind available for Greek, Latin or Georgian. This paper presents the Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum, which turns the ten volumes of the Divan into an open digital corpus. Layout detection, OCR and a vision-language model produce a first structured reading of each record, which specialists then check on a proofreading platform. First corrections show that letters are read reliably and that residual errors concentrate in the editorial signs. The corpus is designed as a lasting platform for documenting Armenian inscriptions and as a source of silver data in Classical and Middle Armenian for language models and computational linguistics.

</details>


### [345] [Tri-DNO: Trilateral Diffusion Noise Optimization for 3D Human Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30607)
*Paul Hinzer,Niklas Gard,Anna Hilsmann,Peter Eisert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tri-DNO：不改动、不重训预训练多模态HOI扩散模型，仅迭代优化扩散初始噪声，提升手-物接触质量、抑制穿透并保持手部位置合理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D人-物交互（HOI）生成对AR/VR与角色动画重要，但手部抓握的几何不一致（接触不足、穿透）会严重破坏真实感；扩散模型虽能合成HOI，物理合理的手-物接触仍难保证。

Method: 提出Tri-DNO扩散噪声优化策略：在预训练的多模态HOI扩散模型上采样，通过对初始噪声进行迭代优化（推理期优化），以促成稳固的手-物接触、减少穿透并保持手部位置真实，无需修改或重训生成模型。

Result: 在GRAB数据集上，相比基线提升了抓握质量；且无需额外模型训练，计算开销相对现有方法不增加；并展示了在媒体制作场景中的适用性。

Conclusion: 推理期噪声优化是一种低成本、即插即用的方式，可在不重训生成器的前提下显著改善HOI生成中的手-物接触物理合理性，具备实际生产应用潜力。

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D human object interactions (HOI) is essential for applications, such as augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR) or character animation of interactive entertainment. A particular challenge lies in the faithful generation of hand grasps in human object interaction scenes, where even minor geometric inconsistencies, such as insufficient contact or interpenetration, can significantly compromise realism. While diffusion-based generative models have shown promising results in HOI synthesis, ensuring physically plausible hand-object interactions remains challenging. We present Tri-DNO, a diffusion noise optimization strategy to sample from a pretrained multimodal HOI diffusion model, improving hand-object contact. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.

</details>


### [346] [CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30613)
*Junyan Lin,Jianqi Ma,Shujie Duan,Hanxin Zhu,Zhihao Hu,Jinming Liu,Shuai Li,Jun Zhang,Xin Jin,Chang Wen Chen,Weidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CineAct：状态优先的智能体式长视频生成框架，用 LLM 推理+冻结图像/视频生成器作为渲染器，实现目标驱动的可交互、跨片段一致的长视频合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放视频生成器单次仅生成数秒片段；延长序列的方法要么依赖预设脚本的智能体系统，要么从上一片段末帧自回归续接，导致屏幕外状态丢失、跨轮幻觉累积，用户无法指定显式目标并让其选择在后续片段中持续生效。

Method: 提出"目标落地交互式视频生成"任务：同一目标允许多种可行路径，用户所选路径须在画面中执行且后果跨片段保持。CineAct 采用状态优先智能体框架：语言模型智能体负责推理，冻结的图像/视频生成器仅作渲染器。交互前 Architect 初始化世界（相机空间布局、资产库、场景图）；每轮推理计划状态变化，用图像生成器产出目标末帧并严格校验，再用 FL2V 模型合成中间运动。

Result: 构建多空间基准（长程分步执行、开放意图分支可行性两套）。相比纯像素基线，显式世界状态建模将多步 rollout 一致性提升 +11.4（自动指标）、+23.1（人工评分），共享目标下的配对分支成功率提升 +30.8 点。

Conclusion: 显式世界状态建模是提升长程交互式视频生成一致性、可控性与分支可行性的关键，为智能体驱动的生成式世界模型提供了可验证范式。

Abstract: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

</details>


### [347] [Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30617)
*Qigong Lei,Qingsong Wang,Wang Lin,Qianyi Yang,Chang Yao,Jingyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AuxCA强化学习框架，通过量化辅助线索依赖（ACD）并将其融入GRPO的细粒度优势加权，使多模态大模型无需显式生成图即可学会可迁移的辅助作图策略，用于几何题求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何问题求解常需图中不存在的辅助构造，而显式绘图方法存在图像生成不稳定与级联误差问题；现有隐式注意力机制仅关注可见元素，难以支撑需要新增构造的推理。

Method: 基于GRPO的强化学习框架：(1) 引入Auxiliary Clues Dependency（ACD），度量辅助视觉线索对token生成的影响，并以细粒度优势加权形式注入GRPO；(2) 增加辅助激励奖励（auxiliary incentive reward），鼓励在正确解中有效利用辅助几何线索；推理阶段不生成显式图。

Result: AuxCA-8B在依赖辅助线的平面几何题上超过显式作图基线Bagel-Canvas，并与领先闭源模型相当；在解析几何、立体几何及外部基准上的提升表明所学策略可跨域迁移。

Conclusion: 将辅助线索依赖信号内化为RL优势加权，可替代显式绘图实现稳定且可迁移的辅助构造推理，为MLLM几何推理提供新范式。

Abstract: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Improvements on analytic geometry, solid geometry, and external benchmarks further suggest that the learned strategies can transfer beyond the training domain. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [348] [Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30641)
*Yingtao Li,Chaoran Feng,Haoran Jiang,Zhenyu Tang,Wangbo Yu,Zhankuo Xu,Jianbin Zhao,Li Yuan,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV
