TL;DR: EvGaze 用楔形棱镜旋转在镜头前引入可控图像运动，并以仿蝇眼控制的多模态学习控制器（亮度+事件+惯性，含快速惯性前馈通路）自适应调节转速，结合编码器角度逐事件补偿几何一致性，从而在更少事件下恢复更多边缘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机只响应亮度变化，边缘可见性依赖垂直于边缘的图像运动；静止或慢速场景下事件稀疏。固定转速的棱镜光学激励在自然运动已充分时会产生冗余事件并引入对齐误差，因此需要自适应调节。

Method: 楔形棱镜旋转式光学激励 + 学习型多模态控制器（融合亮度、事件、IMU 观测），快速惯性通路在视觉更新间细化转速决策；用实测编码器角度在每个事件时间戳上补偿棱镜引起的图像运动以保持几何一致性；闭环在线调速。

Result: EvMotion 上比全速旋转恢复更多边缘且事件数减少 39%；DSEC（模拟光学调制）特征跟踪成功率 0.73（原生事件 0.55、180 RPM 0.67），事件数比 360 RPM 少 26%；真机实验实现在线闭环自适应，平均事件率较全速旋转降低 17%。

Conclusion: 自适应光学激励可有效提升事件相机在低纹理/慢运动场景下的可用性，兼顾事件效率与几何一致性，具备实机闭环部署能力。

Abstract: Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it---a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Rotating a wedge prism in front of the lens introduces controlled image motion to reveal static or slow edges. However, a fixed rotation speed cannot adapt to changing motion conditions: when natural motion is already sufficient, additional optical excitation generates redundant events and introduces unnecessary alignment errors. Inspired by the division of labor between fast haltere feedforward and slower visual feedback in fly gaze control, we present EvGaze, an event camera system that adaptively regulates prism rotation speed. EvGaze employs a learned multimodal controller that integrates luminance, event, and inertial observations, with a fast inertial pathway that refines speed decisions between visual updates. To preserve geometric consistency during speed changes, we compensate for prism-induced image motion at individual event timestamps using measured encoder angles. On EvMotion, EvGaze recovers more edges than full-speed prism rotation with 39% fewer events. On DSEC with simulated optical modulation, it reaches 0.73 feature-tracking success (compared with 0.55 on native events and 0.67 at 180 RPM) while generating 26% fewer events than 360 RPM. Real-device experiments further demonstrate online closed-loop adaptation, reducing average event rates by 17% relative to full-speed rotation.

</details>


### [349] [Beyond Naming Accuracy: Template Composition and Species-Name Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30642)
*Junle li,Bochang zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文在固定模板数量（4个）与候选物种不变的条件下，对80模板库与24个经审校的摄影模板库的所有四模板子集进行系统比较，并对5,487帧新iWildCam数据做同时置信区间推断，发现BioCLIP2与BioCLIP 2.5 Huge谁更"一致"取决于具体句式而非模板数量或名词混用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有比较显示BioCLIP 2.5 Huge在四种摄影模板下比BioCLIP2更少改变预测物种，但在80模板池中排序反转；无法判断反转源于模板数量还是模板措辞，因此需要控制变量的系统性分析。

Method: 固定模板数为4、图像与候选名称不变，在80模板库和24个经审校摄影模板库的全部四模板子集上比较两分类器；再用未使用过的iWildCam 5,487帧做外部验证，并对含两"photo"两"photograph"模板的4,356个子集计算同时95%置信区间。

Result: 在审校模板池整体上Huge更一致，但四模板子集中有19.09%（iWildCam）与5.10%（Rare Species）支持BioCLIP2；外部验证中1,526个子集同时区间支持Huge不一致度更低，43个支持BioCLIP2。

Conclusion: 即使模板数量与名词构成完全相同，具体句子的选择也能决定哪个分类器显得更一致；提示模板评估的结论高度依赖措辞，需以子集级分布而非单点比较报告。

Abstract: Vision-language classifiers identify species by matching images to text prompts containing species names. BioCLIP2 changes its predicted species less often than BioCLIP 2.5 Huge across four photographic templates, but the ranking reverses across a bank of 80 templates. This comparison leaves open whether the reversal depends on the number of templates or their wording. We hold the count at four and compare the classifiers on every four-template subset of the 80-template bank and of a second pool of 24 reviewed photographic templates, keeping images and candidate names fixed. Huge is more consistent across the reviewed pool as a whole, yet 19.09% of its four-template subsets favor Bio-CLIP2 on iWildCam and 5.10% do so on Rare Species. We then test whether both rankings hold on 5,487 frames from previously unused iWildCam sequences. Among 4,356 subsets containing two photo and two photograph templates, simultaneous 95% intervals support lower disagreement for Huge in 1,526 subsets and for BioCLIP2 in 43. Even with the same prompt count and noun mixture, the choice of sentences can determine which classifier appears more consistent.

</details>


### [350] [Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30646)
*Orion Desbonnet,Kei Higuchi,Alex Sykes,Ayush Deshmukh,Victor Leve,Joao Moura,Sethu Vijayakumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于被动双目立体视觉的铰接物体分部件状态估计与几何认证方法，无需深度、近初值或掩码，精度媲美最优模型拟合，认证结果可用于无标注视频自标注以提升仿真到现实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 制造场景中薄壁铰接物体（如折叠纸盒）在任务中变形，需实时估计铰接状态、位姿与半变形部件形状。学习型估计器泛化好但薄结构精度差；模型拟合精确但依赖准确深度、近初值和干净掩码。

Method: 在双目图像中检测CAD模型定义的角点，将铰接模型拟合到检测角点；把刚体的几何认证扩展到铰接物体，按部件输出可信度证书（可判别被遮挡部件的拟合是否为外推伪解）；利用认证后的无标注视频估计生成标签，用于改进sim-to-real迁移。

Result: 7个仿真物体中5个上，认证部件定位精度比最强学习基线（同等读数且提供深度与真值掩码）高3–5倍；真实折叠纸盒端板中位角点误差为纸盒尺寸的2.1%，比所有学习基线低至少40%，也优于以真值初始化的深度拟合。

Conclusion: 将几何认证引入铰接物体估计，实现了低成本双目下的高精度、可自我评估的状态估计，并可作为自标注工具缓解仿真到现实的标注瓶颈。

Abstract: Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer. On five of seven simulated objects, we locate the parts we certify three to five times more precisely than the strongest learned baseline on the same readings, given depth and true masks. On a real folding carton, our median corner error on the end panels is 2.1% of the carton's size, at least 40% lower than every learned baseline and also lower than a depth-based fit initialised near the true state.

</details>


### [351] [Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30666)
*Yu Zhang,Jingrui Li,Congyu Wang,Yuhang Cheng,Wenbo Chen,Xiaobo Zhang,Jing Zou,Yuxi Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Zhengrong-PoleWM 将直接视觉世界模型的潜变量轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应和对动作创新的延迟响应，用共享稳定共轭极点基决定时间演化，从而显式刻画动作因果与时序结构，在四个离线图像目标控制基准上达到 90.83% 成功率且 CEM 搜索延迟显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接（非自回归）视觉世界模型可一次性预测候选动作序列的后果，避免递归潜变量滚动，但未规定动作效应的时间结构：缺乏对时序演化、因果性、初始状态锚定与有界性的显式建模。

Method: 提出 Zhengrong-PoleWM：把潜变量轨迹参数化为"初始条件锚点 + 自由响应 + 对动作创新的延迟响应"之和；非线性网络将视觉历史与因果动作前缀映射为响应系数；由共享的稳定共轭极点库决定各响应随时间的演化；推导精确的重锚定恒等式，给出表示平移后轨迹尾部所需的额外基方向 Ψ_κ(s)。

Result: 四个离线图像目标控制基准（Cube、TwoRoom、PushT、Reacher）上，epoch 20 两训练种子宏平均成功率 90.83%±0.47%，超最强基线 QQWorld 6.08 个百分点；按验证损失选检查点达 91.21%±1.00%。首轮 Cube 受控实验中，神经与极点响应头分别比通用直接预测器高 20.67 和 23.34 个百分点。A100 上 30 次迭代 CEM 搜索中位延迟 74–87 ms（均值 77.5 ms），比 Fast-LeWM 低 15.8%，比自回归 LeWM 快 7.1 倍。

Conclusion: 以极点基显式解耦时间演化与动作条件的轨迹参数化，可同时获得因果一致、锚定精确、有界的直接世界模型预测与低延迟规划，但验证限于离线图像目标控制基准，缺少真机/高维视觉任务的泛化证据。

Abstract: Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $\Psi_\kappa(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

</details>


### [352] [DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30671)
*Dingyi Yao,Tingdong Yu,Guosheng Zhao,Chaojun Ni,Xiaofeng Wang,Jiming Mao,Guan Huang,Lihui Peng,Zheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveDreamer-RSI：以感知学习与数据构建闭环实现递归自我提升的可控驾驶数据生成框架，外环按感知缺口生成带标签视频并更新目标，内环用VLM智能体迭代编辑场景，跨轮提炼可复用的构建策略；nuScenes验证集以约一半合成帧超越数据回放基线4.09 mAP、4.13 NDS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可控生成可扩充驾驶感知训练数据，但视觉真实感并不等价于学习收益；有效生成需随感知模型演化，自适应决定“生成什么数据”与“如何构建数据”。

Method: 双层闭环框架：外环Gap-Guided Target Adaptation依据当前感知缺口生成带标注视频，训练后更新目标；内环用视觉-语言智能体通过观测与执行反馈迭代编辑场景；跨轮Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement从执行经验与下游学习结果中提炼可复用的数据构建建议。

Result: nuScenes验证集上，使用约一半合成帧即较数据回放基线提升4.09 mAP与4.13 NDS。

Conclusion: 数据生成应建模为与感知模型协同演化的闭环过程；以缺口驱动定位、智能体化场景编辑与学习反馈驱动的策略沉淀，可在更少合成数据下取得显著感知增益，具备作为通用自提升生成范式的潜力。

Abstract: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

</details>


### [353] [Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30673)
*Ankit Yadav,Nikhil Cherian Kurian,Arpit Garg,Lingqiao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Harness Search and Merge (HSM)，用 LLM 编排器在可执行评测程序空间上自动搜索并合并 VLM「harness」，用于生成视频中的细微错误定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 定位生成视频错误的效果高度依赖人工设计的调用流程（选帧、工具调用、预测融合），需自动化构建最优 harness。

Method: 将 harness 表示为可执行评测程序，LLM orchestrator 在随机训练子集上独立改进候选 harness，把发现写入 memory，并构造性地合并互补候选。

Result: Spotlight 上 0.234±0.012 F1，超过最强基线 0.173±0.016；在未见过的视频生成器上 0.213±0.008 vs 0.140±0.003；IPV-Bench 上定位性能强且误报率低于已有优化基线。

Conclusion: 对完整 VLM harness 的搜索优于现有评测策略，可迁移到未见生成器并降低真实视频误报。

Abstract: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

</details>


### [354] [Speculate in the Right Order: Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30704)
*Yihan Chen,Jintao Zhang,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Speculation-Aware Ordering (SAO)，将自推测解码中的"生成顺序"作为新优化维度，用条件TV统计离线构造有利于推测的随机顺序，提升自回归图像生成效率与质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自推测解码（同一模型并行起草、串行验证）的效率受随机顺序自回归建模中新增的"生成顺序"自由度影响，但现有工作只改起草/验证策略，未系统分析顺序的作用。

Method: 理论分析生成顺序对效率的两个因素：draft-target 失配（决定拒绝概率）与早拒绝代价（越早拒绝成本越高）；据此提出免训练框架 SAO，用简单的成对条件TV统计构造拒绝代价感知的目标，离线高效搜索/构造 speculation-friendly 生成顺序，无需实际运行昂贵的推测解码评估。

Result: 在多种骨干网络与不同推测宽度下实验表明 SAO 提升解码效率，并附带生成质量提升；与现有自推测解码方法组合时可获得互补的加速收益。

Conclusion: 首次将生成顺序识别为自回归图像生成中高效自推测解码的新优化维度，SAO 免训练、可即插即用地与现有方法叠加。

Abstract: Self-speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive image generation by leveraging the same model for parallel drafting and sequential verification, without requiring an additional draft model. While existing methods primarily focus on improving drafting and verification strategies, recent advances in random-order autoregressive modeling introduce an additional degree of freedom: the generation order. In this work, we theoretically analyze how generation order affects self-speculative decoding efficiency, identifying two key factors: draft-target mismatch, which determines token rejection probabilities, and early-rejection cost, which reflects the higher cost of rejecting tokens earlier in a speculative round. Motivated by these insights, we propose Speculation-Aware Ordering (SAO), a training-free framework for offline optimization of generation orders. Instead of evaluating candidate orders through costly speculative decoding, SAO uses simple pairwise conditional-TV statistics to formulate a rejection-cost-aware objective and efficiently construct speculation-friendly generation orders offline. Extensive experiments across different backbones and speculative widths demonstrate that SAO improves decoding efficiency, with the additional benefit of improved generation quality. Furthermore, SAO provides complementary efficiency gains when combined with existing self-speculative decoding methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to identify generation order as a new optimization dimension for efficient self-speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation.

</details>


### [355] [Intra-Class Diversity Loss for Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30707)
*Wei Zhou,BaXian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出类内多样性损失ICD：将表征分解为类权重方向分量与其正交分量，在正交子空间最大化同类样本差异，作为正则项与分类损失互补以提升ReID泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReID中训练与测试身份不重叠，且类内变化大，需学习泛化表征。现有损失函数主要追求类内紧凑与类间分离，忽略了类内差异中蕴含的有用信息。

Method: 基于表征与类权重向量的几何关系，把每个特征分解为沿类权重方向的分量及正交分量；ICD损失最大化同身份样本正交分量之间的差异，同时由分类损失保持身份判别性。该损失可作为附加正则项插入现有ReID框架，无需修改特征提取网络。

Result: 在三个常用ReID数据集上实验验证ICD的有效性，并证明其与现有度量学习损失具有互补性。

Conclusion: 从类权重正交子空间显式建模类内多样性，是一种可解释、即插即用的ReID正则化目标，可与分类与度量学习损失协同使用。

Abstract: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same pedestrian across different cameras. However, the non-overlapping identities between training and testing sets, together with large intra-class variation, make it challenging to learn generalizable pedestrian representations. Most existing ReID loss functions mainly focus on intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, which may overlook useful intra-class differences. To address these issues, we propose a novel Intra-Class Diversity (ICD) loss that aims to maximize intra-class differences in classification-irrelevant directions. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce this class-weight-orthogonal diversity learning objective for person ReID. Specifically, based on the geometric relationship between the learned representation and its corresponding class-weight vector, we decompose each representation into the component along the class-weight direction and its orthogonal component. This decomposition provides a clear and interpretable geometric basis for modeling intra-class diversity. ICD then encour- ages larger differences among the orthogonal components of samples belonging to the same identity, while the classification loss maintains identity discrimination. The proposed ICD loss can be incorporated into existing ReID frameworks as an additional regularization term without modifying the feature extraction network. Extensive experiments on three widely used ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ICD and its complementarity with existing metric learning losses.

</details>


### [356] [Co-speech Gesture Attribute Annotation with 3D Human Mesh Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30725)
*Frances Yung,Muhammad Naufilr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于人体网格恢复（SAM 3D Body）的两条自动手势属性标注路线：几何规则法与SL-GCN，用于标注10种共语手势属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共语手势在视频中的物理属性标注成本高、人工密集，需要可扩展的自动化方案。

Method: 用SAM 3D Body从单帧估计完整3D人体骨架，再以两种方式映射到手势属性：(1) AI辅助的几何规则；(2) 图卷积网络SL-GCN。在GESRes数据集2020个手势上评估。

Result: 对于高度、手臂旋转角、运动速度等物理定义清晰的属性，两法与专家标注的一致性接近人工标注者之间的一致性；对需要高层多模态语境推理的属性，性能明显偏低。

Conclusion: 规则法所需标注数据少、完全透明、可适配不同标注体系，是数据驱动方法实用且可解释的补充。

Abstract: Co-speech gestures convey meaning alongside speech, but annotating their physical attributes in video is labour-intensive. We propose two approaches to automate annotation of ten gesture attributes using human mesh recovery (HMR), which estimates a full 3D body skeleton from a single video frame: AI-assisted geometrical rules and a graph convolutional network (SL-GCN). Both use pose estimates from SAM 3D Body, evaluated on 2,020 gestures from the GESRes dataset. For physically defined attributes such as height, arm swivel and movement speed, both methods achieve agreement with expert annotation comparable to that between human annotators. For attributes whose annotation requires higher-level multimodal contextual inference, performance remains lower. The rule-based approach requires substantially less annotated data, is fully transparent, and can be adapted to different annotation schemes, offering a practical and interpretable complement to data-driven methods

</details>


### [357] [Same Seed, Different Picture? Deciding Early at Low Resolution for Seed-Faithful Few-Step Flow Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30728)
*Huiran Duan,Weilun Feng,Yuqi Li,Yingli Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的少步扩散采样器 Decide-then-Render (DtR)：用同一初始噪声的低分辨率部分先"决定"构图，再用种子自身噪声重建全分辨率状态并渲染细节，从而在4个大模型上较参考50步采样器提速11–25×且显著提升种子保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步采样器虽快，但从同一噪声出发所生成的图像与标准50步采样器结果在主体、属性、布局层面不一致（种子保真度丢失），而非仅细节差异。作者将此归因于采样初期：当噪声水平仍高于0.9时，初始噪声的低频（粗）分量已决定粗结构，而少步采样器在最初几步内就跨越了这一区间，该区间占其到50步参考距离的25–52%。

Method: 免训练采样器 DtR（Decide-then-Render）：先在低分辨率下、用同一初始噪声的粗分量执行少量步骤以确定构图；随后借助种子自身的噪声重建全分辨率隐状态；最后完成全分辨率的细节渲染阶段。核心观察是可利用"决策粗糙性"——半分辨率运行可做出几乎相同的决策而仅需约三分之一计算。

Result: 在4个大型文生图模型上，DtR 比参考采样器快 11–25×；在各加速比下均比所有对比方法（含按预算标定的少步调度、已发表的多分辨率采样器）更接近50步参考且 ImageReward 更高。在 FLUX.1-dev 上，降至约 8× 加速时仍是最忠实的采样器，优于缓存类加速器；用户研究中86%的成对比较认为其样本更接近参考。方法还可迁移到留出模型与视频生成，蒸馏模型可作为其渲染器。

Conclusion: 少步采样的"种子不一致"根源于采样起点的低频结构决策；通过低分辨率决策 + 全分辨率渲染的两阶段免训练设计，可在大幅加速的同时保持与参考采样器的高度一致，具备跨模型、跨模态的通用性，并为高效生成（含视频生成、蒸馏模型复用）提供可插拔的加速组件。

Abstract: Few-step samplers make large text-to-image flow models fast, but from the same noise they no longer generate the image of the standard 50-step sampler. Subjects, attributes and layout change, not just fine detail. We trace this loss of seed fidelity to the start of sampling. The coarse part of the initial noise decides coarse structure first, while the noise level is still above 0.9. Few-step samplers cross this range in their first steps, which account for 25-52% of their distance to the 50-step reference. Because this decision is coarse, a half-resolution run from the same coarse noise can make nearly the same decision at a third of the cost. We therefore propose Decide-then-Render (DtR), a training-free sampler that decides the composition in a few low-resolution steps, rebuilds the full-resolution state with the seed's own noise and renders the details. On 4 large models, DtR runs 11-25$\times$ faster than the reference sampler. At each speed-up, it is closer to the reference and rated higher by ImageReward than every compared sampler, including few-step schedules calibrated per budget and published multi-resolution samplers. On FLUX.1-dev, it remains the most faithful sampler down to about $8\times$, ahead of caching accelerators. A user study on this model found DtR's samples closer to the reference in 86% of pairwise trials. DtR transfers to a held-out model and to video, and distilled models can serve as its renderers. Project link: this https URL

</details>


### [358] [EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30734)
*Yuan Gao,Dongchen Wei,Xinyang Lin,Shuhua Cao,Xueliang Guo,Zhuohan Li,Yihao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoDepth-Bench 是一个大规模第一人称操作深度数据集/基准，含 941,233 个同步样本、37 个物理环境、6 路标定 RGB 视角加上鱼眼原生视角的度量深度，由 5 个主动红外立体模块重建，球杆仪验证达到毫米级几何精度（中位误差 1.27 mm），并提供环境留出划分；微调 MapAnything 后，在未见环境中度量 AbsRel 从 0.708 降到 0.091，尺度对齐 AbsRel 从 0.327 降到 0.072。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称操作场景缺乏大规模、几何精度可验证的度量深度监督与评测基准，现有基准难以评估对未见环境的泛化，也难以同时衡量深度精度与预测覆盖率（尤其是手部与物体区域）。

Method: 构建 EgoDepth-Bench：37 个真实环境、941,233 个同步样本，每样本含 6 路标定 RGB 与鱼眼原生视角的度量深度；深度由 5 个主动红外立体模块重建；用标定球杆仪做几何精度验证；提供环境留出的数据划分；在单目、双目、多视角模型上评测深度精度与预测覆盖率（含手部/物体）；并以该数据微调 MapAnything。

Result: 球杆仪验证中位误差 1.27 mm，达到毫米级几何精度；微调 MapAnything 在未见环境上把度量 AbsRel 从 0.708 降至 0.091，尺度对齐 AbsRel 从 0.327 降至 0.072。

Conclusion: EgoDepth-Bench 提供了有效监督与严谨评测手段，可用于第一人称操作中的度量与相对深度估计；项目页开放评测代码与交互式 RGB-深度序列。

Abstract: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

</details>


### [359] [Learning Dense Head-Object Contact Estimation with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30751)
*Daniel Sungho Jung,Kyoung Mu Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HECO：用合成数据做稠密头部-物体接触估计，融合文本语义上下文处理多样化交互、用amodal inpainting实现遮挡感知学习克服头发遮挡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 头部在认知感知中关键且易受外部冲击，稠密头部-物体接触估计对安全至关重要，但缺乏真实接触数据；合成数据在数据稀缺场景已被验证有效，因此希望以合成数据驱动该任务。

Method: 构建合成头部-物体接触数据集；两个核心设计：(1) 引入文本特征的语义上下文，编码头部区域与交互物体的语义关系以应对交互多样性；(2) 遮挡感知接触学习，通过amodal inpaint从图像可见信息外推被头发遮挡的接触区域。

Result: 摘要未给出定量指标；作者声称HECO在合成数据集训练后可完成头部-物体接触估计，绕开真实接触数据缺失问题，代码将开源。

Conclusion: 合成数据+语义上下文+遮挡感知amodal学习是解决稠密头部接触估计的可行路径，但缺少真实场景定量验证与实物演示证据。

Abstract: Head serves a critical role in human cognitive and perceptual functions while remaining vulnerable to external impacts, making the understanding of head contact essential for human safety. Despite its importance, dense head-object contact estimation remains largely unexplored, primarily due to the absence of head-object contact data. Recently, it has been shown that synthetic data can serve as powerful training data in limited data scenario, implying the potential of synthetic data in head-object contact estimation. There are two core challenges for dense head-object contact estimation. First, head-object interactions are highly diverse, resulting in substantial variations in contact regions and patterns across different objects and interaction types. Second, head contact regions are often heavily occluded by hair, making direct visual observation of the actual contact regions difficult. To address these issues, we introduce HEad COntact estimation (HECO) with synthetic data. To handle diverse head-object interactions, we leverage semantic context from text features that encode semantic relationships between head regions and interacting objects. To resolve hair occlusion issue of actual head contact regions, we introduce occlusion-aware contact learning that learns to infer head contact beyond visible information from images via amodal inpainting. As a result, we enable head-object contact estimation with HECO trained with our synthetic dataset, overcoming the issue of absence of contact data. The codes will be released.

</details>


### [360] [Screening for nonrigidity in structure from motion using projected reprojection residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30769)
*Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于稀疏SfM重投影误差"空间-时间排列模式"的诊断方法，用于在静态场景假设下检测可疑形变；四组合成管状数据集上8/8运动采集全部检出，明显优于仅用误差幅度的5-6个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏SfM假设场景静态，但形变仍可能得到看似合理（低重投影误差）的重建；现有重投影误差汇总统计（幅值）丢弃了误差在点与视图之间的分布结构，无法区分"正常的几何拟合残差/相机漂移"与"由形变引起的结构化不一致"。

Method: 诊断分两步：1) 先回归去除可由小幅点、相机参数调整以及随时间变化的简单空间趋势解释的残差成分；2) 度量剩余残差与固定空间模式和时间模式的对齐程度。仅使用单一已估计的SfM重建（相机、3D点、图像观测），不求解物理形变参数，定量给出筛查性证据而非形变估计。在四组合成管状族上评估，并以"其他三族最高静态得分"作为每族阈值；再将同一阈值迁移到20个重建变体（外观与流程变化）。

Result: 8个真实运动采集全部被检出（对比误差幅度类汇总仅5-6个）；各族的阈值取其他三族静态最高分，因而静态采集最高分也会被判阳性（存在阈值偏差）；同阈值迁移到20个变体中19个仍保持阳性检出，1个为数值弃权；四族在开发期已知，迁移变体复用了其中两族。

Conclusion: 重投影误差在点-视图间的排列结构携带了幅值统计所遗漏的不一致信息；该方法作为一种轻量筛查工具，可直接在现有SfM输出上标记出"看似合理但可疑"的重建以供进一步检查。局限在于仅在合成管状数据上验证、族先验已知、阈值由同一批数据确定，未在真实形变场景或在线SLAM中验证。

Abstract: Sparse structure from motion (SfM) assumes a static scene, yet deformation may still yield plausible reconstructions. Reprojection-error summaries discard how errors are arranged across points and views. We propose a diagnostic that first removes residual components explainable by small point and camera adjustments and simple spatial trends that change over time. It then measures alignment with fixed spatial and temporal patterns. The diagnostic uses one estimated SfM reconstruction and provides screening evidence rather than a physical deformation estimate. Across four synthetic tubular families, the diagnostic detected all eight acquisitions with prescribed motion, compared with five or six for summaries of reprojection-error magnitude. Each family's cutoff was the highest static score among the other three families, so the static acquisition with the highest score also screened positive. With the same cutoffs, the diagnostic retained positive detections in 19 of 20 reconstruction variants spanning changes in appearance and reconstruction pipeline, with one numerical abstention. These findings show that the arrangement of reprojection errors across points and views can reveal inconsistencies that their magnitudes alone miss. The four families were known during development, and the transfer variants reused two of them. Within this setting, the diagnostic offers a practical way to flag a plausible reconstruction for closer inspection using only its estimated cameras, 3D points and image observations.

</details>


### [361] [GRAIN: Shared-Budget Complementary Re-observation for Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30770)
*Chengxuan Zhou,Shaoyang Zhang,Rui Qian,Juntao Cheng,Feng Liu,Wanru Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRAIN：跨图像统一的裁剪调用预算分配 + 有界输出准入，用分辨率闭包增益排序候选裁剪，在17个冻结检测器上以更少裁剪调用超越call-matched tiling。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重跑冻结检测器于放大裁剪可恢复小/密集目标但每裁剪需额外推理调用；现有slicing/自适应裁剪流程逐图孤立规划，忽视集合级别检测需求差异，导致调用预算分配次优。

Method: 定义跨图可比较的分辨率闭包增益（基于边界安全裁剪内部正区域）；粗假设携带分辨率亏空，裁剪为内部包含的假设闭合几何比例亏空，乘性残差在单调子模代理中折减已覆盖证据；用前缀和+全局最大堆在CPU上于裁剪推理前执行集合级规划；推理后采用Positive-Region Fusion对齐空间准入以匹配规划的内部支撑，再做类别平衡top-k选择。

Result: 在COCO、CrowdHuman、VisDrone-DET上17个冻结检测器（5个家族）中，102个AP@100设置里100个优于call-matched tiling，并迁移至AI-TOD-v2；RF-DETR-S在CrowdHuman上用1/8裁剪调用接近两裁剪tiling；代理排序与精确最优的Spearman相关0.95–0.99，扫描解达精确最优≥98%。

Conclusion: 跨图全局调用分配与实际增益代理可显著提升免训练小目标检测效率；该框架为集合级推理预算调度提供可解释、CPU可执行的高效方案。

Abstract: Re-running a frozen detector on enlarged image crops recovers small and crowded objects without retraining, yet every crop costs an extra detector call. Existing slicing and adaptive-cropping pipelines plan crops per image in isolation, even though inspection demand varies widely across an image collection. We present GRAIN, which unifies cross-image call allocation and bounded-output admission around cross-image comparable resolution-closure gains over boundary-safe crop interiors. Coarse hypotheses carry resolution deficits, crops close a geometric share of those deficits for hypotheses enclosed in their interior positive region, and multiplicative residuals discount covered evidence within a monotone submodular surrogate. Prefix sums and a global max-heap execute this collection-wide plan on CPU before crop inference, and Positive-Region Fusion aligns post-inference spatial admission with the planned interior support before class-balanced top- selection. Across 17 frozen detectors from five families on COCO, CrowdHuman, and VisDrone-DET, GRAIN beats call-matched tiling in 100 of 102 AP@100 settings and transfers to AI-TOD-v2. With RF-DETR-S on CrowdHuman, it nearly matches two-crop tiling using one eighth of the crop calls. At fixed budgets, the surrogate orders candidate plans with Spearman correlations of 0.95 to 0.99 while the sweep attains at least 98% of the exact surrogate optimum. Code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [362] [Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30775)
*Viraj Patel,Deblina Bhattacharjee,Katharine Fraser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出plane-aware神经场框架，用每平面投影从稀疏平面2D测量中学习连续3D+t心血管速度场，并考察物理约束的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D Flow MRI等平面测量只能获得体积内小范围平面的面内两速度分量，重建完整3D+t血流困难；需评估神经场与物理约束在此高度欠定问题中的可行性。

Method: 基于空间-时间坐标输入的隐式神经场，通过per-plane投影算子把3D速度场投到观测平面形成监督；对比plain MLP、RBF插值、以及物理约束SIREN（PC-SIREN），在合成主动脉/动脉瘤数据及真实4D Flow MRI重采样平面上评估，并做扫描配置、扫描数量、空间分辨率消融。

Result: 主动脉：PC-SIREN rRMSE 0.3756 优于MLP 0.4273与RBF 0.7256，且在MRI各解剖段最优；动脉瘤：plain MLP最优 rRMSE 0.07–0.16，PC-SIREN为0.55–0.71。

Conclusion: 连续神经场可从稀疏平面测量重建体血流；但物理约束收益依赖流动特性（与流场匹配），并非普适增益。

Abstract: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

</details>


### [363] [AvatarAnyone: Agentic Reconstruction of Mesh-Based Layered Avatars from YouTube Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30777)
*Aymen Mir,Peter Wonka,Stefanos Zafeiriou,Rıza Alp Güler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AvatarAnyone 用 AI agent 为每个 YouTube 视频中的人规划定制化分层网格化身重建流程，自动预测服装类别与层次并安排优化阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外人像视频中服装类别、类型、层叠方式差异巨大，单一固定分层重建管线无法适用；现有化身多为融合单表面或高斯集合，无法进行换装与布料仿真。

Method: AI agent 预测每人的服装类别、服装类型与层叠顺序，据此选择初始化并分阶段组织优化，输出以身体网格为底、每件衣物/鞋作为独立层的分层网格化身。

Result: 在约150个YouTube视频上验证；四个数据集上优于现有基于网格的可动画单目重建方法；化身可直接导入Blender、Unreal Engine与MuJoCo，支持换装渲染、标准布料仿真与接触建模。

Conclusion: agent 驱动的流程规划使分层网格化身在野外人像视频上可泛化，并带来换装、布料仿真与机器人仿真器直接可用等下游能力。

Abstract: We introduce AvatarAnyone, a method for reconstructing avatars from casual YouTube videos as layered meshes, with each garment and footwear as a separate mesh layered on top of the body mesh. In such videos, people differ in garment classes, clothing types, and layers, and each combination needs a different reconstruction. A single fixed layered reconstruction pipeline therefore fails. AvatarAnyone solves this problem with AI agents that plan a custom optimization for each person's reconstruction. The agents predict the garment classes, the clothing type, and the layering. They use these predictions to choose an initialization and stage the optimization. Because the avatars are layered meshes, they support applications such as virtual try-on and cloth simulation. We change the clothing layers of an avatar and render it in different garments and poses. We can also simulate a clothing layer as cloth over the animated body with a standard cloth simulator. Most existing avatars are one fused surface or a set of Gaussians and cannot do this. We load the avatars directly into Blender, Unreal Engine, and robotics simulators such as MuJoCo. As the avatars are meshes, they support contact modeling with other objects. We show results from around 150 YouTube videos. On four datasets, AvatarAnyone outperforms existing mesh-based methods for animatable monocular reconstruction. Our project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [364] [BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30787)
*Jianfei Jiang,Haochen Yu,Qiankun Liu,Rui Yang,Hongyuan Liu,Xianglong Meng,Jiansheng Chen,Huimin Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BridgeMVS：级联多阶段MVS统一框架，用双向动态融合(BDF)在每一阶段实现单目深度特征与多视图代价体的互更新，并以相对尺度MDE与度量尺度MVS的逐阶段监督实现互增强，在DTU/T&T/ETH3D达到SOTA并提升MDE精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MVS依赖显式几何可获得度量深度，但在弱纹理/重复纹理等特征匹配不可靠区域失效；MDE提供稳健结构先验但尺度模糊。现有混合方法多是单目→MVS的单向利用，未充分挖掘MDE与MVS的相互增强。

Method: 级联多阶段MVS框架，每阶段采用Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion：mono-to-cost用单目结构特征引导代价体细化，cost-to-mono用多视图几何证据重标定单目表示以提升度量尺度一致性；融合表示由粗到细逐级传播，配合阶段式相对尺度MDE监督与度量尺度MVS监督。BDF为可插拔模块，可嵌入已有级联MVS框架。

Result: 在DTU、Tanks-and-Temples、ETH3D上取得SOTA，同时在T&T Intermediate与Advanced排行榜均列第一，并同步提升单目深度估计精度；开源代码。

Conclusion: 双向动态融合能有效桥接单目先验与多视图几何，实现两分支互增强，且具备工程可迁移性（plug-and-play），为稠密三维重建中单目-多视融合提供新范式。

Abstract: Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

</details>


### [365] [PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30796)
*Xueheng Li,Yu Wang,Yuxiang Shen,Wen Xue,Rui Li,Jie Zhang,Chengjun Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PestWeave：一种多模态害虫识别框架，用视觉原型把内容自适应的视觉组织（RWKV+语义token分组+三类辅助token）与文本融合连接起来，并以原型评估文本描述被图像支持的程度来调节融合强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 害虫外观多样，需结合文本物种知识进行多模态识别；但复杂背景会遮蔽判别性视觉线索，文本描述又可能包含当前图像不支持的信息，导致跨模态融合失效。

Method: 视觉分支在RWKV架构上引入语义token分组与三类辅助token（簇原型token、全局token、寄存器token）：相似特征token重排至相邻扫描位置以实现内容自适应扫描并保留空间结构，辅助token分别提供组级摘要、全局上下文和额外交互容量。这些原型进一步用于引导文本调制，评估各语义成分的视觉支持度并调节其相对贡献与整体融合强度，抑制无支撑描述的干扰。

Result: 在多个害虫识别数据集上，PestWeave 被证明有效，并展示出对实际害虫管理的潜力（摘要未给出具体数值增益）。

Conclusion: 该工作将内容自适应的视觉token组织与基于原型的文本调制统一到一个多模态框架中，缓解背景干扰与图文不一致问题；但属于农业领域专用视觉识别，缺少可迁移到机器人/3D/世界模型等核心方向的实证。

Abstract: Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture. Their diverse appearances complicate recognition and motivate multimodal approaches incorporating complementary species knowledge from text. However, complex backgrounds can obscure discriminative visual cues, while textual descriptions may contain information unsupported by the current image, limiting effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose PestWeave, a multimodal framework connecting content-adaptive visual organization with text fusion through visual prototypes. Its visual pathway augments a Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture with semantic token grouping and three types of auxiliary tokens, enabling content-adaptive scanning and contextual modeling while preserving spatial structure. Feature-similar tokens are reordered into adjacent scanning positions, while cluster prototype, global, and register tokens provide group-level summaries, global context, and additional interaction capacity, respectively. These prototypes also guide text modulation by assessing visual support for semantic components and regulating their relative contributions and overall fusion strength, reducing interference from unsupported descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple pest recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of PestWeave and its potential for practical pest management.

</details>


### [366] [Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30802)
*Jiawei Jiang,Haonan Zhou,Wendi Hu,Jiabei Hu,Yina Xiang,Kaiyue Zhou,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ROAM-GS：免训练主动多房间3D重建，用持久目标+可变视野前缀替代贪婪NBV，配合表面重建记忆打分位姿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动重建在多房间场景失效：贪婪下一最佳视角（NBV）不为远距离房间的"通行"给予收益，且过度优化近处不可消除残差；稠密建图则需上千帧才能到达远处房间。

Method: 训练免费的主动多房间重建框架：每次决策选择一个持久目标及通向该目标的可变视野前缀，仅在终点采集视角；用表面重建记忆（Surface Reconstruction Memory）将更新后的缺陷与观察方向投影为位姿评分；持久目标以剩余价值为通行计分，当到达后不再带来可测改进时释放该目标；无需逐场景调参。

Result: HSSD平均覆盖率74%→93%；HM3D 47%→96%（+11.7 dB PSNR）；单房间Replica保真度不降；以少173×的视角数匹配90分钟稠密建图效果。

Conclusion: 以目标级规划替代短视NBV，可在极少视角预算下实现多房间完整几何与高保真渲染，且具备跨场景免调参的泛化性。

Abstract: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\times$ fewer views.

</details>


### [367] [Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30836)
*Cheng-Ru Chou,Shih-Yu Lai,Pei-Lin Chiang,Shou-Po Tsai,Jing-Zhe Huang,Fukuharu Tanaka,Hirozumi Yamaguchi,Bing-Yu Chen,Yu-Lun Liu,Hsun-Ping Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MakeSense: a multimodal fusion framework that keeps sensor-specific evidence in private streams, fuses via shared bottleneck tokens, and trains with paired full/subset views to penalize errors that grow with more sensors (negative fusion).


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Embodied vision systems must handle varying sensor availability, yet even subset-tolerant models exhibit "negative fusion"—adding a sensor increases error. The goal is to mitigate this redundancy-induced degradation and make each additional sensor reliably helpful.

Method: Private per-sensor streams preserve modality-specific evidence; a shared bottleneck token space handles cross-modal exchange. Training pairs full and degraded-subset views of the same observation, with a loss that penalizes higher error when more sensors are used. Geometry-permitting tasks use range-only readout for distance, while remaining predictions draw on all inputs. Plus lightweight adapters and per-dataset training.

Result: Paired tests on five datasets identify helpful vs. harmful sensor additions; reduced negative fusion on MM-Fi; with adapters, improved UAV localization (MMAUD), cooperative 3D detection (V2X-Real), few-shot pose transfer (RELI11D), and command prediction (Humanoid-Everyday); a world model trained on frozen-core outputs forecasts future fused states better than a linear baseline at longer horizons.

Conclusion: A bottleneck-based, subset-supervised fusion scheme with per-task adapters yields consistent gains across human activity, aerial, robotics and driving settings, and its frozen representations support downstream world-model forecasting.

Abstract: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

</details>


### [368] [Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30840)
*Rudra Saxena,Vishal Dev Verma,Rohan Sharma,Palani Thanaraj K*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对PatchCleanser在交通标志识别上可认证精度极低的问题，提出"掩码感知训练"：用防御自身的掩码集随机成对遮挡训练图像并偏向遮挡标志中心区域，在不改变防御与认证流程的前提下将ResNet-50的可认证精度从4.8%提升到60.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PatchCleanser是可认证的对抗补丁防御（两轮掩码，保证任意落在单掩码内的补丁不改变标签），但直接配常规训练的分类器用于交通标志时几乎无认证能力（GTSRB上仅1.7%–4.8%可认证精度）。根因是单个掩码即可遮住区分标志类别的小型中心符号，使掩码后的输入本身失去判别信息。

Method: 提出mask-aware training：在训练阶段对图像施加从防御自身掩码集合中随机采样的成对遮挡，并对标志中心区域过采样的采样偏置，使分类器学会在掩码条件下仍能判别。防御结构、掩码集合与认证程序完全不变，因此可认证保证得以保持（certification-preserving）。

Result: ImageNet预训练ResNet-50上，可认证精度由4.8%升至60.0%；在真实逐图像对抗补丁攻击下，防御后的ResNet-50准确率为85.7%，原始PatchCleanser配常规训练ResNet-50为74.6%。GTSRB基线可认证精度仅1.7%–4.8%。

Conclusion: 可认证防御的实用性不仅取决于认证算法本身，也强依赖于分类器对掩码遮挡的鲁棒性；通过对齐训练分布与防御掩码分布，可在不牺牲理论保证的情况下大幅提升认证精度与经验鲁棒性。属于鲁棒感知/安全方向的工具性工作，与具身智能核心议题关联有限。

Abstract: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.

</details>


### [369] [DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30844)
*Lernie Li,Yuanliu Liu,Pengfei Xiong,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DyLoMo-DiT：以权重共享循环复用中间层（不加参数地加深网络）+稀疏MoE专家分配参数容量+随噪声水平动态改变循环次数，在参数/计算预算匹配下显著降低FID，并在文生图上以1.05B激活参数超过FLUX.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT靠增加参数与计算扩展容量；MoE变体虽解耦参数量与每token计算，但仍需大量参数存储。作者希望在固定存储预算下更高效地利用参数与计算，并把节省的参数量预算让给更多专家或更多独立层。

Method: 提出Dynamic Looped MoE DiT：1) 权重共享的循环结构，对中间层反复施加同一组参数以"免费"加深网络；2) 稀疏专家（MoE）在token维度分配参数容量；3) 动态计算分配，按去噪噪声水平调整循环/前向次数，并对低噪声步分配更多passes。

Result: ImageNet 256×256上，在参数与计算预算匹配条件下，FID相比DiT降低11–24%，相比DiT-MoE降低36–56%；低噪声步多分配passes带来进一步增益；文生图方面，扩展版DyLoMo-DiT的GenEval分数0.714高于FLUX.1的0.673，激活参数仅1.05B（对比12B）。

Conclusion: 参数复用（循环）+稀疏专家+噪声自适应计算分配，能比单纯堆参数更有效地使用参数与计算预算，具备良好的可扩展性与跨任务（类条件生成、文生图）泛化性。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

</details>


### [370] [Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30850)
*Fernando Alonso-Fernandez,Kevin Hernandez-Diaz,Jose Maria Buades,Josef Bigun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究人脸/眼部身份识别表征向性别与年龄估计任务的可迁移性，比较三种复杂度CNN在不同初始化下的固定特征+SVM与端到端微调表现，并提出利用年龄组排序的ordinal loss。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索身份识别（人脸与眼部）预训练表征能否迁移到软生物特征（性别、年龄）估计，并考察眼部区域相对全脸的信息损失能否通过多区域融合弥补。

Method: 在Adience的11,299张手机正面人脸图像上，按预定义五折、subject-disjoint协议，用三种复杂度CNN分别在脸部或眼部身份识别上预训练；对比ImageNet预训练与随机初始化，评估固定特征+SVM和端到端适配两种方式；对眼部则融合左右眼与眼周区域；额外引入ordinal loss建模年龄组序关系。

Result: 端到端训练中域匹配的身份预训练优于ImageNet与随机初始化；联合双眼区域可缩小与全脸的差距，年龄任务尤为明显。最佳性别准确率：全脸88.1%、联合眼部82.9%；年龄：眼部59.0% exact / 93.1% 1-off，全脸57.6% / 95.2%。ordinal loss在各架构与输入区域上一致提升1-off准确率，眼部年龄精度为Adience上已报告最高。

Conclusion: 身份识别表征可有效迁移至性别与年龄估计，域匹配预训练和序数监督是关键增益来源；眼部多区域融合是接近全脸性能的可行轻量方案，可用于受限场景下的软生物特征分析。

Abstract: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images. Three CNNs of varying complexity, pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, are evaluated using fixed features with SVMs and end-to-end adaptation. Experiments use 11,299 frontal smartphone images from Adience, following its predefined five-fold protocol and subject-disjoint validation. Results show that domain-matched identity pre-training outperforms direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation in end-to-end training, while combining both ocular regions narrows the gap with full-face estimation, especially for age. We additionally introduce an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups and consistently improves 1-off accuracy across architectures and input regions. Across the evaluated configurations, best gender accuracies reach 88.1% for the face and 82.9% for combined ocular regions, while age estimation reaches 59.0% exact and 93.1% 1-off accuracy for ocular images, versus 57.6% and 95.2% for the full face. To our knowledge, these are the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.

</details>


### [371] [CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30859)
*Shima Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CableMoE：四个冻结分割专家的事后混合，以"可用性感知概率平均 + 校准残差"为预测，并用伤害惩罚抑制对均值已正确点的额外损失；最终 mIoU 84.906%，优于 SPT（+10.0）与概率均值（+0.263）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输电走廊语义制图可融合异构 LiDAR 与图像预测器，但用学习式路由器替换强集成会损害稀有电气资产（如绝缘子、结构缆），故寻求更保守、更稳健的集成方式。

Method: 事后集成：保留四个冻结分割专家，部署预测为辅以校准残差的概率平均；引入伤害惩罚正则，防止残差在均值已分类正确的点上引入额外损失；消融表明无约束学习混合劣于概率均值，去掉逐点门控反而略有收益。数据划分为三个拟合区、两个不相交残差强度选择区、未触碰的 t5b5 测试区。

Result: mIoU 84.906%、总体精度 98.140%；较 SPT +10.000、较概率均值 +0.263，三个随机种子均优于概率均值。塔架/导线/结构缆/绝缘子四类宏平均 IoU 由 SPT 84.517%、概率均值 97.153% 提升至 98.144%。

Conclusion: 结论是"保守残差组合"有效且必要，属集成/后处理层面的增益；作者明确不作新分割骨干或普适 SOTA 的主张。

Abstract: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art

</details>


### [372] [XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30869)
*Yuhuan Lu,P. Ellen Grant,Davood Karimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 XFreq 框架，利用切片位姿与有限视场在 3D 位置查询 2D 特征，并采用低频/高频双解码器与门控模块，从稀疏 2D 超声切片重建 3D 体积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 超声有临床价值，但只能获得 2D 切片；稀疏切片导致大部分体素未被观测，现有插值或 2D 特征融合方法未充分区分"平滑结构"与"残差细节"的互补作用。

Method: 几何对齐的 splatting 表征（已知切面位姿 + 有限 footprint）+ 3D 位置处的 2D 特征查询；低频解码器从 splat 表征预测平滑 3D 场，高频解码器结合查询到的 2D 特征预测残差；学习式门控模块依据几何与跨切片特征变化调节残差贡献。

Result: 在自建胎儿脑数据集与公开 CETUS 心脏数据集上（切片从 3D 体数据重采样、五折交叉验证），多数设置下 PSNR/SSIM 最高；CETUS 上 32 张输入切片达到 26.82 dB PSNR。消融显示局部特征查询、几何线索与残差预测均有贡献，且增益随输入切片数增加而增大。

Conclusion: 几何对齐的跨视角特征融合对稀疏 2D 切片重建 3D 超声体积有效，频域解耦（平滑场 + 残差）与门控机制是关键设计。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known. Existing methods interpolate observed intensities or incorporate learned 2D image features into 3D reconstruction, but their complementary roles in predicting smooth structure and residual details remain less explored. We introduce XFreq, a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction. It uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations, complementing splatted intensities and sampling geometry. A low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from the splat representation, while a high-frequency decoder additionally incorporates the queried 2D features to predict residual details. A learned gating module regulates the residual contribution based on geometry and cross-slice feature variation. We evaluate XFreq on an in-house fetal brain dataset and the public CETUS cardiac dataset, using slices resampled from 3D ultrasound volumes and fivefold cross-validation. Among the compared methods, XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings across both datasets, reaching 26.82 dB PSNR on CETUS with 32 input slices. Ablation studies further show the contributions of local feature querying, geometric cues, and residual prediction, with gains generally increasing as more input slices are used. Our findings highlight the value of geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices.

</details>


### [373] [A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30888)
*Anand S Sahadevan,Sunita Arya,Anup Kumar Das,Bimal Kumar Bhattacharya,S Manthira Moorthi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TeakTreeNet：2cm 分辨率无人机柚木树二值分割数据集与评测协议；基准测试 U-Net/PSPNet/DeepLabV3/SegFormer，SegFormer 取得 SOTA（F1 0.938、IoU 0.968），且从头训练即优于 ImageNet 预训练 CNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率无人机影像的柚木树精确分割对可持续林场管理重要，但缺乏专用基准与可复现评测协议。

Method: 构建 6391 张 224×224 专家标注无人机影像块的数据集；在原生 2cm 分辨率下统一评测四种架构（U-Net、PSPNet、DeepLabV3、SegFormer），覆盖从头训练与 ImageNet 预训练设置，并做三随机种子可复现实验与边界刻画分析。

Result: SegFormer 达 F1 0.938±0.002、IoU 0.968±0.001、Accuracy 0.986±0.001，优于全部预训练 CNN；从头训练的 SegFormer 已超过 ImageNet 预训练基线；Transformer 在密集林分场景边界 delineation 更优。

Conclusion: 域自适应训练即可满足需求，无需大规模预训练开销；建议将 SegFormer 作为林业监测的部署方案，并公开数据集与评测协议以支持后续方法可比。

Abstract: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks. We introduce TeakTreeNet, a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocol for binary teak-tree segmentation at native 2cm resolution. Four state-of-the-art architectures: U-Net, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer were rigorously benchmarked across scratch and ImageNet-pretrained settings with three-seed reproducibility. SegFormer establishes new SOTA performance with F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak), IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak), and Accuracy 0.986 +/- 0.001, outperforming all pretrained CNNs. Domain-adaptive training suffices, as the scratch SegFormer outperforms ImageNet pretrained baselines, avoiding large-scale pretraining overhead. Comprehensive analysis reveals Transformer's superior boundary delineation for dense plantation scenarios. TeakTreeNet provides researchers with 6391 expertly annotated drone patches (224x224) and establishes reproducible evaluation protocols, enabling direct comparison of future methods. Our benchmark demonstrates SegFormer's optimal balance of accuracy, efficiency, and deployability for operational forestry monitoring of teak plantations for India's western tropical forests.

</details>


### [374] [Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30895)
*Bohe Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出Ego-MC-Bench/QICD两个任务步骤完成判定基准可被"盲看视频的定时器"击败，提出video-blind frontier概念并证明现有结果均落在该边界内；随后提出Evidence-Contrastive Training(ECT)，用同时刻同录制的负样本消除时间线索，使2B模型在两个基准上跨越该边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式物理任务助手需周期性判断步骤是否完成、是否出错。作者怀疑现有基准的高分主要来自"知道何时"（利用已过时间与指令先验）而非"看到什么"（真正理解视频），因此需要揭示并突破这一捷径。

Method: 用一个完全不看视频的定时器（25s报警、30s确认每步）作为强基线，形式化"video-blind frontier"——仅依赖已过时间、指令与训练统计可达到的完成准确率–错误F1最优折衷。提出ECT：在基准自身问题上微调，并将正样本与同一录制、同一已过时间点的负样本配对，使时间无法区分正负，迫使模型依赖视频证据。

Result: 定时器在Ego-MC-Bench取得mistake F1=0.373，超过所有已发表结果（≤0.27）；所有已发表的逐步结果及12个零样本模型均落在该边界内。ECT在209个QICD视频上约15 GPU小时训练一个2B模型，四个随机种子下均在两基准跨过边界；零适配迁移到Ego-MC-Bench时，及时确认59%无错误步骤（同骨干、用约25k合成反事实训练的已发表模型仅30%）。等时间条件下区分完成/未完成达90–92%（指令典型时长基线65%），时间戳重标定几乎无影响，替换为其他录制则完成准确率下降约2/3。

Conclusion: 现有基准存在严重的时间捷径偏差，ECT通过同时刻负样本对比有效消除该捷径，模型决策真正依赖视频内容。工作同时提供了诊断指标（frontier、等时配对、时间戳重标定、录制替换）与可复现资源。

Abstract: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

</details>


### [375] [World Models as Native Latent Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30898)
*Qinyue Li,Weijie Qiao,Qingyi Tao,Zerui Gong,Zhe Yang,Quanzhou Li,Taolin Zhang,Jinglin He,Zhonghua Wu,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Native LAM 把预训练视频扩散 Transformer 同时用作 IDM 与 FDM，仅以可学习的 dynamics registers 作为因果桥梁，通过反事实时间对训练，从大规模无动作视频中蒸馏紧致潜在动作；据此提出 PAWlicy 范式，用 Native LAM 作动力学教师预训练 VLA 策略（不生成视频）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模异质视频（第一视角人视频、异构机器人录像）蕴含丰富动力学，但缺动作标注或共享动作空间；既有潜在动作模型（LAM）从头训练 IDM/FDM，在像素重建、潜变量容量与精度间权衡，且表示稠密纠缠。

Method: Native LAM：单一预训练视频扩散 Transformer 兼任 IDM 与 FDM，可学习 dynamics registers 为唯一因果耦合；在仅运动不同的反事实时间对上训练，使 registers 蒸馏出紧凑潜在动作。PAWlicy：以 Native LAM 作为大规模视频上的动力学教师，预训练 VLA 策略，推理时不生成视频。

Result: LARY 基准上动作分类与控制回归均优于现有 LAM；无需迁移目标即在新型机器人、新场景及人手→机器人间复现同一运动。3.8B 模型在 RoboTwin 2.0（域随机化示教）达 93.6% 平均成功率，为 VLA 最高；RoboDojo 各维度有竞争力，Precision 与榜首持平；真机两任务优于 pi_0.5 基线。仅用公开数据与公开世界模型。

Conclusion: 预训练视频世界模型可被视作 LAM 并近乎零改动地提取潜在动作，构成强动力学教师，为 VLA 提供可跨具身迁移的动作预训练范式，且优于从头训练的 LAM 与基线策略。

Abstract: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

</details>


### [376] [GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30900)
*Anh Dao,Quan-Dung Pham,Danh Vinh Le,Tuyen Pham Le,Quan Nguyen,Yuzhang Shang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GlanceNav 是一个基于混合 MLLM 的流式视觉语言导航器：用 Gated DeltaNet 循环状态 + 短窗口注意力 + 按状态变化度选取的关键帧库，实现每步恒定计算与恒定大小记忆；并配套 Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe) 强化学习，利用常数时间可拷贝的记忆回到最接近目标处由专家纠错。4B 模型在 R2R-CE/RxR-CE val-unseen 达 71.9%/73.6% SR，104 ms/step。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 导航策略在每个决策步重复编码历史帧、按单步样本训练，导致计算冗余、可用历史短；且仅用整回合标量结果奖励学习纠错，信用分配粗糙。作者希望导航器每帧只编码一次、每步恒定代价，同时保有长程记忆并能从失败中高效学习。

Method: (1) 混合架构：Gated DeltaNet 循环层跨回合携带状态，注意力层保存近期观测短窗口 + 由"帧对循环状态改变量"筛选的关键帧小库，形成恒定尺寸记忆，训练与推理记忆一致，可整回合训练。(2) CoRe 强化学习：因记忆可常数时间复制，将偏离的 rollout 回卷到最接近目标时刻，由专家纠正少量动作，并以结果变化为决策分配信用。(3) 仅用 R2R-CE/RxR-CE 训练集 + 1,000 条指令做 RL。

Result: 4B 模型在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上 SR 分别为 71.9% 与 73.6%；R2R-CE 上比此前最强的单 RGB、无外部数据方法高 9.1 点，单步耗时 104 ms。

Conclusion: 恒定代价的流式记忆 + 记忆回卷式反事实 RL 可在不依赖外部数据的情况下显著提升 VLN 成功率与效率，说明"每帧编码一次 + 长程循环状态 + 关键帧稀疏保留"是可行范式。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

</details>


### [377] [Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30909)
*Yicheng Zhang,Xun Zhang,Jingyuan Ma,Tianyu Yu,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的第二眼提示（SLP）：将图像-问题对在输入中重复一次，使第二份副本的全部视觉与文本token都能因果地看到完整输入，形成统一多模态编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM采用因果注意力，先出现的模态只能在部分观测下编码，无法获得完整多模态上下文，导致图文理解不统一。

Method: 无训练推理期技巧：在输入中重复图像-问题对；第二份副本中的token可关注完整上下文；额外视觉token亦作为prefill草稿纸贡献计算（空白图像替代也可提升）。

Result: 12个基准上所有评估模型平均分均有提升，覆盖9个开源模型(3B-72B)与3个闭源前沿模型，Gemini 3 Flash在MATH-Vision上最高增益5.6分。

Conclusion: 机制分析表明问题引导第二张图像的注意力位置，额外视觉token的隐状态保留答案相关信息；输入呈现方式是提升VLM性能的简洁有效手段。

Abstract: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

</details>


### [378] [Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30911)
*Nusrat Jahan,Mst. Eshrat Jahan Esha,Masuma Sadia,Saad Ahmed,Md Zahim Hassan,S M Jahangir Alam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建孟加拉国 BanglaWaste-23 垃圾图像数据集（4,160 图、172 个物理物体、23 类），提出按“物体不重叠”的五折交叉验证评估 11 个 ImageNet 预训练模型与 2 个从头训练模型，揭示随机划分严重高估泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有垃圾分类研究普遍在随机划分上报告近乎完美的准确率，但同一物体的多张照片同时出现在训练集与测试集，导致性能被严重高估，无法反映模型对“未见过的物体”的真实识别能力；同时医疗废弃物误分风险高，需要可信的评估协议。

Method: 采集并标注 4,160 张图像（172 个独立物理物体、23 类家庭与医疗垃圾），每张图记录对应物体 ID；在物体不重叠（object-disjoint）五折交叉验证与随机划分两种协议下评测 11 个 ImageNet 预训练模型及 2 个从头训练模型（紧凑自定网络与 MobileNetV3-L）；另在达卡第二数据集上做跨域测试。

Result: 未见物体上最佳预训练模型 macro-F1 达 98.8%，6 个模型统计上无显著差异；随机划分使从头训练模型准确率虚高 15–19 个百分点；从头训练模型漏检医疗物品 11–13%，预训练模型低于 1%；在达卡数据集上预训练模型准确率下降 15–22 个百分点。

Conclusion: 垃圾分类分类器应在物体不重叠的划分上评估，随机划分结果只应视为性能上界；数据集与代码已公开。

Abstract: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at this https URL .

</details>


### [379] [FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30935)
*Marcell Kégl,Csaba Benedek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FGSCalib：无标靶、无需初始外参的固定相机-LiDAR在线重标定方法，利用场景中任意运动目标的前景分割，通过边界邻近场与两阶段模拟退火求解外参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定式基础设施中的相机-LiDAR对需周期性重标定，但使用标定靶会导致设备停用；现有方法多依赖特定目标类别或需要较准的初始外参。

Method: 假设场景中存在任意运动物体；两传感器各自将运动前景从静态背景中分离（不依赖物体类别）；把相机前景掩码转换为边界邻近场；对选定帧对执行两阶段模拟退火优化外参，无需测量初始外参，兼容旋转式与非重复扫描式（Livox）LiDAR。

Result: 21个仿真场景中中位误差5.3 cm/0.19°；72个真实场景（9对传感器、8个场景，参考值为43次人工标定平均），在18 cm/1.8°容差下取五次运行最低代价，51/72通过（Livox 20/24，最强基线仅11；旋转式LiDAR 31/48，基线仅1次达标）；中位误差9.5 cm/0.9°，略逊于单次人工标定（7.3 cm/0.7°）。代码与数据集已公开。

Conclusion: FGSCalib实现了免标靶、免初始值的固定式相机-LiDAR外参标定，在多场景与多类LiDAR上显著优于基线并接近人工标定精度，适合作为基础设施长期维护工具。

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.

</details>


### [380] [SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30938)
*Muhammad Fasih Ishfaq,Giulio Weikmann,Lorenzo Bruzzone*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SIAMBA：一种伪孪生 Mamba 网络，联合 Sentinel-1 SAR 与 Sentinel-2 多光谱影像进行双时相洪水变化检测，在多尺度上做门控跨模态对数比差异学习并通过选择性状态空间建模长程上下文，取得 IoU 81.98%、OA 93.57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洪水变化检测需快速响应，Sentinel-2 提供判别性光谱信息而 Sentinel-1 SAR 提供全天候结构信息，二者联合需处理时序证据与跨模态异质性；云污染、光照变化、成像几何与相干斑噪声，以及地物响应的异质性使问题复杂化。

Method: 伪孪生架构，各模态独立编码器 + 双池化 SE 重标定 + 选择性状态空间（Mamba）长程空间上下文建模；门控跨模态变化模块在多个语义层级计算绝对、带符号与相对对数比差异；注意力细化跳跃连接支撑渐进多尺度解码。

Result: 在 OMBRIA 基准（含独立测试集及法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那、东帝汶区域子集）上，独立测试集 IoU 81.98%、OA 93.57%，为该对比中的最高值；四个空间不重叠区域子集上的非加权平均 IoU 与 OA 亦为最高。

Conclusion: 选择性状态空间上下文建模与门控多尺度差异学习相结合，可有效提升跨地理场景的洪水变化制图性能。

Abstract: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.

</details>


### [381] [Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30945)
*Yuze Sun,Zhongjie Duan,Yingda Chen,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Diffutoon-2 提出一个视频扩散框架，通过“动画重建”自监督方式学习卡通着色：用冻结的视频骨干，由两个互补模块分别从线稿和模糊颜色重建动画片段，推理时用真实视频提取的同类条件联合引导生成，无需跨域配对数据或风格参考图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频卡通化方法依赖成对的真实/风格训练数据或额外视觉参考（风格图、LoRA等）；Diffutoon 虽规避配对数据，但基于图像扩散骨干，仅用短窗口运动模块并需重复重叠窗口去噪，时序一致性与生成质量受限。

Method: 以视频扩散模型为主干并冻结参数；构建两个独立的动画片段重建模块，分别以线稿（outline）和模糊颜色（blurred color）为条件自监督重建动画视频；推理阶段，从真实感视频中提取同类型条件，两模块联合引导生成，从而避免跨域训练配对与外部风格参考。

Result: 在定量指标与人工评测上均优于通用视频生成基线和该领域的专用卡通化基线。

Conclusion: 以视频扩散骨干替代图像扩散+短窗口时序模块的架构，并用动画自重建替代跨域监督，可在零配对数据、零风格参考的条件下实现时序更一致、质量更高的卡通着色，为该任务提供了更简洁有效的范式。

Abstract: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

</details>


### [382] [Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30964)
*Peizheng Li,Xin Ai,Guanghui Cheng,Zikang Dong,Qiange Wang,Yanfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Graph2Scene：免训练地将场景图（节点=元素、边=关系）转译为选择性注意力引导，按复杂度自适应控制时长并逐步放松约束，提升复杂提示的组合生成与关系准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注意力控制方法只关注"元素出现在何处"，忽视"元素之间如何交互"，导致关系 token 将注意力错误分配到无关区域，造成关系缺失或错误。

Method: 免训练框架：用场景图显式表示元素-关系依赖，转化为选择性注意力引导——将每个元素 grounding 到对应区域，并引导相关元素间的关系交互；同时根据场景复杂度自适应调整控制时长，并在去噪过程中渐进式放松图引导以避免过度约束。

Result: T2I-CompBench 与 ConceptMix 上组合生成（尤其物体关系）明显提升；ConceptMix 关系准确率从 0.59 提升至 0.84（对比最强 FLUX.1 区域控制基线）；LongBench-T2I 上长复杂提示亦具优势。

Conclusion: 将场景图作为核心控制信号、并以复杂度自适应+渐进放松的方式实施注意力引导，是提升文本到图像组合性和关系保真度的有效免训练路径。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other. As a result, relation tokens describing interactions between elements may assign high attention to irrelevant regions, leading to missing or incorrect interactions.
