In this paper, we propose Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that treats scene graphs as a core control signal for diffusion generation. It represents elements as nodes and their relations as edges, and translates these element-relation dependencies into selective attention guidance. It grounds each element to its corresponding region and guides relational interactions among the involved elements. To achieve appropriate relation control without over-constraining the generation process, Graph2Scene further adapts the control duration to scene complexity and progressively relaxes graph guidance during denoising. Experiments on T2I-CompBench and ConceptMix show clear improvements in compositional generation, especially for object relations. On ConceptMix, Graph2Scene improves relationship accuracy from 0.59 to 0.84 over the strongest FLUX.1-based regional-control baseline. Results on LongBench-T2I further show its advantage on long and complex prompts.

</details>


### [383] [Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31021)
*Zhuoying Yang,Yichen Guo,Kathy Jia,Zichang Su,Ayesha Kashif,Nange Hai,Jeffrey Ming Han Li,Zhewen He,Silvio Kempf,Ni Jiachen,Junjie Yang,Muhammad Hamza,Zakaria El Ouahidi,Gabriel Azpitarte,Manling Li,Yi Fang,Shuhong Liu,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LatentParse：免训练框架，用"分析师VLM"通过预定义工具探针CLIP/DINOv3/VGGT的潜在特征，解析为显式空间证据文本报告，与图像一同输入下游VLM回答多视图空间推理问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在多视图空间推理上薄弱，因为需要跨视图对应与场景几何，而VLM难以可靠提取；但预训练视觉编码器（CLIP的物体-区域关联、DINOv3的跨视图语义匹配、VGGT的多视图几何）已在其潜在特征中编码了这些信息。直接把特征渲染为灰度特征图放进上下文，VLM无法利用。

Method: 免训练流水线：(1) 分析师VLM调用预定义工具探测三类编码器特征——定位物体、跨视图跟踪、测量视图间运动；(2) 将探测结果蒸馏为简洁文本报告；(3) 文本报告+原图共同输入目标VLM作答。不涉及任何模型训练。

Result: 在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench、SPAR-Bench上，五个VLM相对仅图像基线平均提升0.7–2.4个百分点；MMSI-Bench上Qwen3-27B（原文"Qwen3.8-27B"）从34.4%升至39.5%，相机相关题目提升最大达19.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 潜在特征在被解析为关系证据（而非原始特征图）后即可被VLM有效利用，无需训练；为多视图空间推理提供了一种即插即用的特征解析范式。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [384] [OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31022)
*Liu Yang,Huiyu Duan,Yixuan Gao,Sirui Liu,Lu Liu,Zhaolin Cai,Ke Gu,Xiongkuo Min,Xiaoping Zhang,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniV-Bench基准，包含4,123条全景视频与8,923条人工标注问答（覆盖通用、空间、时空3大类11项细粒度任务），用于评测MLLM对360°全向视频的时空理解；并给出OmniV-Harness，一个基于视点引导证据初始化、任务相关证据采集与自适应工具调用的智能体框架，可稳定提升MLLM的沉浸式时空推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全向视频（ODV）提供完整360°视场与丰富空间上下文，但现有MLLM的时空理解评测多面向透视视频，其在沉浸式360°时空信息上的理解能力几乎未被系统考察；同时现有模型在该类数据上存在明显性能瓶颈，缺少针对性的增强手段。

Method: 1）构建OmniV-Bench：从多样场景采集4,123条高质量ODV，设计11项任务（通用理解、空间理解、时空理解三类），人工标注8,923条QA对，系统性基准测试主流MLLM；2）提出OmniV-Harness：面向ODV的agentic框架，通过视点（viewpoint）引导的证据初始化定位关键观测方向，按任务需求选择性获取证据，并结合自适应工具调用来补充时空信息，从而增强MLLM推理。

Result: 基准实验表明ODV的时空复杂度对当前MLLM构成显著挑战，各模型在三类任务上均存在明显不足；引入OmniV-Harness后，MLLM的沉浸式时空推理性能获得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了ODV时空理解评测的空白，并以agentic harness的形式提供了可迁移的增强范式；基准与框架拟于发表后开源。

Abstract: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [385] [WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31023)
*Richard Shaw,Arthur Moreau,Athanasios Papaioannou,Thomas Tanay,Zhensong Zhang,Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WildAnySplat：学生-教师前馈3DGS框架，用瞬态掩码与双边网格实现野外多视图的鲁棒新视角合成


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈式重建方法在受控采集数据上表现良好，但真实"in-the-wild"多视图图像存在瞬态遮挡、光照变化与相机ISP差异导致的多视图不一致，显著降低重建质量；且成对的干净-野外数据稀缺。

Method: 采用student-teacher架构：教师网络处理干净图像提供规范表征监督，学生网络处理野外输入以学习瞬态鲁棒、外观一致的三维表征。数据侧采用混合策略，结合真实配对采集、合成增广与由优化式重建生成的伪干净标签以弥合域差。网络为transformer主干加DPT头分别预测相机位姿、深度与高斯；额外预测逐视图瞬态掩码以对光度监督重加权并抑制不可靠高斯；引入双边网格模块建模逐图像颜色变换以恢复规范辐射表征。

Result: 在具有挑战性的野外基准上，对瞬态遮挡与外观变化的鲁棒性优于现有前馈方法，同时保持前馈高斯泼溅的快速推理。

Conclusion: 通过教师蒸馏+瞬态掩码+双边网格的组合，将前馈3DGS的重建能力从受控采集扩展到野外多视图，兼顾鲁棒性与实时性；但仅给出定性/相对比较结论，缺少具体量化指标与位姿/几何精度分解，也未验证机器人或具身场景下的在线可用性。

Abstract: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods. To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data. We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation. Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

</details>


### [386] [Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31025)
*Julian Wyatt,James Willoughby,Allison Clement,Irina Voiculescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MCTP（蒙特卡洛Token剪枝）通过在前向传播中显式移除token并估计其对预测的影响，从而刻画预训练ViT对不同深度剪枝的响应；发现DINOv3具有高度一致的token重要性排序（依赖前缀“sink”token），而SigLIP 2不具备，需保护少量patch sink token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作只比较不同的token削减算法，而未研究模型本身如何响应剪枝、以及这种响应随深度如何变化。作者希望建立一种事后（post-hoc）方法，量化预训练ViT对剪枝的鲁棒性与内部token重要性的稳定性。

Method: 提出Monte Carlo Token Pruning：在前向过程中显式删除token，并通过蒙特卡洛采样多次删除组合，估计每个token对最终预测的影响（token impact）及不同深度间重要性排序的一致性（Coherent Aggregation）。对DINOv3、SigLIP 2等近期预训练模型做扰动分析：移除前缀token、保护少量高范数“sink”token，并统计目标框外token影响的变化。

Result: DINOv3等多数模型在各深度保持相近的token重要性排序（高Coherent Aggregation），SigLIP 2则不一致。该一致性依赖预测在剪枝下存活，即需保留高范数sink token：前缀token天然保留；无前缀的SigLIP 2把sink形成于patch token上，易被剪枝删除。移除DINOv3前缀token会导致预测与一致性崩溃；对SigLIP 2仅保护5个token即可将目标框外token影响降低最多62%。

Conclusion: MCTP提供了一种评估预训练ViT对剪枝响应的通用事后工具，并给出设计启示：token削减方法应显式保留“sink”token，尤其对无前缀结构（如SigLIP 2）的模型需在patch上保护少量高范数token。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".

</details>


### [387] [Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31036)
*Saugat Pandey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析潜在扩散模型输出的"déjà vu"痕迹：冻结视觉基础模型中间层可无训练检测该痕迹；痕迹绑定于生成器精确解码器，对模糊不敏感、对重缩放/JPEG鲁棒性差；并揭示基准测试中尺寸匹配协议可反转检测器比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建式生成图像检测依赖"输出再过一次自编码器变化很小"这一现象，但该现象何时能揭示生成图像、何时失效尚不清晰，且现有基准可能因协议缺陷给出误导性结论。

Method: 利用冻结视觉基础模型的中间层特征读取自编码器往返痕迹，无需训练；在Synthbuster上对比八个自编码器（SD 1.3/1.4/2/XL等）的检测率；用仅含真实照片与自编码器副本的数据训练检测器，并与16.2万生成图像训练的检测器在GenImage上比较及融合；开展JPEG重存、重缩放、模糊等扰动实验与基准协议分析。

Result: Synthbuster上精确解码器在5%误报率下捕获94-100%对应生成图像，而近似版本仅7-42%；仅用真实照片训练者与大规模生成图像训练者性能相当（+2.3点，95% CI [0.9, 3.7]）且融合互补；单次重缩放加JPEG重存或轻度模糊损失19-27点；Chameleon可仅凭图像宽度求解；真实图像尺寸匹配协议可致+4.4或-9.7点差异并反转结论。

Conclusion: 自编码器往返痕迹是有效但脆弱的生成图像检测信号，其强度来自模态相关特征而非像素误差；检测器须匹配精确解码器，且基准构建协议（尺寸匹配、图像宽度）本身可决定结论，需谨慎设计。

Abstract: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not. Read by a frozen vision foundation model without training, the trace is strongest in intermediate layers, and, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image. It belongs to the generator's exact decoder: on Synthbuster, the exact decoders of Stable Diffusion 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL are the strongest of eight autoencoders and catch 94-100% of their generators' images at a 5% false-alarm rate (SDXL's version identified post hoc), while near-identical versions catch 7-42%. A detector trained only on real photographs and their autoencoder copies matches one trained on 162k generated images on GenImage (+2.3 points, 95% CI [0.9, 3.7]) and complements it in fusion, but one resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs it 19-27 points. Two lessons concern benchmarks. The in-the-wild benchmark Chameleon can be solved from image width alone. And on Synthbuster, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images' size decides whether our detector leads or trails (+4.4 or -9.7 points): the matching protocol alone can reverse a detector comparison. Code and per-image scores: this https URL

</details>


### [388] [Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31048)
*Jiaze Li,Jingyang Chen,Wenhao Zhao,Haoran Xu,Zhenlong Yuan,Dianmo Sheng,Yuanxing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hindsight Twins (HinT) 用二元组“重写模板”蒸馏：分别用预期修正与观测错误填充 critic 的修订模板，仅在用户 prompt 锚定下蒸馏两者的速度差，并对齐槽外 token 状态以抑制文本编码器的全局串扰，从而在保持低偏好偏差的同时提升文本-图像对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 self-teacher 方法用 VLM critic 修订后的 prompt 作为条件来蒸馏自身的错误，但对齐提升有限；且 self-teacher 与 hindsight-contrast 变体会吸收 critic 引入的无关改动（光照、布景等）。作者归因于两点：(1) 修订 prompt 已直接写明修正目标，导致有用信号被大量整场景改写细节淹没；(2) 即使 critic 将错误定位到单一 span，self-teacher 仍以整段重写为条件，使预期修正与无关新增纠缠。

Method: 构造"孪生"提示：同一 critic 修订模板分别填入预期修正与观测错误，各自作为条件；以用户原 prompt 为锚，仅蒸馏两孪生输出的速度差（velocity difference），使无关新增在差分中抵消。由于文本编码器会把单槽位的编辑扩散到所有 token，进一步对孪生在槽位之外的 token 状态做对齐（token-state alignment），限制串扰范围。在 Qwen-Image-2512、SD3.5-M、FLUX.2-klein 上验证。

Result: 在三个基础模型上，HinT 将 critic 诱导的偏好偏差维持在基础模型水平，同时对齐增益持平或超过既有自蒸馏方法；在 12 轮自训练中持续提升，而对比式基线出现衰退。

Conclusion: 将"错误/修正"以差分目标而非整段重写条件的方式注入自蒸馏，是抑制 critic 偏置、实现可持续多轮自提升的关键；token 级串扰需显式校正。

Abstract: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

</details>


### [389] [UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31068)
*Safal Thapaliya,Jiatan Huang,Debapriya Chatterjee,Yanfang Ye,Chuxu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UMAMI多模态数据集与基准，将独立采集的食物图像、营养记录与受访者健康/摄入历史链接，并设计视觉营养问答、个性化食物推荐、条件感知食物替换三项诊断任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭图像识别食物不足以判断营养含量与个体饮食适配性：视觉相似食物营养谱可能不同，错误选择食物记录会导致决策错误；且满足营养约束不等于与个人摄入相关。需将图像、营养记录与个体摄入历史联合评估。

Method: 构建UMAMI数据集，对齐食物图像、营养档案与受访者健康与摄入记录；设计三个诊断任务（视觉营养问答、个性化食物推荐、条件感知食物替换），并设置配对实例与输入控制实验，考察视觉身份与受访者上下文对决策的影响。

Result: 实验同时发现食物记录选择错误与营养规则应用错误；更高的规则遵从度并不必然提升与后续记录摄入的一致性。

Conclusion: 多模态系统用于饮食决策时，需评估其如何选择与使用结构化证据；基准、代码与面板已公开。

Abstract: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [390] [Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31096)
*Malay Phadke,Akshay Gokhale*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对CT血管造影动脉瘤候选的3D卷积分类器做患者不重叠、保留标识符的审计，发现1201个正样本patch中有232个全零数组（含170个训练正样本），并检验归因驱动数据裁剪的三项可测声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归因方法常被用来指认"异常/有害"训练样本并据此修改数据集，但这一流程隐含"检测到异常→删除有益"的跳跃假设，缺少对检测有效性、危害程度与干预收益的分离验证；同时历史研究存在无标识符记录按位置拼接导致的样本身份混淆。

Method: 将归因驱动数据裁剪形式化为三个可独立检验的声明（异常检测、危害性估计、干预效用）。在患者不重叠、保留标识符的审计协议下，对3D CNN动脉瘤候选分类器统计全零patch并追溯其来源；用GradCAM++与Integrated Gradients检查跨方法的空间归因一致性；进行五种配对训练种子的删除实验（移除170个损坏训练正样本 vs 全量训练），并设置排除零值测试样本与预算匹配的随机删除对照。

Result: AUC从全量训练0.9652±0.0039降至删样本后0.9617±0.0044，差值−0.0035（95% CI −0.0082至0.0007），无显著提升；排除34个原始零值测试正样本后差距反而扩大，否定"空白记忆"解释；随机删除对照表明差异并非单纯源于训练集缩小。GradCAM++空间集中度对全部候选类别均居中，与历史结论相反；两种归因方法对正样本呈负秩相关，限制方法无关的解剖学解释。

Conclusion: 输入损坏不等同于删除可提升泛化；归因驱动的医学影像数据裁剪必须显式落实泄漏控制、样本身份可追溯与干预实验验证，而不能仅凭归因异常直接改数据。

Abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

</details>


### [391] [CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31128)
*Johan Ziruo Ye,Xingguang Yan,Søren Hauberg,Angel X. Chang,Hao Zhang,Peter Lempel Søndergaard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrownFusion：用几何图像（geometry image, "CrownImage"）编码牙冠表面坐标，训练隐扩散模型在邻牙联合嵌入条件下生成个体化牙冠设计，并提出基于对颌牙贴近度的咬合适配度量，同时发布FDI 16 Crown Dataset（11,513例口内扫描）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统牙冠CAD生成多用点云表示，空间分辨率受限，导致生成结果平滑、细节丢失；且临床上同一患者存在多种有效牙冠设计，需要能表达形态多样性并能评估多解的评价指标。

Method: 将3D牙冠表面表示为2D网格几何图像（高空间分辨率），以周边牙列联合学习的嵌入作为条件，构建潜在扩散模型进行概率化生成；提出基于与对颌牙接近度的咬合适配指标以容纳多解；开源大规模标注口内扫描数据集。

Result: 定量实验与专家参与的定性评估表明可生成解剖合理、具患者特异性形态变化的牙冠；相比点云方案更好地保留细节、缓解平滑伪影。

Conclusion: 几何图像+隐扩散为牙齿CAD提供高分辨率、多解友好的生成范式，并配套数据集与评价指标推动后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.

</details>


### [392] [SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31135)
*Fareeha Amir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SRCWDNet：跨窗口注意力 + 双图标签关联 + 神经分类器链，用于多标签遥感场景分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签遥感场景分类存在复杂空谱模式、极端类别不平衡与标签依赖建模不足的问题。

Method: 三个模块：(1) Cross-Window Attention 借可学习全局 token 融合局部/全局视觉上下文；(2) Dual Label-Graph 自适应融合统计共现图与语义嵌入学习图做标签关系推理；(3) Neural Classifier Chain 顺序预测标签以利用标签依赖；训练采用非对称图一致性损失，五折交叉验证。

Result: MLRSNet 与 China-MAS50k 上准确率 98.93%/96.53%，F1 0.9365/0.8723，优于 CNN、Transformer 及轻量基线。

Conclusion: 联合建模视觉注意力与自适应标签相关性可显著提升长尾分布下的多标签遥感场景分类性能。

Abstract: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.

</details>


### [393] [HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31140)
*Chaofan Li,Qihan Ding,Shihan Wang,Zhehao Shen,Boyu Shen,Quanyu Chen,Haoyu Wu,Lan Xu,Xin Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HoloSplat：将前馈重建器在Gaussian头之前切分，用"服务端token压缩+客户端token恢复"实现多码率人体体积视频实时流式传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时自由视角人体视频流需要逐帧重建、严格带宽预算与轻客户端解码；现有逐帧优化或前馈推理产生海量3D Gaussian负载超出流式上限，而激进压缩又严重损害渲染质量。

Method: 在Gaussian head前切分前馈重建器，引入多码率流式编解码：服务端做不透明度引导的token剪枝、PCA降维、token锚点无损几何编码；客户端将特征重建超网络融合进Gaussian head补偿压缩损失；并提出Neural Session Calibration，在warm-up阶段用 incoming 相机视角在线微调Gaussian head，零逐帧开销地适应新相机参数与拍摄条件。

Result: 在4块RTX 5090上以50 Mbit/s平均达32.2 FPS；单帧解码为3D Gaussians在RTX 3050 Ti笔记本GPU上耗时22.1 ms；传输数据比未压缩float32 Gaussians少22.8×；校准解码使PSNR提升1.050 dB。

Conclusion: 通过前馈重建器切分与端到端token级压缩/恢复，可在消费级GPU上实现高质量、低带宽、实时的人体体积视频流式传输，warm-up在线校准进一步消除域/相机参数偏移带来的质量退化。

Abstract: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.

</details>


### [394] [Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31143)
*Umut Kocasari,Bartłomiej Baranowski,Richard Shaw,Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero,Matthias Nießner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Head Anything 将预训练单图 image-to-3D 生成器改造为多图联合生成器，通过轻量 correspondence-attention 适配器实现跨图对应点注意力，从少量多视角/多表情照片生成像素对齐的细节头部网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图 image-to-3D 生成器把每张图当作独立新物体，对同一人的多张图像会各自独立幻觉不可见区域，未复用其他图像信息；而从头训练多图 3D 先验又受限于 3D 头部数据稀少。

Method: 不训练多图先验，而是把具有原生 3D 隐空间（3D latent）的预训练单图生成器转为对全部图像联合去噪的生成器；由于全局跨图注意力难以从稀缺 3D 头部数据中学到，引入轻量 correspondence-attention adapter，使每个 3D token 只关注其他图像中的对应点。对应关系由将神经参数化头部模型 fit 到生成器自身单图输出得到，测试时无需真值；同时用真值对应与拟合对应混合训练以增强对拟合误差的鲁棒性。最终每个网格与自身图像保持像素对齐，并从其他图像借用不可见区域。

Result: 在头部扫描数据上，相比最佳 image-to-3D 生成器，头部 Chamfer 距离降低 32%，跨帧不一致性降低 47%，且生成的网格提升人脸跟踪效果。

Conclusion: 通过适配器式跨图对应注意力复用单图生成器原生 3D 先验，可在少样本条件下获得一致且细节丰富的多视角头部重建，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [395] [Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31156)
*Sagnik Ghosh,Aswin C. Sankaranarayanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级router预测源token的空间锚点分数，解码器仅对固定预算的top-k token做注意力，使渲染成本与源图数量解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer-based view synthesis无需显式3D表示即可复现细节与视角相关效果，但解码器对每帧要关注所有源token，渲染时间随源图数量线性增长。栅格化可用视锥剔除图元，而源token无显式位置与范围，无法被剔除——需找到可剔除的代理信号。

Method: 关键洞察：源token本质上是空间锚点，各自编码局部区域，因此任意视角的注意力集中于少数token。用轻量router由源token与目标视角预测token重要性并排序，解码器只关注top-ranked固定预算token；用解码器真实注意力做监督，并引入非最大抑制（NMS）压制冗余token。

Result: 24张源图、两视角token规模下，比LagerNVS快6.4倍，PSNR仅低0.68 dB；单一排序可服务任意预算，支持渲染时动态调整token预算。

Conclusion: 以"注意力稀疏性+可学习router"实现免显式3D剔除的前馈视角合成加速，成本与源图数量解耦，预算可运行时调节，为可扩展前馈渲染提供通用加速范式。

Abstract: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.

</details>


### [396] [SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31163)
*Kangping Hu,Akshay Mehra,Stephen Mussmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPROUT: 通过仅文本模型预测"目标锚定效用"（DGPO 梯度范数）来主动选择偏好微调提示词，避免生成无信息图像，将均匀采样的同等效果所需迭代减少到约44%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I 扩散模型偏好微调的计算主要花在生成候选图像上，但训练提示词通常均匀随机采样，导致大量图像对模型对齐贡献极小，算力浪费严重。

Method: 将提示选择分解为效用分数、效用分数估计器与批选择三部分。提出 SPROUT：用一个纯文本模型对提示词池（含未见提示）预测效用，每轮迭代后用已观测效用重训；随机化接受规则将预测转为批次，从而不产生额外图像生成。对 DGPO，效用定义为目标函数在提示的图像组上产生的梯度范数。

Result: 在 GenEval 上用 DGPO 微调 SD1.5，SPROUT 约 44% 的迭代即达到均匀采样的最终分数，且相对均匀采样与基于方差的采样器 CGPO 均提升学习曲线 AUC；在四个训练未用过的奖励模型上仍有效，方法排序在 DPG-Bench 与 T2I-CompBench++ 上保持一致。

Conclusion: 提示词选择是提升偏好微调可扩展性的低成本高收益组件；梯度范数型效用可被文本模型有效外推，且泛化到未见奖励模型与基准。

Abstract: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [397] [Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31164)
*Yong-Hyun Park,Guande He,Joon Hyeok Kim,Hansheng Chen,Kaifan Yu,Chaoqi Luo,Xun Huang,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文分析自回归(AR)视频生成中FlowMap蒸馏失效的原因，提出反漂移引导与运动感知引导两种互补机制，使纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步AR视频生成中达到DMD蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlowMap蒸馏可直接学习教师去噪轨迹，是实现少步生成的天然途径；但在自回归视频生成中，现有少步模型仍须依赖DMD（分布匹配蒸馏）才能保持竞争力，代价是牺牲样本多样性并需要大型双向教师模型。作者希望厘清独立AR FlowMap蒸馏的性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出两种互补引导机制：(1) 反漂移引导——训练辅助模型模仿学生rollout的漂移，作为负向引导分支帮助AR教师纠正漂移的学生轨迹；(2) 运动感知引导——定位运动区域patch并选择性施加skip-layer引导，降低FlowMap学生学习运动内容的难度。方法可泛化至π-Flow、MeanFlow与一致性蒸馏，教师规模1.3B。

Result: 在1.3B AR教师上，方法对π-Flow、MeanFlow、一致性蒸馏均有效，提升生成质量并减少30秒长rollout的漂移。4步π-Flow学生在VBench上与14B教师蒸馏的DMD学生持平，同时保留了AR教师原有的样本多样性。

Conclusion: 纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步自回归视频生成中是可行的，无需依赖DMD与大规模双向教师；漂移纠正与运动可学性是两个关键瓶颈。该工作属视频生成加速/蒸馏的算法改进，与具身智能、3D重建、机器人操作等核心研究方向关联较弱。

Abstract: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $\pi$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $\pi$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

</details>


### [398] [On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31184)
*Boyang Wang,Kevin Blackburn-Matzen,Oindrila Saha,Matheus Gadelha,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用视频编解码器思路剪枝视觉生成模型的冗余条件token，并以on-policy自蒸馏训练DiT适配器，实现66%条件token剪枝、2倍加速与73% KV cache缩减且几乎不掉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视觉生成模型将所有条件（身份、涂鸦、深度图、运动视频等）token化后拼接到输入序列，条件token在计算与显存上迅速成为瓶颈，而其中大量信息在时空上高度冗余，缺少高效利用率机制。

Method: 1）基于经典视频编解码器的残差/帧间冗余判据设计codec-based token pruning，丢弃冗余条件token；2）提出on-policy self-distillation（OPSD），让学生DiT adapter在自身采样轨迹上学习剪枝模式，抑制分布偏移导致的画质下降；二者合为CodecOPSD，并在自研视频扩散模型上扩展到16种条件模态。

Result: 平均剪枝66%条件token几乎无质量损失；去噪速度提升2倍，KV cache模式显存最多缩减73%；可迁移到其他SOTA图像/视频生成模型，条件越多、帧数越长、分辨率越高收益越大。

Conclusion: 将经典编解码冗余建模与on-policy蒸馏结合是一种通用、低成本的条件token压缩方案，具备跨模型、跨模态可扩展性，可作为现有条件生成模型的高效推理插件。

Abstract: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

</details>


### [399] [WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31209)
*Jingxi Chen,Yujia Chen,Cornelia Fermuller,Yiannis Aloimonos,Wen-Sheng Chu,Du Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldLatent 提出以统一 4D 潜空间作为世界感知与生成的共同"协议"，用多模态 VAE 将 4D 外观、几何、动态压缩融合为单一结构化潜表征，使感知与生成成为同一潜空间上的互补去噪过程，单模型单训练循环同时获得零样本 4D 感知、连贯 4D 生成与可控编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPT 的成功源于把理解与生成统一到共享 token 表征，而 4D 时空视觉仍缺乏共同表征协议：深度/相机等感知与生成要么由分离的单向流水线处理，要么由未对齐的单模态空间拼接而成，导致模型碎片化、任务专用化，难以支撑通用 4D 空间智能。

Method: 提出 WorldLatent 框架：1) 设计多模态 VAE，将 4D 视觉外观、几何与动态压缩融合为单一结构化潜表征，形成统一 4D 潜空间协议；2) 在该潜空间上把感知与生成统一表述为对同一潜变量的互补去噪过程，从而用单个生成模型、单一训练循环同时学习两类能力，摆脱任务专用模型与堆叠式单模态表征。

Result: 在代表性 4D 基准上，融合潜协议在单一模型内实现专家级零样本 4D 感知、连贯 4D 生成以及可控编辑，表明异构 4D 任务可在共享表征协议下统一。

Conclusion: 该工作证明统一潜表征协议可无缝统合多样 4D 任务，为通用 4D 空间智能提供可扩展基础；抽象未给出定量指标、实时性与代码/泛化细节，其"专家级"提升幅度与真实场景泛化仍需验证。

Abstract: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [400] [LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31216)
*Richeek Das,Pratik Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析LeJEPA中SIGReg正则项无法真正实现各向同性高斯的两个问题（正则项弱、目标过严），并提出PolarReg：只约束特征模长与方向的边缘分布而不强制独立性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeJEPA依赖SIGReg将特征正则化为各向同性高斯，但作者认为该目标在实践中无法达到，且与对齐项存在冲突：对齐项将特征模长与方向耦合，而各向同性高斯要求二者独立。因此需要重新审视该正则项的有效性与目标合理性。

Method: 提出两点分析结果：(1) 设计改进正则项以更好地实现原目标；(2) 论证自监督编码器不应具有各向同性高斯特征，指出对齐项与SIGReg冲突，且实测LeJEPA特征并非各向同性；(3) 将各向同性高斯正则重构为仅约束模长与方向的边缘分布（不强制独立），得到简洁的PolarReg项，无需调参即可在多种数据集、批大小和嵌入维度上稳定优化。

Result: 改进后的正则项在ImageNet-100上以1.3倍更少epoch达到SIGReg的最终精度；PolarReg在ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch匹配LeJEPA及其变体精度，并提升最终精度1.8个点。

Conclusion: LeJEPA的各向同性高斯目标既弱又过严；仅约束模长与方向边缘分布的PolarReg更符合自监督表征的实际结构，收敛更快、精度更高且对超参鲁棒。

Abstract: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

</details>


### [401] [CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31222)
*Mohammed Baharoon,Sung Eun Kim,Mahmoud Hussain Alabbad,Lucas Bijnens,Ali Piracha,Reem Alwasiah,Talal Yahyan,Abdulrahman Alamoudi,Mashael Alshehri,Rayan Alsager,Hannah Hancock,Anna M. Hunkemöller,Peter Youssef,Mona A. Alhammad,Afnan Aljumayan,Brecht Van Berkel,Eric Bijnens,Saud Alhussain,Maarten Steyvers,Rolf Symons,Bryan Eelen,Ayed Alaklubi,Maha Buraykan Alshammari,Amirah Fahad Alshammeri,Tomas Gilvydis,Ibrahim AlTurki,Monerah Almohideb,Ali Alburkani,Shahad Alhomaiani,Fatima Jabali,Abdulrhman Aljouie,Daesung Kim,Junha Im,Michael Moritz,Hassan R. Alomaish,Pranav Rajpurkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CTLink：文本提示驱动的3D胸部CT病灶分割模型，可在扫描上定位报告所述发现，在ReXGroundingCT基准与MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding挑战赛（48队第一）上显著优于VoxTell。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射报告仅以文字描述所见，未在影像上标注对应位置，读者无法直观看到每条发现指向哪个异常区域；现有文本提示分割模型在胸部CT报告级病灶定位上性能不足。

Method: 提出CTLink文本提示3D分割模型，训练于4123例平扫胸部CT、9547条已分割报告发现，含新标注数据集ReXGroundingCTv2（1134例、1895条发现，且每条发现的每个实例均被分割）；评估用hit rate、instance F1与mean Dice，并用7模型集成参赛；由两位独立放射科医师对50例重复分割以衡量人机一致性与评分者间一致性。

Result: ReXGroundingCT验证集（200例）上hit rate 0.816、instance F1 0.456、mean Dice 0.400，对比VoxTell的0.533/0.175/0.234（P<.001均显著）；MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding测试集上7模型集成取得48支队伍中最高的hit rate（0.782）与instance F1（0.386）；在50例上达到或超过放射科医师间一致性。

Conclusion: CTLink实现了报告级文本提示的3D病灶分割并达到领先水平，模型权重与数据集开源；主要局限为弥散性非局灶性发现，其范围标注即使医师之间也不一致。

Abstract: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at this https URL , and the dataset at this https URL .

</details>


### [402] [Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31225)
*Mohammad Hossein Moslemi,Mahdi Beitollahi,Zhimin Mei,Jiale Cai,Bissan Ghaddar,Boyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIPA：将合成图像视为可学习原型，冻结编码器按特征相似度分配真实样本，通过最大化跨增强视图分配的互信息并避免平凡解，实现高效的SSL数据集蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏(DD)在监督学习上已较成熟，但自监督学习(SSL)场景下研究不足——蒸馏数据需保留对增强不变表示学习至关重要的信息，现有方法难以保证跨增强视图的一致性。

Method: 提出互信息原型对齐(MIPA)：把合成图像作为可学习原型，用冻结编码器将真实样本按特征相似度分配到原型；将"同一真实图像多个增强视图应得到稳定原型分配"作为增强不变性代理目标，通过跨视图分配间的互信息最大化来优化合成图像，同时抑制所有样本坍缩到少数原型的平凡解。

Result: 在图像分类基准上，MIPA生成的合成数据训练出的表示质量优于现有蒸馏方法，同时降低蒸馏过程的时间与存储开销。

Conclusion: MIPA以冻结编码器+原型分配+互信息目标的形式，为SSL数据集蒸馏提供了简洁高效的一体化方案，兼顾表示质量与蒸馏成本。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

</details>


### [403] [TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31233)
*Hani Alomari,Md Atabuzzaman,Chris Thomas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过"成对统计量"找出双塔编码器在难负样本上比匹配对上更一致的权重方向，用LLM agent做权重空间编程得到闭式修正，并蒸馏为TowerBridge：秒级计算、无需微调即可提升21个CLIP检查点的检索性能并降低hubness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP式双编码器存在模态间隙(modality gap)，导致难负样本常排在正确匹配之前而使检索失败；但事后强行去除间隙在所有检查点上都损害检索，说明"间隙本身"并非症结，需要定位真正有害的方向。

Method: 提出一个成对统计量，识别两塔在难负样本上一致性高于匹配对的方向；借权重空间编程(weight-space programming)由LLM agent检视两塔并写出闭式权重编辑（无反向传播），可编辑任意组件（13个中有12个选择改输出投影）。随后基于难负样本margin的一阶分析，将该反复出现的修正蒸馏为TowerBridge——仅用25,000对标注数据、秒级计算的闭式配方，架构与推理成本不变。

Result: 在21个CLIP检查点（含8个agent未见过的）上平均提升COCO test检索16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k test 6.6；ImageNet零样本精度下降不超过0.5点；在全部21个检查点上降低hubness；在另外4/5个其他家族双编码器上也提升检索。

Conclusion: 检索失败的原因是特定"对齐过度"的方向而非模态间隙本身；沿这些方向轻度衰减即可在不破坏表征结构的前提下提升跨模态检索与检索分布（hubness），且方法轻量通用、可迁移至未见模型与其他双编码器家族。

Abstract: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

</details>


### [404] [Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31237)
*JB Kim,Byungwoo Jeon,Kyungmin Lee,Hyeonmo Kang,Cheonbok Park,Shinyoung Joo,Jinwoo Shin,Jeonghoon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Integral 将预训练视觉语言模型扩展为统一多模态模型，核心是让理解与生成共享同一视觉表征空间：Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的分层特征构造共享视觉 token，Block-wise MoT 引入仅在 block 边界与 VLM 交互的轻量生成流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一理解与生成的多模态模型难以兼顾两种能力；直接复用预训练 VLM 的已有知识可行，但该知识难以被视觉生成模块有效利用。作者指出关键瓶颈在于理解与生成使用异质视觉表征。

Method: 构建共享视觉表征空间，含两个互补组件：(1) Abstraction Fusion——在冻结视觉编码器上聚合层级表征，生成共享视觉 token；(2) Block-wise MoT——轻量生成流仅在 block 边界处与 VLM 交互。整体保持预训练理解能力的同时赋予生成能力，并做控制实验对比"共享表征"与"独立表征空间"。

Result: 在保持原有理解能力的同时获得较强视觉生成能力；控制实验显示，在重建保真度相当的前提下，共享视觉表征相较独立表征空间显著提升生成学习效果。

Conclusion: 预训练 VLM 学习到的表征本身已可作为视觉生成的有效基础；统一模型中表征共享是关键设计维度，而非仅靠增加生成能力或重建指标。

Abstract: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

</details>


### [405] [Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31238)
*Zihang Lin,Huaiyuan Qin,Liangli Zhen,Qing Guo,Jun Liu,Yew-Soon Ong,Hongyuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现自监督ViT（DINOv2/v3）在白噪声上存在"空想性视错觉"（pareidolia）：少数特征方向在patch间形成空间连贯模式，构成"空想子空间"，在自然图像上占据大部分特征方差，并抑制了物体涌现能力；提出免训练的Pareidolia Subspace Calibration（PSC），仅在噪声输入上测量该子空间并缩减其方向方差，从而在物体发现、显著性检测和视频物体分割上大幅提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOv2/DINOv3的稠密特征虽更强，但其"物体涌现"（在patch上自动识别物体）能力远不如DINO。此前缺乏对这一差距成因的机理解释。作者类比人类空想性视错觉，试图揭示自监督ViT特征中隐藏的虚假空间结构问题。

Method: 1）在纯白噪声输入上分析ViT特征，发现少数方向形成空间连贯模式（pareidolic subspace）；2）量化该子空间在自然图像特征方差中的占比；3）逐层追踪该现象的形成位置，并对比patch级损失与图像级损失的训练方式；4）提出Pareidolia Subspace Calibration（PSC）：仅在噪声输入上估计空想子空间，对自然输入特征沿这些方向做方差缩减校准，无需重新训练。

Result: 空想子空间在DINOv2/DINOv3的自然图像特征方差中占主导，而在DINO中占比很小，可解释物体涌现能力差距；缩放该子空间可稳定恢复物体发现能力；该现象在所有自监督模型的中间block形成，但仅在使用patch级损失训练的模型中延续到最后一层，仅用图像级损失时在受控训练下会消退。PSC在物体发现上提升最多31.7 CorLoc，显著性检测提升30.2 maxF，视频物体分割提升59.9 J。

Conclusion: ViT中的空想性虚假空间结构由patch级训练目标固化，是物体涌现能力的主要阻碍；基于噪声估计的免训练校准方法PSC可显著提升多种物体涌现任务，提供了特征分析与实用工具的双重贡献。

Abstract: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous this http URL find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features this http URL call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic this http URL natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in this http URL excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their this http URL experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than this http URL findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining this http URL diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object this http URL identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

</details>


### [406] [Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31239)
*Chen Wang,Jiahui Huang,Riccardo de Lutio,Alex Trevithick,Bryan Chu,Jiawei Ren,Laura Leal-Taixé,Shengyu Huang,Lingjie Liu,Haithem Turki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lyris 提出长视频生成框架：在已观测区域使用持久点云记忆作为锚点，在未观测区域由视觉语言模型（VLM）生成"每个物体一个带标签 3D box"的粗粒度布局并沿相机轨迹渲染，从而联合实现长时间、精确相机控制且返程一致的场景漫游。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭单张照片生成长时程、远距离漫游视频时，现有方法各有缺陷：基于记忆的视频生成方法只能保持已见内容，超出视域后没有锚点，导致相机漂移，且文本提示只能命名物体而无法确定位置；布局条件方法能提供精确锚点与空间控制，但依赖人工标注布局。根因是"未观测区域缺少锚点"。

Method: 双锚点混合框架：(1) 持久点云记忆记录已观测或已生成区域；(2) 未观测区域由 VLM 创作 3D 布局，粒度极粗——每个物体仅一个带标签的 3D 包围盒，便于 VLM 生成与用户编辑；(3) 将布局沿相机路径渲染为条件，驱动视频模型生成，实现相机可控且空间一致的扩展。

Result: 从单张照片生成超过 3 分钟、超过 50 米的漫游，可穿过门框进入照片中从未出现的房间；在四个数据集的分钟级往返（round-trip）评测中，相机误差降低 3.8 倍，返程一致性平均提升 22%，大幅超越 SOTA。

Conclusion: 粗粒度 3D box 布局是 VLM 与视频生成模型之间高效可行的接口；"记忆 + 生成式布局"双重锚定可同时解决长距离相机漂移与空间一致性问题，并可支持用户交互编辑。

Abstract: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

</details>


### [407] [Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31240)
*Seongchan Kim,Soowon Son,Sangoh Kim,Hyunah Ko,Eunbeen Hong,Hyunkoo Lee,Sanghyun Lee,WonJun Moon,Kihong Kim,Dongyeon Son,Woongchan Nam,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对自动驾驶推理型VLA模型提出结构化剪枝方法MoOP，融合推理与轨迹两个目标的重要性排序剪VLM，并聚合去噪步重要性固定选择专家MLP通道子集；参数减30%仍不崩塌，减39.4%得1.37倍加速与36.6%省显存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型VLA（用CoT指导动作生成）带来显著显存与算力开销，需要在保持场景理解与轨迹预测的同时压缩模型。作者通过Taylor重要性分析发现：推理与轨迹目标对同一VLM结构的重要性分配不同；动作专家中MLP通道在去噪步间的重要性排序比query head更稳定，且少数通道贡献大部分重要性。

Method: MoOP：VLM侧将推理目标与轨迹目标的重要性秩融合进行剪枝；动作专家侧聚合各去噪步的重要性以选取固定MLP通道子集，实现一次性结构化剪枝，无需剪枝后微调。

Result: 总参数减24.0%（仅剪VLM）时驾驶指标持平或略优于最强基线，LingoQA保留94.0%；减30.0%时退化最小且推理能力不崩塌；剪除93.75%专家MLP通道后总减39.4%，开环误差几乎不变、闭环具竞争力；端到端推理加速1.37倍，峰值显存降36.6%，无需微调。

Conclusion: 多目标重要性融合与跨步聚合的通道选择可有效压缩推理型VLA，在保持理解与轨迹能力的同时获得实际部署收益；属相邻领域的模型效率工作，非具身核心任务。

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

</details>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [408] [Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28612)
*Yifei Cheng,Xiaolin Zhang,Yu-Xuan Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究选择题问答中的选项排列偏置（permutation bias），提出共享位置编码结构（SP-B/SP-V）配合纯注意力蒸馏（attention-only distillation）在降低排列敏感性的同时恢复准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在选择题/文本选项重排序场景下对选项顺序敏感（permutation bias），导致预测不稳定；仅靠多数投票或结构调整存在准确率损失，缺乏对根因的系统分析与兼顾鲁棒性与精度的方案。

Method: ①将排列偏置现象归为四类典型场景；②以MCQA文本选项重排为例做根因分析；③结合set encoding提出共享位置+blocked cross-unit attention（SP-B），并扩展为双向cross-unit attention（SP-V）以支持模态交互；④针对结构性改动带来的精度下降，提出从冻结原生模型进行的attention-only蒸馏以恢复模型能力。

Result: 在三个模型上，方法在全排列宏平均准确率上持平或优于多数投票，并比监督微调高1.95–4.20个百分点；共享位置降低排列敏感度，attention-only蒸馏在SP结构下提升准确率。

Conclusion: 共享位置设计可有效抑制排列偏置，attention-only蒸馏可弥补其精度代价，为排列偏置缓解与模型能力恢复提供了可行范式。

Abstract: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three models, our method is comparable to or better than majority voting in macro-average all-permutation accuracy, and outperforms supervised fine-tuning by 1.95-4.20 percentage points. This work provides valuable insight into permutation bias mitigation and model capability recovery.

</details>


### [409] [Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28745)
*Jianxin Gao,Bohan Chen,Runze Li,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RuleCraft 基准（1240 个图像问答，覆盖 155 条 Minecraft 规则，答案经游戏引擎验证），发现多模态大模型在"仅看图像"时会用现实物理而非游戏规则作答；在提示中命名游戏可显著提升准确率（主集 8.2–19.8 分，压力集 33.8–52.7 分）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测在提示中显式命名游戏，混淆了"规则知识"与"世界选择"能力，无法判断模型是否真正依据游戏规则进行推理。

Method: 构建三条件对照评测：文本问答、图像+游戏名、纯图像；所有结果由游戏引擎校验；辅以推理链分析、两种额外游戏迁移实验，以及中性的"请给出所示世界的规则"提示干预。

Result: 六个主流模型均知晓规则且能识别游戏，但纯图像条件下按现实物理作答；错误集中于游戏与现实偏离的规则、尤其游戏使场景保持不变的情形；推理链先陈述游戏规则再按现实作答；命名游戏主要是"替换"而非"补充"现实默认；一项中性提示即可恢复大部分差距。

Conclusion: 命名游戏的评测只衡量规则知识，不反映世界选择；需引入"仅观测"条件下的规则应用评测。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models can state the rules of a video game, but do they apply them when they only see the game? We introduce RuleCraft, 1,240 image questions over 155 Minecraft rules with outcomes verified in the game engine, each asked in text, on the image with the game named, and on the bare image. Six widely used models know the rules and recognize the game, yet answer the bare image by real-world physics: naming the game raises their accuracy on rules where the game departs from reality by 8.2-19.8 points on a main set and by 33.8-52.7 on a hard stress-test set. Their errors pick the real-world outcome, the gap is largest where the game leaves a scene unchanged, and reasoning traces state the game's rule, then answer by reality. On the main set, naming the game mostly swaps the real-world default for the game's. The pattern holds with reasoning, recurs in two more games, and persists on questions the models themselves take to be about the game; one neutral sentence asking for the rules of the world shown recovers much of the gap. Evaluations that name the game measure knowledge of its rules, not world selection.

</details>


### [410] [Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28947)
*Jiaqi Su,Jie-Jing Shao,Yichen Liu,Long-Kai Huang,Haiyan Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NightWatch：为视觉语言模型计算机使用智能体（CUA）配备 0.8B 的 System-1 流式监控模型，持续跟踪界面状态，把每个动作决策锚定在"当前"状态而非陈旧快照，从而弥合感知-动作延迟差（perception-action gap）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CUA 以离散截图感知环境，VLM 推理延迟大 + 界面高度动态，导致观测在动作执行前已过期，产生陈旧动作与空等；缺乏实时态势感知。

Method: 即插即用框架：不改动智能体的模型、提示词与动作空间。主 VLM 智能体与轻量 System-1 监视器 NightWatch-0.8B 耦合，对界面状态做流式监控，低算力低延迟地维护环境同步，仅在状态变化时及时唤醒/纠正决策。

Result: OSWorld-Verified 上非推理 wall-clock 时间降 33%、浪费时间降 53%，任务成功率持平；DynaCU-Bench 上大 VLM 智能体成功率 39.5%→44.2%；在仅截图输入下优于 AOI、PUSV 等被动观察基线，并优于参数量大 30 倍以上的 System-1 决策模型。

Conclusion: 感知的"时序"与"内容"同等关键；该工作指向持续具备环境意识的智能体范式，而非逐回合感知。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than $30\times$ its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.

</details>


### [411] [How Reliable is AI-Generated Audio Description? A Multilingual Expert Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29658)
*Annette Rios,Lukas Fischer,Sarah Ebling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对意大利语和德语电影AI生成音频描述（AD）脚本进行专家评估，比较GPT-4o与Qwen流水线与人工描述的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业音频描述制作成本高，限制了盲人及低视力群体的可及性；近年出现大量自动化AD脚本/音频生成方法，但缺乏系统的专家质量评估。

Method: 由专业音频描述员对AI生成的AD脚本进行评分与错误标注，采用细粒度错误分类体系（内容、角色、流畅性、连贯性），对比GPT-4o、基于Qwen的流水线与人工撰写描述三类来源。

Result: GPT-4o优于Qwen模型，但两者均显著落后于人类专业水平：错误率明显更高、质量评分更低。错误集中在两方面：1）角色指代问题（识别错误与命名不一致）；2）内容错误与幻觉（错误表述或虚构事件），这些直接影响观众对叙事的理解。

Conclusion: 当前AI生成的AD脚本尚不足以替代专业人类撰写，后续研究应重点改进角色指代一致性与事实/幻觉控制。

Abstract: Audio description (AD) makes visual media, such as video, accessible to blind or low-vision (BLV) audiences, but the high cost of professional production limits coverage. Due to recent advances in AI, numerous approaches to automatically generate intermediate AD scripts and/or final AD audios have been proposed. We present an expert evaluation of AI-generated AD scripts for movies in Italian and German that compares two AI systems, a GPT-4o- and a Qwen-based pipeline, against human-authored descriptions. Professional audio describers rated description quality and annotated errors using a detailed error taxonomy that includes content, character, fluency and coherence errors. The results show that while GPT-4o outperforms the Qwen models, both AI systems still fall short of human professional quality: the generated descriptions show substantially higher error rates and lower quality ratings. Based on the error annotations, we identify two key areas that require improvement: 1) character references, which includes both issues with identification and coherent naming, and 2) content errors and hallucinations, where the AD misrepresents or invents events. These error types are particularly critical, as they directly affect the viewer's ability to follow the narrative.

</details>


### [412] [Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29874)
*Tardelli Ronan Coelho Stekel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对VLM转录手写作文时"过度纠正"的问题，作者构建BRESSAY基准（1000篇巴西葡语手写作文），在CER之外加入错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率/召回率与行结构指标；微调LightOnOCR-3-1B得到Escriba-OCR-1B，CER从5.6%降至2.06%，并可在CPU上4bit量化运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 写作反馈工具与研究需要对学习者手写作文做忠实转录，保留拼写错误、换行、删除线与插入内容；但现有VLM虽能识别手写，却倾向于把文本改写成"正确语言"，使错误被抹平、编辑痕迹丢失。同时学校侧需要可本地部署的开源权重模型，缺乏针对性的评测基准。

Method: 发布BRESSAY（1000页巴西葡语手写作文）及评测基准：在CER基础上增加错误保留率、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率/召回率与行结构一致性，并用配对bootstrap置信区间评估。评测22个开源基线（最好为Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B，CER 5.6%），确认均无法可靠复现编辑标记且将39–78%的词典外词替换为标准词。随后在647页训练集上单卡85分钟微调LightOnOCR-3-1B得到Escriba-OCR-1B，并做三随机种子稳定性、4bit量化CPU推理、跨语料（40封他语料信件）泛化及权重插值实验，另附教师人工复核。

Result: Escriba-OCR-1B达2.06% CER，比最佳基线低3.5点（95% CI [−4.2, −2.9]）；ICDAR 2024竞赛指标下2.1% CER，优于已发表最佳页级结果（2.2–2.4%）。恢复67%插入、77%不可辨认删除，97%页面行结构一致，但仍将60%疑似拼写错误规范化。三种子差异≤0.04 CER；4bit量化后普通CPU约1分钟/页。跨语料上与该基座模型持平（且无其附加注释），但对未见词误读更多，权重插值可弥补约一半差距。教师复核显示45%可判定的"疑似纠正"实为BRESSAY真值错误，说明基于词典的指标可能低估保留能力。

Conclusion: VLM的"规范化倾向"可量化且可通过小规模微调显著缓解；开源1B模型在忠实转录（错误、编辑标记、行结构）上超过大模型基线并具备校园CPU可部署性。但拼写错误规范化仍未彻底解决，且基于词典的自动评估存在系统性偏差，需人工复核校正。作者开源模型、基准代码与复核数据。

Abstract: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.

</details>


### [413] [Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30460)
*Ting Chen,Geng Li,Guohao Chen,Hanjia Lyu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CONCOR 受控评测基准，用 Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM) 直接衡量对比解码(CD)方法在真值候选与各类幻觉候选之间的竞争关系，并分析校正的方向一致性、组成与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式与判别式基准只看最终任务分数，易被候选过滤、生成轨迹变化和响应偏置混淆，无法隔离对比解码调整本身的效果。

Method: 构建受控基准，直接比较真值答案与不同类型幻觉候选在对比校正后的分数差，以 CGM 作为核心指标，并扩展为方向一致性、校正成分分解与可靠性分析。

Result: 现有 CD 方法呈现不同校正行为：部分方法稳定偏向真值候选；另一些校正幅度大但引入更多错误。这解释了它们对增大对比强度的相反响应（部分提升、部分退化）。

Conclusion: 应评估对比校正本身而非仅依赖最终输出性能；CONCOR 提供了可控、可解释的框架以理解和改进 CD 幻觉缓解方法。

Abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). CGM also enables analysis of directional consistency, composition, and reliability of contrastive corrections. Our evaluation reveals that existing CD methods exhibit distinct correction behaviors: some consistently favor ground-truth candidates, whereas others produce strong corrections but also introduce more errors. Crucially, these differences help explain their contrasting responses to increased contrast strength, which improves some methods while degrading others. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating the contrastive correction itself, rather than relying solely on final-output performance, and CONCOR provides a controlled and interpretable framework for understanding and improving CD methods for hallucination mitigation.

</details>


### [414] [ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31198)
*Rui Sun,Junhua Huang,Luca Zancato,Md Mofijul Islam,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ToolSmith：让多模态搜索智能体自动生成并复用新工具，在瘦身基础工具库上持续扩展，提升域内与域外检索问答表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态搜索智能体依赖手工打造的小型搜索/视觉工具库，构建维护成本高且对新型查询、证据格式与失败模式僵化；人类则能从熟悉部件中临时造新工具并跨任务复用，故需自动工具生成框架。

Method: 提出 ToolSmith 自动工具生成框架：以精简基础工具库为起点，按需自动生成新模块化工具，并在多轮推理+视觉+实时搜索流程中复用；在不同规模主干 VLM 部署的智能体上验证，含 3 个域内多模态搜索基准与 10 个域外基准，采用 VLM-as-a-Judge 评估协议。

Result: ToolSmith 在所有部署智能体上一致优于基础工具库，且较大主干模型收益更大，体现出可扩展性。

Conclusion: 自动工具生成与复用是替代手工工具库的可行路径，具备随模型规模放大的收益潜力；但评估主要依赖 LLM/VLM 判分，缺乏物理或真实场景验证。

Abstract: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>

### [415] [Lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering for Trojan-Resilient AI Inference Engines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29734)
*Soumita Chatterjee,Sudip Ghosh,Tamal Ghosh,Bhargab B. Bhattacharya,Hafizur Rahaman*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出免训练的谱子空间滤波（SSF）框架：利用SVD在隐特征空间分离良性/恶意子空间，推理时对激活做谱投影"清洗"，抑制多触发器后门且无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多触发器后门攻击效应分布隐蔽，难以检测与缓解；现有去后门方法多需重训练或已知触发器。

Method: 离线采集少量触发样本，提取隐层特征；用SVD识别主导的恶意子空间，在推理时对激活进行子空间投影（谱擦洗）以压制后门激活分量；不修改模型权重、不重训练。

Result: 在AlexNet、ResNet18、VGG16、MobileNetV2、ViT上，ASR由94.2–99.8%降至平均2.07%，干净精度最高保持98.54%，推理开销低；对不同投毒率和多触发器并发具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 一种轻量运行时防御，适用于AI推理引擎/加速器部署场景，但仅在图像分类骨干与单一子空间线性假设下验证，缺乏下游任务与真实部署评估。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a significant security threat to deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on AI inference engines and hardware accelerators. By embedding hidden triggers during training, these attacks induce malicious behavior while maintaining high accuracy on benign inputs. Multi-trigger backdoor attacks are particularly challenging to detect and mitigate because of the distributed and stealthy nature of their effects. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a training-free Spectral Subspace Filtering framework that detects and suppresses backdoor-induced activations by analyzing latent feature representations. Exploiting the geometric separation between benign and malicious feature distributions, the framework employs Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify the dominant malicious subspace and performs inference-time spectral scrubbing through activation projection. This approach suppresses backdoor effects without model retraining, requiring only a small set of triggered samples collected offline. Experimental evaluation across CNN and transformer architectures, including AlexNet, ResNet18, VGG16, MobileNetV2, and Vision Transformer (ViT), demonstrates that the proposed method reduces the attack success rate (ASR) from 94.2-99.8% to an average of 2.07%, while preserving clean accuracy of up to 98.54% with low inference overhead. The framework also demonstrates robustness across varying poisoning rates and multiple concurrent triggers, highlighting its potential as a lightweight runtime defense for enhancing the security and reliability of AI inference engines against backdoor attacks.

</details>


### [416] [EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30004)
*Zehao Liu,Huashuo Lei,Xi Lin,Haoang Li,Yuliang Chen,Huarui Zhang,Yifan Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 EnvTrap：不改模型与指令、仅重排环境中已有物体即可诱发具身智能体的危险动作，并给出后果感知防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能的攻击面从文本/视觉扩展到物理环境，已有攻击依赖注入指令、对抗视觉输入或训练期改策略，需研究"仅环境层面"操纵是否足以造成安全后果。

Method: 构造 paired safe/trap/null-trap 三类场景的诊断流水线，在 5 个动作策略与世界模型上测试仅在环物体重排下的危险动作率；用后果预测任务对照模型与人类准确率；提出 consequence-aware 防御。

Result: 仅环境扰动使危险动作率平均达 83.4%；世界模型呈相似脆弱模式；后果预测准确率接近随机而人类较高；防御在仿真降低陷阱触发率 76.3 个百分点、真实后端合并降低 62.9 个百分点。

Conclusion: 漏洞根源是物理推理缺陷——模型能识别任务相关物体但无法预见空间关系如何改变行为后果；EnvTrap 使该缺口可测，并可将危险布局转为安全训练数据。

Abstract: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface.
