Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [417] [SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28185)
*Sudhakar Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAMA is a training-free rPPG estimator that fuses quality-weighted POS/CHROM spectra, suppresses pulse-free reference bands, tracks heart rate via Viterbi with a random-walk prior, and outputs a per-window confidence-weighted waveform; it achieves the lowest cross-dataset mean MAE at 30s and 10s window levels but does not beat neural baselines per video.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Standard rPPG benchmarking reports one heart rate per video, which conceals the short-window behaviour relevant to real tele-consultation pulse reading; the authors further stress that learned methods rely on dataset-specific tuning and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video.

Method: Training-free pipeline: (i) quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra; (ii) discounting frequencies occupied by pulse-free references from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry, background brightness); (iii) Viterbi ridge tracking of heart rate under a random-walk prior; (iv) track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with per-window confidence. No learned parameters or dataset-specific tuning. Evaluated on 218 recordings/111 participants across UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a 2-participant MMPD subset, using a fixed face box and a re-implemented rPPG-Toolbox protocol.

Result: Lowest cross-dataset mean MAE at all protocol levels: 4.40 vs 5.13 bpm per video; 4.80 vs 5.43 (30s); 5.05 vs 6.59 (10s). Bootstrap intervals of paired differences vs POS exclude zero on 30s and 10s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video; no gain on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Rejecting the 20% least confident windows cuts pooled 10s error from 4.06 to 2.33 bpm. Per-video protocol found to have a 1.2-1.6 bpm floor when heart rate drifts; skin tone not recoverable from uncalibrated video; method underperforms top published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG.

Conclusion: A transparent, tuning-free classical signal-processing baseline yields reliable short-window heart-rate tracking with calibrated per-window confidence and exposes the limits of the per-video benchmark, but it is not a state-of-the-art replacement for learned rPPG models; the authors advocate instrumented, skin-tone-stratified data collection.

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

</details>


### [418] [torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28195)
*Vajira Thambawita,Pål Halvorsen,Ole-Christoffer Granmo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: torchtsetlin将Tsetlin Machine家族实现为原生PyTorch模块，用批式二项采样实现Type I/II反馈，训练较GPU基线快2.4–81.2倍且精度持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Tsetlin Machine实现为C/CUDA内核加sklearn风格封装，脱离深度学习生态，难以与PyTorch模型、设备迁移和训练流程集成。

Method: 将自动机状态表示为张量缓冲区，实现vanilla/weighted/coalesced/回归/卷积（序列、图像、体数据）及逐像素分割等变体；核心是把Type I与Type II反馈批式化，把自动机状态跃迁转化为事件计数并以二项分布抽样实现，每个mini-batch仅一次提交。

Result: 在来自现有库的十个基准上与基线精度相当；除两个最小基准外，同GPU下比PyTsetlinMachineCUDA快2.4–10.9倍、比tmu快10.3–81.2倍；支持.to(device)、state_dict()与单次update(x,y)更新。

Conclusion: 提供纯Python、MIT许可、PyPI可安装的可解释规则学习工具包，全部结果由单一脚本复现。

Abstract: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: this https URL package: this https URL .

</details>


### [419] [From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28197)
*Changyu Du,Stavros Nousias,Syed Salman Ahmed,Kai Dietmair,Mohammad Alrabab'h,André Borrmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: S2Bench：将场景级Scan-to-BIM建模形式化为"智能体3D编码"任务，128个真实场景、专家参考模型，含并行异步协作框架，并评测5个智能体与1个协作团队共1028次重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D测量到CAD几何的转换已可行，但建成环境的工程级BIM重建需要语义解释与一致的构造约束，超越单纯曲面拟合；缺乏可统一测量、建模、迭代的评测框架。

Method: 构建S2Bench（5个领域、128个真实扫描场景，公开+私有，配专家参考模型）；共享框架使智能体可在Python中测量扫描、在在线CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件并迭代修正代码；提出并行异步协作——主导者下发版本化任务、并行建模、整合受版本约束的提案。

Result: 领先智能体5cm内覆盖率96%，但mIoU仅63%；无智能体在超过38%的场景通过全部工程检查；覆盖率与工程合规性随场景尺度下降；小模型组队可同时提升三项指标，大场景增益更明显；扫描残差可有效指导几何修复，而语义类别与构造关系难以落地和验证。

Conclusion: Scan-to-BIM的瓶颈在于语义与工程关系推理而非几何拟合，多智能体异步协作是有效改进方向。

Abstract: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at this https URL

</details>


### [420] [Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28532)
*Enguang Fan,Binh Minh Tran,Fulin Wang,Jiaxi Li,Klara Nahrstedt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Walks2Maps 是一个物理引导框架，仅用手机行走中采集的 Wi-Fi RTT 与运动观测，在没有平面图、AP 坐标和位置标签的情况下联合重建室内度量地图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常手机行走是低成本、可扩展的室内几何数据来源，但运动轨迹存在漂移、无线电测距受多径效应扭曲，导致单靠视觉或无线电相似性会得到失真的地图。

Method: 联合优化行人轨迹、AP 位置与每条轨迹的步幅尺度；利用共享 AP 观测跨局部坐标系连接不同行走，利用 RTT 度量范围约束相对几何与尺度；采用非对称 range loss 以适应多径引起的额外延迟；最后由重建路径恢复通道路径布局。

Result: 在办公楼 11 条路线、30 个 AP、22 条手机轨迹上，AP 与轨迹中位误差分别为 0.87 m 与 0.89 m，行走区域 F1 达 0.985；消融显示无线电相似性可识别地点但地图仍失真，保留 RTT 度量信息可消解歧义，非对称建模比对称 loss 将 AP 误差降低 54%。

Conclusion: 无线电与运动测量可联合揭示室内几何，无需专门建图测绘；作者将公开数据集与工具包。

Abstract: Everyday smartphone walks offer a scalable source of indoor geometry, but their motion traces drift and their radio measurements are distorted by multipath. We present Walks2Maps, a physics-guided framework that reconstructs a shared metric map from Wi-Fi round-trip-time (RTT) and motion observations, without a floor plan, surveyed access-point (AP) coordinates, or position labels. Walks2Maps jointly estimates pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and per-trajectory stride scales, then recovers the pathway layout from the reconstructed paths. Shared AP observations connect walks recorded in different local frames, while metric ranges constrain their relative geometry and scale. An asymmetric range loss accommodates multipath-induced excess delay. On 22 phone trajectories collected along 11 routes on an office floor with 30 APs, Walks2Maps achieves median AP and trajectory errors of 0.87 m and 0.89 m, respectively, and a walked-area F1 score of 0.985. Ablations show that radio similarity can recognize places while still producing a distorted map; retaining the metric information in RTT resolves this ambiguity. Asymmetric modeling further reduces AP error by 54% relative to a symmetric loss. These results demonstrate how radio and motion measurements can jointly reveal indoor geometry without a dedicated mapping survey. We will release the dataset and toolkit.

</details>


### [421] [MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29154)
*Kewei Wei,XueXiang Wen,Bocheng Hu,Weili Xu,Haiyang Yu,Kaiyue Zhou,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MVAgent 将多视频理解拆分为"局部观察"与"跨视频判断"，用每个视频一个 LocalAgent 维护私有观察历史，由 GlobalAgent 协调跨视频推理，训练-free。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视频理解需要综合不同视频证据进行跨视频推理，但现有 agent 用单一控制器同时做观察决策与跨视频判断，导致上下文被所有视频的观察累积污染。

Method: 训练-free 框架：每个视频配一个 LocalAgent，自行规划对该视频的观察并保留私有观察历史；GlobalAgent 通过指令调度各 LocalAgent，并结合联合观察整合其报告，完成跨视频推理。

Result: 在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 上，用三种尺寸的 Qwen3.5 平均较同模型单遍推理提升 5.1 分、较最强同类 agent 提升 5.0 分；用 GPT-6-sol 较单遍推理提升 4.3 分；同硬件下速度为同类 agent 的 1.8–2.7 倍。

Conclusion: 显式分离局部观察与全局协调的角色分工，可在不训练的情况下提升多视频推理效果并显著提高效率。

Abstract: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

</details>


### [422] [Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29884)
*Himanshu Gupta,Brendan Crowe,Christoffer Heckman,Bradley Hayes,Zachary Sunberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 系统比较粒子滤波信念（weighted unordered sets）作为RL策略输入的多种编码方案（统计摘要、CGF特征、置换不变集合编码器，含端到端与预训练），在8个POMDP任务上评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粒子滤波能表示多模态信念，但其无序加权集合形式与固定维度的常规策略网络不兼容；需明确哪种粒子信念编码方式最适合作为控制输入，且"重构得好的编码未必利于控制"这一假设值得验证。

Method: 固定信念估计与策略优化，仅变化输入编码：对比统计摘要、累积量生成函数(CGF)特征、置换不变集合编码器（池化类与Set Transformer）；编码器可端到端训练，或以信念重构、任务相关预测进行预训练，亦考察潜空间对齐。

Result: 在8个任务上，池化式集合编码器与梯度CGF特征在端到端训练下表现稳定；Set Transformer配合恰当预训练取得最佳性能。任务特定预训练的收益取决于其目标是否包含决策相关的信念结构；信念重构预训练与潜空间对齐收益更为有限/有选择性。

Conclusion: 粒子信念编码的选择不应仅以重构保真度为标准；能良好重构信念的编码未必是好的控制输入，应按任务相关结构选择与预训练编码器。

Abstract: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.

</details>


### [423] [CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29969)
*Xiaoqian Hu,Ruihong Qiu,Yanran Tang,Sen Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CARE-3D 提出强化学习后训练框架用于具身智能体的情境化 3D  grounding 推理：先用 SFT 建立合法工具交互，再用 GRPO（冻结 3D grounding 模块）优化，并引入「返回证据的反事实归因」做证据敏感信用分配与「组覆盖采样」保持工具覆盖度，在 MSQA/Beacon3D 上优于纯答案+格式奖励的 SFT/GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法从监督轨迹中学习 grounded 交互，主要模仿预设的证据获取模式，而非优化「返回证据对正确答案的支撑度」；同时结果奖励对中间工具选择的信用分配不足，导致低频工具探索不足。作者希望智能体能自适应决定 ground 什么、调用哪一工具、以及如何评估返回证据的效用。

Method: 两阶段：①在 grounding 指令上做 SFT，建立有效的工具调用交互；②用 GRPO 进行强化后训练，3D grounding 模块保持冻结。核心组件：(a) Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence——对单步返回证据做反事实移除/替换以度量其对最终答案的边际贡献，实现细粒度、证据敏感的信用分配；(b) Group Coverage Sampling——在组内采样时约束工具分布，缓解 GRPO 下低频工具欠探索（熵塌缩）问题。

Result: 在 MSQA 与 Beacon3D 两个 3D 场景 QA 基准上，相较仅使用答案+格式奖励的 SFT 与标准 GRPO 均获稳定提升，空间推理子类与 grounding-答案一致性改善尤为明显；代码开源。

Conclusion: 将 RL 后训练的奖励设计从「结果正确」推进到「证据有效性」，可通过反事实证据归因与工具覆盖采样在不改动视觉 grounding 模块的前提下显著提升具身 3D 推理质量。

Abstract: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{ this https URL }{CARE-3D}.

</details>


### [424] [SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30042)
*Jenna Kang,Bingxuan Li,Colin Groth,Anatolii Evdokimov,Sai Zhang,Qi Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SWAM 将多智能体世界模型中的角色状态演化与自回归视觉生成解耦：轻量状态模型仅凭动作传播 NPC 动力学，并用预测状态通过新型条件化方案（指示角色可能出现的区域）引导扩散 Transformer，无需显式几何图或可见性测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依靠视觉历史无法可靠刻画相机视野外独立行动的 NPC 状态；现有联合多视图生成或共享持久状态方法依赖外部地图、场景几何等观测，或预定义状态转移。

Method: 状态-动作世界模型：轻量状态模型从动作传播角色动力学（运动先验 + 学习的场景相关修正），不消耗生成帧；预测状态作为空间条件与视觉历史共同条件化自回归扩散 Transformer，让模型自行学习角色外观与遮挡，而非依赖几何图或可见性测试。

Result: 在基于 Godot 的自定义第一人称射击游戏中，视觉保真度、NPC 一致性及长时程稳定性均优于现有方法；NPC 可在可见性变化、交互与重生中保持观测一致。

Conclusion: 状态-视觉解耦是提升交互式世界模型中多智能体一致性的有效范式，且可避免显式场景几何依赖，具备推广到更复杂交互环境的潜力。

Abstract: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

</details>


### [425] [WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30662)
*Binhui Xie,Jinmin Li,Haomiao Tang,Guangting Wang,Song Jin,Jianwei Zhu,Fengyun Rao,Jing Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WeMM-Ecom：面向电商场景的多模态大模型家族（0.8B稠密至35B MoE/3B激活），采用两阶段持续预训练+混合思维后训练（on-policy蒸馏与RL），在28项电商基准与64项通用基准上评估，并在微信生产环境处理十亿级日请求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态大模型在电商垂类任务（商品目录管理、多模态商品检索、直播电商）上能力不足，需要在保持通用性能的同时实现领域专精。

Method: 五档规模模型族；两阶段持续预训练逐步提高电商数据比例；混合思维后训练结合on-policy蒸馏与强化学习，支持非思考/思考双模式；自建23项内部+5项开源电商基准、8大业务场景，外加64项通用基准

Result: 电商基准上35B-A3B超越Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、HY4、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash等更大旗舰开源模型；通用基准上各规模均超同规模Qwen3.5，轻量版优于MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B、LFM3-VL-2B；已在微信数百个生产场景落地，日请求达十亿级

Conclusion: 验证了"领域数据渐进注入+混合思维后训练"可同时获得电商专精与通用竞争力的可扩展路线，并开源权重与训练细节

Abstract: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at this https URL .

</details>


### [426] [Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30816)
*Gizem Karagoz,Tanir Ozcelebi,Nirvana Meratnia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将XAI的alignment评估形式化为结构化配置空间，系统分析GT表示、指标族、软/硬指标公式与阈值策略等设计选择对评估结论的影响，并提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XAI评估本质需要以人为中心的专家验证，但难以规模化，因此学界普遍采用alignment-based指标（将归因图与预定义GT比对）。然而这类评估隐含地偏向评估过程中的多项设计选择，导致结论可能不可靠，而这些问题缺乏系统性刻画。

Method: 把alignment评估建模为结构化配置空间；构建统一评估框架，在2D/3D合成与真实数据集上交叉建模XAI方法、GT表示、指标族、soft/hard公式与阈值策略之间的交互；提出基于局部熵和边界质量比的归因模式分类法。

Result: 实验揭示存在系统性flow（XAI-GT-指标三元组配置），特定配置下（如soft/hard指标实现）alignment结果呈现不同行为模式；不同指标族与归因结构对阈值敏感度差异显著。

Conclusion: Alignment评估不能被视为固定不变的XAI质量度量；研究为设计更可靠、行为感知的XAI评估协议提供实践性指导。

Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [427] [Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30962)
*Wenhao Wang,Panrong Tong,Quyu Kong,Pengxiang Li,Haowen Yang,chenglin Cai,Siheng Chen,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CUA-SEE 闭环评测环境，从 rollout 证据共同演化任务与可执行验证器，实现基准演化、诊断演化与验证器演化三重目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Computer-use agents (CUAs) 能力快速提升，但现有基准评测仍偏静态：难度上限固定、功能覆盖有限、聚合分数粒度粗，逐渐削弱其区分度与诊断价值。

Method: 构建闭环评测环境，分解为三个目标：(1) 基准演化——通过队列校准难度与覆盖增长扩展评测范围；(2) 诊断演化——利用 agent 条件化的能力边界探针提升分辨率；(3) 验证器演化——将变化的需求转化为状态锚定的检查点并做对抗性验证，提升精度。

Result: 在多个 agent、应用与轮次上，CUA-SEE 能生成有挑战性且可度量的任务，同时保留过程级证据。

Conclusion: 将自适应评测定位为自演化 agent 的可扩展对偶：持续追踪 agent 能做什么、边界在哪、进度测量是否可靠。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [428] [MACE: Memory-Augmented Crop-Disease Evaluation of Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28573)
*Tirtho Roy,Shreyan Ganguly,Muhammad Arbab Arshad,Nikhil Bhattacharya,Soumik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: MACE：免训练方法，用“症状描述+疾病标签”的记忆库增强冻结视觉语言模型，实现跨十种作物的作物病害诊断，分布内准确率42.8%→62.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有作物病害表型依赖专家目视或专用模型，难以规模化；冻结VLM+源知识库只描述典型症状，忽略个体差异。作者希望用检索记忆补足案例级症状变异的描述。

Method: MACE为冻结VLM的知识库补充“症状描述–疾病标签”配对记忆。查询图像先转成文本描述，与记忆匹配后仅检索出文本描述和疾病标签（不检索图像），因此诊断模型只见到查询图像本身；该方法无需训练，并做了标签-only与标签+描述两种检索消融。

Result: 在十种作物上使用Claude Sonnet 5.5，分布内准确率由42.8%升至62.2%，在留出图像集上由50.7%升至57.0%。增益主要来自检索到的疾病标签，附加文本描述在分布内再提升约6个百分点。

Conclusion: 症状记忆检索是以免训练（in-context）方式低成本增强VLM作物病害诊断的有效手段；但任务属农业领域视觉诊断，与具身/3D/世界模型核心议程相关性低。

Abstract: In plant phenotyping, crop disease diagnosis has traditionally relied on expert assessment of visible symptoms and on models tailored to specific crops or diseases, and both are difficult to scale across field conditions. Recent methods provide frozen vision-language models with source-grounded knowledge bases that summarize the typical symptoms of each disease but describe little of how symptoms vary across individual cases. We introduce MACE (Memory-Augmented Crop-Disease Evaluation), a training-free method that supplements the knowledge base with a memory of symptom descriptions paired with known disease labels. MACE matches a description of the query image against this memory and retrieves only text descriptions and disease labels, so the query is the only image that the diagnosis model sees. Across ten crops, MACE with Claude Sonnet 5.5 improved accuracy over the knowledge-base baseline from 42.8% to 62.2% in distribution and from 50.7% to 57.0% on held-out image collections. Retrieved disease labels accounted for most of the gain, and adding the corresponding text descriptions improved in-distribution accuracy by about six percentage points.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [429] [Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29886)
*Neeli Tummala,Mitra J. Hartmann*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 提出以"控制"重构"主动感知"：区分机制性控制、策略性控制与主体性控制三种相互作用形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "主动感知"一词在神经科学与工程学中被广泛使用但缺乏统一定义，导致主动-被动对比含糊不清，也阻碍生物、工程与混合感知系统的统一分析。

Method: 概念性框架构建：将感知的"主动性"重新表述为对感觉获取的控制，并划分为机制性控制（物理上结构感觉输入）、策略性控制（通过自适应与注意过程在闭环中调制感知）、主体性控制（智能体可用的感知策略及其选择权限）三类，分析其单独或组合出现时对感觉输入、知觉、行为与性能的不同后果。

Result: 该框架厘清了主动-被动对比，并通过"控制什么、如何控制、由谁控制"三问，为生物、工程与混合感知系统提供共同的分析基础（摘要未涉及实证验证）。

Conclusion: 主动感知应被理解为感觉获取控制的多种形态；三分控制框架为跨领域研究提供统一术语与比较基准。

Abstract: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [430] [Face Is Not All You Need: MIME Benchmark for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30288)
*Yuxin Jia,Xing Lan,Wensong Wang,Jian Xue,Feiliang Ren,Ke Lu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 该研究形式化定义了不完整多模态情感识别（IMER）任务，构建了覆盖细粒度面部退化、严重面部退化与全模态丢失的MIME基准（2000个视频片段），并提出Chain of Emotion（CoE）分析范式，用定制指标剖析MLLM的情感线索感知与推理过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MER方法假设输入完整且良好对齐，真实场景中的模态退化会导致严重性能崩溃；同时已有鲁棒性评测仅做粗粒度全模态移除，缺乏细粒度不完整设定与可解释的情感推理分析。

Method: 定义IMER任务；构建MIME基准数据集（2000视频片段，含细粒度面部细节退化、严重面部退化、极端全模态丢失三档）；提出CoE分析范式及配套指标，对7个主流MLLM做系统性评测与推理链剖析。

Result: 实验发现面部退化时身体语言与场景上下文是关键补偿机制；模型的基础视觉感知能力与高层认知推理之间存在显著差距。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了聚焦的鲁棒多模态情感识别评测平台和可操作的洞见，但未提出新的鲁棒识别方法或模型架构。

Abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) is a fundamental task in multimedia understanding, where state-of-the-art methods have achieved prominent success relying on the assumption of complete, well-aligned multimodal inputs. However, real-world unconstrained scenarios often suffer from unpredictable modality degradation and information loss, leading to catastrophic performance collapse of existing MER models that heavily depend on facial cues as the core inference anchor. However, few systematic works evaluate model robustness under diverse, fine-grained incomplete settings, as prior works are limited to coarse-grained full-modality removal and neglect interpretable analysis of emotional reasoning. To bridge this gap, we formally define the Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition (IMER) task, which benchmarks model generalization and robustness under multi-grained modality and emotional information loss. We further construct MIME, a dedicated IMER benchmark with 2,000 video segments covering realistic fine-grained facial-detail degradation, severe facial degradation, and extreme full-modality loss, surpassing the limited coarse-grained settings of prior works. We also propose the Chain of Emotion (CoE) analysis paradigm with tailored metrics to dissect the fine-grained emotional cue perception and reasoning process of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments on seven mainstream MLLMs reveal that body language and scene context act as critical compensatory mechanisms under facial degradation, while a pronounced gap exists between models' basic visual perception ability and high-level cognitive reasoning. Our work provides a focused evaluation platform and actionable insights for advancing robust multimodal emotion recognition. Our dataset and code are public at this https URL .

</details>


<div id='cs.GR'></div>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [431] [Temporal Persistence for Stylized Rendering: Historical Image Storage and Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28114)
*Daniel Szelogowski*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何用现代渲染器复刻《塞尔达传说：梅祖拉的假面》中"重叠剪影+渐进淡出"式运动模糊：通过在Godot引擎中实现完整图像历史、共享图像区域、选择性保留像素变化三类方案，并用独立合成的参考图验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 《Majora's Mask》(2000)的重叠剪影与渐进淡出形成独特运动模糊外观——早期场景状态仍保留在当前帧中。现代渲染器复现该效果需权衡历史采样时机、贡献保留方式，以及内存与算力预算下的历史表示。

Method: 在Godot引擎中实现并对比三种历史表示：完整图像历史（10帧、20 Hz采样）、共享图像区域、选择性保留像素变化的稀疏表示；以独立合成的参考图作为评价基准。进一步测量半精度(half-float)存储与自适应/稀疏方案对显存与GPU耗时的影响。

Result: RTX 3060 Ti、10帧@20Hz历史下，半精度存储使历史分配到减半，存储pass中位耗时在720p降2.40倍、1080p降1.73倍，且保持源精度；稀疏表示在低分辨率下减少分配83.81%，但GPU耗时增至445.25倍。

Conclusion: 历史图像的分辨率/精度格式选择是可观的性能杠杆，而稀疏表示虽在大幅节省内存的同时引入极高计算开销；重建元数据与分配策略共同决定内存收益，需按预算取舍。

Abstract: The overlapping silhouettes and gradual fading in The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (released April 27, 2000) produce a distinctive depiction of motion blur, in which earlier scene states remain visible as part of the current image. Reproducing this appearance in a modern renderer involves decisions about when historical images are sampled, how their contributions are retained, and how the resulting history can be represented within the available memory and processing budget. In this paper, we investigate these decisions through complete image histories, shared image regions, and selectively retained pixel changes, using Godot engine implementations evaluated against independently composited references. For a ten-image history sampled at 20 Hz on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti, half-float storage halves history allocation and reduces median storage-pass duration by factors of 2.40 at 720p and 1.73 at 1080p, preserving the supplied source precision. The adaptive experiments examine how memory savings depend on reconstruction metadata and allocation, including a sparse representation that reduces allocation by 83.81% at low resolution with 445.25 times the GPU duration.

</details>


### [432] [STAC++: Plug-and-Play Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Aware Cache Compression for Streaming 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28793)
*Boyi Zhu,Youcheng Cai,Dong Wang*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: STAC++: 一种无需训练、即插即用的流式三维重建框架，通过自适应八叉树空间KV缓存、响应感知缓存压缩与时间上下文精炼，在无界长序列场景下压缩并复用空间记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式3D重建需要在有限显存下保持几何精度，但STAC采用固定分辨率的空间KV缓存，随场景扩展显存持续增长，难以支撑无界长序列重建。

Method: 三项无需训练的模块：(1) Adaptive Spatial KV Cache (ASKC) 用八叉树组织KV状态，按区域与网络层自适应分配分辨率；(2) Response-Aware Cache Compression (RACC) 以注意力输出变化量为准则进行KV合并，兼顾存储节省与几何保持；(3) Temporal Context Refinement (TCR) 复用缓存的中间特征，仅重算骨干网络短后缀，用后续观测精炼历史预测。可插入四种预训练的流式骨干。

Result: 在长序列与大场景上显著降低空间记忆占用，同时保持有竞争力的重建质量；TCR在有限计算开销下进一步带来质量提升。

Conclusion: 空间KV记忆的自适应压缩与复用是突破流式3D重建显存瓶颈的有效途径，且以即插即用形式具备良好通用性与工程实用性。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve geometry under limited memory, yet STAC's fixed-resolution spatial key-value (KV) cache grows as scenes expand. We propose STAC++, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that compresses and reuses spatial memory for long-term reconstruction in unbounded scenes. Adaptive Spatial KV Cache (ASKC) organizes KV states into an octree with adaptive resolutions across regions and layers. Response-Aware Cache Compression (RACC) guides KV merging by measuring attention-output changes, balancing storage savings with geometric preservation. Temporal Context Refinement (TCR) reuses cached intermediate features and recomputes only a short backbone suffix to refine historical predictions with later observations. Integrated into four pretrained streaming backbones, STAC++ reduces spatial memory consumption while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality on long sequences and large scenes, with further quality gains from refinement at limited computational overhead. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [433] [Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30879)
*Amir Razlighi,Ali Mahdavi Amiri,Yiorgos Chrysanthou,Andrey Voynov,Daniel Cohen-Or*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 预训练视觉扩散模型经视觉状态–最佳走法(State–NBM)对微调后，可在图像空间直接预测依赖多步后果的“下一最佳走法”，无需显式搜索或符号表示，重复预测即逐步构造解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列推理任务（棋类、寻路）依赖显式搜索或符号推理；作者想检验视觉扩散模型的生成能力能否自发承载前瞻式价值估计，从而在一次前向预测中做出全局最优决策。

Method: 在预训练视觉扩散模型上，以(当前状态图像, 下一最佳走法)对做简单微调；推理时仅从当前状态图像直接采样走法，无符号表示、无前瞻展开、无搜索；多次NBM预测串行组合成完整解。测试任务：国际象棋残局、栅格寻路（均匀代价与异构地形代价）、Connect Four、围棋、台球。

Result: 国际象棋中合法走法预测准确且找最佳走法频率显著高于检索相似训练局面，并能预测需多步战术才能获利的弃子；寻路中能在均匀代价图上生成最短路径、在异构代价地形上选中总体代价更低的长路线，且地形代价从示例中隐式学得（无数值代价监督）。能力可扩展至Connect Four、围棋与台球。

Conclusion: 直接视觉走法预测可支撑全局性决策与成功的序列求解，说明“策略学习而非搜索”可作为视觉模型完成前瞻性任务的替代路径；为扩散/世界模型在序列决策与规划中的应用提供证据。

Abstract: In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference. Previous work demonstrated that these models can generate complete solutions to geometric and reasoning problems. Here, we show that simple fine-tuning on visual state--NBM pairs enables a pretrained model to select actions whose value depends on consequences several steps ahead. Each move is predicted directly in image space from the current state, without an explicit symbolic representation or search procedure. Repeated NBM predictions then construct a solution one decision at a time. We demonstrate this capability on chess puzzles and tile-based pathfinding, and show that it extends to Connect Four, Go and billiards. In chess, the model predicts legal moves and finds the best move far more often than by recalling similar training positions, including piece sacrifices whose benefit emerges only through later tactical continuations. In pathfinding, it constructs shortest paths on uniform-cost maps and cost-optimal routes across terrain tiles with different traversal costs, choosing longer routes when they are cheaper overall. These costs are learned implicitly from examples, without numerical cost supervision. These results show that direct visual move prediction can support globally informed decisions and successful sequential problem solving.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [434] [5G NR Sensing of Robotic Arm Motion in Indoor Factory Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28053)
*Neeraj Varshney,Anuraag Bodi,Steve Blandino,Jian Wang,Camillo Gentile,Nada Golmie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文构建了面向工业工厂(InF)环境的单站ISAC机械臂运动学跟踪评估框架：基于部件级准确定性信道模型与分层运动学变换生成任意关节运动轨迹，结合3GPP InF信道模型与5G NR PRS波形，在InF-SH/InF-DH场景下量化杂波对感知性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业场景中机械臂的高精度感知是ISAC的重要应用方向，但已有研究多采用简单点目标或刚体模型，缺乏与真实机械臂信道测量、数字孪生匹配的高保真目标模型，也未系统评估工业杂波(尤其密集遮挡)对ISAC跟踪可靠性的制约。

Method: 以自研上下文感知信道测量系统与数字孪生获得的分部件准确定性机械臂信道模型为基础，通过分层运动学变换生成任意铰接运动剖面；将高保真目标模型嵌入标准化3GPP InF信道(含InF-SH、InF-DH两类杂波)，以5G NR PRS为感知波形，采用3GPP合规天线方向图与模拟波束赋形进行系统级仿真，评估检测概率与有效感知覆盖。

Result: LOS条件下可实现较高估计精度；InF-DH密集杂波导致严重遮挡，即便机械臂位于TRP正下方，检测概率也降至约P_d≈10%，有效感知覆盖显著萎缩；InF-SH中达到P_d≥90%要求目标紧邻TRP，有效覆盖半径约13 m。

Conclusion: 工业密集杂波是制约ISAC机械臂跟踪可靠性的主导因素，需要针对性部署/波束与杂波抑制策略；所提框架为关节目标ISAC系统级评估提供了可复用的高保真建模范式。

Abstract: This paper investigates the performance of monostatic Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems for tracking robotic arm kinematics in industrial factory (InF) environments. Building on a part-specific quasi-deterministic channel model previously derived from high-resolution robotic-arm measurements using our context-aware channel sounder and digital twin, we develop a framework for generating arbitrary articulated motion profiles through hierarchical kinematic transformations. By integrating this high-fidelity target model with the standardized 3GPP InF channel model, we employ 5G New Radio (NR) Positioning Reference Signals (PRS) as the sensing waveform to enable comprehensive system-level evaluation. Simulations are conducted for both sparse clutters (InF-SH) and dense clutters (InF-DH) scenarios using 3GPP-compliant antenna radiation patterns and analog beamforming, allowing us to assess the impact of industrial clutter on sensing performance. The results show that while high estimation accuracy is achievable under Line-of-Sight (LOS) conditions, dense clutter in InF-DH environments introduces severe blockage that significantly limits sensing reliability. In particular, the effective sensing coverage in InF-DH is drastically reduced, with detection probability dropping to approximately \(P_d \approx 10\,\%\) even when the robotic arm is located directly beneath the Transmission Reception Point (TRP). Furthermore, in InF-SH, achieving a high detection probability (e.g., \(P_d \geq 90\,\%\)) requires the target to remain in close proximity to the TRP, with an effective coverage radius of approximately 13 m.

</details>


### [435] [FlowPAC: Flow-Guided Visual Pruning and Action Caching for Efficient VLA Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28256)
*Jintao Cheng,Yipu Zhang,Haozhe Wang,Lin Jiang,Jiang Xu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlowPAC 用任务感知光流作为共享物理信号，联合优化 VLA 的视觉 token 与动作计算，实现无需训练的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型推理延迟高、显存占用大，难以边缘部署；现有免训练加速方法（视觉 token 剪枝、动作缓存）采用静态资源分配，与机器人动态交互不匹配，导致控制性能下降，并引起 KV-cache 布局碎片化与关键区域算力浪费。

Method: 提出局部性感知框架 FlowPAC：以任务感知光流为共享物理信号。(1) Direction-Aware Trajectory Propagation (DATP)：沿运动方向传播 token 选择；(2) Locality-Aware Contiguous Token Selection (LACT)：保持保留 token 的空间连续性，降低内存碎片，支持高效 KV-cache 压缩；(3) Flow-Conditioned Action-Block Refresh (FCAR)：依据运动动力学自适应决定动作块刷新。

Result: 在 LIBERO 闭环评测中，30% 视觉 token 保留率下相对 dense 基线获得 2.13× 端到端加速，成功率基本保持。

Conclusion: 将计算分配同时对齐物理动力学与硬件约束，是 VLA 边缘高效部署的关键；仅靠静态剪枝或缓存策略不足。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency and memory footprint remain major barriers to edge deployment. Existing training-free acceleration techniques, such as visual token pruning and action caching, typically rely on static resource allocation. This mismatch with dynamic robotic interactions not only degrades control performance but also causes severe hardware inefficiencies, including fragmented KV-cache layouts and wasted compute on non-critical regions. To address this, we propose FlowPAC, a locality-aware framework that leverages task-aware optical flow as a shared physical signal to jointly optimize visual and action computation. Specifically, we introduce Direction-Aware Trajectory Propagation (DATP) and Locality-Aware Contiguous Token Selection (LACT) to jointly handle visual token dynamics and enforce spatial locality, reducing memory fragmentation and enabling efficient KV-cache compression. This is complemented by Flow-Conditioned Action-Block Refresh (FCAR) for adaptive action computation based on motion dynamics. Extensive closed-loop evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that FlowPAC achieves a 2.13$\times$ end-to-end speedup over the dense baseline while essentially maintaining the success rate with 30% visual-token retention. These results validate that aligning computation allocation with both physical dynamics and hardware constraints is essential for efficient VLA deployment on edge systems.

</details>


### [436] [Neural Fidelity Calibration: Turning Field Anomalies into Simulation Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28260)
*Youwei Yu,Lantao Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC)，用条件流匹配从机器人自身执行数据在线推断仿真器物理参数与残差保真度（未建模动态差异 + 感知环境与真实几何差异），配合仿真训练的异常检测器触发重校准与乐观探索策略；5 个平台（39 参数、128x128 残差地形图）后验最准，真实户外雪/泥/湿草轮式机器人轴故障场景导航成功率 26%→70%，姿态 jerk 降 88%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真到真机迁移的策略在现场常失败：传统仿真器校准只调少数手工挑选参数，即便校准后仍无法刻画未建模动态；而基于机载感知重建的环境又继承传感噪声与伪影。因此需要一种能同时、在线地从执行数据中推断物理参数与"残余保真度"的方法。

Method: 以条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）为核心的生成式后验推断框架，从机器人执行轨迹直接在线推断仿真器物理参数及残差项（残余动态差异 + 感知几何与真实几何之差，表示为 128x128 残差地形图）。用仿真训练的异常检测器仅凭机载传感信号判断何时需要重校准或微调；再用乐观面对不确定性（OFU）的探索策略主动降低后验不确定性。在 5 个机器人平台上验证，最多 39 个校准参数。

Result: 后验分布精度优于既有 simulation-based inference 基线；物理户外实验中，遭遇车轴故障的轮式机器人跨雪地、泥地、湿草，崎岖地形导航成功率从 26% 提升至 70%，姿态 jerk 降低 88%。

Conclusion: 将"残余保真度"显式建模为仿真校准对象，并用条件流匹配实现可扩展的在线后验推断，使仿真器在故障与未知地形下仍具可用保真度，为 sim-to-real 提供了一条无需手工选参、可在线自维护的校准路径。

Abstract: A policy that transfers from simulation to a lab robot often fails in the field. Calibrating a simulator from real-world data typically targets only a few hand-picked parameters, and even calibrated simulators fail to capture unmodeled dynamics, while environments reconstructed via onboard perception inherit sensing noise and artifacts. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), a framework based on conditional flow matching that infers online, directly from a robot's execution data, both simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity - the remaining dynamics discrepancy and the gap between perceived and true environment geometry. A simulation-trained anomaly detector determines when recalibration or fine-tuning is required using onboard sensory signals alone, while an exploration policy actively modulates posterior uncertainty using optimism in the face of uncertainty. Across five robot platforms with up to 39 calibrated parameters and a 128x128 residual terrain map, NFC achieves the most accurate posterior distributions compared to established simulation-based inference baselines. In physical outdoor experiments with a wheeled robot suffering an axle failure across snow, mud, and wet grass, NFC increases rough-terrain navigation success from 26% to 70% while reducing orientation jerk by 88%.

</details>


### [437] [Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28274)
*Youwei Yu,Lantao Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: NFC用条件流匹配在部署中在线校准仿真器物理参数与"残差保真域"，同时建模sim-to-real动力学差异和感知导致的环境不确定性，实现真实到仿真（real-to-sim）的策略微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域随机化需专家物理知识，真实数据标定通常只针对少数手工选定参数；仿真器仍缺失真实效应，基于机载感知重建的环境继承传感误差，限制策略提升。

Method: 条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）在潜空间推断物理参数与残差域的后验；仅当检测到异常时触发预训练策略微调（信息性框架）；顺序NFC以仿真预训练估计器作为提议分布；幻觉策略按"面对不确定性时的乐观主义"调节后验不确定性；从推断后验采样真实环境用于策略精调。

Result: 在5种机器人（最多39个物理参数、128x128残差地形）上，后验精度优于既有仿真推断方法；轴断裂轮式机器人在雪、泥、湿草上，崎岖地形成功率从26%提升至70%，姿态jerk降低88%。

Conclusion: 在线、潜空间、事件触发的仿真器保真度校准可有效弥合sim-to-real差距，并兼顾感知不确定性，具备真实机器人部署验证。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can transfer agile robot skills from simulation to the real world, but closing the sim-to-real gap by domain randomization requires expert physics knowledge, and simulator calibration from real data typically targets a few hand-picked parameters. Even then, simulators miss real-world effects, and environments reconstructed from onboard perception inherit sensing errors that limit policy improvement. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), which uses conditional flow matching to calibrate simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity domains online during deployment. Residual fidelity captures sim-to-real dynamics discrepancies and perception-induced environment uncertainty. NFC operates in a latent space so that realistic environments can be sampled from the inferred posterior for real-to-sim policy fine-tuning. The framework is informative: the pretrained policy is fine-tuned only when an anomaly is detected, sequential NFC seeds its proposal from the simulation-pretrained estimator, and a hallucination policy modulates posterior uncertainty following optimism in the face of uncertainty. NFC attains the most accurate posteriors among established simulation-based inference methods on five robots with up to 39 physical parameters and a 128x128 residual terrain. On a wheeled robot with a broken wheel axle deployed on snow, mud, and wet grass, NFC raises success on rough terrain from 26% to 70% and reduces orientation jerk by 88%. Code and videos will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [438] [Intervention-Robust VLA: Diverse Demonstrations for Robot Deployment with Safety Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28289)
*Tzu-Yuan Huang,Shao-Hsuan Chang,Dai-Jie Wu,Ralf Römer,Yung-Hui Li,Stefan Sosnowski,Angela P. Schoellig,Kenneth Marino,Sandra Hirche*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: InteR-VLA: 用多样化任务完成演示扩大任务相关状态覆盖，使训练分布对齐"带安全过滤的部署分布"，从而在相同数据预算下实现安全干预下仍保持任务能力的干预鲁棒VLA框架，真实实验中Safe Success Rate从0%提升至90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA从演示中学习需覆盖大量安全关键情形，现实采集不可行；测试时安全过滤器可纠正不安全动作，但会把机器人推入训练数据覆盖差的状态，造成分布偏移、任务性能下降。

Method: 提出InteR-VLA干预鲁棒框架：利用多样化任务完成演示扩展任务相关状态覆盖，使训练分布更好地匹配安全过滤后的部署分布，在同等数据预算下缓解干预诱导的分布偏移；在两种VLA主干上进行验证。

Result: 在分布内与分布外真实世界实验中保持安全性，Safe Success Rate由名义策略的0%提升至最高90%，并在两个评测VLA上一致优于名义数据训练。

Conclusion: 通过训练分布与安全过滤部署分布的对齐，可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下获得干预鲁棒的VLA策略，为安全部署提供了数据侧的可落地方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential for learning complex robotic behaviors from demonstrations. However, learning safe behavior directly from data requires extensive coverage of safety-critical situations, which is often impractical in real-world settings. Test-time safety filters provide an alternative by correcting unsafe actions during deployment, but these interventions can drive the robot into states poorly covered by the training data, thereby degrading task performance. We introduce InteR-VLA, an intervention-robust framework for VLAs that leverages diverse task-completing demonstrations to broaden task-relevant state coverage and maintain competence under safety interventions. By better aligning the training distribution with safety-filtered deployment under the same data budget, our approach mitigates intervention-induced distribution shift while preserving task performance. Real-world experiments across in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings show that InteR-VLA maintains safety, increases Safe Success Rate up to 90% from 0% for nominal policies, and consistently outperforms nominal-data training on both evaluated VLAs.

</details>


### [439] [Probing Invisible Actuation Shifts for Test-time Calibration of Visuomotor Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28308)
*Jie Liu,Hui Xie,Qinfeng Feng,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出测试时校准方法PEA：通过主动探测在一集中识别执行偏移（增益/延迟/漂移）并用闭式估计补偿，另用可移除低秩适配器应对视觉偏移，无需训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA/WAM等视觉运动策略部署到相机与控制器不同于训练数据的机器人上，导致两类偏移：视觉偏移（可见，策略可感知）与执行偏移（不可见，只需重调控制器、时延或加负载即出现），后者在域随机化下仍显著降低成功率。

Method: 每个episode前执行短探测动作：逐轴以已知指令移动单臂轴，使增益、延迟、漂移产生可分离响应轨迹；闭式辨识器从响应中估计偏移参数，对后续每条指令做补偿，使机器人执行策略意图的运动；辨识器不依赖策略训练，适用于任意冻结策略。对仍存在视觉偏移的情形，用可移除低秩适配器对冻结策略做测试时自适应。

Result: 在LIBERO上使用WAM与VLA验证：无任何策略训练下，PEA辨识器挽回大部分因执行偏移损失的4成以上成功率；对训练中未见的偏移具泛化性，如Cosmos-Policy在LIBERO-Spatial从61.0%提升至89.7%。

Conclusion: 将执行偏移作为可主动辨识的物理参数、与视觉偏移解耦处理，是提升冻结视觉运动策略跨平台部署鲁棒性的有效且轻量路径，且具备泛化到分布外偏移的能力。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs) are increasingly deployed on robots whose cameras and controllers differ from those used to collect their training data. Such deployment introduces two kinds of shifts. Visual shifts, such as a moved camera, change the observed images; actuation shifts, such as a retuned controller, latency or an added payload, change only how commanded actions translate into robot motion. Invisible to the policy, actuation shifts sharply degrade its success, even under domain randomization. In this work, we propose PEA, a test-time calibration method that identifies actuation shifts through active probing before task execution. Specifically, before each episode, the robot executes a short probe that moves one arm axis at a time with known commands, so that gain, delay and drift leave separable traces. A closed-form identifier estimates them from the response, and PEA compensates every subsequent command so that the robot executes the motion the policy intends. The identifier requires no policy training and thus applies to any frozen visuomotor policy. Since visual shifts remain visible to the policy, PEA further adapts the frozen policy with a removable low-rank adapter, addressing coupled visual and actuation shifts. Experiments on LIBERO with a WAM and a VLA show that, without any policy training, the identifier of PEA recovers most of the success lost to actuation shifts and generalizes to shifts unseen during training (e.g., from 61.0% to 89.7% on LIBERO-Spatial with Cosmos-Policy).

</details>


### [440] [Learning a Food World Model That Predicts the Next State from Production Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28319)
*Inkyu Sa,Gaurav Kuppa,Steve Van der Hoeven,Konstantin Stulov,Rajat Bhageria,Luis Rayas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: From 61,773 self-supervised production picks, learn a food-picking world model that predicts post-pick heightmap and picked mass with uncertainty, achieving 10.93 g RMSE (9% better than commanded target, 24% better than controller's internal estimate).


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Food assembly robots must hit a target weight per pick, but the physical dynamics of scooping food are unclear, and the production controller's internal mass estimate is inaccurate. A predictive world model could support planning and policy learning beyond mass-only regression.

Method: Self-supervised world model trained on 61,773 production picks auto-labeled by camera+scale. Inputs: pre-pick pan heightmap (2.5 mm grid), commanded pick action, food type, utensil. Outputs: post-pick heightmap and picked mass with uncertainty. Evaluated on 12,294 held-out picks over nine foods; compared with gradient-boosted trees on 20 hand-crafted features; uncertainty-based pick rejection.

Result: Test RMSE 10.93 g, 9% below commanded target / per-food mean, 24% below controller's internal estimate; GBT is 0.2 g better but predicts only mass. Rejecting most uncertain picks answers 89.4% with 10.28 g RMSE. Model barely responds to commanded volume/depth (little variation in closed-loop data) and fails silently at unseen target weights.

Conclusion: Production logs can self-supervisely yield a useful world model with calibrated uncertainty, but closed-loop data bias (low action variation) and out-of-distribution targets remain open issues; future work: action-primitive conditioning, cross-food/utensil generalization.

Abstract: Food assembly robots pick ingredients from a pan, and every pick must deliver a target weight. We learn a world model of food picking from 61,773 production picks, labeled automatically by a camera and a scale (self-supervised learning). From the pre-pick heightmap of the pan on a 2.5 mm grid, the commanded pick action, the food and the utensil, the model predicts the post-pick heightmap and the picked mass with uncertainty. We evaluate the mass prediction on 12,294 held-out picks of nine foods. The production controller keeps each pick near its commanded target. The model's root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.93 g is 9% lower than that of the commanded target or of a per-food mean. This RMSE is 24% lower than that of the controller's internal mass estimate. Gradient-boosted trees on 20 hand-crafted features have a 0.2 g lower RMSE, but they predict only the mass, not the next state that planning and policy learning need. Using the predicted uncertainty, we decline the most uncertain picks and answer 89.4% of picks with an RMSE of 10.28 g. The prediction barely responds to the commanded volume and depth, because they vary little in closed-loop production. The model also fails without warning at target weights not seen in training. Future directions include action-primitive conditioning and a more general model across foods and utensils. We give recommendations for learning world models from production data.

</details>


### [441] [Defending Vision-Language-Action Models against Transferable Attacks via Visual-Proprioceptive Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28346)
*Jiahao Wang,Ming F. Li,Han Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于本体感受（proprioception）的可信空间参考来检测并缓解VLA模型中可迁移对抗攻击：将机器人本体状态推断的位置与视觉特征推断的位置对齐比较，用二者偏差作为攻击检测信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在机器人任务中表现强，但对抗攻击具有跨任务可迁移性，威胁真实系统安全；作者观察到各种可迁移攻击的共同后果是破坏模型对机器人自身本体的感知，因此需要一个与攻击无关的通用防御信号。

Method: 以机器人本体感受状态构建可信空间参考，从视觉特征推断机器人感知位置，比较两者不一致性来检测可迁移对抗补丁；并在此基础上做缓解处理以保持闭环控制性能。辅以真实机器人实验验证。

Result: 实验显示可有效检测可迁移对抗补丁，并提升闭环任务性能；真实机器人任务上验证了防御有效性。

Conclusion: 利用物理可信的本体感受信息作为锚点，是一种模型无关、攻击无关的通用VLA对抗防御思路，具备真实部署可行性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in a wide range of robotic tasks. However, adversarial attacks in VLA models have shown strong transferability across robotic tasks, posing significant threats to robotic systems. Despite their different attack strategies, we observe that these transferable attacks share a common consequence: they disrupt the VLA model's perception towards the robot itself. Motivated by this observation, we propose a proprioception-grounded defense framework that leverages trusted proprioceptive information to detect and mitigate transferable adversarial attacks. Specifically, we utilize the robot's proprioceptive states to establish a trusted spatial reference, and compare it with the robot's perceived location inferred from visual features. Discrepancies between these two sources provide a reliable signal for detecting adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective detection of transferable adversarial patches and improved closed-loop performance. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our defense on real-world robotic tasks.

</details>


### [442] [Knowing What You Carry: Scalable Physics-Anchored World Models for Robotic Planning with Liquid Payloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28387)
*Yicheng Zhu,Linfeng Tian,Yang Chen,Tao Li,Zilin Bian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 构建GPU并行的FLIP-多体耦合液晃仿真器PLiMB生成数据，并提出物理锚定的可扩展世界模型（模态晃动+侧翻先验、由运动历史估计隐藏液面状态、学习式残差修正），在20Hz控制周期内批量评估数千候选轨迹，在近侧翻极限下显著优于刚体负载与低阶晃动模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 载液机器人（配送机器人、自主卡车）需在近安全极限处保证安全，而液体载荷在机动后持续运动且状态极少被测量；耦合流体仿真太贵无法逐候选评估，低阶晃动模型仅在远离共振时准确，靠近共振与侧翻极限时小预测误差即可让不安全方案看似安全。

Method: 1）PLiMB：GPU并行晃动仿真器，首次将FLIP液体与多辆多体车辆双向耦合；2）世界模型：模态晃动与侧翻物理先验 + 从车辆自身运动历史（罐内无传感器）估计隐藏液体状态 + 学习式修正项；不做流体仿真即可在单GPU单批次内于20Hz节拍下对数千候选规划打分。

Result: 以“世界模型引导规划器实际选出的方案”为评价指标：近侧翻极限时，刚体载荷假设或公开低阶晃动模型在有安全方案可选的情况下反复选中不安全方案；本文方法在标准罐中从不出现，在晃动模态落入机动频带的宽罐中不安全选择约减半；宽罐中先前驾驶遗留的液体状态会改变最优方案，从运动历史推断该状态使近极限预测误差减半。

Conclusion: 将多体动力学先验、隐状态估计与学习修正结合的世界模型，可在避免昂贵流体仿真的前提下满足批量候选规划的计算预算，并将安全评估建立在规划决策层面的真实后果上；避免仅以预测误差评价世界模型。

Abstract: Payload-carrying robots, such as delivery robots and autonomous trucks, must choose motions that keep them and their payload safe, so their planners predict the outcome of each candidate motion. Modern planners compare thousands of candidates per step on a GPU, using world models such as batched simulators or learned predictors. Most of them assume a rigid payload, but a liquid payload keeps moving after a maneuver, and its state is rarely measured. Near a safety limit, small prediction errors can make an unsafe plan look safe. Coupled fluid simulations are accurate but too costly for every candidate, while low-order slosh models are cheap but accurate only away from resonance. We study this trade-off on a ground vehicle with a partly filled tank near its rollover limit. First, we build PLiMB (Parallel Liquid-MultiBody), a GPU-parallel slosh simulator that, to our knowledge, couples FLIP liquid two-way with many multibody vehicles for the first time. It provides training data and a high-fidelity reference. Second, we propose a scalable physics-anchored world model that combines a modal-slosh and roll prior, an estimate of the hidden liquid state from the vehicle's own motion history (no sensor in the tank), and a learned correction. Without simulating the fluid, it scores thousands of candidate plans in one batched pass within a 20 Hz control tick on one GPU. We judge each world model by the plans it leads a planner to choose. Near the rollover limit, planners that treat the liquid as a rigid payload or use published low-order slosh models repeatedly pick unsafe plans when a safe one exists. Ours never does in our standard tank and makes about half as many in a wide tank whose sloshing mode lies in the maneuver band. There, the liquid state left by earlier driving can change the best plan, and reading it from the vehicle's history halves our model's near-limit prediction error.

</details>


### [443] [A Hybrid Multi-Goal Path Planning Framework for Powered Wheelchairs in Dynamic Environments: From Simulation to Real-World Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28394)
*Damla Leblebicioğlu,Ege Özgül,Taşkın Padır*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TSP全局任务排序+人工势场(PF)引导+局部RRT/A*的混合导航框架，用于自主电动轮椅在多目的地场景下的静态/动态避障，并用点模型与考虑平台尺寸的椭圆模型进行仿真与实机对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电动轮椅在以人为本的环境中需同时解决多目的地任务排序与连续动态避障；单纯全局规划无法应对动态障碍，单纯局部规划易偏离全局路径。

Method: TSP-全局任务排序；PF势场将全局路径信息传递给局部规划器以保持路径对齐；局部规划器采用方向感知、扩展邻域的A*或带环境感知采样与两步扩展的RRT；碰撞检测分别使用点模型与椭圆模型（考虑平台尺寸）。仿真设置普通/拥挤/超拥挤三档；实机使用动捕真值，无动捕场景依赖机载LiDAR与RGB-D。

Result: 将轮椅几何（椭圆模型）纳入避障后，碰撞行为发生明显变化；在此模型下TSP-PF-RRT与TSP-PF-A*避障性能相当。仿真与实机（动捕+机载感知）均完成验证。

Conclusion: 混合TSP-PF-局部规划框架可在多目的地服务机器人（轮椅）上实现有效导航；碰撞评估必须结合机器人真实几何，否则结果会失真，采用椭圆模型后两种局部规划器差异消失。

Abstract: Autonomous powered wheelchairs (PWs) operating in human-centered environments must combine efficient multi-destination path planning with continuous collision avoidance strategies in the presence of static and dynamic obstacles. This study presents a hybrid framework integrating Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP)-based global task ordering, Potential-Field (PF) guidance, and local Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) and A-star (A*) planners. PF guidance transfers global path information to local planners, helping the robot stay aligned with the global path during obstacle avoidance. Local planning is enhanced with direction-aware, extended-neighborhood A* or RRT using environment-aware sampling and two-step extension. The TSP-PF-RRT and TSP-PF-A* methods are evaluated in normal, crowded, and extra-crowded simulation environments using point-based and elliptical robot models. The elliptical model accounts for platform dimensions during collision avoidance phase. Hardware tests on the physical PW use motion capture (MoCap) for ground-truth measurements, while outside-MoCap experiments rely on onboard LiDAR and RGB-D sensing. Results show that incorporating the wheelchair geometry changes the observed collision behavior, yielding comparable collision avoidance performance between the two hybrid planners under the elliptical model.

</details>


### [444] [Occupancy Planar Patch: Incremental Probabilistic Bounded-Plane Reconstruction from LiDAR Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28403)
*Jiahao Wang,Chaehyeon Song,Dongjiao He,Jan Quenzel,Lintong Zhang,Ayoung Kim,Maurice Fallon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OPP：以"射线-面片"关联在距离空间中同时建模LiDAR测距噪声、平面不确定性与自由空间，实现增量式有界平面片在线重建，兼顾高精度与紧凑建图，实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR在线表面重建若沿用无序点集的处理范式，会忽略各向异性测距噪声（沿已知射线的深度不确定性）以及射线本身隐含的自由空间信息，导致平面几何被噪声污染。作者希望构建一种显式尊重传感器测量几何的观测模型。

Method: 提出Occupancy Planar Patch（OPP）：增量式有界平面片表示，直接在range-space中评估表面似然与自由空间，显式建模传感器噪声、平面不确定性及射线净空。采用统一的"射线-面片"关联权重，联合驱动三件事：平面几何更新、表面边界细化、相机纹理融合。仅在几何证据确定的区域保守接收表面。

Result: 在Oxford Spires与Multi-Campus共6个序列上评测，OPP在对比方法中精度最高、重建误差最低，地图存储量处于最紧凑之列；几何重建每帧约81 ms（实时），纹理投影额外134 ms。

Conclusion: 以结构性精度优先于无约束完整性，适合建筑建模等对几何保真度要求高的场景；局限是覆盖范围可能保守，未提供开源代码线索。属于增量式LiDAR建图/表面重建的增量改进型工作。

Abstract: Online surface reconstruction from LiDAR scans requires observation models that respect the sensor's physical measurement geometry. Unlike unordered point sets, LiDAR returns carry anisotropic range noise along known rays, which also implicitly identify free space. We introduce the Occupancy Planar Patch (OPP), an incremental bounded planar patch representation that evaluates surface likelihoods and free space directly in range-space, allowing sensor noise, plane uncertainty, and ray clearance to be explicitly modelled during reconstruction. A single ray-to-patch association weight jointly updates plane geometry, refines surface boundaries, and blends camera imagery. The method is evaluated using six sequences from the Oxford Spires and Multi-Campus datasets. OPP achieves the highest precision and lowest reconstruction error among evaluated methods, while producing stored maps among the most compact. By conservatively admitting surfaces only where geometric evidence is certain, OPP prioritises structural precision over unconstrained completeness, which is well suited for architectural modelling. Geometric reconstruction operates in real time, requiring 81 ms per frame on a representative sequence, with texture projection adding 134 ms.

</details>


### [445] [ScaleEvals: Scaling Generalist Policy Evaluation through Reset-Free Autonomous Play](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28411)
*Amitoj Sandhu,Ethan Sick,Omkaar Buddhikot,Nadia Laswi,Wesley Durbano,Nadun Ranawaka,You Liang Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ScaleEvals：面向机器人通用策略的免复位（reset-free）连续"物理游玩"评测协议，VLM AutoPrompter 自动生成场景化任务，VLM AutoGrader 自动判分（与人评一致率 90.7%），软胜 Bradley-Terry 汇总排名并用标签分层 ANOVA 做能力诊断；每站位 23.0 次/小时净 rollout，人工投入降 98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界评测通用机器人策略受限于人工复位、人工打分与固定小任务集，诊断覆盖不足，无法规模化。

Method: DROID 与 YAM 双平台上跨机器人编队持续物理游玩、免人工复位；VLM AutoPrompter 生成任务及难度/语言指令/技能标签；VLM AutoGrader 评估任务进度；soft-win Bradley-Terry 聚合评分，标签分层 ANOVA 给出可解释能力画像。

Result: 3000+ 真实自主 rollout；5 个 SOTA 通用策略排名与留出人工评测在 DROID 上相关 r=0.94、rho=0.90（p=0.018），YAM 上 r=0.839、rho=0.80；动词/技能/物体条件证据重组可预测未见提示词下的策略次序，10 任务 240 次前瞻性 rollout 中三策略排序以 96% 成对一致率复现。

Conclusion: 自动化、免复位、可扩展的真实机器人评测流程可在极低人工成本下复现人工排名，并能预测排序反转位置，为通用策略提供细粒度能力诊断。

Abstract: Real-world evaluation of generalist robot policies is bottlenecked by manual resets, human grading, and small fixed task suites with limited diagnostic coverage. We present ScaleEvals, a scalable reset-free protocol that evaluates policies through continuous physical play across a robot fleet. A VLM AutoPrompter generates scene-grounded tasks with difficulty estimates, language prompts, and skill tags, enabling performance analysis across diverse rollouts. A VLM AutoGrader assesses task progress, achieving 90.7% agreement with human graders. Scores are aggregated via a soft-win Bradley-Terry model, while tag-stratified ANOVA provides interpretable capability diagnostics. Across 3,000+ physical autonomous rollouts on DROID and YAM, ScaleEvals achieves 23.0 net rollouts/hr per station while reducing active human labor by 98%. By ranking five SOTA generalist policies, ScaleEvals correlates with held-out manual evaluation ranking on DROID (r=0.94, rho=0.90, p=0.018), and remains internally consistent on a second embodiment, YAM (r=0.839, rho=0.80). Beyond aggregate rankings, we observe behavioral compositionality: recombining verb-, skill-, and object-conditioned evidence predicts policy order on unseen prompts. Across 10 tasks and 240 prospective physical rollouts, we recover three-policy orderings of 96% pairwise concordance, demonstrating ScaleEvals can predict not just which policy leads, but where rankings reverse.

</details>


### [446] [Belief-Driven Quantum Magnetometer Control for GPS-Denied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28416)
*Murtuza Lemonwala,Laxima Niure Kandel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将导航滤波器的位置信念经磁异常图预测场强分布，据此按闭式规则自适应设定Ramsey干涉磁力仪的相位与询问时间，在模糊极限与退相干极限间权衡；在真实空军飞行数据上显著优于固定参数基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型无人机可搭载的低SWaP量子磁力仪灵敏度弱，且通常以固定参数开环运行；长询问时间提升灵敏度却带来相位模糊，需依据场强不确定性自适应决策。

Method: 信念驱动感知闭环：滤波器预测场分布→闭式规则在模糊极限与退相干极限之间选择Ramsey相位与询问时间；在72个独立飞行窗口上与固定参数基线对比，并做相位对齐/询问时间两部分消融，另在IBM超导量子比特上验证规则与经验最优的接近程度，并与信息感知路径规划耦合。

Result: 63/72窗口优于固定基线（p=2e-11）；低SNR传感器误差降20-27%，中等对比度传感器降30-44%；丢失起始后询问时间自适应使中位误差降37-42%；规则询问时间在1.3倍经验最优内；与信息感知路由耦合使任务误差降15-40%；高质量传感器与精确地图下增益小。

Conclusion: 将传感器参数由导航信念闭环驱动，是不增加SWaP即可提升磁异常导航精度的有效手段，收益集中在低信噪比与初始不确定场景。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles increasingly need to navigate without satellite positioning. Magnetic anomaly navigation (Mag-Nav) with quantum magnetometers offers a passive, unjammable fix, but the low size-weight-and-power (SWaP) sensors that small drones can carry are weak, and they are operated open loop at a fixed setting. Interferometric (Ramsey) magnetometers face a trade-off: long interrogation times are more sensitive but become ambiguous when the expected field is uncertain. The navigator's own position belief, pushed through the anomaly map, predicts that field. We close this loop. The filter's predictive field distribution sets the Ramsey phase and interrogation time at every epoch, through a closed-form rule that moves between an ambiguity limit and a decoherence limit. We evaluate it on real U.S. Air Force flight data (real tracks, inertial drift, measured fields, and a survey map tested 18 months after it was flown), with only the Ramsey sensor modelled. Against fixed-setting baselines, 63 of 72 independent flight windows favour belief driven sensing ($p = 2 \times 10^{-11}$). Error falls by 20-27% for low-SNR sensors and 30-44% for mid-contrast sensors. An ablation separates the two ingredients. Phase alignment drives the gain in steady flight, and the rule matches the best fixed setting without the hindsight tuning that setting requires. After a lost start, interrogation time adaptation is essential, cutting median error by 37-42% even against hindsight-tuned phase-aligned settings. Gains are small for high-quality sensors with accurate maps. On an IBM superconducting qubit, the rule's interrogation time stays within $1.3\times$ of the empirical optimum. Coupled with information-aware routing, belief-driven sensing lowers mission error by 15-40%.

</details>


### [447] [LoKiTO: Local Kinodynamic Trajectory Optimization for UAVs based on Memory-Efficient Neural Distance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28438)
*Guillermo Gil-Garcia,J. A. Cobano,L. Merino,F. Caballero*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LoKiTO：以Chebyshev多项式参数化轨迹、结合在线神经ESDF（约1MB内存）的3D局部动力学可行轨迹优化器，用于空中机器人局部重规划，动态可行性合规率>99.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有梯度类规划器或受限于显式体积地图的高内存占用，或无法严格满足动力学约束；需同时兼顾内存效率与严格动力学可行性。

Method: Chebyshev基多项式参数化（良好数值条件）+模块化代价函数内嵌动力学约束；碰撞感知由LiDAR在线更新的连续神经ESDF提供，将地图内存压缩至约1.0MB；在高度杂乱仿真环境与Fast-Planner、EGO-Planner对比基准测试。

Result: 动态可行性合规率超99.4%，显著优于基线；中位障碍物间距更高。

Conclusion: 良好条件的连续参数化与显式动力学推理相结合，为空中机器人局部重规划提供实用且可扩展的基础。

Abstract: This paper introduces LoKiTO, a 3D local kinodynamic trajectory optimizer that combines a Chebyshev polynomial parameterization with an online neural Euclidean Signed Distance Field (ESDF) representation for aerial robotics. While current gradient-based planners often struggle with the high memory requirements of explicit volumetric maps or fail to strictly enforce dynamic limits, LoKiTO embeds kinodynamic constraints directly into a modular cost function and exploits the numerical conditioning properties of the Chebyshev basis. Collision awareness is provided by a continuous, memory-efficient neural ESDF updated online from LiDAR measurements, which drastically reduces map memory consumption to approximately 1.0 MB. Benchmarking in highly cluttered simulated environments against state-of-the-art baselines (Fast-Planner and EGO-Planner) demonstrates the superiority of our approach. Experimental results show that LoKiTO achieves over 99.4% dynamic feasibility compliance, significantly outperforming the baselines, and maintaining higher median clearance from obstacles. By coupling a well-conditioned continuous parameterization with explicit kinodynamic reasoning, LoKiTO provides a practical and extensible basis for local replanning in aerial robotics.

</details>


### [448] [AlpaSafe: Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28509)
*Qiren Wang,Mingyu Guo,Weisong Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AlpaSafe：复用冻结驾驶VLA预填充末位隐状态的轻量风险感知轨迹选择器（1.7M参数，0.75ms/决策）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶VLA评估以"最优候选"打分，隐含部署时不存在的oracle选择器；而在线评估器需专门训练场景/世界模型并逐候选展开rollout，代价高。作者希望低成本、免rollout地评估实际执行轨迹的风险。

Method: 读取冻结驾驶VLA prompt prefill的最后一个hidden token，用一个轻量head将它与每个候选轨迹融合，基于闭环仿真结果训练，预测相对分数与碰撞/越界二分类logits；再用固定规则剔除在两个风险logit上被支配的候选，在剩余候选中选最高分。不增加rollout，也不训练VLA本体。

Result: 在525个AlpaSim场景上，相比Alpamayo默认取首个样本规则与均匀随机选择，在selected regret和top-1 agreement上更优；有责碰撞或越界率从6.41%、6.10%降至4.93%。选择器仅1.7M参数，每次决策0.75ms。

Conclusion: 复用VLA既有场景表征做候选轨迹风险筛选，是一种低成本、可即插即用的部署选择器；局限在于仅在仿真闭环中验证，未给出实车或真实道路证据，且风险标签依赖仿真结果分布。

Abstract: Reasoning-based driving vision-language-action (VLA) models propose multiple candidate trajectories at each decision, yet only one is executed. Standard evaluation scores the best candidate, assuming an oracle selector that deployment lacks, and leaves the risk of the executed candidate unexamined. Existing online evaluators typically close this gap with a purpose-trained scene or world model, often rolling out each candidate through it at inference time. We introduce AlpaSafe, a risk-aware trajectory selector that reuses the scene representation a frozen driving VLA computes while proposing its candidates. AlpaSafe reads the last hidden token of the VLA's prompt prefill. A lightweight head, trained on the closed-loop simulation outcomes of the candidates, fuses this token with each candidate trajectory and predicts a relative score and collision/offroad logits. A fixed rule removes candidates dominated on the two risk logits and selects the highest-scoring candidate among those remaining, adding neither rollouts nor VLA training. Experiments on 525 AlpaSim scenes show that AlpaSafe outperforms Alpamayo's default first-sample rule and uniform random selection in selected regret and top-1 agreement, and reduces the collision-at-fault or offroad rate from 6.41% and 6.10% to 4.93%. The selector has 1.7M parameters and takes 0.75 ms per decision.

</details>


### [449] [Lifted Multiple Shooting for Parallel-in-Time Contact-Rich Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28512)
*Wei-Chen Li,Glen Chou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出lifted multiple shooting轨迹优化转写：将接触冲量作为优化变量，配合隐式微分计算灵敏度，并设计时间并行原-对偶内点求解器IP-PAS，在六个接触丰富动态任务上大幅提升成功率并支持40000步长时域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富规划需要处理机器人-环境耦合动力学（惯性、接触力、摩擦），但接触动力学的非光滑性与多模态性使基于梯度的优化困难；传统multiple shooting难以满足摩擦锥可行性与接触模型一致性。

Method: 将接触冲量显式作为决策变量，使状态转移约束可用满足摩擦锥的冲量满足，并单独约束其与接触本构模型的一致性；通过隐式微分获取灵敏度，从而支持广泛的接触本构关系；同时提出IP-PAS时间并行原-对偶内点求解器，达到O(log T)并行深度。

Result: 在六个全动态接触丰富规划任务（含非抓取推物与灵巧手内操作）上，无需接触引导代价，lifted multiple shooting相较标准multiple shooting成功率提升最多81.5个百分点；IP-PAS解质量与串行方法相当，加速最多3.1倍，可扩展至40000时间步。

Conclusion: 将接触冲量提升为优化变量并结合时间并行内点求解，是规避接触非光滑性、实现长时域高维接触丰富轨迹规划的有效途径。

Abstract: Planning through contact requires accounting for the coupled dynamics of a robot and its environment, including inertial effects, contact forces, and friction. However, the non-smoothness and multimodality of contact dynamics and contact geometry makes gradient-based optimization challenging. In this work, we propose lifted multiple shooting, a trajectory optimization transcription that can be solved directly using nonlinear program solvers. By introducing contact impulses as optimization variables, our formulation allows the optimizer to satisfy the state-transition constraints using friction-cone-feasible impulses while separately enforcing their consistency with the contact model. Our formulation supports a broad class of contact constitutive relations, with sensitivities computed through implicit differentiation. To enable efficient planning over long horizons and for high-dimensional systems, we further introduce IP-PAS, a parallel-in-time primal-dual interior-point solver that achieves O(log T) parallel computational depth. We evaluate the proposed methods on six fully dynamic contact-rich planning tasks, including nonprehensile pushing and in-hand manipulation, without contact-guiding costs. Lifted multiple shooting improves success rates by up to 81.5 percentage points over standard multiple shooting, while IP-PAS achieves solution quality comparable to serial methods with up to a 3.1x speedup and scales to horizons of 40,000 timesteps.

</details>


### [450] [Environment-Aware Probabilistic State Estimation of Continuum Robots from Planar Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28521)
*Aedan Mangan,Spencer Teetaert,Chengnan Shentu,Michael G. Brandel,Jeremy J. Heit,Alexander Norbash,Timothy D. Barfoot,Nikolay Atanasov,Tania K. Morimoto,Jessica Burgner-Kahrs*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种概率状态估计器，将已知环境表示为符号距离场并融入连续体机器人的形变估计，融合运动相机对机体固定标记的平面图像与驱动指令，实现无内置传感器的全身连续状态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人全长柔性，在受限环境中不可避免地与环境接触，导致建模困难、状态难以解析求解，因此需要从运行中可获得的信息在线估计其状态；而医疗与工业场景中环境往往预先已知（术前影像、设计模型），这一先验尚未被充分利用。

Method: 以符号距离场（SDF）编码已知环境几何，构建在弧长与时间上连续的概率状态估计器，输入为异步的、可位于机器人任意位置的测量（含运动相机对机体固定标记的平面图像投影）与驱动指令，通过概率滤波融合并输出带不确定性的全身连续状态。

Result: 在仿真主动脉弓与硬件体模中，估计器均成功将机器人跟踪至目标分支；单视角条件下，引入已知环境先验使末端误差由机器人长度的2.5%降至1.6%（仿真）和由20.0%降至11.3%（体模）。

Conclusion: 利用已知环境先验的连续概率状态估计可有效支撑无传感器连续体机器人的导航与控制，但实验限于仿真与体模，真机临床/工业部署验证仍待补充。
