A systematic analysis of the existing conversion relationships reveals that, although most conversions among these models have already been established in the literature, a direct analytical conversion between POE and HAY, and CPC and HAY remains unavailable. Relying instead on a sequential combination of the existing POE-DH and DH-HAY conversions, for example, introduces several limitations. To address this gap, we develop a constructive analytical conversion between POE-HAY and HAY-CPC models based on Lie group theory, formally established through a set of lemmas and propositions. The proposed algorithms are illustrated using an RRRP SCARA robot and an RRHHHH Puma 560 manipulator. The direct POE-HAY conversion is compared with the sequential POE-DH-HAY approach, as well as HAY-CPC in terms of several relevant criteria, demonstrating the advantages of the proposed solution. Finally, we demonstrate the practical significance of the completed analytical conversion framework in an open-loop kinematic calibration experiment on an ABB IRB 1600 manipulator, using an API Radian EMSD3 Laser Tracker for measurements. The experimental results demonstrate that proper model selection combined with completed analytical conversion scheme directly improves calibration accuracy.

</details>


### [586] [Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31079)
*Jingyuan Liu,Yongwei Chen,Yishan Yang,Zexin He,Xingang Pan,Zhi Hou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WVP 用"腕部视频预测 + 几何位姿估计"的闭环框架实现通用操作策略：视频生成器预测未来腕部视角，复用预训练3D模型的位姿估计器通过模型拼接（latent直连）恢复相机轨迹，映射为末端执行器位姿，跨任务与跨本体零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用操作策略需完成新任务、适应陌生场景并跨机器人本体迁移技能。直接学RGB到动作的端到端策略难以在数据扩展与几何泛化之间兼顾，作者希望把"任务知识"与"几何运动估计"解耦，使前者可由大量人类/机器人视频扩展，后者可跨任务、跨本体复用。

Method: 以腕部相机轨迹作为动作表征（经固定手眼变换确定末端位姿）；视频生成器预测未来腕部视角，位姿估计器由预训练3D模型改造以恢复相机轨迹；采用model stitching将生成器预测的latent直接映射进估计器中间特征空间，绕过RGB解码，降低误差与计算开销；整体构成闭环策略。

Result: 位姿估计器无需微调即在Franka Panda、PiPER-X、Galaxea R1 Pro上迁移；在桌面与洗衣房场景中，覆盖精细抓取、插入及可变形物体操作，零样本分布外评测成功率超过50%。

Conclusion: 腕部视角视频预测+几何位姿估计的分解式设计是可行的通用操作范式，具备跨本体零样本迁移与OOD泛化能力；但零样本成功率仍约50%，规模化与鲁棒性（长时序、接触-rich任务）是后续重点。

Abstract: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at this https URL .

</details>


### [587] [Real2Worlds2Real: Scaling Self-Improving Agentic Real2Sim2Real for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31098)
*Jinzhong Gu,Jiakai Chen,Xinyi Cao,Yan Shen,Hangke Sui,Shutian Zheng,Xiang Xiao,Haoran Lu,Fan Xu,Lu Shi,Daochen Shi,Ruihua Zhang,Wei Zhan,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Ruihai Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Real2Worlds2Real：agentic 自改进框架，用工具编排从少量视觉观测+任务描述构建数字孪生并扩展为"数字表亲"（digital cousins），再由同一智能体编排数据生成、策略学习与精炼，并将验证过的流程蒸馏为可复用技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实交互数据采集成本高，Real2Sim2Real 是有希望的替代路径，但难以跨任务与物理交互规模化：仿真世界构建需人工、保真度不足、多样性受限，且策略开发与建世界割裂。

Method: 两阶段智能体框架：(1) 世界构建——智能体自适应选择工具、基于视觉与执行反馈迭代修正几何与物理参数，生成数字孪生并做多样化扩展（digital cousins）；(2) 策略开发——按任务需求与仿真 rollout 反馈协调数据生成、策略学习与精炼。跨任务蒸馏可复用技能以加速后续世界构建与长程任务。

Result: 世界保真度提升，策略可成功迁移到真机；性能随世界多样性增加与交互数据规模扩大而提升；技能复用提升建世界效率与长程任务成功率。

Conclusion: 将仿真世界构建与策略学习统一为自改进 agentic 闭环，并以技能蒸馏实现跨任务累积增益，是面向规模化机器人操作学习的可行路径。摘要未提供定量指标与真机评测规模细节，可比性受限。

Abstract: Scaling robot manipulation learning remains challenging due to the high cost of collecting real-world interaction data. Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) offers a promising route by enabling policy learning in simulation grounded in real-world observations, yet scaling this paradigm across diverse tasks and physical interactions remains difficult. We introduce Real2Worlds2Real, a self-improving agentic framework that integrates scalable simulation-world construction with policy development. Given limited visual observations and task descriptions, its tool-orchestration harness constructs faithful digital twins and expands them into diverse, physically executable digital cousins. The agent adaptively selects tools and revisits construction decisions, using visual and execution feedback to refine geometry and physical behavior. Building on these worlds, the agent orchestrates policy development by coordinating data generation, policy learning, and refinement based on task requirements and simulation rollout feedback. Across both stages, the agent distills validated procedures into reusable skills that guide subsequent tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved world fidelity and successful real-world policy transfer, with performance gains from increasing world diversity and interaction-data volume. Skill reuse further improves world-building efficiency and long-horizon task success.

</details>


### [588] [NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31099)
*Lemeng Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 NoveltyGate：发现 VLA 前缀 token 计算的"误差—依赖鸿沟"，用无训练的"新颖性"测试（token 输入是否偏离校准子空间）而非近似误差来路由 token 到低秩或原始 MLP，在 LIBERO 上将 π0.5 前缀加速至 1.61×并保持闭环成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配 VLA（如 π0.5）每个控制步都用 2B 参数骨干重编码图像与指令，前缀的 FFN 占主要算力。直觉方案是让大多数 token 走低秩 MLP、只对近似误差大的 token 精确计算，但作者发现该直觉失效：误差大的 token 往往不是策略真正依赖的 token。

Method: 先做诊断实验：即便使用知道每个 token 精确误差的理想验证器，其 token 选择仍导致比"新颖性测试"（输入是否落在校准阶段见到的子空间外）大 1.3–1.7× 的动作偏差。据此提出 NoveltyGate：每层在每个矩阵乘之前对所有前缀 token 一次性决定走低秩还是原始 MLP；每层决策一次避免搬运宽中间张量、保持静态形状，使整个前缀可作为单个 CUDA graph 执行。无训练、即插即用。

Result: LIBERO 上前缀加速最高 1.61×；相同算力下与通道剪枝、低秩压缩相比，距原策略偏差小 2.7–2.9×；闭环任务成功率保持。

Conclusion: 误差小的 token 未必是策略依赖的 token——误差集中于第三人称相机等低权重 token，而新颖性测试倾向腕部相机这一动作强依赖视角。以新颖性而非误差作路由信号，是 VLA 推理加速更有效的准则。

Abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ re-encode the camera images and the instruction with a 2B-parameter backbone at every control step, and the feed-forward layers of this prefix account for most of its compute. A natural way to save this compute is to send most tokens through a low-rank MLP and compute exactly only the tokens whose approximation error is large. We find that this intuition is wrong. Even a verifier that knows every token's exact error picks the wrong tokens, producing 1.3--1.7$\times$ larger action deviation than a simple test of whether a token's input is novel, that is, whether it falls outside the subspace seen during calibration. Large errors concentrate in tokens the policy relies on little, such as the third-person camera, while the novelty test favors the wrist camera, a view the action depends on heavily. We call this the error--reliance gap. Building on it, we propose NoveltyGate, a training-free method that routes each prefix token, once per layer and before any multiplication, to either a low-rank or the original MLP. Deciding once per layer instead of once per matrix product avoids moving wide intermediate tensors and keeps every shape static, so the whole prefix runs as a single CUDA graph. On LIBERO, NoveltyGate accelerates the $\pi_{0.5}$ prefix by up to 1.61$\times$, stays 2.7--2.9$\times$ closer to the original policy than channel pruning and low-rank compression at equal compute, and preserves closed-loop task success.

</details>


### [589] [RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31115)
*Yanzhe Chen,Zhijun Cao,Zechen Bai,Wenzheng Zeng,Kevin Yuchen Ma,Yiqi Lin,Guoqiang Liang,Xiaokang Liu,Ke Sun,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RUIBench（30个操作任务/5套件）与 RUIKit（6种动作抽象×2种交互形式=13种接口），在统一感知与控制下系统研究"机器人使用接口"(RUI)对基础模型物理执行可靠性的影响，仅换接口即使前沿agent成功率从45%升至81%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型具备物理推理能力，但从"推理"到"可靠机器人执行"的转化仍困难；作者认为关键但被忽视的因素是机器人使用接口（RUI），即agent如何表达与执行物理动作。需要系统化、受控地量化接口本身的影响，而非仅关注策略或模型能力。

Method: 构建 RUIBench：覆盖世界知识、上下文学习、发现、动态交互、接触丰富操作五类套件的30个操作任务；提出 RUIKit 统一框架，将6种动作抽象与2种交互形式交叉组合，在共享感知与控制条件下得到13种接口，进行受控对比实验（含前沿agent与微调4B模型）；并分析接口效用与agent行为、物理不确定性的关系。

Result: 仅改变RUI，前沿agent成功率45%→81%，微调4B模型13%→47%；有效接口通过减少冗余决策同时保留必要反馈提升性能，收益受agent行为与物理不确定性调制；发现"验证缺口"——agent常在可观测失败下仍宣告成功，需超越单步动作的任务级验证。

Conclusion: RUI设计是具身agent可靠性的关键因素，可作为独立于模型能力的优化维度；任务级验证机制的缺失是当前系统的重要短板。

Abstract: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

</details>


### [590] [WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31126)
*Zien Wang,Yuhao Pan,Yunfeng Fan,Nan Cheng,Xin Xia,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WeaveVLA 通过稀疏图神经网络显式建模任务相关的相对3D关系，并用成对递归边状态跨观测维护几何上下文，将关系token注入动作专家，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN及三个真机任务上均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖预训练视觉-语言表征做指令条件控制，但对任务相关3D关系及其在操作过程中的演化只有隐式理解，导致分布外或空间精度需求场景下鲁棒性不足。

Method: 任务条件稀疏图：以物体、夹爪及邻近参照为节点编码相对3D关系；成对递归边状态跨观测累积几何证据；学习查询readout将图表示压缩为关系token，与原始视觉-语言上下文共同条件化动作专家；附加几何重建辅助损失以保持空间结构。实例化于StarVLA-GR00T与π0.5骨干。

Result: LIBERO两骨干均超98%平均成功率；LIBERO-Plus上分别从74.9%→82.0%、85.7%→87.8%；CALVIN D→D有额外提升；三个真机任务标准条件55.6%→70.0%，OOD扰动33.3%→53.3%，均优于π0.5基线。

Conclusion: 显式、时序化的相对3D关系建模可有效补强VLA的空间理解，且以插件形式兼容不同骨干，真机与OOD鲁棒性收益明显，属VLA+几何感知交叉的强实证工作。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{WeaveVLA}, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and $\pi_{0.5}$, achieving over 98\% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9\% to 82.0\% and from 85.7\% to 87.8\%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN D$\rightarrow$D. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6\% to 70.0\% under standard conditions and from 33.3\% to 53.3\% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the $\pi_{0.5}$ baseline in both settings.

</details>


### [591] [EmboEagle: An Efficient Agentic Embodied Framework for Long-horizon Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31173)
*Fan Xu,Zhongtao Wang,Hao Wu,Yitong Zhu,Wenzhuo Ma,Long Li,Zhuohao Li,Zhisheng Chen,Rui Su,Kun Wang,Xian Wu,Wanli Ouyang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EmboEagle：闭环智能体框架，统一子任务条件化的WAM控制、潜空间自适应监督与记忆引导的几何恢复；RMBench 91.3%、LIBERO-Mem 90.6%，VLM调用减少74.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程机器人操作需跨多个相互依赖阶段可靠执行，但独立WAM存在物理误差累积，而无状态VLM监督延迟高（chunkwise）且缺乏3D空间持久性。

Method: (1) 解耦两阶段flow matching适配序列WAM，保留跨阶段视觉历史并在子任务边界校准截断动作监督；(2) 无需辅助视觉编码器，将教师干预决策蒸馏为轻量路由门控，仅依赖WAM Action Expert的chunk前后潜状态转移与子任务嵌入；(3) VLM被调用时解耦诊断状态与离散路由动作，基于结构化记忆（初始参考、活跃抓取绑定、工具轨迹）执行参数化恢复原语，并强制修复后验证。

Result: RMBench 91.3%、LIBERO-Mem 90.6%平均成功率，较最强基线分别提升8.0与9.8个百分点；相同执行器权重下真实世界成功率优于VoLoAgent；自适应门控将VLM调用减少74.2%（91.3% vs 93.7%成功率）。

Conclusion: 潜空间自适应监督+记忆引导恢复可在几乎不损成功率的前提下大幅降低VLM依赖，为长程WAM闭环执行提供高效范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation demands reliable execution across interdependent stages, yet standalone World-Action Models (WAMs) suffer from compounding physical errors, while stateless Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervision incurs prohibitive chunkwise latency and lacks 3D spatial persistence. We present EmboEagle, a closed-loop agentic framework that unifies subtask-conditioned WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided geometric recovery. First, we adapt sequential WAMs via decoupled two-stage flow matching that preserves cross-stage visual history while calibrating truncated action supervision at subtask boundaries. Second, without an auxiliary vision encoder, we distill teacher intervention decisions into a lightweight routing gate driven solely by the WAM Action Expert's pre- and post-chunk latent transitions and subtask embeddings. Third, upon invocation, the VLM decouples diagnostic status from discrete routing actions and executes parameterized recovery primitives grounded in structured memory (initial references, active grasp bindings, and tool traces), followed by mandatory post-repair verification. Across RMBench and LIBERO-Mem, EmboEagle achieves 91.3\% and 90.6\% average success, surpassing the strongest baselines by 8.0 and 9.8 percentage points, while boosting real-world success over VoLoAgent under identical executor weights. Moreover, adaptive gating cuts VLM calls by 74.2\% versus chunkwise monitoring (91.3\% vs. 93.7\% success).

</details>


### [592] [VITA-WAM: Manifold-Aligned World-Action Modeling for Real-Time Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31195)
*Boqi Zhao,Dechen Gao,Hanchu Zhou,Hang Wang,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VITA-WAM通过流隐空间对齐（FLA）使潜在观测流形与动作流形对齐，将含视觉/语言/本体感知的隐表示直接传输为隐动作，实现单步ODE生成动作，55.67 ms，较FastWAM加速2.10×，LIBERO-Plus 上超10步FastWAM 21.47 pp。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）依赖大生成模型与迭代采样，动作生成延迟高，难以实时部署。两大低效根源：(1) 从无信息高斯噪声传输到精确动作需要多步ODE；(2) 反复通过昂贵的交叉注意力注入任务上下文。

Method: 提出VITA-WAM架构与manifold-aligned flow matching（VITA flow matching）：以同时学习并对齐源流形与动作流形为核心，直接把包含视觉、语言、本体感知信息的潜在观测表示传输为潜在动作。设计flow latent alignment（FLA）目标，促进潜在观测表示与动作表示之间的流形对齐，从而实现少步（甚至单步）ODE的精确生成；同时该架构消除了去噪迭代中对观测条件化的高开销注意力机制，且无需蒸馏。

Result: 单步ODE下，VITA-WAM 比10步FastWAM在LIBERO-Plus上高21.47 pp、在LIBERO上高1.65 pp；推理延迟55.67 ms，相比FastWAM实现2.10×加速；性能提升来自FLA目标而非蒸馏。

Conclusion: 联合学习并对齐观测与动作流形可显著简化生成路径，使WAM在保持甚至超越多步基线精度的同时获得实时级推理速度，为WAM的实时部署提供了简洁有效的免蒸馏方案。局限在于仅在LIBERO系列仿真基准上验证，缺乏真实机器人部署证据，且与大规模主干结合的扩展性待测。

Abstract: World action model (WAM) is a promising paradigm for visuomotor control by jointly modeling world dynamics and actions. Notably, existing WAMs often rely on large generative models and iterative sampling which incur substantial latency for action generation, limiting real-time deployment. In particular, there are two root causes of inefficiency in conventional flow matching or diffusion based action models in WAMs: 1) transporting uninformative Gaussian noise into precise actions necessitating multiple ODE steps, and 2) repeatedly injecting task context through expensive cross-attention modules. Our key insight is that jointly learning and aligning the source and action manifolds streamlines the transport between them, substantially accelerating action generation. Building on this insight, we introduce VITA-WAM, a WAM architecture with manifold-aligned flow-matching (VITA flow matching) that directly transports latent observation representations containing visual, language, and proprioceptive information into latent actions. More specifically, a flow latent alignment (FLA) mechanism is employed to facilitate manifold alignment between latent observation and action representations, enabling accurate generation with few ODE steps. The resulting architecture also eliminates costly attention for observation conditioning during repeated denoising steps. Notably, with a single ODE step, VITA-WAM outperforms 10-step FastWAM by 21.47 pp on LIBERO-Plus and by 1.65 pp on LIBERO, achieving these gains through the FLA objective without distillation, while inferring at 55.67~ms latency, a $2.10\times$ speedup compared to FastWAM.

</details>


### [593] [Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31201)
*Xiao-Ming Wu,Kang Liao,Yuexiao Ma,Taolin Zhang,Mingqian Zhou,Nuo Chen,Ziming Li,Yihang Luo,Rui Li,Zhonghua Wu,Tianyu Xie,Xiawu Zheng,Zhongang Cai,Zhi Hou,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Embo-Harness框架，系统研究以多模态前沿模型直接作为策略的闭环harness设计（prompting/planning/action execution/tool use），蒸馏出六条经验并给出实用配方，RoboLab-120达83.3%成功率（超最强基线26.2pt），4个真机任务20次零样本试验成功15次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿多模态模型已能直接从观测与指令生成机器人动作，被直接用作闭环harness中的策略，但其harness设计原则与实际驱动性能的能力来源尚不清楚，缺少系统性实证分析。

Method: 构建Embo-Harness框架，对robotic agentic loop的四个环节（提示、规划、动作执行、工具使用）做受控实验与消融；据此提炼六条经验与一套实用配方（偏好利用模型原生视觉推理与工具使用接口而非手工规划/技能/动作先验，并给出动作表示、chunking、推理预算、视觉观测、短多动作序列、策略精炼的有效选择）；用受控干预分析模型对空间目标估计与低层关节/轨迹生成的依赖程度。

Result: RoboLab-120上83.3%成功率，超最强已报告基线26.2个百分点；4个真实操作任务20次零样本试验成功15次；干预实验表明性能更依赖准确的空间目标估计，而非显式的低层关节或轨迹生成。

Conclusion: 给出构建强前沿模型即策略harness的实用配方，并澄清驱动性能的关键能力在于空间目标定位而非低层动作生成，对VLA/具身智能体的系统设计有直接指导意义。

Abstract: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.

</details>


### [594] [ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31205)
*Zexin He,Rui Li,Yushi Lan,Chengkai Jin,Zhi Hou,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ACAP 将单个机器人拆分为由多个持久编码智能体组成的团队，每个成员负责一个可配置控制组（如机械臂+夹爪、躯干+底盘），并由一个超智能体负责任务分配、依赖协调与动态控制权切换，从而在需要时支持紧耦合协作操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用单一编码智能体控制整台机器人时，本来相互独立的工作会被串行推理阻塞，导致整体执行延迟；而机器人各部件间又存在物理依赖，需要协调，因此需要兼顾并行性与紧耦合协作的框架。

Method: 提出了异步编码智能体框架 ACAP：以持久化的成员智能体分别对配置的控制组进行推理与执行，实现异步推理-执行；引入 hyper-agent 负责任务分配、依赖协调以及 lead/member 之间的动态控制权分配；并提供统一的成员接口用于底盘与躯干控制，同时发布含观测、生成程序、动作与反馈的真实 rollout 数据集。

Result: 25 种任务/平台设置共 72 次真实 rollouts 中，相比单智能体 Direct Policy 任务均衡时间成本降低 28.2%，在 Fully Parallel、Parallel-Sequential、Collaborative 三类任务上均有提升；全部 8 个 Collaborative 设置中平均时间成本优于 Fixed Delegation；额外 90 次 rollout 研究中，六个任务的平均 30 分钟截断时间成本均低于 Direct；并展示了移动操作中的底盘与躯干控制。

Conclusion: 异步多智能体编码策略能有效提升真实机器人执行效率，超智能体机制是兼顾并行独立工作与紧耦合协作的关键；作者同时开放框架与真实 rollout 数据集，以支持编码智能体在物理世界中推理与行动的研究。

Abstract: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.

</details>

### [595] [Real-time Priority-aware UAS Arrival Planning Framework for Multi-layer UTM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28459)
*Anisha Mohapatra,Prasanna Ramamurthy,Shridhar Velhal,M. Sethumadhavan,Suresh Sundaram*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出面向多层UTM终端空域（同心环漏斗+离散等待槽+连接边+降落平台）的实时、优先级感知UAS到达规划框架，用贪心顺序规划+滚动时域实现新增到达、风扰动与紧急着陆的快速重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端空域资源有限，密集到达需全程时空分离；新增到达、风扰和紧急着陆请求超出传统停机位排序能力，需快速重规划且保持计算可解。

Method: 将终端空域建模为同心环漏斗、离散等待槽、连接边与降落平台；先按优先级确定着陆顺序，再对UAS逐一贪心规划其槽位分配、遍历路径、着陆时刻及槽位进出时刻，已规划轨迹视为固定；对槽、边、平台施加时空冲突约束；在滚动时域中纳入新到达、反应式调整风扰影响并优先紧急UAS而不改动已完成操作。

Result: 计算结果表明可在运行时限内生成并更新可行、无冲突的到达计划，并为紧急UAS提供快速着陆通道。

Conclusion: 该框架适用于动态多层UTM环境下的响应式、安全关键到达管理。

Abstract: This paper proposes a real-time, priority-aware UAS arrival-planning framework for multi-layer UTM terminal airspace represented as a funnel of concentric rings, discrete holding slots, connecting edges, and a landing pad. Managing dense arrivals is challenging because terminal resources are limited and UAS must remain spatially and temporally separated throughout their approaches. New arrivals, wind disturbances, and emergency landing requests further require rapid replanning beyond conventional landing-pad sequencing. To achieve computational tractability, the framework employs a greedy planning method that first establishes a priority-aware landing order and then plans the UAS sequentially. For each UAS, the method determines its slot assignments, traversal path, landing time, and slot entry and exit times while treating previously planned trajectories as fixed. Spatial and temporal constraints prevent conflicts on holding slots, connecting edges, and the landing pad. Within a rolling-horizon implementation, the framework incorporates new arrivals, reactively adjusts plans affected by wind disturbances, and prioritizes emergency UAS without altering completed operations. Computational results show that the method generates and updates feasible, conflict-free arrival plans within operational time limits while providing expedited landing access to emergency UAS. The results demonstrate the suitability of the proposed framework for responsive and safety-critical arrival management in dynamic multi-layer UTM environments. Video link: this https URL

</details>


### [596] [Autonomous UAV Navigation in an Unknown Environment via Multi-Trajectory Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30463)
*Danilo Saccani,Lorenzo Fagiano*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出多轨迹模型预测控制(mt-MPC)，在同一有限时域最优控制问题中并行评估多条未来状态轨迹，从而部分解耦约束满足(避障安全)与代价最小化(目标趋近)，用于LiDAR部分可观测环境下无人机自主导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR仅提供局部环境描述，障碍物约束随运动时变，标准MPC需在安全性与目标趋近之间做刚性权衡，常导致保守或不可行。作者希望在单一FHOCP内解耦安全性(约束满足)与利用性(代价优化)，提升未知环境下自主导航的可行性与性能。

Method: 分层控制架构：底层回路稳定飞行器轨迹并跟踪设定点；高层为mt-MPC控制器。mt-MPC在同一个FHOCP中显式考虑多条未来状态轨迹(多模态预测/决策)，使约束满足与代价函数最小化在一定程度解耦。在环境时不变假设下给出递归可行性与持续避障保证，并与标准MPC在仿真中对比。

Result: 理论上导出递归可行性与持续避障的保证(时不变环境假设下)；仿真表明相较标准MPC有良好性能提升。

Conclusion: 多轨迹MPC为部分可观测、时变约束下的无人机自主导航提供了一种兼顾安全与任务达成的统一优化框架，具备可行性保证；局限在于保证依赖时不变环境假设，证据仅来自仿真，未经实机验证。

Abstract: A novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation, named multi-trajectory MPC (mt-MPC), is presented and applied to the problem of autonomous navigation of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in an unknown environment. The UAV is equipped with a LiDAR sensor, providing only a partial description of the surroundings and resulting in time-varying constraints as the vehicle navigates among the obstacles. The control system layout is hierarchical: the low-level loops stabilize the vehicle's trajectories and track the set-points commanded by the high-level, mt-MPC controller. The latter is required to plan the UAV trajectory trading off safety, i.e. to avoid collisions with the uncertain obstacles, and exploitation, i.e. to reach an assigned target location. To achieve this goal, mt-MPC considers different future state trajectories in the same Finite Horizon Optimal Control Problem (FHOCP), enabling a partial decoupling between constraint satisfaction (safety) and cost function minimization (exploitation). Recursive feasibility and, consequently, persistent obstacle avoidance guarantees are derived under the assumption of a time invariant environment. The performance of the approach is studied in simulation and compared with that of a standard MPC, showing good improvement.

</details>


<div id='cs.DL'></div>

# cs.DL [[Back]](#toc)

### [597] [CHICO: Bridging Sparse Metadata and Multimodal Evidence in Cultural Heritage Collections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30923)
*Vagner Inácio de Oliveira,Paula Dornhofer Paro Costa*

Main category: cs.DL

TL;DR: CHICO is a multimodal dataset built from Europeana, containing 60k+ cultural heritage catalog records with curated metadata fields, linked images, and contextual information for evidence-grounded description generation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cultural heritage aggregators expose millions of digitized items but their catalog records are sparse, heterogeneous, and often link to inaccessible images, making reproducible multimodal experimentation difficult.

Method: Curates Europeana records into a structured dataset: paired catalog fields (title, description, subject/type metadata, provider context) and validated image links, preserving original raw records alongside the structured fields.

Result: Releases 60,000+ heritage records with associated images; supports evidence-grounded caption/description generation, multimodal retrieval, metadata enrichment, and evidence-based evaluation.

Conclusion: CHICO offers a reproducible, provenance-preserving resource for multimodal research on cultural heritage, extensible to retrieval and metadata tasks beyond description generation.

Abstract: Cultural heritage aggregators provide access to millions of digitized items. Yet their catalog records often contain sparse, heterogeneous metadata, with associated media links that may not lead to accessible images. Structuring and validating these resources for multimodal AI research can support reproducible experimentation. To this end, we present CHICO (Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects), a multimodal dataset derived from Europeana that brings together curated catalog fields, images, and contextual information to support evidence-grounded description generation while retaining the original Europeana records. It comprises more than 60,000 cultural heritage records with associated images. Although originally developed for that purpose, it can also support multimodal information retrieval, metadata enrichment, and evidence-based evaluation.

</details>
