### [598] [Beyond Fidelity: Evaluating Synthetic Medical Imaging Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28154)
*Seyed Kahaki,Alexander R. Webber,Tahsin Rahman,Elim Thompson,Jana Delfino,Aldo Badano*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出 ScoreCard Toolkit，将 7Cs 框架中的六个维度（Congruence、Coverage、Completeness、Consistency、Constraint、Comprehension）工程化为模块化流水线，用于评估合成医学影像数据集质量，并在数字病理、数字乳腺摄影和头部 CT 三种模态上演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成医学影像数据集的评价主要依赖通用计算机视觉的保真度指标，无法刻画解剖合理性、覆盖度、元数据完整性、子群一致性与文档质量等临床相关属性，缺乏系统化、可跨模态的质量评估手段。

Method: 构建模块化评估流水线，包含预处理、特征提取（外观、纹理、形状，并可扩展至放射组学特征、深度学习嵌入与基础模型表征）、指标计算、可视化与结构化评分卡生成；将 7Cs 中的六个维度操作化为可计算指标，补充保真度指标之外的约束违背、解剖不合理形状伪影与元数据一致性检查。

Result: 在合成全切片病理图像块、合成数字乳腺摄影与合成头部 CT 三种模态上完成端到端验证；生成的评分卡揭示各数据集特有的质量特征，包括分布偏倚与覆盖缺口，这些因素可能影响模型开发或测试的有效性。

Conclusion: ScoreCard 提供了一种实用、可扩展、模态无关的合成医学影像数据集质量评估与透明化报告框架，可作为保真度指标的互补工具；但属于评估工具，未提供生成方法或下游模型性能的实证增益。

Abstract: The growing use of synthetic medical imaging datasets (SMD) in the development and evaluation of machine learning models has motivated interest in systematic methods to assess dataset quality across different imaging modalities. Common evaluation strategies rely heavily on fidelity-oriented metrics developed for general computer vision and may not capture clinically relevant properties such as anatomical plausibility, dataset coverage, metadata completeness, subgroup consistency, or documentation quality. We present the ScoreCard Toolkit that operationalizes six of the seven dimensions found within the 7Cs approach for SMD evaluation across Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension. The ScoreCard Toolkit provides a modular pipeline for preprocessing, feature extraction, metric computation, visualization, and structured scorecard generation. This approach complements standard fidelity-based evaluation by exposing quality characteristics not captured by those measures alone, including constraint violations, anatomically implausible shape artifacts, and metadata-related consistency issues. The toolkit supports appearance, texture, and shape features and is designed to accommodate additional feature representations, including radiomic features, deep-learning embeddings, and foundation-model representations. We demonstrate the end-to-end workflow across three imaging modalities: synthetic digital pathology whole-slide image patch data, synthetic digital mammography, and synthetic head CT. Across all three modalities, the resulting scorecards reveal dataset-specific quality characteristics, such as distributional biases and coverage gaps that may impact their effectiveness for model development or testing. ScoreCard provides a practical, extensible, and modality-agnostic approach for evaluating and transparently reporting SMD quality.

</details>


### [599] [Which Vertebral Landmark Errors Change a Cobb Angle? Geometry-Weighted Supervision for Radiographic Landmark Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28156)
*Zizhao Peng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出从三角度读片器几何推导训练损失，用Hadamard正交基在8个角点位移自由度中单独加权影响弦宽的旋转方向，在372张正位X光片上验证可降低脊柱曲率读取的对称百分比误差（18.45%→17.20%→16.89%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脊柱曲率测量本质上是角点定位后用连线旋转角度，但常规坐标监督不区分各方向对角度读数的敏感度差异，导致像素误差下降未必带来角度一致性提升。

Method: 分析椎体四边形8个角点位移自由度，识别出使左右弦旋转的单一局部方向，其角度敏感度与弦宽成反比；借Hadamard正交基构造残差加权损失，保留其余7方向监督，并叠加软成对角度项；5折图像级划分、45次拟合、三种子角点集成，辅以单角点扰动分析。

Result: 池化对称百分比误差由坐标监督18.45%降至几何加权17.20%，再加软角度项至16.89%（配对差−1.56pp，95% bootstrap区间[−2.51,−0.61]）；软项增量区间含零；单种子下旋转残差降36.1%，归一化角点误差由2.60%升至2.71%；单折中单位弦直接监督同样有增益且与几何加权差异不确定。

Conclusion: 揭示了地标保真度与指定几何读片器一致性之间的可测量权衡；结论限于内部图像级划分与地标导出的目标角度，未涉及真实读片流程或跨机构泛化。

Abstract: A network that localizes vertebral corners can reduce pixel error while rotating the line used to measure spinal curvature. We derive a training loss from the geometry of a three-angle reader. Of the eight corner-displacement degrees of freedom of a vertebral quadrilateral, one local direction rotates its left-to-right chord. The angular sensitivity in this direction is inversely proportional to chord width. An orthonormal Hadamard basis lets us give this residual extra weight during training while retaining supervision on the other seven directions. In five-fold image-level development experiments on 372 anteroposterior radiographs, we compared three objectives across 45 fits of the same landmark network. The three-seed corner ensemble reduced pooled symmetric percentage error from 18.45% with coordinate supervision to 17.20% with geometry weighting. Adding a soft pairwise-angle term yielded 16.89%, a paired difference of $-1.56$ percentage points from coordinate supervision (95% image-bootstrap interval $[-2.51,-0.61]$). The interval for the increment from adding the soft term included zero. In a single-fold comparison, direct unit-chord supervision also reduced error, and its difference from geometry weighting was uncertain. Across single-seed runs, rotational residual error fell by 36.1% while normalized corner error rose from 2.60% to 2.71%. Perturbing one vertebra at a time also showed when a small rotation changes the selected end pair. These results identify a measurable trade-off between landmark fidelity and agreement with a specified geometric reader. The evaluation concerns an internal image-level split and landmark-derived target angles.

</details>


### [600] [Duplicate- and Patient-Overlap Leakage in Brain MRI Tumor Classification: A Multi-Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28161)
*Xin Li,Samson Oluwadare*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 对Cheng/Figshare脑肿瘤MRI基准做图像重复与患者重叠审计，用图像级 vs 记录ID不相交协议、五折40次原始训练、患者簇bootstrap及固定测试集暴露实验，量化重叠对判别性能、概率误差与模型排名的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一患者的重复MRI图像与相近切片会同时污染脑肿瘤分类器的评估；先前工作对患者重叠如何影响判别能力、校准误差和模型排名的量化审计不足。

Method: 基于Cheng/Figshare数据集（3064张增强T1切片、3类肿瘤、233个记录ID，DICOM原始记录不可验证）；4种CNN架构在图像级与记录ID不相交协议下各5折训练（40次原始运行），患者簇bootstrap估计不确定性；扩展含60次划分种子、40次训练种子及72次固定测试集“同胞暴露”实验并配类匹配其他患者对照；Holm校正的多重检验。

Result: 未发现完全重复图像，筛查配对中跨患者近重复证据薄弱；图像级减记录ID不相交的平衡准确率差为+0.0318~+0.0462；图像级评估下ECE与多类Brier分更低；该差异在ResNet50与DenseNet121新种子下持续，但原始排名反转未复现；仅ResNet50第2折通过Holm校正；16个相关探索性子组估计均为正但无一致剂量-反应关系。

Conclusion: 患者重叠与该基准上的表观性能提升相关；固定测试集比较无法将患者身份与共享解剖/采集特征分离，且未做独立外部临床验证。属医学影像评估方法学审计，对本方向的阅读优先度低。

Abstract: Background. Repeated MRI images and distinct slices from the same patient can both compromise evaluation of brain tumor classifiers. Objective. We audited image duplication and examined how patient overlap relates to discrimination, probability error and model ranking. Methods. The Cheng/Figshare dataset contains 3,064 contrast-enhanced T1 MRI slices, three tumor classes and 233 recorded patient IDs. The dataset author advised treating the IDs as individuals, but original DICOM records were unavailable for verification. Four CNN architectures were trained under image-level and recorded-ID-disjoint protocols with five folds matched on size and class counts (40 original runs). A patient-cluster bootstrap quantified uncertainty. The extension added 60 split-seed runs, 40 training-seed runs and 72 fixed-test sibling-exposure runs with class-matched other-patient controls. Results. We found no exact duplicate images and little evidence of cross-patient near-duplicates among screened pairs. Image-level minus recorded-ID-disjoint balanced accuracy ranged from +0.0318 to +0.0462 across models. Expected calibration error and multiclass Brier scores were lower on the image-level evaluation sample. The balanced-accuracy difference persisted across new seeds for ResNet50 and DenseNet121, but their original ranking reversal did not replicate. Only ResNet50 in fold 2 passed Holm correction in the five-test exposure family. All 16 correlated exploratory subgroup estimates were positive, with no consistent dose-response. Conclusions. Patient overlap was associated with higher apparent performance on this benchmark. Fixed-test comparisons could not isolate patient identity from shared anatomy or acquisition characteristics. No independent external clinical validation was performed.

</details>


### [601] [The UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28164)
*Augusto Sarquis Serpa,Mariana Ramos Scolari,Eduardo Moreno Judice de Mattos Farina,Eduardo Caminha Nunes,Felipe Matsuoka,Felipe Campos Kitamura,Nitamar Abdala*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset：285 例未增强 CT（344 序列、99,883 图像、264 患者），提供肝脏脂肪变性二分类标签，用于胸部 CT 机会性筛查研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肝脂肪变性常见、多无症状，在因其他原因（如胸部 CT 部分包含上腹部）进行的 CT 检查中可见，但缺乏公开、去标识化的数据集支撑自动检出研究。

Method: 由放射科住院医师在肝脏三个 ROI 与脾脏一个 ROI 间比较衰减值给出二分类标签；以「肝衰减低于脾衰减」作为自动判别的技术验证判据；图像以去标识化 DICOM 发布，并按 226 训练 / 38 胸部 CT 测试划分用于 2022 年 Kaggle 竞赛。

Result: 自动判据标签与人工标签在 206/226 训练患者上一致（91%）。

Conclusion: 该数据集为胸部 CT 上的机会性脂肪肝筛查提供了公开基准，但标注基于简单阈值规则，规模与临床标注深度有限，属医学影像数据集类工作。

Abstract: Hepatic steatosis is common, usually asymptomatic, and frequently visible on CT examinations performed for other reasons, including chest CT, in which the upper abdomen is partly included. We describe the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Dataset, a public collection of 285 unenhanced CT studies (344 series, 99,883 images) from 264 patients examined at a single academic center in Brazil: 152 patients with chest CT and 112 patients with abdominal CT. Each patient has a binary label for the presence of hepatic steatosis, assigned by a radiology resident who compared the attenuation of three regions of interest in the liver with one in the spleen. Images are provided in de-identified DICOM format. The dataset was used in the UNIFESP Chest CT Fatty Liver Competition, hosted on Kaggle in 2022, with 226 patients for training and 38 patients with chest CT for testing. In a technical validation, the criterion of liver attenuation lower than spleen attenuation, measured automatically, agreed with the labels in 206 of the 226 training patients (91%). The dataset is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [602] [Quality-Control Policies Shape Model Behaviour in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28179)
*Mario Parreño Centeno,Yu Guan,Pedro Montero Pavón,Sanna Palosaari,Juha Väyrynen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出PathQC-3C数据集与TileNet框架，将组织/背景/伪影的稠密质量估计与任务相关的输入选择策略解耦，使质控政策可配置、可测试，并在CAMELYON16、弱标签肺分类和PathQCAug设置中验证策略效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算病理模型的质量控制策略决定哪些图像区域进入模型，但当质量估计与输入选择耦合时，其效应难以孤立评估；作者希望将质控政策显式化、可配置化、可测试化。

Method: 构建PathQC-3C数据集（32类癌/组织、1,194张H&E全切片中的1,661个稠密标注区域）；提出TileNet，将稠密组织/背景/伪影估计与任务特定输入选择策略分离；在三个留出队列上评估默认预测器并与统一化质控基线对比，由单病理学家盲审审阅策略决策，并在三个下游设置中测试替代策略。

Result: CAMELYON16多示例学习中，背景感知选择使固定tile预算下池化OOF ROC-AUC从0.758提升至0.839；弱标签肺分类中严格伪影排除使候选池缩小约43%，匹配训练集规模与患者贡献后指标差异较小且依指标而异；PathQCAug在严重合成伪影下提升高伪影tile宏Dice，并在三个随机种子下优于随机擦除与清洁组织对照。

Conclusion: 将质量估计与策略执行分离提供了可审计地控制进入计算病理模型的图像内容的方式；合适策略依任务而异，临床价值尚待确立。

Abstract: Quality-control policies determine which image regions are used by computational pathology models, but their effects are difficult to isolate when quality estimation and input selection are coupled. We make these policies explicit, configurable and testable. We introduce PathQC-3C, comprising 1,661 densely annotated regions from 1,194 haematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images across 32 cancer/tissue categories, and TileNet, a framework that separates dense tissue/background/artefact estimation from task-specific input-selection policies. We evaluated the default predictor across three held-out cohorts and against harmonised quality-control comparators, assessed policy decisions in a blinded single-pathologist audit, and tested alternative policies in three downstream settings. In retrospective CAMELYON16 multiple-instance learning, background-aware selection improved the pooled out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.758 to 0.839 compared with random sampling from the same exhaustive candidate pool under a fixed tile budget. In weak-label lung classification, strict artefact exclusion reduced the pre-matching candidate pool by approximately 43%, with small metric-dependent differences after matching training-set size and patient contribution. PathQCAug, which composites real artefact components during tumour-stroma model adaptation, improved macro Dice on high-artefact tiles under severe held-out composited artefacts across three training seeds and outperformed random-erasing and clean-tissue controls. Separating quality estimation from policy execution provides an auditable way to control which image content enters computational pathology models; the appropriate policy is task specific, and clinical utility remains to be established.

</details>


### [603] [Beyond Outlier Rejection: Transient-Aware Reconstruction of Multi-Stack MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28184)
*Anika Knupfer,Maximilian Lindholz,Maria Camila Bustos-Vivas,Joseph V. Hajnal,Bodo Rosenhahn,Jana Hutter*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出"分析-合成"分解框架，将每次MRI采集的体素显式解释为共享静态解剖+每栈刚体/平滑非刚体运动+稀疏瞬态场，无需训练数据即可分离运动/瞬变信号，优于SVRTK/NeSVoR并可用于病灶定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多栈2D切片重建（SVRTK、NeSVoR）把不符合解剖的部分降权丢弃，但在活体组织中，扫描期间的变化（胎动、子宫收缩）本身即临床相关生理信号，应被保留并分离建模而非简单抑制。

Method: 基于精确采集几何的生成式分解模型：静态解剖（所有栈共享）+每栈刚体变换+每栈平滑非刚体形变+每栈稀疏瞬态场，配鲁棒重加权防止瞬态污染解剖；逐被试优化、无训练数据、单一超参配置适用于所有数据集。

Result: 数字体模上静态变化完全保留于解剖，瞬态栈在12mm半径处恢复68%信号；留出栈预测NCC：子宫0.897 vs 0.874/0.863（123例）、跨站点前列腺0.847 vs 0.795/0.757（85例）、胎儿脑0.771 vs 0.763/0.747（83例）；瞬态场检测损坏胎片AUROC 0.94；作为冻结健康异常检测器输入，子宫病灶定位AUROC 0.76 vs 0.71/0.71（37例）。

Conclusion: 显式建模采集期间瞬态变化可同时提升结构保真度与运动/异常信息利用率，具备跨器官、跨站点泛化能力且无需训练数据。

Abstract: Clinical MRI typically acquires the organ of interest as consecutive stacks of 2D slices in different orientations. Reconstruction methods such as SVRTK and NeSVoR fuse them into one volume and down-weight what does not fit, although in living tissue the change during the scan is often the signal itself and can contain clinically relevant physiological information, such as fetal motion and uterine contraction. We propose an analysis-by-synthesis decomposition that explains every acquired voxel through its exact acquisition geometry as a static anatomy shared by all stacks, a rigid and smooth non-rigid motion per stack, and a sparse transient field per stack for changes during one acquisition only. A robust reweighting keeps such changes out of the anatomy. The model is fitted per subject without training data, with one configuration for all datasets. On a digital phantom with known ground truth, static changes are kept entirely in the anatomy, and the transient field of the stack that saw a transient recovers 68% of it at 12mm radius. From identical inputs, the anatomy predicts held-out stacks better than SVRTK and NeSVoR on uterine (NCC 0.897 against 0.874 and 0.863, 123 patients) and on prostate MRI from unseen sites and scanners (0.847 against 0.795 and 0.757, 85 patients), and on fetal brain MRI as well as SVRTK and better than NeSVoR (0.771 against 0.763 and 0.747, 83 fetuses). The transient fields flag corrupted fetal slices with an AUROC of 0.94 against expert raters. As the input of a frozen anomaly detector trained on healthy subjects only, the anatomy localizes radiologist-delineated uterine lesions better than the SVRTK and NeSVoR volumes (AUROC 0.76 against 0.71 and 0.71, 37 patients).

</details>


### [604] [EID-Net: Endoscopic Illumination-aware Degradation Correction Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28198)
*Junzhi Liu,Yinghao Zeng,Yang Liu,Huafeng Li,Xiaosong Li*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: EID-Net：从内窥镜图像中显式提取面向内窥镜的退化先验，并通过光照调制的转置注意力（调制 key-value 特征子空间）注入解码器，实现结构保持的空间非均匀曝光与色偏校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内窥镜图像在复杂照明下存在空间非均匀曝光退化（局部欠曝、过曝及光照引起的颜色变化），且与组织纹理纠缠，通用低光增强/复原方法难以在提升可见性的同时保持局部结构与色彩线索。

Method: 将光照校正从全局强度调整转为统一的退化先验表示：编码器显式提取内窥镜导向的退化先验（illumination-aware degradation prior），在解码器中通过 illumination-modulated transposed attention 机制按先验自适应调制 key-value 特征子空间以引导特征聚合。

Result: 在 CEC、Endo4IE、EndoVis17、EndoVis18 四个数据集上的实验表明，EID-Net 优于近期的内窥镜增强方法与通用图像复原方法（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体指标）。

Conclusion: 面向内窥镜场景的专用退化先验 + 注意力调制是处理空间非均匀曝光与色偏的有效范式，代码已开源；但属医学影像增强领域，与具身/3D重建核心方向关联弱。

Abstract: Endoscopic images captured under complex illumination conditions often suffer from spatially non-uniform exposure degradation, including local under-exposure, over-exposure, and illumination-induced color variation. These degradations are usually entangled with tissue structures, making it challenging for general-purpose low-light enhancement and image restoration methods to improve visibility while preserving local structural and chromatic cues. In this paper, we propose EID-Net, an endoscopic illumination-aware degradation correction network for structure-preserving endoscopic illumination correction. Rather than treating illumination correction as a global intensity adjustment, EID-Net explicitly extracts an endoscopy-oriented degradation prior from the input image to characterize illumination-related variations in a unified representation. This prior is then introduced into the decoder through an illumination-modulated transposed attention mechanism, where it adaptively guides feature aggregation by modulating the key-value feature subspace. Extensive experiments on CEC, Endo4IE, EndoVis17, and EndoVis18 datasets demonstrate that EID-Net performs favorably against recent endoscopic enhancement and general image restoration methods. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [605] [3D-EMCAD: Efficient Multi-scale Convolutional Attention Decoding for Volumetric Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29027)
*Iftakhar Hossain,Israt Jahan Sinthia,Md. Hadiur Rahman Khan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 将2D轻量解码器EMCAD扩展为3D分割解码器，在BraTS 2020上与四种解码器在统一编码器和训练协议下对比，发现解码器选择对体素级脑肿瘤分割精度无显著影响，而3D-EMCAD参数量与运算量最小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年体素级脑肿瘤分割倾向使用高容量解码器，在高空间分辨率的3D场景下计算代价高，而轻量解码器EMCAD仅在有2D验证，缺少3D场景下的有效性与必要性证据。

Method: 将EMCAD全部算子三维化、把标准归一化替换为组归一化以适配体素训练的小批量，得到3D-EMCAD。固定同一3D SegResNet编码器与训练协议，在BraTS 2020（369例、三折交叉验证）上对比3D-EMCAD、SegResNet原版解码器、Attention U-Net解码器、UNet++和普通U-Net解码器五种解码器。

Result: 五种解码器性能统计上不可区分：平均Dice跨度仅0.0071，小于多数模型的折间波动；配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验显示3D-EMCAD与四基线中的三个无显著差异。3D-EMCAD解码器参数最少（1.15 M）、运算量最少（8.6 G），比得分不更高的UNet++少7.3倍运算量。

Conclusion: 在适度的计算预算之上，增加解码器容量对体素级脑肿瘤分割无可测收益；解码器架构选择在固定编码器条件下并非性能瓶颈。

Abstract: Encoder-decoder networks are widely used for volumetric brain tumor segmentation, yet recent trends favor high-capacity decoders that incur steep computational costs in 3D at high spatial resolutions. The Efficient Multi-scale Convolutional Attention Decoder (EMCAD) is a lightweight decoder that achieves strong accuracy at very low cost, but it has been validated only in 2D. Here, we extend EMCAD to volumetric segmentation (3D-EMCAD) by converting all operations to 3D and replacing standard normalization layers with group normalization to suit the small batch sizes of volumetric training. To isolate the impact of decoder choice, we evaluate five decoders: the proposed 3D-EMCAD, a vanilla SegResNet decoder, an Attention U-Net decoder, UNet++, and a plain U-Net decoder using an identical 3D SegResNet encoder and training protocol on BraTS 2020 (369 cases, three-fold cross-validation). The five decoders yield statistically indistinguishable performance: their mean Dice scores span only 0.0071, less than the fold-to-fold variation of most models, and a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test shows no significant difference between 3D-EMCAD and three of the four baselines. Importantly, 3D-EMCAD achieves this shared accuracy with the fewest decoder parameters (1.15 M) and operations (8.6 G), requiring $7.3\times$ fewer operations than UNet++, which scores no higher. These findings demonstrate that decoder capacity beyond a modest budget offers no measurable benefit for volumetric brain tumor segmentation.

</details>


### [606] [Generalizable Variable-Rate Adaptation for Image Coding for Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29914)
*Yui Tatsumi,Hiroshi Watanabe*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出任务无关（loss-agnostic）的蒸馏框架，将预训练固定码率ICM模型作为冻结教师，学生模型通过重要性自适应量化与蒸馏优化实现变码率、连续码率控制，无需原任务损失或下游标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICM模型多为固定工作点训练，扩展到可变码率困难：不同任务与模型设计的训练目标不一致，难以直接改造。

Method: 冻结的固定码率ICM教师模型 + 学生模型；引入重要性自适应量化（importance-adaptive quantization）与基于蒸馏的优化，使学生以单模型覆盖连续码率区间，并保持任务相关的潜在分量。

Result: 在现有ICM模型上实验表明，所提方法可实现连续码率控制，识别性能与固定码率模型相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 蒸馏是一种通用的、与任务损失解耦的变码率化路径，可单一模型替代多固定码率模型部署，降低存储与训练成本。

Abstract: Image Coding for Machines (ICM) aims to preserve task-relevant information for machine vision under limited bitrates. However, most ICM models are trained for a fixed operating point, and extending them to variable-rate compression is challenging because their training objectives differ across tasks and model designs. In this paper, we propose a loss-agnostic distillation framework for variable-rate ICM. A pretrained fixed-rate ICM model is used as a frozen teacher, while a student model learns variable-rate behavior through importance-adaptive quantization and distillation-based optimization. This enables continuous bitrate control with a single model while preserving task-relevant latent components, without requiring the original task-specific loss or downstream task labels. Experiments based on existing ICM models demonstrate that the proposed method provides continuous bitrate control and achieves competitive recognition performance compared with the fixed-rate models.

</details>


### [607] [Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31014)
*Sahar Askari,Amin Golnari*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文通过在同一批模型上测量人口统计学编码、诊断公平性差距和成员推断脆弱性，检验三者是否对齐。结论是隐私泄露与公平性/ demographic 编码基本无关，应分别审计；线性头或更短训练可降低泄露且几乎不损失效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学基础模型既可编码患者人口统计学信息、又可能暴露训练集成员身份，社区常将这两类风险视为同一问题，缺乏在同一模型上对二者相关性的实证检验。

Method: 在冻结的 BiomedCLIP、DINOv2、RAD-DINO 嵌入上训练 200 个线性或 MLP 头（3 个随机种子），在 CheXpert 与 NIH ChestX-ray14 上审计；测量人口统计学解码能力、诊断公平性差距（如年龄相关漏诊）与成员推断 AUC，并做线性擦除（erase linearly decodable demographics）对照实验。

Result: 人口统计学编码几乎不能解释患者脆弱性的方差，72 个 CheXpert 关联在统计上等价于零；擦除线性可解码的人口统计学信息未改变泄露，但缩小了年龄相关漏诊差距。泄露主要由头部容量与训练时长决定：RAD-DINO 上线性头 MIA AUC 为 0.694，30 epoch MLP 为 0.907，测试性能相近。

Conclusion: 公平性与隐私应作为独立维度分别审计；使用线性探针头或缩短训练可在几乎不损失临床效用的前提下降低成员推断泄露。

Abstract: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [608] [State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28508)
*Yuxiang Wei,Zundong Wu,Weiyu Sun,Qizhen Lan,Yanteng Zhang,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spectator：线性潜空间"世界模型"追踪个体fMRI脑状态；配套BrainStateBench基准，含State/Forecast/Updating三任务，显示仅凭刺激的编码器无法捕捉脑状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑世界模型无法维持持久潜状态，且标准神经预测相关性指标无法区分模型是真正追踪个体脑状态还是仅依赖刺激输入，缺乏直接检验状态推断/预测/更新的评测手段。

Method: 在全皮层、电影刺激驱动的fMRI上构建BrainStateBench，用冻结线性探针读取潜状态以检验状态推断（State：重复刺激下的试次间变异）、无新观测的预测（Forecast）与带新观测的更新（Updating）。提出Spectator：以联合嵌入预测目标训练的线性潜世界模型，将短/长时程观测历史编码为双时间尺度潜状态，并由当前状态与刺激线性预测状态转移。

Result: 仅刺激编码器在无脑观测时fMRI预测相关达0.320（State为0%）；已有深度脑世界模型仅0.239且State≤0.4%。Spectator取得0.349相关，State 5.5%、Forecast 16.0%、Updating 20.3%，全面优于基线，且预测速度比深度模型快逾20倍。

Conclusion: 持续潜状态对自然脑活动建模是可学且可验证的，简化的线性潜世界模型在该任务上优于深度方案；但State绝对水平仍低，提示个体状态追踪仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

</details>


### [609] [RadAG: Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28809)
*Hyeongchan Jeon,Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG)，通过沿奖励梯度扰动单个注意力块的 logits 构造参考点并做外推，从而在无需全生成器反向传播的前提下实现奖励引导采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时引导方法存在权衡：外推式引导（CFG 及变体）仅需前向计算，但参考点由与奖励无关的启发式规则构造，无法指向特定奖励；基于梯度的奖励引导虽能直接提升奖励，却需在每一步反传整个生成器，代价高昂。作者希望兼得两者优点。

Method: RadAG 在单个注意力块上计算奖励对该块注意力 logits 的梯度，据此构造对抗性扰动参考，并将采样外推至远离该参考的方向；理论上证明该更新使干净估计的奖励获得一阶提升，且反向传播止于被扰动的块而非贯穿整个生成器。

Result: 在 FLUX.2-klein-4B 与 9B 上，结合 PickScore 与美学奖励，RadAG 在所有设置下取得最高的目标奖励，且耗时比梯度式和候选式基线少 30–65%。

Conclusion: 局部化（单块）奖励梯度足以构造有效的外推参考，从而以接近前向引导的开销获得奖励对齐效果，为推理时奖励引导提供了一条低成本路径。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models have achieved remarkable success in generation, yet their samples often remain suboptimal in fidelity and text alignment. Two lines of inference-time methods address this: extrapolation guidance, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) and its variants, and reward guidance, which aligns samples with reward models of human preference. Extrapolation guidance needs only forward passes, but it builds its reference by heuristic rules unrelated to the reward and therefore cannot steer sampling toward a given reward. Gradient-based reward guidance steers sampling directly toward a higher reward, but backpropagates through the entire generator at every step. This trade-off raises the question of whether extrapolation guidance can steer sampling toward a higher reward without a full backward pass. To answer this, we introduce Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG), which constructs the reference by perturbing the attention logits of a single block against their reward gradient and extrapolates away from it. We prove that this update increases the reward of the clean estimate to first order, while its backward pass stops at the perturbed block instead of traversing the entire generator. On FLUX.2-klein-4B and 9B with PickScore and aesthetic rewards, RadAG achieves the highest target reward in every setting with 30-65% less time than gradient-based and candidate-based baselines.

</details>


### [610] [DiRGeo: Learning Directional Geometry of Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29057)
*Muhammad Ahtesham,Xin Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiRGeo 在冻结视觉表征上学习 Randers 几何下的方向性几何，用自监督对比从有序图像轨迹估计状态相关方向场，实现不对称的表示距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉表征的几何度量是对称的，对沿同一路径的正向与反向运动赋相同代价，无法刻画视觉过程中的方向性结构（如吸引子收敛方向、过程特异性偏置）。

Method: 基于 Randers 几何学习状态依赖的方向场：从有序图像轨迹以自监督对比目标训练，无需语义标签；引入球面切空间校正以剥离归一化伪影，并用吸引子相对分解区分方向结构与共同收敛效应。在 17 种视觉过程、3 个编码器族、多个表征深度上验证。

Result: 实现一致的方向判别与整路径不对称性，且超出简单吸引子解释；方向场在更深层表征中更具过程特异性；自然视频实验显示事件相关的方向偏好；作为功能验证可指导图像复原方法的选择。

Conclusion: 方向性几何可作为对称表征分析的有效补充，为视觉表征提供新的结构刻画维度。

Abstract: Conventional geometric measures of visual representations are symmetric, assigning equal costs to forward and reverse motion along the same path. We propose DiRGeo, a framework for learning directional geometry over frozen visual representations. Grounded in Randers geometry, DiRGeo learns a state-dependent directional field from ordered image trajectories through self-supervised contrast, without semantic labels. Sphere-tangent correction and attractor-relative decomposition distinguish learned directional structure from normalization artifacts and common convergence. Experiments across 17 visual processes, three encoder families, and multiple representation depths demonstrate consistent directional discrimination and whole-path asymmetry beyond simple attractor-based explanations. The learned fields become increasingly process-specific in deeper representations, while natural-video experiments reveal event-dependent directional preferences. As functional validation, DiRGeo guides restoration selection. These results establish directional geometry as a useful complement to symmetric representation analysis.

</details>


### [611] [Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29269)
*Bowyn Tan,Zhilong Zheng,Yang Guan,Liming Xiao,Liye Tang,Xiao Li,Naizheng Wang,Keqiang Li,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DUET 提出双向投影算法：将新任务训练后的参数调整建模为双重约束优化，同时施加旧任务与新任务的 Jacobian 零空间约束，并用交替投影+收缩映射定理保证收敛，以有效秩感知的步长准则解决秩亏 Jacobian 下步长失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一致性正则/零空间投影（如 OGD、GPM 类方法）只做单向投影，仅最小化到新任务最优点的参数距离，忽略新任务损失地形，导致新任务可塑性受限。

Method: 训练后调整表述为双约束优化：最小化新旧训练间参数距离，s.t. 两任务损失保持约束；设计交替双向投影求解器，收敛性由收缩映射定理证明；提出有效秩感知的步长选择准则以支持可靠的多步投影。

Result: 在多个数据集上一致优于单向投影基线，达到 SOTA。

Conclusion: 双向耦合的零空间约束＋理论保证的交替投影器，为持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡提供了比单向投影更优的范式。

Abstract: Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algorithm, whose convergence is guaranteed by the contraction mapping theorem. For reliable multi-step projection, we rectify existing step size selection criteria via an effective-rank aware formulation, overcoming their failure under rank-deficient Jacobians. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET consistently outperforms existing unidirectional projection methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.

</details>


### [612] [CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29494)
*Ewsey Obzherin,Samira Atlangirieva,Anastasia Antsiferova,Valentin Khrulkov,Art Prosvetov,Andrey Kuznetsov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CoHABIT 框架，用互补的空间规则（几何有效性、可达性、功能组织、可配置设计偏好含风水）与基于学习型居民策略的动态评估（多智能体日常活动、资源共享、协调、个体负担）来评价家具布局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有家具布局评估多停留在静态几何/功能规则层面，缺乏对居民实际使用行为、多人协调与个体负担的刻画，难以说明布局如何服务不同家庭。

Method: 静态评估：几何有效性、人机功效可达性、功能组织、可配置偏好（含风水）。动态评估：学习居民策略以模拟多智能体家庭中的日常活动、资源共享与协调；受控对比实验分析空间准则与家庭行为的不同影响因素；用独立核验的家庭需求数据为动态比较提供锚定。

Result: 受控对比显示空间准则与家庭行为揭示布局质量的不同侧面；居民画像与日程会影响家具排序结果。

Conclusion: 将静态空间规则与行为仿真结合，可对家具环境对不同家庭的适配性给出可解释的评估。

Abstract: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

</details>


### [613] [Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29815)
*Tong Li,Chenru Wang,Chris Thomas,Shengwei An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文系统评估"模型免疫"（model immunization）的鲁棒性，发现现有方法对攻击者配置过拟合，在变化有害数据、适配策略或模型初始化后保护效果大幅失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源权重模型微调成本显著下降，恶意行为者可低成本将其适配至有害能力；现有免疫方法声称能在保留良性效用的同时抵御此类适配，但仅在优化所用的攻击配置附近评估，存在虚高的安全假象。

Method: 以控制变量方式解耦攻击者配置的三大要素（有害数据、适配策略、模型初始化），在文本到图像生成与图像分类任务上评估四种免疫方法，并补充语言模型实验结果。

Result: 逐一变换任一配置要素即导致保护效果显著退化，许多情况下被免疫模型重新习得有害能力的程度几乎与未免疫模型相当。

Conclusion: 现有模型免疫无法可靠地保护模型，对有害适配仍显脆弱，亟需面向真实威胁模型（多配置分布）的免疫设计。

Abstract: Efficient fine-tuning techniques have substantially reduced the cost of adapting open-weight models, enabling malicious actors to readily fine-tune them toward harmful capabilities. In response, model immunization modifies a pretrained checkpoint to resist subsequent adaptation toward designated harmful capabilities while preserving its utility and adaptability for benign tasks. Furthermore, a few immunization methods have sought to keep their protection robust to some changes in the attacker's adaptation. However, fine-tuning offers attackers many more low-cost options, and we observe that existing methods still substantially overfit to the attacker configuration they are optimized against. Such overfitting stays hidden when immunization is evaluated under, or near, this configuration, so the reported protection may give a false sense of security. To rigorously evaluate model immunization, we conduct experiments, varying one component of this configuration at a time: the harmful data, the adaptation strategy, or the model initialization. Across four immunization methods on text-to-image generation and image classification, with additional results on language models, these variations substantially degrade the protection, and in many cases the immunized model relearns the harmful capability nearly as well as the un-immunized model. Existing immunization therefore cannot reliably protect models, leaving them vulnerable to harmful adaptation.

</details>


### [614] [Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29905)
*Frédéric Li Combeau,Nicolas Michel,Toshihiko Yamasaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CL-P设定（训练与测试阶段均存在域偏移的持续学习+测试时适应），并指出朴素结合TTA会因BatchNorm共享统计量破坏已训练域；提出DOSE，按图像来自待适应域的概率比例施加适应，可无缝组合任意CL与TTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CL假设训练期分布漂移、CTTA仅在测试期处理新域，二者对训练与测试两阶段均需在线适应域偏移的联合设定探索不足；且直接组合CL与TTA会造成严重遗忘。

Method: 定义CL-P协议：训练阶段类似域增量学习，测试阶段先在未来域上做TTA"预览"，再在所有已见域评估。分析发现损害主要来自跨域共享的BatchNorm统计量；提出DOSE（Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain），在测试时做自适应域推断，以图像属于预览域的概率为权重按比例施加适应，从而解耦于具体CL/TTA方法。

Result: 在ResNet与ViT骨干、多种CL与TTA基线组合及多域数据集上共24个设置中，DOSE在全部设置中不劣于单用CL方法，并在除一个之外的所有设置中优于朴素组合。

Conclusion: 朴素CL+TTA组合会显著加剧遗忘，根源在于共享归一化统计量；按域概率加权的在线统计量调节（DOSE）是一种通用、即插即用的解决方案，为两阶段域偏移下的持续适应提供实用基线。

Abstract: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

</details>


### [615] [PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30050)
*Yasaman Mohammadpour,Pouya Shaeri,Ariane Middel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PsyDrift：以 ASD/健康对照监督学习 128 维功能连接表征，并用仅由健康样本潜变量训练的 DDPM 做重建偏差评分，在 ABIDE-I 20 站点上进行留一站点交叉验证（分类器 AUROC 0.798，DDPM 0.718），ABIDE-II/ADHD-200 冻结迁移 AUROC 分别为 0.69/0.61。作者自承相对传统健康参考打分器的增益不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）神经影像标记受个体异质性与采集站点差异干扰，单个分类判决难以刻画"偏离正常"的连续程度；作者希望在 ASD 监督表征空间内引入健康参考的生成式偏差建模，得到可解释的连续偏离分数。

Method: 编码器输出 128 维功能连接表征（受 ASD/HC 标签监督）；在该潜空间上仅用健康训练样本训练 DDPM；以扩散去噪重建与原始表征的距离作为受试者偏离分数。评估 1102 名被试、ABIDE-I 全部 20 站点、五随机种子留一站点交叉验证；并与同表征上的匹配健康参考打分器对比；在 ABIDE-II 与 ADHD-200 上做不重训、不调超参的冻结评估。

Result: 平均站点 AUROC：分类器 0.798±0.003，DDPM 0.718±0.013；匹配健康参考打分器为 0.68–0.71，扩散模型的数值优势统计显著性未确立。ASD 组内分数与 ADOS Total 相关 Spearman ρ=0.108 (p=0.038)、与全量表 IQ ρ=−0.138 (p=0.002)，且未校正年龄、性别、站点与头动。冻结迁移：ABIDE-II 合并 AUROC 0.69，ADHD-200 0.61。

Conclusion: 工作验证了"ASD 监督表征 + 健康参考扩散偏差打分"这一流程的可行性，但增量预测价值与临床价值均未确立；消融证据表明扩散建模本身未带来显著提升。属医学神经影像应用类工作，与本领域核心方法议题关联有限。

Abstract: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $\rho = 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($\rho = -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.

</details>


### [616] [How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30064)
*Xuanya Zhu,Da Li,Xiatian Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过曲率正则化作为受控干预，从动作条件“转移场”视角研究隐空间转移几何如何影响世界模型的多步规划效用，发现适度正则提升规划、过度则有害，且效应主要通过非仿射动作响应分量起作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估多依赖单步预测精度，但这一指标无法刻画多步规划效用；规划的关键在于区分不同候选未来，因此需要研究隐空间转移场的几何性质（曲率）如何塑造规划表现。

Method: 提出动作条件转移场（transition-field）分析视角，将转移场分解为仿射与非仿射分量；以曲率正则化作为受控干预，在四个连续控制任务上扫描正则强度；在冻结模型中直接操纵非仿射动作响应以验证因果作用；在LeWM上测试5种采样与梯度求解器，并在DINO-WM上验证rollout几何趋势；辅以注意力可视化。

Result: 适度曲率正则化改善规划，过强则损害；正则主要通过非仿射分量降低动作敏感性；直接操纵非仿射响应可改变候选选择与闭环成功率；曲率总体上使预测未来更接近，但保留更多沿目标方向的差异，解释了跨任务效应差异；多求解器与跨模型趋势基本一致。

Conclusion: 隐空间转移几何（曲率与非仿射动作敏感性）是决定世界模型多步规划效用的关键因素，可作为独立于单步精度的设计与诊断维度。

Abstract: World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.

</details>


### [617] [Regularizing Hard Examples Improves Adversarial Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30065)
*Hyungyu Lee,Saehyung Lee,Ho Bae,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究对抗训练中"难样本对泛化的负面影响"，理论证明对抗训练使难样本难度增幅远大于易样本、且难样本仅通过记忆标签被拟合；据此提出难度比例标签平滑（DPLS）自适应缓解该负面效应，从而提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究发现在标准训练中剪除"难学习样本"能提升泛化，但这一现象在对抗训练中未被研究；直接剪除难样本又面临最优阈值难以确定的问题，因此需要一种能保留难样本收益、同时规避其负面效应的自适应方法。

Method: 理论分析：证明对抗训练下难样本难度增量显著大于易样本，且难样本仅靠记忆标签被拟合；据此对难样本的负面影响进行理论+实证分析。方法：提出 Difficulty Proportional Label Smoothing (DPLS)，按样本难度成比例地施加标签平滑，自适应削弱难样本的记忆化负面影响。

Result: 理论与实证均表明剪除对抗训练中的难样本可提升模型鲁棒性；DPLS 无需人工设定剪除阈值，即可在利用难样本信息的同时规避其负面效应，实验显示鲁棒性得到提升。

Conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性可由"样本难度—记忆化"视角解释并改善；DPLS 提供了一种免阈值、可落地的难样本处理策略，但该方法属于通用对抗训练技术，未涉及具身/机器人感知与操作任务验证。

Abstract: Recent studies have validated that pruning hard-to-learn examples from training improves the generalization performance of neural networks (NNs). In this study, we investigate this intriguing phenomenon -- the negative effect of hard examples on generalization -- in adversarial training. Particularly, we theoretically demonstrate that the increase in the difficulty of hard examples in adversarial training is significantly greater than the increase in the difficulty of easy examples. Furthermore, we verify that hard examples are only fitted through memorization of the label in adversarial training. We conduct both theoretical and empirical analyses of this memorization phenomenon, showing that pruning hard examples in adversarial training can enhance the model's robustness. However, the challenge remains in finding the optimal threshold for removing hard examples that degrade robustness performance. Based upon these observations, we propose a new approach, difficulty proportional label smoothing (DPLS), to adaptively mitigate the negative effect of hard examples, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of NNs. Notably, our experimental result indicates that our method can successfully leverage hard examples while circumventing the negative effect.

</details>


### [618] [SGPC: Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint for Stable Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30265)
*Yifan Liu,Nan Zhang,Yang Cong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出安全引导策略(SGP)与安全引导策略约束(SGPC)，将安全RL重构为带条件性引导约束的约束优化问题，仅在策略被预测越出安全集时激活引导，最终得到可直接插入off-policy算法的actor训练约束，实例化为SAC-SGPC与TD3-SGPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始-对偶方法中，收益与约束惩罚通过自适应拉格朗日乘子耦合优化，在安全边界附近易产生策略振荡，并放大安全集外不可靠reward估计的影响，导致最优性与约束可行性的权衡困难。

Method: 引入SGP作为低成本参考策略并定义SGPC条件约束；actor更新时用学到的cost critic评估当前策略是否越界，越界则由SGP提供邻近低cost训练参考、由SGPC引导优化，进入安全集后该约束失效、退化为标准COP；对辅助COP施加原始-对偶优化，导出可插拔的actor训练约束并嵌入SAC与TD3。

Result: 在多个Safety-Gymnasium基准上，SGPC显著降低约束违反与cost振荡，同时保持有竞争力或更优的任务回报，取得更好的最优性-安全性权衡。

Conclusion: 以“条件激活的安全引导约束”替代纯乘子耦合，可缓解安全边界附近的策略振荡与安全集外估计偏差，是一种通用、即插即用的off-policy安全RL改进范式。

Abstract: Off-policy safe reinforcement learning (RL) faces a challenging trade-off between task optimality and constraint feasibility. In primal-dual methods, the coupled optimization of cumulative reward and constraint penalties through adaptive Lagrange multipliers may induce oscillatory policy updates near the safety boundary and amplify the effect of unreliable reward estimates outside the safe set. To address these issues, we formulate a new constrained optimization problem (COP) for safe RL by introducing a Safety-Guiding Policy (SGP) and a corresponding Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC). The proposed COP augments the standard COP in safe RL with a conditional safety-guidance constraint. During actor updates, the current actor is evaluated using the learned cost critic. If it is predicted to be outside the safe set, SGP provides a nearby lower-cost training reference, and SGPC guides actor optimization toward this reference. Once the policy enters the safe set, the added constraint becomes inactive, and the formulation reduces to the original COP. This formulation leads to a plug-in actor-training constraint that can be integrated into off-policy safe RL algorithms. By applying primal-dual optimization to the auxiliary COP, we finally derive an SGPC-based off-policy safe RL algorithm and implement it in two representative off-policy algorithms, yielding SAC-SGPC and TD3-SGPC. Experiments on multiple Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks demonstrate that SGPC achieves a better optimality-safety trade-off by substantially reducing constraint violations and cost oscillations while maintaining competitive or better task returns.

</details>


### [619] [Object-Centric Differentiable Logic Networks for Abstract Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30736)
*Hanne Say Eren,Ana Ezquerro,Ozan Özdenizci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Slot-Dwn：以无监督物体中心感知（slot）结合基于查找表（LUT）的无权重网络 MH-DWN，在布尔空间中做高效符号逻辑推理，以稀疏输入路由构建关系瓶颈，在抽象视觉推理基准上以更少参数、更快收敛实现强OOD泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉智能能以有限认知资源和极少经验进行关系类比与模块化抽象推理并泛化到新问题，而深度模型依赖大规模任务特定训练、易利用视觉捷径。现有神经符号方法虽解耦感知与推理，但依赖显式规则监督或参数庞大的Transformer，重蹈计算低效。

Method: 统一无监督物体中心感知（slot attention类）与逻辑符号推理；推理核心为 Multi-Head Differentiable Weightless Network（MH-DWN），以查找表在布尔空间完成可微推理；引入LUT驱动的关系瓶颈与稀疏输入路由以降低计算开销，并简化视觉感知复杂度。

Result: 在系统性规则泛化、小样本异常检测、多关系推理等抽象视觉推理基准上，极端OOD条件下性能与SOTA相当，可训练参数最多减少52%，收敛速度显著更快。

Conclusion: 以无权重LUT推理替代参数密集Transformer，是构建高泛化、低资源神经符号抽象视觉推理的有效路径；但评测限于合成/抽象视觉基准，缺乏真实场景或具身任务验证。

Abstract: Human visual intelligence enables efficient reasoning capabilities on abstract visual problems with bounded cognitive resources and minimal experience, and yields remarkable generalization to novel problems with its ability to draw relational analogies and modular abstractions. In contrast, deep learning models require exhaustive task-specific training on large datasets, making them prone to exploiting visual shortcuts and resulting in poor generalization. While neuro-symbolic approaches attempt to bridge this gap by decoupling perception from reasoning with dedicated computation units, existing solutions rely either on explicit rule supervision or parameter-heavy transformer architectures that reintroduce the computational inefficiencies they aim to solve. We introduce Slot-Dwn to address these limitations, a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies unsupervised object-centric perception with logic-based symbolic reasoning. Our model utilizes a Multi-Head Differentiable Weightless Network (MH-DWN) that performs efficient reasoning entirely in Boolean space using look-up tables (LUTs). Our framework reduces visual perception complexity and introduces a LUT-based relational bottleneck with sparse input routing to minimize computational overhead. We evaluate Slot-Dwn across various abstract visual reasoning benchmark tasks targeting systematic rule generalization, sample-efficient anomaly detection, and multi-relational reasoning. We demonstrate that Slot-Dwn yields competitive performance with respect to the state-of-the-art, under extreme out-of-distribution regimes, while requiring up to 52% fewer trainable parameters, with significantly faster convergence.

</details>


### [620] [Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30986)
*Yihong Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iTDM从理论上揭示现有前向扩散RL方法本质是带符号奖励加权回归(RWR)，存在behavior–policy不匹配引起的baseline梯度漂移，并提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配目标实现精确baseline不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前向扩散RL（无需轨迹反传的确定性ODE采样）被广泛用于高效对齐扩散模型，但作者指出其现有方法隐含假设策略速度等于行为边际速度，在CFG rollout、离线/异策略更新及在线自一致性不完善时该假设失效，导致baseline非不变与梯度漂移、训练不稳定。

Method: 利用后验得分恒等式取Trajectory Distribution Matching的无穷小时限，构造时间局部的奖励引导目标，得到锚定在行为速度上的样本级梯度，无需额外学习reward-tilted目标得分；再以在线辅助去噪器跟踪该速度，在辅助最优处保证精确的baseline不变性。

Result: 在组合生成、文本渲染、偏好对齐实验中取得SOTA的域内与域外表现；在GenEval2上收敛速度约为对比方法3倍，并可平滑扩展至0.87而不崩溃。

Conclusion: baseline诱导的梯度漂移是前向扩散RL的核心稳定性问题，iTDM通过瞬时局部匹配目标与辅助去噪器给出兼顾在线与离线RL的稳健方案，并提供开源代码。

Abstract: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [621] [RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31049)
*Yihao Qiao,Jiajian Ma,Wushuang Rui,Abhishek Jha,Aarti Darji,Yiqiu Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 分析PFN的PCA接口在少样本多模态表格学习中失效的机制：逐列标准化抹掉PCA分数方差导致样本塌缩为正单纯形；提出免训练的旋转冻结嵌入（RoFE），在PFN推理前旋转PCA分数使各列方差近似相等，从而保留嵌入几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFN等表格基础模型依赖上下文学习，但其预训练特征维度远低于现代图像/文本编码器输出的数百至数千维嵌入；现有用PCA压缩冻结嵌入的接口在标注样本稀少时甚至不如简单线性分类器，需查明并修复该失效机制。

Method: 从理论上识别PFN逐列标准化的方差消除问题（PCA保留全部方向时样本退化为等距正单纯形），提出RoFE：对PCA分数做正交旋转后再送入PFN推理，理论证明旋转可使列方差近似相等，使标准化近似保持嵌入几何；方法完全免训练。

Result: 在多种图像与文本分类任务、不同编码器和表格基础模型上，RoFE在低数据场景下优于PCA接口，并超过需要任务特定训练的基线；增益同样延伸到回归任务。

Conclusion: 指出了PCA+PFN接口的标准化塌缩失效机制，并以免训练的旋转修正给出简洁的理论与实证解，为多模态表格基础模型的少样本应用提供了低成本改进。

Abstract: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.

</details>

### [622] [A high-speed and high-resolution 3D velocity map imaging system with a neuromorphic camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28768)
*Sulaiman Abubakar,Blessed Oguh,Akaninyene Udoikono,Hackim Musah,Suk Kyoung Lee,Wen Li*

Main category: physics.ins-det

TL;DR: 用神经形态（事件驱动）相机替代帧相机，实现2微秒延迟的单粒子（离子/电子）探测，将相机式3D速度成像（VMI）系统的动量成像帧率从数kHz提升到100kHz以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统帧相机受读出速率限制，相机式VMI系统速度仅数kHz，成为动量成像通量的瓶颈；微通道板（MCP）成像探测器的快速响应潜力未被充分利用。

Method: 搭建改进的相机式3D-VMI系统，采用事件驱动神经形态相机配合微通道板成像探测器，利用事件触发机制实现低延迟单粒子命中探测，保留高空间分辨率与多命中（multi-hit）能力。

Result: 实现2 μs探测延迟，系统成像速度>100 kHz（较帧相机系统提升约1–2个数量级），同时维持优异的多命中能力与高时间分辨率。

Conclusion: 神经形态相机可显著突破相机式VMI的通量瓶颈，为高重复频率原子分子物理、超快动力学与反应显微成像提供高通量探测方案。

Abstract: An improved camera-based 3D-velocity map imaging (VMI) system was demonstrated with a neuromorphic camera. We show a machine vision event-driven camera can achieve an unprecedented latency of 2 microseconds when detecting single ion/electron with a microchannel plate imaging detector, which boosts the speed of the momentum imaging system to more than 100 kHz, while the system with a conventional frame camera is limited to a few kHz. The high spatial resolution of the camera offers additional performance boost while maintaining excellent multi-hit capability and a high time resolution.

</details>


### [623] [A Camera-Based Single-Volume, Monolithic Compton Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29116)
*Alex Bocchieri,Devanshi Jain,Andreas Velten*

Main category: physics.ins-det

TL;DR: 提出一种基于 SPAD 相机与单一紧凑整体式闪烁体的康普顿相机原型，可在 4π 视场内重建放射源位置，并能分辨整体式闪烁体内的两个同时事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统闪烁体康普顿相机需两个独立闪烁体体积或单一分割闪烁体，导致探测器体积庞大、效率低，且读出技术难以在整体式闪烁体中分辨相邻的两个事件。

Method: 采用百万像素级 SPAD 阵列相机（高分辨、高速光子计数、易扩展）配合一个紧凑整体式闪烁体，构建康普顿相机；沿用此前探索的多种光学与测量配置，扩展至在单一闪烁体中实现双事件分辨与多位置源重建。

Result: 原型成功在跨 4π 球面度视场的多个位置重建伽马射线源，并可在单一整体式闪烁体中分辨两个同时发生的事件。

Conclusion: SPAD 相机 + 单片闪烁体方案可实现紧凑、便携的康普顿相机，突破分割闪烁体在体积与效率上的限制。

Abstract: A Compton camera measures two events in a detector from individual gamma-rays to reconstruct the radiation source. Conventional scintillator-based Compton cameras consist of two separate scintillator volumes or a single segmented scintillator, resulting in drawbacks regarding detector bulkiness and efficiency. Their scintillator readout techniques struggle to resolve two nearby events in one monolithic scintillator. Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras have recently been proposed for measuring scintillation events in various configurations. SPAD array sensors enable high-resolution photon-counting acquisition at high rates that is easily scalable to millions of pixels. Prior work has explored different optics and measurement arrangements as well as demonstrated measurement of single interaction locations. In this work, we extend these capabilities to demonstrate a practical radiation imaging device in the form of a Compton camera consisting of a SPAD camera and one compact, monolithic scintillator. Our Compton camera prototype successfully reconstructs a gamma-ray source over multiple locations that span a 4$\pi$ steradian field of view. Our approach is able to resolve two simultaneous events in one monolithic scintillator and enables Compton camera devices with compact, monolithic scintillator volumes for enhanced portability.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [624] [Who Plays What: Same-Instrument Music Separation from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29411)
*Abhinaba Roy,Ambuj Mehrish,Sebastiano Vascon,Dorien Herremans*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 利用演奏者身体与手部关键点的运动（速度）作为条件，通过cross-attention引导预训练音源分离器，实现"点击某位乐手即提取其独立音轨"的同乐器逐人分离，并在真实合奏录音上首次完成逐人评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一合奏中多位乐手演奏相同乐器时，外观与音色均无法区分；现有纯音频与音视频（依赖外观）分离器难以区分个体。唯一可区分的线索是各人"如何动、何时动"。

Method: 用户点击视频中某乐手，模型跟踪该目标；用高层视频特征与身体/手部关键点速度构建tokens，经cross-attention注入预训练音乐分离器，得到目标乐手的音频。先前运动方法仅在单人视频合成混音上评测。

Result: 在URMP真实合奏中58名与他人类同乐器的乐手，模型中位SDR达5.3 dB，四个已发布分离器（纯音频与音视频/外观）≤0.3 dB；同乐器二重奏差距更大；在MUSIC基准上亦超越音视频基线。消融显示替换为静帧或视频与音频错位一小段时间增益即消失，证实增益来自运动。

Conclusion: 运动线索是解决同乐器逐人分离的关键，并首次在真实合奏上给出逐人分离的量化评测与有效方法。

Abstract: When two musicians in an ensemble play the same instrument, they sound alike and their instruments look alike. Audio-only separators, and audio-visual separators that rely on appearance, cannot tell them apart. What still differs is how each player moves, and when. We study same-instrument per-player separation: a user clicks one musician in a video and receives that musician's sound alone, even when other players in the video play the same instrument. Our model follows the clicked player and describes them with high level video features and the velocities of body and hand keypoints. A pretrained music separator attends to these tokens through cross-attention. Earlier motion-based separators were scored only on synthetic mixtures of solo videos. We give the first per-player evaluation of same-instrument separation on real ensemble recordings. On 58 players in URMP, each sharing an instrument with at least one other player in the piece, our model reaches a median SDR of 5.3 dB, while four released separators, audio-only and audio-visual, stay at or below 0.3 dB. The gap is wider on same-instrument duets, and our model also beats the audio-visual baselines on their own MUSIC benchmark. Tests show that the gain comes from movement: replacing the video with a still frame removes it, and so does shifting the video by a fraction of a second against the audio.

</details>


### [625] [LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30714)
*Yuxuan Jiang,Zehua Chen,Yusheng Dai,Andong Wang,Weibei Dou,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: LiveAudio converts a bidirectional video-to-audio diffusion model into a streaming real-time generator via progressive causal fine-tuning plus distillation, producing block-by-block audio with 143 ms time-to-first-frame and RTF 0.79 on one A100.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式应用（直播、游戏、交互式世界模型）需连续接收视频并实时配音，而现有V2A模型多为双向、需看完整段视频才能出声，从零训练的流式模型音质与同步性又不足。

Method: 不从头训练，而是把高质量双向模型转为流式生成器：逐块生成音频，每块仅依赖已播放视频；采用渐进式因果微调（progressive causal fine-tuning）使模型适应因果条件，再蒸馏减少每块采样步数，实现低延迟流式扩散。

Result: VGGSound上音质与同步性均优于已有流式模型，同步性甚至超过源双向模型；单张A100上RTF=0.79实现实时，首帧时延143 ms。

Conclusion: 以"双向模型→因果流式模型"的微调+蒸馏路线可同时保留音质并取得实时低延迟，为交互式/世界模型的实时音视频生成提供可行范式。

Abstract: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at this https URL .

</details>

### [626] [Participant-Independent Validation of Smartphone Video and Wearable Inertial Sensing for Coach-Rated Running-Form Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27996)
*Kian Lee,Eric Zhou*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 用侧视手机视频+IMU加速度做跑姿分类，294段记录/20名跑者/4类提示；视频单模态macro F1=0.310（多数类基线0.168），加IMU融合反而降至0.267，且融合效果依赖模型族与验证设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业教练与实验室之外的跑姿（跑步技术）反馈获取成本高，希望用低成本设备（手机+可穿戴IMU）实现自动化的跑姿评估与分类。

Method: 侧视智能手机视频（姿态特征）+ 可穿戴IMU三轴加速度；4项提示（落地位置、腾空、三关节伸展、上体姿态）；100次重复的四人留出划分、录制级别聚合窗口预测；主模型LightGBM（超参沿用量级特异搜索固定），并用Logistic回归、线性SVM、随机森林、XGBoost做稳健性对比；特征级早期融合。

Result: 仅视频LightGBM平均macro F1=0.310，显著高于多数类基线0.168；加入IMU后降至0.267（配对均值差-0.043）。稳健性分析中视频单模态均优于基线；融合效果随模型族而异：线性SVM小幅正增益、Logistic回归近中性、树模型下降。录制级别与留跑者性能差距明显。

Conclusion: 智能手机姿态特征中存在可跨参与者迁移的微弱信号；但IMU融合的"收益"高度依赖验证设计、模型族与目标类别，简单特征级融合不能可靠泛化到未见跑者，需采用跑者留出评估。

Abstract: Automated running-form assessment could make technique feedback more accessible outside professional coaching and laboratory settings. We evaluated a low-cost pipeline combining side-view smartphone video with wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) acceleration for coach-rated running-form classification. The dataset comprised 294 labeled recordings from 20 runners and 1,555 windows across four cues: landing position, suspension, triple extension, and upper-body posture. The primary analysis used 100 repeated four-runner holdout splits, recording-level aggregation of window predictions, and LightGBM models with hyperparameters fixed from prior modality-specific searches. Video-only LightGBM achieved mean macro F1 of 0.310, versus 0.168 for a majority-class baseline. Adding IMU features reduced macro F1 to 0.267, a paired mean difference of -0.043. Robustness analysis with Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM found that video-only models had higher mean performance than the majority baseline, whereas fusion effects depended on model family: Linear SVM showed a small positive effect, Logistic Regression was approximately neutral, and tree-based models showed lower performance with fusion. These results indicate a modest participant-independent signal in smartphone pose features. However, apparent IMU-fusion gains depended strongly on validation design, model family, and target category. The gap between recording-level and participant-independent performance underscores the need for runner-holdout evaluation and suggests that simple feature-level fusion does not reliably generalize to unseen runners.

</details>


### [627] [Social-Qwen: From Individual Nonverbal Cues and Emotion to Multiparty Social Dynamics Understanding with Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28001)
*Tung Nguyen,Jouh Yeong Chew*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: Social-Qwen: 两阶段框架，先分析多人场景中每个参与者的非语言线索与情绪，再用指令微调表示推断群体级参与度，并通过知识蒸馏弥补个体标注缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人交互场景要求机器人从个体级理解上升到群体级社会动态理解；端到端确定性模型缺乏可解释的中间状态建模，而大VLM虽有效但体积与算力开销大、难以实时，且群体交互数据与个体标注稀缺。

Method: 假设显式建模个体状态是准确理解群体状态的关键。Social-Qwen 采用两阶段：第一阶段逐参与者分析非语言线索与情绪，第二阶段以指令微调表示推断群体参与度；针对群体数据缺乏个体级标注，使用知识蒸馏迁移监督信号。

Result: 在 OUC-CGE 数据集上显著优于既有端到端基线，达到群体参与度分析的SOTA；并在跨多种社交活动的自建数据集及群体和谐度等其他社会动态估计任务上表现一致，显示泛化鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 显式个体级状态建模+指令微调为可扩展的机器人社会智能提供了可行路径，具备实时社交智能体应用的潜力。

Abstract: Effective participation in multiparty scenarios requires robots to move beyond individual toward understanding group-level social dynamics, which are inherently complex due to the interplay of nonverbal cues, internal states, and interaction context. Existing approaches often rely on end-to-end deterministic models, while recent state-of-the-art methods such as large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) address this issue to some extent but remain limited by their size and computational cost for real-time applications. Moreover, both approaches are constrained by the scarcity of multiparty interaction data and annotations, which describe how individual nonverbal cues and emotional states contribute to social dynamics which describe collective outcomes such as group engagement. We hypothesize that explicitly modeling individual-level states is essential for accurate group-level understanding. To this end, we present Social-Qwen, a two-stage framework that first analyzes each participant's nonverbal cues and emotions, then infers group-level engagement using instruction-tuned representations. To mitigate the lack of individual annotations in group datasets, we employ knowledge distillation to transfer supervision signals. Experiments on the OUC-CGE dataset show that Social-Qwen significantly outperforms prior end-to-end baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance in group engagement analysis, demonstrating the promise of instruction tuning for scalable social intelligence in robots. We further evaluate robustness by testing generalization to (1) an in-house dataset spanning multiple social activities and (2) estimating other social dynamics such as group harmony. Results suggest consistent performance, highlighting Social-Qwen as a promising approach toward real-time social intelligence for intelligent agents.

</details>


### [628] [Constellations of Colour: Mapping Semantic Neighbourhoods in CLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28004)
*Matt DesLauriers*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 将2500个命名颜色用CLIP文本编码器嵌入并降维到2D图，通过阈值化最小生成树连接成"星座"，可视化CLIP颜色语义中的色相/明度/彩度渐变与语义邻域（植物、虚构、食物）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索视觉-语言模型如何组织颜色语言的文化与知觉维度，为设计师提供可解释、面向创作者的语义导航工具。

Method: 研究型设计（RtD）：2500个颜色名→CLIP文本嵌入→2D投影→阈值化最小生成树形成不连通的"星座"聚类；人工解读可视化结果。

Result: 映射图呈现沿色相、明度、彩度等常规轴的渐变，并出现植物（风信子、矢车菊）、虚构引用（"Robin Hood green"）、食物（奶油糖果、太妃糖）等语义邻域。

Conclusion: CLIP颜色语义可被可视化解释，可作为按语义关联构建配色的设计工具，指向基于基础模型的艺术家友好颜色工具。

Abstract: How do vision-language models organise the cultural and perceptual dimensions of colour language? This pictorial presents a research-through-design visualisation of colour semantics in CLIP, a pretrained vision-language model. A dataset of 2,500 named colours is embedded with CLIP's text encoder, projected to a 2D map, and connected via a thresholded minimum spanning tree to create disjoint "constellations" of related colour terms. The resulting maps offer a model for navigating the semantic and perceptual relationships between colour terms. The visualisations reveal gradients along familiar axes (hue, lightness, chroma), as well as semantic neighbourhoods, including botanical language (hyacinth, cornflower, tulip), fictional references ("Robin Hood green", "warlock purple"), and food (butterscotch, toast, toffee). These visualisations give designers and creatives a map for exploring colour linguistically and building palettes by semantic association, pointing towards interpretable, artist-facing colour tools derived from foundation models.

</details>


### [629] [Psychological State Monitoring Methods Based on Multimodal Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28008)
*Ran Meng*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出分层多模态情感识别框架，同步采集面部图像、语音与可穿戴生理信号，采用早/晚融合混合架构，在真实压力响应数据集上达到约91%准确率与0.88 F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理状态监测需要更高准确率与可靠性，单一模态（如人脸）性能受限，需在时空维度整合面部、语音与生理信号以更完整地刻画情绪。

Method: 三级分层框架：(1) 摄像头、麦克风、可穿戴传感器同步采样；(2) 各模态独立预处理与特征提取；(3) 高端融合架构同时结合early fusion与late fusion，稳健整合跨模态信息；辅以消融实验定位关键模块。

Result: 真实压力响应数据集上，融合系统整体准确率约91%、平均F1约0.88，优于最佳单模态（人脸88%）；时序分析显示不同群体的压力跟踪响应存在异质性；精度/召回/准确率/F1的量化评估显示方法较为均衡。

Conclusion: 该工作为精确情绪推断提供了工程可行、数据驱动的方案，并为智能心理健康评估与以人为中心的系统设计提供方法学支撑。

Abstract: The computer-Based Multimodal Emotion Recognition System needs to increase the accuracy and reliability of psychological state monitoring. A hierarchical framework was proposed in this paper to integrate facial images, speech signals and other physiological indicators of emotion in time and space for more complete analysis of human emotions. Synchronously sample data streams from webcams, microphones and wearable sensors, and then preprocess and extract features specific to each type of data. A high-end fusion architecture is adopted to combine early- and late-fusion methods and thus robustly integrate cross-modal information. Experimental validation in a real-world stress-response dataset showed good performance. The overall recognition accuracy and mean F1-score of the fused multimodal system are both about 91% and 0.88, respectively, which are superior to the best unimodal approach (face, 88% accuracy and F1-score 0.88). Temporal analysis shows that the groups for stress tracking are not uniformly adapted and resilient, and ablation experiments have determined which modules contribute significantly to the stability of the system. According to all kinds of quantitative evaluations of precision, recall, accuracy and F1 scores, the proposed method shows good balance and is practical and generally applicable. The research has provided an engineering-feasible, data-driven solution for precise emotion inference and offered methodological support for intelligent mental health assessment and human-centered system design.

</details>


### [630] [Beyond Code and Pixels: Co-Generating Editable and Visually Rich Presentations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28010)
*Wenrui Zhou,Jiashun Liu,Sujie Hu,Bang Liu,Ling Pan*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: SlidesWeaver：混合式多智能体系统，通过共享的幻灯片组/单页状态协调语言与视觉智能体，结合分阶段多模态承诺、扩散式版面规划与两种生成调度，生成可编辑且视觉丰富的 PPTX。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化生成 PPTX 可编辑但设计刻板；图像生成视觉丰富但内容被扁平化为难以编辑的像素。混合方案需协调内容、版面与外观之间的相互依赖决策。

Method: 混合多智能体系统：语言与视觉智能体通过共享的 deck 级与 slide 级状态协同；采用分阶段多模态承诺、基于扩散的构图规划（composition planning），并针对“构图自由度 vs 文本准确保留”两种优先级设计两套生成调度；保留原生文本与几何结构以保证可编辑性。

Result: 在 24 种系统-模型配置、共 1,728 次生成中，所有评估维度上的整体质量均稳定领先，同时保持结构可控性、可编辑性与实用生成效率。

Conclusion: 混合式多智能体设计可在保持原生可编辑性的前提下兼顾视觉丰富度，为文档/演示生成提供了可复用的“状态共享+多模态承诺+调度切换”范式。

Abstract: Generating PPTX presentations is a structured task that requires semantic planning, visual composition, precise layout, and editability, motivating collaboration among specialized agents. However, programmatic methods offer editability but often produce rigid designs, while image-based methods provide visual richness but flatten content into difficult-to-edit pixels. A hybrid system can combine these strengths, but must coordinate interdependent decisions across content, layout, and appearance. To address this challenge, we propose SlidesWeaver, a hybrid multi-agent system that coordinates language and vision agents through shared deck- and slide-level states. Specifically, it uses staged multimodal commitment, diffusion-based composition planning, and two generation schedules for different priorities between composition freedom and accurate text preservation, while preserving native text and geometry. Across 1,728 generations spanning 24 system-model configurations, SlidesWeaver achieves consistently superior overall quality across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining structural control, editability, and practical generation efficiency.

</details>
